items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," if we sing [the service], we sing 3 stichera of the Theotokos
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p4 === (Ли́стъ а҃ ѻ҆б.) всесвѣ́тлаѧ. * Ра́дꙋйсѧ клѧ́твы ѹ҆бїе́нїе, * прароди́тельныѧ на́шеѧ Ѻ҆трокови́це, * бл҃ги́хъ хода́таица сꙋ́щи.
items.english_text: When the ice of ignorance held fast all creation through the assaults of the enemy, and the multitude of idols was served, then, O glorious martyrs, with a fervent heart and with the warmth of divine faith ye brought this to an end, lovingly shedding your blood for Him Who openly poured out His blood upon the Cross.

provenance.verbatim_source: When the ice of ignorance held fast all creation through the assaults of the enemy, and the multitude of idols was served, then, O glorious martyrs, with a fervent heart and with the warmth of divine faith ye brought this to an end, lovingly shedding your blood for Him Who openly poured out His blood upon the Cross.

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," if we sing [the service], we sing 3 stichera of the Theotokos
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ скорбѧ́щихъ ра́досте, * и҆ ѡ҆би́димыхъ предста́тельнице, * и҆ ѹ҆бо́гихъ пита́тельнице, * стра́нныхъ же ѹ҆тѣше́нїе, * и҆ же́зле слѣпы́хъ, * немощны́хъ посѣще́нїе, * трꙋжда́ющихсѧ покро́ве и҆ застꙋ́пнице, * и҆ си́рыхъ помо́щнице, * мт҃и бг҃а вы́шнѧгѡ, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречⷭ҇таѧ: * потщи́сѧ, мо́лимсѧ, * спасти́сѧ рабѡ́мъ твои̑мъ.
items.english_text: When by divine beckoning ye separated yourselves for supernatural struggles, having cast off the corruptible body, then, being strengthened by the power of the Almighty, ye were not terrified of fire, nor of the cutting sword. Therefore, having bowed your necks unto God, O blessed ones, ye received your end with joy.

provenance.verbatim_source: When by divine beckoning ye separated yourselves for supernatural struggles, having cast off the corruptible body, then, being strengthened by the power of the Almighty, ye were not terrified of fire, nor of the cutting sword. Therefore, having bowed your necks unto God, O blessed ones, ye received your end with joy.

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," if we sing [the service], we sing 3 stichera of the Theotokos
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Покро́въ и҆ застꙋпле́нїе, на́мъ хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡмъ ты̀ є҆сѝ, * и҆ прибѣ́жище держа́вно мт҃и бг҃а вы́шнѧгѡ. * Но и҆ ны́нѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ при́снѡ, * бо́дренною твое́ю моли́твою, * не преста́й молѧ̀ * спастѝ рабы̑ твоѧ̑ ѿ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїй всѣ́хъ. * Ꙗ҆́кѡ тѧ̀ съ бг҃омъ и҆́мамы застꙋпле́нїе всѝ хрⷭ҇тїа́не * и҆ прибѣ́жище.
items.english_text: John the valiant sufferer, Valerian, and Chariton, and Charita with them, and divine Justin, Euelpistus, and glorious Hierax, having dyed their garment from their divine blood, and being clothed together, stand before the King of all in the heavens, before Christ the King with the Angels.

provenance.verbatim_source: John the valiant sufferer, Valerian, and Chariton, and Charita with them, and divine Justin, Euelpistus, and glorious Hierax, having dyed their garment from their divine blood, and being clothed together, stand before the King of all in the heavens, before Christ the King with the Angels.

items.section: Other stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Дре́вꙋ крⷭ҇тномꙋ тѧ̀ Їи҃се пригвожде́на, * зрѧ́щи неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ, * пла́чꙋщи глаго́лаше: * ча́до сла́дкое, * почто̀ ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ менѐ ро́ждшꙋю тѧ̀ є҆ди́нꙋ, * свѣ́те непристꙋ́пный пребезнача́льнагѡ ѻ҆ц҃а̀? * Потщи́сѧ и҆ просла́висѧ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ да сла́вꙋ полꙋ́чатъ бж҃твеннꙋю, * и҆́же бж҃твенныѧ стⷭ҇ти твоѧ̑ сла́вѧщїи.
items.english_text: Rejoice, star radiant as the sun; rejoice, all-immaculate cause of all good things! Rejoice, thou who didst contain the uncontainable God, who didst sprout forth the ear of immortality; rejoice, divine palanquin and all-radiant portal!

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, star radiant as the sun; rejoice, all-immaculate cause of all good things! Rejoice, thou who didst contain the uncontainable God, who didst sprout forth the ear of immortality; rejoice, divine palanquin and all-radiant portal!

items.section: Other stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, гла́съ, в҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. Їрмо́съ: Грѧди́те лю́дїе, пои́мъ пѣ́снь Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ бг҃ꙋ, * раздѣ́льшемꙋ мо́ре, * и҆ наста́вльшемꙋ лю́ди, * ꙗ҆̀же и҆зведѐ и҆зъ рабо́ты є҆гѵ́петскїѧ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: All-radiant portal! Rejoice, slaying of the ancestral curse, O Maiden, who art the mediatress of good things!

provenance.verbatim_source: All-radiant portal! Rejoice, slaying of the ancestral curse, O Maiden, who art the mediatress of good things!

items.section: Other stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченическими ѹ҆кра́шени свѣ́тлостми, * чистому̀ предстоитѐ мꙋ́ченицы прⷭ҇то́лꙋ влⷣки всѣ́хъ, * на́шихъ согрѣше́нїй разрѣше́нїе подаю́ще.
items.english_text: O Joy of all that sorrow, and protectress of the wronged, and nourisher of the poor, consolation of travelers, and staff of the blind, visitation of the sick, shelter and patroness of them that labor, and helper of orphans, Mother of God the Most High: thou art all-pure; hasten, we pray thee, that thy servants may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Joy of all that sorrow, and protectress of the wronged, and nourisher of the poor, consolation of travelers, and staff of the blind, visitation of the sick, shelter and patroness of them that labor, and helper of orphans, Mother of God the Most High: thou art all-pure; hasten, we pray thee, that thy servants may be saved.

items.section: Other stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Блг҃очести́вїи и҆́стины побо́рницы, * пред̾ мꙋчи́тельскимъ сꙋди́щемъ подви́гшесѧ є҆диномь́сленнѡ, * низложи́ша пре́лесть дїа́волю
items.english_text: A protection and defense art thou unto us Christians, and a mighty refuge, O Mother of God the Most High. But now as always, through thy vigilant intercession, cease not to pray that thy servants may be saved from all tribulations; for next to God, all we Christians have thee as defense and refuge.

provenance.verbatim_source: A protection and defense art thou unto us Christians, and a mighty refuge, O Mother of God the Most High. But now as always, through thy vigilant intercession, cease not to pray that thy servants may be saved from all tribulations; for next to God, all we Christians have thee as defense and refuge.

items.section: Other stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ра́нами и҆ ꙗ҆́звами и҆ скорбмѝ, * бл҃гозва́ннїи и҆скꙋпи́ша великомч҃нцы Хрⷭ҇то́во црⷭ҇тво, * въ не́мже вѣнцено́сцы ны́нѣ живꙋ́тъ.
items.english_text: No other mighty refuge, nor tower of strength, nor unassailable wall have we truly gained save thee, O all-pure one. Unto thee do we flee, and unto thee do we cry aloud: O Lady, help, lest we perish! Show forth thy grace upon us, and the glory of thy strength, and the majesty of thy tender mercy.

provenance.verbatim_source: No other mighty refuge, nor tower of strength, nor unassailable wall have we truly gained save thee, O all-pure one. Unto thee do we flee, and unto thee do we cry aloud: O Lady, help, lest we perish! Show forth thy grace upon us, and the glory of thy strength, and the majesty of thy tender mercy.

items.section: Other stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: О҆чꙋжде́на твои́хъ рꙋ́къ созда́нїе, * бг҃а ми́лости бога́тыи, * во ѹ҆тро́бꙋ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ неискꙋсомꙋ́жныѧ дѣ́вы, * и҆ сїю̀ предста́тельницꙋ на́мъ показа́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee nailed unto the tree of the Cross, O Jesus, she that knew not wedlock weeping said: O sweet Child, why hast Thou left me alone who bare Thee, O inaccessible Light of the unoriginate Father? Hasten and be glorified, that they who glorify Thy divine passions may receive divine glory!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
Beholding Thee nailed unto the tree of the Cross, O Jesus, she that knew not wedlock weeping said: O sweet Child, why hast Thou left me alone who bare Thee, O inaccessible Light of the unoriginate Father? Hasten and be glorified, that they who glorify Thy divine passions may receive divine glory!

items.section: Other stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: О҆утвержде́нїе Хрⷭ҇та̀ въ се́рдцы твое́мъ носѧ̀, * мꙋ́жески сопроти́вилсѧ є҆сѝ Їꙋсті́не и҆стѧза́ющымъ, * беззако́нновати пребеззако́ннѡ тебѣ̀ велѧ́щымъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings received incorruptible crowns from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength, they cast down the tyrants and shattered the powerless insolence of demons: through their supplications save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion, Tone 4:*
Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings received incorruptible crowns from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength, they cast down the tyrants and shattered the powerless insolence of demons: through their supplications save our souls!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тѣ́ло ра́намъ веледꙋ́шнїи преда́вше, * ра́довахꙋсѧ прозрѧ́ще вѣ́чное наслажде́нїе, * и҆ бꙋ́дꙋщꙋю сла́вꙋ и҆ свѣ́тлость.
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* *Come, O ye peoples, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the sea and guided the people whom He brought out of Egyptian bondage, for He hath been glorified.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1. Heirmos:*
*Come, O ye peoples, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the sea and guided the people whom He brought out of Egyptian bondage, for He hath been glorified.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: О҆́блаки дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ разорѝ, * со́лнце сла́вы легкїй ѻ҆́блаче, * и҆ ѹ҆́мъ мо́й свѣ́томъ наста́ви, * почерне́нїемъ ѕло́бы ѡ҆мраче́нный.
items.english_text: Adorned with the splendors of martyrdom, O martyrs, ye stand before the pure throne of the Master of all, granting the remission of our sins.

provenance.verbatim_source: Adorned with the splendors of martyrdom, O martyrs, ye stand before the pure throne of the Master of all, granting the remission of our sins.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, є҃. Подо́бенъ: Собезнача́лное сло́во: Їꙋсті́нъ, и҆ Харі́тѡнъ, Пеѡ́нъ, * Е҆ѵелпі́стъ, Харі́та, Їера́ѯъ, и҆ Валерїа́нъ: * свѣти́лницы свѣ́тлїи, * ѡ҆зарѧ́ющїи концы̀ земны̑ѧ, * лꙋчмѝ подвигѡ́въ свои́хъ, * велегла́снѡ да восхва́лѧтсѧ вѣ́рою, * Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ молѧ́щїисѧ, спасти́сѧ на́мъ.
items.english_text: The pious champions of truth, having stepped forward with one mind before the tribunal of the tyrants, cast down the deception of the devil

provenance.verbatim_source: The pious champions of truth, having stepped forward with one mind before the tribunal of the tyrants, cast down the deception of the devil

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Їрмо́съ: О҆услы́шахъ гдⷭ҇и слꙋ́хъ твоегѡ̀ смотре́нїѧ, * и҆ просла́вихъ тѧ̀ є҆ди́не чл҃вѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: By wounds, and stripes, and tribulations, the divinely called great-martyrs purchased the kingdom of Christ, wherein they now dwell crowned.

provenance.verbatim_source: By wounds, and stripes, and tribulations, the divinely called great-martyrs purchased the kingdom of Christ, wherein they now dwell crowned.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Їꙋсті́на, и҆ Харі́тѡна, * и҆ Харі́ты, и҆ Пеѡ́на страда́нїемъ, * а҆́ггл҃стїи чи́нове ѹ҆диви́шасѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having seen the creation of Thy hands alienated, O Thou Who art rich in God's mercy, Thou didst take up Thy dwelling in the womb of a Virgin who knew not man, and hast shown her unto us as a protectress.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having seen the creation of Thy hands alienated, O Thou Who art rich in God's mercy, Thou didst take up Thy dwelling in the womb of a Virgin who knew not man, and hast shown her unto us as a protectress.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p6 === (Ли́стъ в҃ ѻ҆б.) Сокрꙋша́єма тѣлеса̀ ра́нами, * бж҃твенное и҆схода́та́йствоваша дꙋша́мъ блаже́нство.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *Establish us in Thee, O Lord, Who by the Tree didst put sin to death; and plant Thy fear in the hearts of us who sing praise unto Thee.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
*Establish us in Thee, O Lord, Who by the Tree didst put sin to death; and plant Thy fear in the hearts of us who sing praise unto Thee.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже мы́сленное ѹ҆́глїе, * бж҃твеннымъ ѻ҆гне́мъ попали́сте ле́сть, * и҆ свѣти́ла мі́ра мч҃нцы ꙗ҆ви́стесѧ.
items.english_text: Bearing the foundation of Christ in thy heart, O Justin, thou didst manfully oppose those who interrogated thee, who most unlawfully commanded thee to break the law.

provenance.verbatim_source: Bearing the foundation of Christ in thy heart, O Justin, thou didst manfully oppose those who interrogated thee, who most unlawfully commanded thee to break the law.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ѵелпі́ста, Їера́ѯа, * непрекло́нныхъ мч҃нкъ мꙋ́жествꙋ, * тмы̀ кнѧ́зи ѹ҆боѧ́шасѧ.
items.english_text: A divinely bestowed choir, a God-chosen army of holy martyrs, a holy assembly gathered today, hath conquered the bodiless foes together with the body.

provenance.verbatim_source: A divinely bestowed choir, a God-chosen army of holy martyrs, a holy assembly gathered today, hath conquered the bodiless foes together with the body.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆́же ѻ҆́гнь бж҃тва̀, * во ѹ҆тро́бѣ дѣ́во прїе́мшаѧ, * ѻ҆гнѧ̀ мѧ̀ и҆зба́ви и҆ мꙋ́ки.
items.english_text: Having given over their bodies unto stripes, the magnanimous ones rejoiced, foreseeing eternal enjoyment and future glory and brightness.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having given over their bodies unto stripes, the magnanimous ones rejoiced, foreseeing eternal enjoyment and future glory and brightness.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Їрмо́съ: Свѣ́та пода́телю, и҆ вѣкѡ́въ тво́рче гдⷭ҇и, * во свѣ́тѣ твои́хъ повелѣ́нїй наста́ви на́съ: * ра́звѣ бо тебѐ и҆но́гѡ бг҃а не зна́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Dispel the clouds of my soul, O light cloud of the Sun of glory, and with light guide my mind, which is darkened by the blackness of malice.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Dispel the clouds of my soul, O light cloud of the Sun of glory, and with light guide my mind, which is darkened by the blackness of malice.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋ́ха бж҃твеннагѡ и҆спо́лнивсѧ, * лꙋка́вствїѧ лю́тыѧ дꙋ́хи, * тече́нїи крове́й твои́хъ мꙋ́нче Їꙋсті́не, * ѹ҆дави́лъ є҆сѝ блаже́нне, пострада́въ крѣ́пкѡ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 5, Podoben: "The Word co-unoriginate" (Собезнача́лное сло́во):* Justin, and Chariton, Peon, Euelpistus, Charita, Hierax, and Valerian: radiant luminaries who illumine the ends of the earth with the rays of their struggles, let them be praised with a loud voice in faith, as they pray unto Christ that we may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 5, Podoben: "The Word co-unoriginate" (Собезнача́лное сло́во):*
Justin, and Chariton, Peon, Euelpistus, Charita, Hierax, and Valerian: radiant luminaries who illumine the ends of the earth with the rays of their struggles, let them be praised with a loud voice in faith, as they pray unto Christ that we may be saved.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Благода́тивъ дꙋ́шꙋ и҆сповѣ́данїи сщ҃енными, * притꙋпи́лъ є҆сѝ ве́тхагѡ врага̀ ѕло́бꙋ, * Харі́тѡне страда́льче, бж҃твенныхъ страстоте́рпецъ, * честно́е ѹ҆добре́нїе.
items.english_text: Fervent protectress and invincible, certain and unashamed hope, wall, protection, and haven of them that flee unto thee, O pure Ever-Virgin: with the Angels pray thou unto thy Son and God to grant peace unto the world, and salvation, and great mercy.

provenance.verbatim_source: Fervent protectress and invincible, certain and unashamed hope, wall, protection, and haven of them that flee unto thee, O pure Ever-Virgin: with the Angels pray thou unto thy Son and God to grant peace unto the world, and salvation, and great mercy.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́же сп҃са Хрⷭ҇та̀, * ѹ҆подо́блшаѧсѧ земны̑мъ ро́ждшаѧ, * премно́жествомъ бога́тства милосе́рдїѧ: * тогѡ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃а чи́стаѧ молѝ, * спастѝ рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee hanging willingly upon the Cross between thieves, O Christ, Thy Mother, maternally torn in her inward parts, said: O sinless Son, how art Thou unjustly nailed unto the Cross like an evildoer, wishing as the Tender-hearted One to bring the human race to life?

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
Beholding Thee hanging willingly upon the Cross between thieves, O Christ, Thy Mother, maternally torn in her inward parts, said: O sinless Son, how art Thou unjustly nailed unto the Cross like an evildoer, wishing as the Tender-hearted One to bring the human race to life?

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Їрмо́съ: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, * неизслѣ́днꙋю млⷭ҇рдїѧ твое́гѡ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ, * ѿ тлѝ бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *I have heard, O Lord, the report of Thy dispensation, and I have glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*I have heard, O Lord, the report of Thy dispensation, and I have glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Їꙋсті́на, и҆ Харі́тѡна, Пеѡ́на, * и҆ Валерїа́на, Харі́ты же, и҆ Їера́ѯа, и҆ Е҆ѵелпі́ста, * всѝ пресвѣ́тлꙋю па́мѧть просла́вимъ.
items.english_text: At the suffering of Justin, and Chariton, and Charita, and Peon, the angelic ranks were amazed.

provenance.verbatim_source: At the suffering of Justin, and Chariton, and Charita, and Peon, the angelic ranks were amazed.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже небе́сныѧ ѕвѣ́зды сїѧ́юще, * цр҃кви чⷭ҇тны́мъ ѹ҆твержде́нїемъ, * вселе́ннꙋю всю̀, свѣтоли́нїемъ страда́нїѧ просвѣща́ете.
items.english_text: Their bodies being shattered by wounds mediated divine blessedness for their souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: Their bodies being shattered by wounds mediated divine blessedness for their souls.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Безмѣ́рнагѡ ѡ҆камене́нїѧ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀, * ѡ҆держи́маго мно́гими согрѣше́нїи, * бг҃ороди́тельнице влчⷣце, * и҆ гее́нскомꙋ ѻ҆гню̀ подлежа́щаго.
items.english_text: Like spiritual coals ye burned up deceit with divine fire, and were revealed, O martyrs, as luminaries of the world.

provenance.verbatim_source: Like spiritual coals ye burned up deceit with divine fire, and were revealed, O martyrs, as luminaries of the world.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, в҃. Премꙋ́дростїю бж҃твенныхъ твои́хъ слове́съ Їꙋсті́не, * це́рковь бж҃їѧ всѧ̀ ѹ҆краси́вшисѧ, * житїя̀ твоегѡ̀ свѣ́тлостїю мі́ръ ѡ҆свѣща́етъ: * и҆злїя́нїѧ же ра́ди кро́ве вѣне́цъ прїе́мъ, * и҆ со а҆́гг҃лы предстоѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀: * молѝ непреста́ннѡ w всѣ́хъ
items.english_text: At the courage of Euelpistus and Hierax, unbending martyrs, the princes of darkness were struck with fear.

provenance.verbatim_source: At the courage of Euelpistus and Hierax, unbending martyrs, the princes of darkness were struck with fear.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p7 === (Ли́стъ г҃) всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Virgin who in thy womb didst receive the fire of the Godhead, deliver me from fire and torment!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O Virgin who in thy womb didst receive the fire of the Godhead, deliver me from fire and torment!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Їрмо́съ: Тѣ́лꙋ злато́мꙋ премꙋ́дрыѧ дѣ́ти не послꙋжи́ша, * и҆ въ пла́мень са́ми поидо́ша, * и҆ бо́ги и҆́хъ ѡ҆берга́ша, * средѝ пла́мене возопи́ша, * и҆ ѡ҆росѝ я҆̀ а҆́гг҃лъ, * ѹ҆слы́шасѧ ѹ҆жѐ ѹ҆́стъ ва́шихъ моли́тва.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *O Giver of light and Creator of the ages, O Lord, guide us in the light of Thy commandments; for beside Thee we know no other God.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*O Giver of light and Creator of the ages, O Lord, guide us in the light of Thy commandments; for beside Thee we know no other God.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пре́лести глꙋбинꙋ̀ крове́й рѣко́ю и҆зсꙋши́сте, * то́ки чꙋде́съ и҆сточи́сте, * ѹ҆гаша́юще ѹ҆́глїе мꙋ́ченицы лю́тыхъ страсте́й, * вопїю́щымъ всегда̀: * бл҃гослове́нъ бг҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: Filled with the Divine Spirit, O blessed martyr Justin, having suffered valiantly, thou didst drown the fierce spirits of malice in the streams of thy blood.

provenance.verbatim_source: Filled with the Divine Spirit, O blessed martyr Justin, having suffered valiantly, thou didst drown the fierce spirits of malice in the streams of thy blood.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃ества ѻ҆гне́мъ любвѐ мꙋ́дрїи, * ве́щь ѕло́бы доблемꙋ́дреннѡ попали́сте, * и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆гнезра́чнїи возсїя́вше, * всѣ́хъ вопїю́щихъ сердца̀ бл҃гоче́стнѡ просвѣти́сте: * бл҃гослове́нъ бг҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: She who is named after grace was filled with divine grace; and forgetting woman's natural weakness, she trampled down the foe lawfully and received glory.[^6]

provenance.verbatim_source: She who is named after grace was filled with divine grace; and forgetting woman's natural weakness, she trampled down the foe lawfully and received glory.[^6]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́дростїю бж҃їею Їꙋсті́нъ мꙋ́дрый ѹ҆кра́шенъ, * є҆́ллинское ѡ҆бꙋѝ мꙋдрова́нїе бл҃года́тїю, * ѹ҆вѣ́ривъ покланѧ́тисѧ трⷪ҇цѣ, * и҆ правосла́внѡ зва́ти: * бл҃гослове́нъ бг҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: Having endowed thy soul with grace through sacred confessions, thou didst blunt the malice of the ancient enemy, O sufferer Chariton, precious ornament of divine passion-bearers.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having endowed thy soul with grace through sacred confessions, thou didst blunt the malice of the ancient enemy, O sufferer Chariton, precious ornament of divine passion-bearers.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Дѣ́во чⷭ҇таѧ, неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ чⷭ҇таѧ бл҃гослове́ннаѧ, * низпада́ющихъ и҆справле́нїе, * согрѣша́ющихъ проще́нїе, * спасѝ мѧ̀ блꙋ́днаго, * спасѝ сн҃ꙋ твое́мꙋ зовꙋ́ща: * бл҃гослове́нъ бг҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O pure one, who didst bear Christ the Savior, Who likened Himself unto earthly men through the surpassing multitude of the riches of mercy: pray unto Him as God to save thy servants.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O pure one, who didst bear Christ the Savior, Who likened Himself unto earthly men through the surpassing multitude of the riches of mercy: pray unto Him as God to save thy servants.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҆. Їрмо́съ: Въ пе́щь ѻ҆́гненнꙋю ко ѻ҆трокѡ́мъ є҆вре́йскимъ снизше́дшаго, * и҆ пла́мень въ ро́сꙋ прело́жшаго бг҃а, * по́йте дѣла̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ гдⷭ҇а, * и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *Wallowing in the abyss of sins, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy tender mercy: bring me up from corruption, O God!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*Wallowing in the abyss of sins, I call upon the unfathomable abyss of Thy tender mercy: bring me up from corruption, O God!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже въ пещѝ ѻ҆́гненнѣй, * въ мꙋ́кахъ терпѣли́внѡ и҆скꙋси́вшесѧ, * страстоте́рпцы гдⷭ҇ни, * па́че зла́та вои́стиннꙋ бж҃ественнѡ, вопїю́ще, ѡ҆блиста́сте, * Хрⷭ҇та̀ превозно́симъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Let us all glorify the most radiant memory of Justin, and Chariton, Peon, and Valerian, and Charita, and Hierax, and Euelpistus!

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us all glorify the most radiant memory of Justin, and Chariton, Peon, and Valerian, and Charita, and Hierax, and Euelpistus!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Со Їꙋсті́номъ мꙋ́дрымъ да воспое́тсѧ Харі́та, * и҆ Харі́тѡнъ, и҆ Пеѡ́нъ, * и҆ Їера́ѯъ вели́кїй, съ Валерїа́номъ, * страда́нїемъ ле́сть ѿгна́вшїи, * и҆ а҆́ггл҃скимъ ли́кѡмъ совокꙋ́пльшїисѧ.
items.english_text: Without tempest, through divine governance, ye passed through the deep sea of torments, O martyrs, and reached the tranquil haven of the Kingdom of Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: Without tempest, through divine governance, ye passed through the deep sea of torments, O martyrs, and reached the tranquil haven of the Kingdom of Christ.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Къ вѣ́чнѣй жи́зни ведо́ми мꙋ́дрїи, * доблемꙋ́дреннѡ вы̑и мечꙋ̀, * є҆динома́слїемъ дꙋшѝ, * всѝ преклони́сте мꙋ́ченицы, * ꙗ҆́кѡ же́ртвы бг҃ꙋ прине́сшесѧ.
items.english_text: Shining like the stars of heaven, by the precious confirmation of the Church, ye enlighten the whole universe with the radiance of your suffering.

provenance.verbatim_source: Shining like the stars of heaven, by the precious confirmation of the Church, ye enlighten the whole universe with the radiance of your suffering.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Живота̀ сꙋ́щи и҆сто́чникъ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ во́дꙋ жи́зни поро́ждши, * дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ и҆стлѣ́вшꙋю, * грѣхо́внымъ пла́менемъ, * дѣ́во бцⷣе напо́й, * да тѧ̀ сла́влю во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Deliver me from immeasurable hard-heartedness, me who am held fast by many sins, O Lady Mother of God, and who am liable unto Gehenna's fire!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Deliver me from immeasurable hard-heartedness, me who am held fast by many sins, O Lady Mother of God, and who am liable unto Gehenna's fire!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Їрмо́съ: Бг҃а бг҃а сло́ва, неизрече́нною мꙋ́дростїю, * прише́дшаго ѡ҆бнови́ти А҆да́ма, * ꙗ҆́дїю въ тлѣ́нїе па́дшаго лю́тѣ: * ѿ ст҃ы́ѧ
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2:* With the wisdom of thy divine words, O Justin, the whole Church of God, having adorned herself, enlightens the world with the brightness of thy life; and having received a crown for the outpouring of thy blood, standing with the Angels before Christ: pray unceasingly for all

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 2:*
With the wisdom of thy divine words, O Justin, the whole Church of God, having adorned herself, enlightens the world with the brightness of thy life; and having received a crown for the outpouring of thy blood, standing with the Angels before Christ: pray unceasingly for all

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Їꙋсті́новѣ мꙋ́дрости, * и҆ Харі́ты мꙋ́жествꙋ, * и҆ Харі́тѡновѣ де́рзости вои́стиннꙋ, * Пеѡ́ны же и҆ Їера́ѯа до́блимъ подвигѡ́мъ, * и҆ Валерїа́на къ лю́тымъ многомꙋ терпѣ́нїю, * и҆ а҆́ггл҃и чꙋди́шасѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *The wise Children did not serve the golden image, but entered into the flame themselves, and derided their gods; amid the flame they cried aloud, and an Angel bedewed them: The prayer of your lips hath already been heard.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*The wise Children did not serve the golden image, but entered into the flame themselves, and derided their gods; amid the flame they cried aloud, and an Angel bedewed them: The prayer of your lips hath already been heard.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже на колесни́цꙋ бж҃е́ственнꙋю всѣ́дше сла́внїи, * кро́вїю ва́шею къ не́й ра́достнѡ востеко́сте, * и҆ рꙋко́ю живоно́сною, * побѣ́дныѧ прїя́сте мꙋ́дрїи вѣнцы̀, * непреста́ннѡ w на́съ молѧ́щесѧ.
items.english_text: With the river of your blood ye dried up the depth of deceit, and poured forth streams of miracles, O martyrs, quenching the coals of fierce passions for them that ever cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: With the river of your blood ye dried up the depth of deceit, and poured forth streams of miracles, O martyrs, quenching the coals of fierce passions for them that ever cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Неискꙋсомꙋ́жнѡ, сло́во па́че сло́ва ро́ждшаѧ, * дѣ́во неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ чⷭ҇таѧ, * напа́стей и҆змѝ на́съ, * и҆ всѧ́кихъ бѣ́дъ, * и҆ вре́да дꙋшетлѣ́нна и҆ страсте́й, * и҆ вѣчнꙋ́ющагѡ пла́мене, и҆ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїѧ.
items.english_text: With the fire of divine love, O wise ones, ye valiantly burned up the matter of malice; and having shone forth like fire, ye piously enlightened the hearts of all who cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: With the fire of divine love, O wise ones, ye valiantly burned up the matter of malice; and having shone forth like fire, ye piously enlightened the hearts of all who cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: [Дереворитна заставка]
items.english_text: Adorned with divine wisdom, wise Justin made foolish the pagan wisdom by grace, having confirmed [the faithful] to worship the Trinity and to cry aloud in an Orthodox manner: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: Adorned with divine wisdom, wise Justin made foolish the pagan wisdom by grace, having confirmed [the faithful] to worship the Trinity and to cry aloud in an Orthodox manner: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́жде, въ в҃ де́нь. И҆́же во сты́хъ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ на́шегѡ Ніки́фора патрїа́рха кѡнстанти́нограда, и҆сповѣ́дника. Стїхи̑ры, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O pure Virgin, who knewest not wedlock, pure and blessed one, restoration of the fallen, forgiveness of sinners: save me, the prodigal, save me as I cry aloud unto thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O pure Virgin, who knewest not wedlock, pure and blessed one, restoration of the fallen, forgiveness of sinners: save me, the prodigal, save me as I cry aloud unto thy Son: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́стины водрꙋже́нїе, * и҆ вѣ́ры ѹ҆твержде́нїе, * и҆ догма́тѡвъ предложи́телѧ тѧ̀ зна́емъ, * бл҃гоче́стїѧ согла́сника, * чистоты̀ селе́нїе, * и҆ прїя́телище и҆збра́нное, * бл҃гово́нїе дꙋ́ха, * и҆ превели́кое сокро́вище ѹ҆че́нїй, * и҆ ѡ҆снова́нїе хрⷭ҇товы це́ркве, * сбаще́нноявле́нне бг҃одꙋхнове́нне. * Восхваля́емъ тѧ̀, * и҆ ѹ҆чи́телей печа́ть, * и҆ бж҃твенное и҆зwбраже́нїе, * Хрⷭ҇това тайнноводи́телѧ, * ста́ю бл҃же́нне, * и҆ бг҃ото́чнꙋю рѣкꙋ̀ разꙋмѣ́нїй, * беззако́нникѡвъ и҆ хꙋ́лникѡвъ мы́сли потоплѧ́юща премꙋ́дре.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *Praise ye Him as Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages: God Who descended into the fiery furnace unto the Hebrew Children, and turned the flame into dew.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*Praise ye Him as Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages: God Who descended into the fiery furnace unto the Hebrew Children, and turned the flame into dew.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: А҆пѡ́лѡвъ прее́мника, * страда́льцевъ є҆динонра́вна, * по́стникѡвъ є҆диноревни́телѧ, * премꙋ́дрости тала́нтъ, * ѹ҆мно́живъ пребога́те, * ра́дости сподо́билсѧ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇а твоегѡ̀, * и҆спещре́нъ бл҃года́тїю * бж҃е́ственнагѡ сїя́нїѧ, * и҆ за́рею мы́сленнѡ
items.english_text: Having been patiently tried in torments as in a fiery furnace, O passion-bearers of the Lord, ye truly shone forth divinely brighter than gold, crying aloud: We exalt Christ above all unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having been patiently tried in torments as in a fiery furnace, O passion-bearers of the Lord, ye truly shone forth divinely brighter than gold, crying aloud: We exalt Christ above all unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p9 === (Ли́стъ д҃) мы́сленнѡ сїя́ѧ дꙋхо́вною, * и҆ ны́нѣ предстои́ши десни́цѣ жизноно́снѣй, * ѿтꙋ́дꙋ лꙋчмѝ * всегда̀ ѡ҆блиста́емь сла́вне.
items.english_text: With wise Justin let Charita, and Chariton, and Peon, and great Hierax be praised, together with Valerian, who through suffering drove away deceit and were united unto the angelic ranks.

provenance.verbatim_source: With wise Justin let Charita, and Chariton, and Peon, and great Hierax be praised, together with Valerian, who through suffering drove away deceit and were united unto the angelic ranks.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры, гла́съ, и҆. Подо́бенъ: Ѡ҆ пресла́внагѡ чꙋдесѐ!
items.english_text: Being led unto eternal life, O wise ones, with valiant wisdom ye all bowed your necks unto the sword in unanimity of soul, O martyrs, having offered yourselves as sacrifices unto God.

provenance.verbatim_source: Being led unto eternal life, O wise ones, with valiant wisdom ye all bowed your necks unto the sword in unanimity of soul, O martyrs, having offered yourselves as sacrifices unto God.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Въ бж҃твенныхъ незаходи́мыхъ внꙋ́трь, * и҆́стинныѧ же ски́нїи, ю҆́же гдⷭ҇ь водрꙋзѝ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ сщ҃е́нникъ зако́ненъ * вше́лъ є҆сѝ преподо́бне, * не чꙋжде́ю ѻ҆́ч҃е кро́вїю, * но твое́ю, * Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ подо́бѧсѧ, * совѣ́тномꙋ не покори́сѧ томле́нїю, * є҆́юже бг҃ꙋ ѻ҆́ч҃е ѹ҆годи́лъ є҆сѝ до конца̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Being the wellspring of life, in that thou didst bear the Water of Life, O Virgin Mother of God, give drink unto my soul, which is corrupted by the flame of sin, that I may glorify thee unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сло́вомъ и҆ дѣя́нїемъ ѹ҆кра́шенъ, * и҆ сщ҃енною то́ю ѡ҆де́ждею, * и҆ ѹ҆че́нїѧ пра́востїю, * Ніки́форе всемꙋ́дре, * премꙋ́дрости пита́телю, * и҆сповѣда́нїемъ си́хъ прїя́лъ є҆сѝ, * заточе́нїи и҆стѧза́емь, * терпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ ѹ҆се́рднѡ, * по́мысла крѣ́постїю лю́таѧ * всѧ̑ приходѧ́щаѧ бл҃же́нне.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *God, God the Word, Who came by unutterable wisdom to renew Adam, who had fallen grievously into corruption through eating: from the Holy*

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Спаси́ мѧ̀ влчⷣце пречⷭ҇таѧ, * ꙗ҆́же сп҃са Хрⷭ҇та̀ неизрече́ннѡ ро́ждшаѧ: * тѧ́ бо є҆ди́нꙋ стѧжа́хъ предста́тельницꙋ, * и҆ неѡбори́мꙋю стѣ́нꙋ, * и҆ покро́въ и҆ ра́дованїе, * и҆ дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ бж҃е́ственное ѹ҆тѣше́нїе. * Ты̀ ѹ҆́бw мѧ̀ и҆зба́ви неꙋсыпа́ющагѡ че́рвїѧ, * и҆ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ вѣ́чнꙋ́ющагѡ, * мт҃и Хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а.
items.english_text: Virgin, Who was ineffably incarnate for our sake: Him do we, the faithful, magnify with songs in one mind.

provenance.verbatim_source: Virgin, Who was ineffably incarnate for our sake: Him do we, the faithful, magnify with songs in one mind.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Тѧ̀ ви́дѧщи пригвожда́ема * на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ Їи҃се, * и҆ стра́сти прїе́млюща во́лею, * дѣ́ва и҆ мт҃и твоѧ̀, * влⷣко, * ѹ҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ вопїя́ше: * ча́до сла́дкое, * ра́ны непра́веднѡ ка́кѡ терпи́ши? * Врачꙋ̀, * и҆сцѣли́вый чл҃вѣ́ческое неможе́нїе, * и҆ ѿ тлѝ всѣ́хъ и҆зба́вивый млⷭ҇рдїемъ твои́мъ.
items.english_text: Shining with divine glory, O valiant sufferers, ye broke the chill of deceit, and became partakers of the sacred passions of Him Who took flesh for our sake, and with Him ye rejoice eternally in the heavens.

provenance.verbatim_source: Shining with divine glory, O valiant sufferers, ye broke the chill of deceit, and became partakers of the sacred passions of Him Who took flesh for our sake, and with Him ye rejoice eternally in the heavens.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, д҃. Пра́вило вѣ́ры и҆ ѻ҆́бразъ кро́тости, * воздержа́нїѧ ѹ҆чи́телѧ, * ꙗ҆ви́ тѧ ста́дꙋ твоемꙋ̀, * ꙗ҆́же веще́й и҆́стина: * сегѡ̀ ра́ди стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ смире́нїемъ высѡ́каѧ, * нището́ю бога́таѧ, * ѻ҆́ч҃е Ніки́форе, * молѝ Хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, * спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: At the wisdom of Justin, and the courage of Charita, and truly at the boldness of Chariton, at the valiant struggles of Peon and Hierax, and at the great endurance of Valerian amid fierce torments, even the Angels marveled.

provenance.verbatim_source: At the wisdom of Justin, and the courage of Charita, and truly at the boldness of Chariton, at the valiant struggles of Peon and Hierax, and at the great endurance of Valerian amid fierce torments, even the Angels marveled.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Ніки́фора ꙗ҆́кѡ побѣдоно́сца пѣ́снми пою̀. Ѳеофа́на. Гла́съ, д҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. Їрмо́съ: Мо́рѧ чермнꙋ́ю пꙋчи́нꙋ, * невла́жными стопа́ми, * дре́внїй пѣшеше́ствовалъ Їи҃ль, * крⷭ҇тообра́зными мѡѷсе́овыма рꙋка́ма
items.english_text: As upon a divine chariot having mounted, O glorious ones, ye joyfully ascended toward it by your blood; and from the life-bearing hand, O wise ones, ye received victorious crowns, unceasingly praying for us.

provenance.verbatim_source: As upon a divine chariot having mounted, O glorious ones, ye joyfully ascended toward it by your blood; and from the life-bearing hand, O wise ones, ye received victorious crowns, unceasingly praying for us.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p10 === (Ли́стъ д҃ ѻ҆б.) рꙋка́ма, а҆мали́ковꙋ си́лꙋ въ пꙋсты́ни побѣди́лъ є҆́сть.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having borne without man the Word beyond word, O pure Virgin who knewest not wedlock: deliver us from assaults, and from all tribulations, and from soul-corrupting harm, and from passions, and from the everlasting flame and condemnation!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆сцѣлѝ сокрꙋше́нїе пренепоро́чнаѧ человѣ́чества, * тво́рца ро́ждши всѧ̑ ны̀ и҆спра́вльшаго низве́рженныѧ, * паде́нїемъ пра́ѻцъ, бг҃оневѣ́стнаѧ.
items.english_text: As the setting-up of truth, the confirmation of the faith, and the proclaimer of dogmas do we know thee, the harmonizer of piety, dwelling of purity, and chosen receptacle, fragrance of the Spirit, and surpassing great treasure of teachings, and foundation of Christ's Church, O divinely inspired sacred luminary! We praise thee, the seal of teachers and divine image, the mystagogue of Christ, O blessed bishop, and the God-flowing river of understandings that wisely drowns the thoughts of the lawless and of blasphemers!

provenance.verbatim_source: As the setting-up of truth, the confirmation of the faith, and the proclaimer of dogmas do we know thee, the harmonizer of piety, dwelling of purity, and chosen receptacle, fragrance of the Spirit, and surpassing great treasure of teachings, and foundation of Christ's Church, O divinely inspired sacred luminary! We praise thee, the seal of teachers and divine image, the mystagogue of Christ, O blessed bishop, and the God-flowing river of understandings that wisely drowns the thoughts of the lawless and of blasphemers!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Їрмо́съ: Не мꙋ́дростїю, и҆ си́лою, и҆ бога́тствомъ хва́лимсѧ, * но тобо́ю ѻ҆́ч҃ею ѵ҆поста́сною мꙋ́дростїю Хрⷭ҇тѐ: * нѣ́сть бо ст҃ъ, па́че тебѐ чл҃вѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: Successor of the Apostles, of equal character with the sufferers, equal in zeal with the ascetics: having multiplied the talent of wisdom, O exceedingly rich one, thou wast accounted worthy of the joy of thy Lord, adorned with the grace of divine radiance and mentally with the beam

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оглаго́ливый ѻ҆́гненный ѧ҆зы́къ тво́й бж҃твенный, * ѻ҆гне́мъ разꙋ́мнымъ терно́вныѧ попалѝ є҆́реси, * бг҃омꙋ́дре ѻ҆́ч҃е сла́вне.
items.english_text: of spiritual brightness, and now thou standest before the life-bearing right hand, ever illumined thence with rays, O glorious one!

provenance.verbatim_source: of spiritual brightness, and now thou standest before the life-bearing right hand, ever illumined thence with rays, O glorious one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆сповѣ́дающе ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ превѣ́чномꙋ, * сн҃а собезнача́льна, * напослѣ́докъ и҆зъ твоеѧ̀ ѹ҆тро́бы ро́ждшасѧ пречⷭ҇таѧ, * вои́стиннꙋ сла́вимъ тѧ̀ бж҃їю мт҃рь.
items.english_text: Into the inner divine sanctuary of the unwaning light, of the true Tabernacle which the Lord pitched,[^8] as a lawful high priest thou didst enter, O venerable father, not with the blood of another, but with thine own, imitating Christ; thou didst not submit to the conspiracy of torment, by which thou didst please God unto the end, O father!

provenance.verbatim_source: Into the inner divine sanctuary of the unwaning light, of the true Tabernacle which the Lord pitched,[^8] as a lawful high priest thou didst enter, O venerable father, not with the blood of another, but with thine own, imitating Christ; thou didst not submit to the conspiracy of torment, by which thou didst please God unto the end, O father!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Премꙋ́дрости: Слове́съ твои́хъ бл҃года́ть разꙋ́мныхъ, * и҆ ѹ҆че́нїй высота̀ та́йныхъ, * бж҃твеннаѧ на́мъ бы́сть восхожде́нїѧ лѣ́ствица: * дх҃о́внꙋю бо ѻ҆́ч҃е стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ трꙋбꙋ̀, * се́ю проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ бж҃твеннаѧ ѹ҆че́нїѧ. * Тѣ́мже и҆ на мѣ́стѣ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ ѕла́чнѣ, * ѕвѣ́рѧ ѿгна́лъ є҆сѝ пра́щею слове́съ твои́хъ, * Ніки́форе бл҃же́нне, * молѝ Хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, * грѣхѡ́въ ѡ҆ставле́нїе пода́ти, * чтꙋ́щымъ всечⷭ҇тно́ю твою̀ па́мѧть.
items.english_text: Adorned with word and deed, and with that sacred vesture, and with the rectitude of teaching, O all-wise Nikephoros, fosterer of wisdom: through confession of these things thou didst accept exile, and being examined and tried, thou didst endure fervently with strength of mind all tribulations that befell thee, O blessed one!

provenance.verbatim_source: Adorned with word and deed, and with that sacred vesture, and with the rectitude of teaching, O all-wise Nikephoros, fosterer of wisdom: through confession of these things thou didst accept exile, and being examined and tried, thou didst endure fervently with strength of mind all tribulations that befell thee, O blessed one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ дѣ́вꙋ и҆ є҆ди́нꙋ въ жена́хъ, * тѧ̀ безъ сѣ́мене ро́ждшꙋю бг҃а пло́тїю, * всѝ ѹ҆блажа́емъ
items.english_text: An instrument of the Spirit wast thou revealed to be, addressed from above with divinely inspired voices, proclaiming the ineffable mystery of the Savior and His divine, true, and distinguished truths, loudly preaching unto us the Incarnation of the Word, which is beyond comprehension and higher than all understanding and thought, O most honorable one!

provenance.verbatim_source: An instrument of the Spirit wast thou revealed to be, addressed from above with divinely inspired voices, proclaiming the ineffable mystery of the Savior and His divine, true, and distinguished truths, loudly preaching unto us the Incarnation of the Word, which is beyond comprehension and higher than all understanding and thought, O most honorable one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ дѣ́вꙋ и҆ є҆ди́нꙋ въ жена́хъ, * тѧ̀ безъ сѣ́мене ро́ждшꙋю бг҃а пло́тїю, * всѝ ѹ҆блажа́емъ
items.english_text: Save me, O all-pure Lady, who didst ineffably bear Christ the Savior; for thee alone have I gained as protectress, and unassailable wall, and shelter, and rejoicing, and the divine consolation of my soul. Deliver me, therefore, from the unsleeping worm and from the everlasting fire, O Mother of Christ God!

items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* A rule of faith and image of meekness, a teacher of abstinence hath the truth of things shown thee unto thy flock; therefore through humility hast thou acquired lofty things, and through poverty rich things: O father Nikephoros, pray unto Christ God that our souls may be saved![^9]

items.english_text: Action hast thou shown to be the stepping-stone unto contemplation; for having harmoniously attuned thy soul through active virtue, O exceedingly rich Nikephoros, thou didst soar aloft unto the supreme, preeminent contemplation.

items.english_text: Having put to death earthly thoughts through abstinence, and having directed thy soul with diligence, O divinely inspired Nikephoros, thou hast reached the havens of stormless enjoyment.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ дѣ́вꙋ и҆ є҆ди́нꙋ въ жена́хъ, * тѧ̀ безъ сѣ́мене ро́ждшꙋю бг҃а пло́тїю, * всѝ ѹ҆блажа́емъ
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *Not in wisdom, nor in power, nor in riches do we boast, but in Thee, the hypostatic Wisdom of the Father, O Christ: for there is none holy beside Thee, O Lover of mankind.*

items.english_text: Thy God-speaking, fiery, divine tongue burned up thorny heresies with the spiritual fire, O divinely wise, glorious father!

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ дѣ́вꙋ и҆ є҆ди́нꙋ въ жена́хъ, * тѧ̀ безъ сѣ́мене ро́ждшꙋю бг҃а пло́тїю, * всѝ ѹ҆блажа́емъ
items.english_text: Having searched out the depth of wisdom through the love of wisdom, with the cords of thy teachings thou hast clearly drawn in them that rejected the image of Christ, O right marvelous one!

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ дѣ́вꙋ и҆ є҆ди́нꙋ въ жена́хъ, * тѧ̀ безъ сѣ́мене ро́ждшꙋю бг҃а пло́тїю, * всѝ ѹ҆блажа́емъ
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Прему́дрости):* The grace of thy wise words and the height of thy mystical teachings have become for us a divine ladder of ascent; for thou didst gain a spiritual trumpet, O father, and through it didst preach divine dogmas. Therefore hast thou also settled in a place of pasture, having driven away the beast with the sling of thy words, O blessed Nikephoros: pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto them that lovingly honor thy all-honorable memory!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:

items.english_text: As Virgin and alone among women, who without seed didst bear God in the flesh, all we generations of men call thee blessed

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ : А҆́гница и҆ па́стырѧ и҆ и҆зба́вителѧ, а҆́гница зрѧ́щи на крⷭ҇тѣ̀, восклица́ше пла́чꙋщи, и҆ го́рькѡ рыда́ющи, вопїѧ́ше : мі́ръ ᲂу҆́бѡ ра́дꙋетсѧ прїе́млѧ тобо́ю и҆збавлені́е, ᲂу҆тро́ба же моѧ̀ гори́тъ зрѧ́щи твоѐ ра́спѧтїе, є҆́же терпи́ши за милосе́рдїе мт҃и, долготерпѣли́ве гдⷭ҇и . ми́лости бе́здно, и҆ и҆сто́чниче неисчерпа́емый, ᲂу҆милосе́рдисѧ и҆ да́рꙋй согрѣше́ній ѡ҆ставле́ні́е, вѣ́рою пою́щымъ бж҃твенныѧ стра̑сти твоѧ̑ .
items.english_text: ...bless thee, all generations of mankind: for the fire of the Godhead took up its dwelling in thee, and as an infant dost thou nourish with milk the Creator and Lord. Therefore, both the angelic and the human race worthily glorify thy most holy childbearing, and with one accord cry aloud unto thee: Pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto them that with faith worship thy most holy childbearing.

provenance.verbatim_source: ...bless thee, all generations of mankind: for the fire of the Godhead took up its dwelling in thee, and as an infant dost thou nourish with milk the Creator and Lord. Therefore, both the angelic and the human race worthily glorify thy most holy childbearing, and with one accord cry aloud unto thee: Pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto them that with faith worship thy most holy childbearing.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Їрмо́съ : Вознесе́на тѧ̀ ви́дѣвши цр҃ковь на крⷭ҇тѣ̀, сл҃нце првⷣное, ста̀ въ чи́нѣ свое́мъ, досто́йнѡ взыва́ющи : сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й гдⷭ҇и .
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding the Lamb and Shepherd and Deliverer upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb wept and cried out, and bitterly lamenting, she cried aloud: The world indeed rejoices, receiving deliverance through Thee, but my inward parts are on fire, beholding Thy crucifixion which Thou dost endure out of tender mercy, O longsuffering Lord! O abyss of mercy, and inexhaustible wellspring: have compassion, and grant remission of sins unto them that in faith hymn Thy divine passions!

provenance.verbatim_source:

Beholding the Lamb and Shepherd and Deliverer upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb wept and cried out, and bitterly lamenting, she cried aloud: The world indeed rejoices, receiving deliverance through Thee, but my inward parts are on fire, beholding Thy crucifixion which Thou dost endure out of tender mercy, O longsuffering Lord! O abyss of mercy, and inexhaustible wellspring: have compassion, and grant remission of sins unto them that in faith hymn Thy divine passions!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою бж҃твенною, че́люсти сщ҃енноѧвле́нне нечести́выхъ сокрꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ, тве́рдымъ твои́мъ сло́вомъ : си́хъ побѣди́въ, и҆ чествова́ти научи́лъ є҆сѝ бж҃ественный сп҃са ѻ҆́бразъ .
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *Beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Sun of righteousness, the Church stood in her station, worthily crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*Beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Sun of righteousness, the Church stood in her station, worthily crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆сповѣ́дані́емъ бж҃ственное сщ҃е́нство, свѣ́тлѡ ᲂу҆ѧсни́лъ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е ні́кифоре, львово сѣровство̀ загражда́ѧ, та́инниче неизрече́нныхъ бг҃опрїѧ́тне .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By divine power, O sacredly revealed one, thou didst crush the jaws of the ungodly with thy firm word; having conquered them, thou didst teach [all] to honor the divine icon of the Savior.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By divine power, O sacredly revealed one, thou didst crush the jaws of the ungodly with thy firm word; having conquered them, thou didst teach [all] to honor the divine icon of the Savior.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ю́ношески проти́вилсѧ ні́кифоре, бл҃гочести́выми ᲂу҆че́нїи чⷭ҇ты́ѧ цр҃кве, ра́ною слове́съ твои́хъ во́лки ѿгна́лъ є҆сѝ, вѣ́рꙋ пра́вꙋю ко́рмѧйствоу́ющыѧ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By confession thou didst radiantly illumine the divine priesthood, O father Nikephoros, shutting the lion's savagery,[^12] O God-pleasing initiate of unutterable mysteries.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By confession thou didst radiantly illumine the divine priesthood, O father Nikephoros, shutting the lion's savagery,[^12] O God-pleasing initiate of unutterable mysteries.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Воплоще́нна безпло́тнаго пе́рвѣе, ро́ждши сло́ва бж҃їа всенепоро́чнаѧ, ѡ҆брадо́ваннаѧ мі́ръ ѡ҆бнови́ла є҆сѝ . тѣ́мже тѧ̀ бг҃оневѣ́сто, вѣ́рою правосла́вною почита́емъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With youthful vigor didst thou oppose [the heretics], O Nikephoros, with the pious teachings of the honorable Church; by the wounding of thy words thou didst drive away the wolves that steer astray the upright faith.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With youthful vigor didst thou oppose [the heretics], O Nikephoros, with the pious teachings of the honorable Church; by the wounding of thy words thou didst drive away the wolves that steer astray the upright faith.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Їрмо́съ : Ты̀ гдⷭ҇и мо́й свѣ́тъ въ мі́ръ прише́лъ є҆сѝ, свѣ́тъ ст҃ы́й, ѡ҆браща́ѧй и҆з̾ мра́чна невѣ́дѣнїѧ, вѣ́рою воспѣва́ющыѧ тѧ̀ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having borne the Word of God incarnate Who before was bodiless, O all-immaculate one, thou who art full of grace hast renewed the world. Therefore, as the Bride of God, with Orthodox faith we honor thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having borne the Word of God incarnate Who before was bodiless, O all-immaculate one, thou who art full of grace hast renewed the world. Therefore, as the Bride of God, with Orthodox faith we honor thee.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́мъ и҆мѣ́ѧ чи́стъ, на нб҃са̀ восходѧ́щь, ра́зꙋма и҆ премꙋ́дрости невѧнꙋ́щїй цвѣ́тъ ѡ҆брѧ́лъ є҆сѝ всеблаже́нне .
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *Thou, my Lord, hast come into the world as Light, a holy Light turning from gloomy ignorance them that hymn Thee with faith.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*Thou, my Lord, hast come into the world as Light, a holy Light turning from gloomy ignorance them that hymn Thee with faith.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́ні́е дꙋша́мъ правосла́внымъ, ᲂу҆роси́лъ є҆сѝ слове́съ твои́хъ бг҃одохнове́нне, зе́млю же неразꙋ́мныхъ ѡ҆прове́рглъ є҆сѝ твои́ми ᲂу҆че́нїи .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having a pure mind ascending unto the heavens, O all-blessed one, thou didst find the unfading flower of understanding and wisdom.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having a pure mind ascending unto the heavens, O all-blessed one, thou didst find the unfading flower of understanding and wisdom.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сло́во дѣ́ѧтелно, и҆ живо́тъ є҆́мьѧ неѡ҆́бьемлемь, ꙗ҆́кѡ со́лнце ѡ҆блиста́ѧ, честна́ѧ цр҃кве
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst drop down as dew the healing of thy words upon Orthodox souls, O divinely inspired one, and didst overthrow the land of the senseless by thy teachings.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst drop down as dew the healing of thy words upon Orthodox souls, O divinely inspired one, and didst overthrow the land of the senseless by thy teachings.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p12 === (Fol. 5v) цр҃кве просвѣща́еши ᲂу҆твержде́нїе .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With active word and embracing life uncontained, shining like the sun, thou dost enlighten the honorable Church's

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтоно́снѡ зарѧ́ми сїѧ́ѧ дх҃о́вными, цр҃квамъ, бг҃омꙋ́дре ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ сто́лпъ неи҆звра́венъ, и҆ ѻ҆́блакъ къ наслѣ́дїю веды́й не́бномꙋ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast the release from the ancestral mother's curse, O all-immaculate one, having conceived Him Who crowned us with divine blessings.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thou wast the release from the ancestral mother's curse, O all-immaculate one, having conceived Him Who crowned us with divine blessings.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Всю̀ твою̀ жи́знь бг҃ꙋ ѡ҆ст҃и́лъ є҆сѝ, пребыва́ѧ по все́й вселе́ннѣй нача́льникъ, просла́вилсѧ є҆сѝ сщ҃енноѧвле́нне ѻ҆́ч҃е блаже́нне .
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *I will sacrifice unto Thee with a voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the blood that flowed for mercy's sake from Thy side.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*I will sacrifice unto Thee with a voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the blood that flowed for mercy's sake from Thy side.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Растерза́етъ плете́нїа безбо́жныхъ є҆ресе́й, твоѐ бг҃одохнове́нное сло́во, ѻ҆бою́дꙋ ѻ҆́стрымъ мече́мъ ᲂу҆тѣ́шителѧ, свѣ́тъ же и҆́стины всѣ̑мъ предпоказа̀ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Shining radiantly with spiritual beams, O divinely wise one, thou didst appear unto the churches as an immovable pillar and a cloud leading unto the heavenly inheritance.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Shining radiantly with spiritual beams, O divinely wise one, thou didst appear unto the churches as an immovable pillar and a cloud leading unto the heavenly inheritance.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Зако́ни пресла́внѡ є҆стества̀ разрѣша́ютсѧ : дв҃а бо ражда́етъ, и҆ пита́етъ ѻ҆трокови́ца неискꙋсобра́чнѡ, заче́нши всѣ́хъ зижди́телѧ и҆ гдⷭ҇а .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst consecrate all thy life unto God; abiding as a leader over all the universe, thou wast glorified, O sacredly revealed, blessed father.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst consecrate all thy life unto God; abiding as a leader over all the universe, thou wast glorified, O sacredly revealed, blessed father.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, д҃ . Подо́бенъ : Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ : Побѣ́ды вѣне́цъ, Ѽ ні́кифоре, съ небесѐ пресла́вне, ꙗ҆́кѡ прїе́мъ ѿ бг҃а, спаса́й вѣ́рою почита́ющыѧ тѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ сщ҃еннонача́лника хрⷭ҇това, и҆ ᲂу҆чи́телѧ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy divinely inspired word tears apart the webs of godless heresies with the two-edged sword of the Comforter, and showed forth the light of truth unto all.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thy divinely inspired word tears apart the webs of godless heresies with the two-edged sword of the Comforter, and showed forth the light of truth unto all.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ї҆́косъ : Ꙗ҆́коже небозва́нъ гра́дъ бж҃їй на горѣ̀, вели́кїй їера́рхъ столъ̀ водрꙋже́нъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ, соблюда́ѧ мі́ръ мл҃твами, полкѝ безбо́жныхъ побѣди́въ, пребы́сть невреди́мъ, ѿ врагѡ́въ стрѣлѧ́нїй невѧ́зенъ, всѣ́хъ цр҃ѧ и҆ гдⷭ҇а внꙋ́трь въ се́рдцы носѧ́ . тѣ́мже и҆ ᲂу҆ѧсни́лъ чтꙋ́щыѧ хрⷭ҇та̀ на і҆кѡ́нѣ, съ высоты̀ добродѣ́телей, и҆ столпа̀ дѣ́лъ, пра́щею мета́етъ на полкѝ врагѡ́въ, две́ри же млⷭ҇рдемъ ѿверза́етъ, вѣ́рою пою́щымъ сего̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ ст҃и́телѧ хрⷭ҇това и҆ ᲂу҆чи́телѧ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The laws of nature are marvelously undone: for a virgin bears, and the maiden nourishes without knowing wedlock, having conceived the Creator and Lord of all.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The laws of nature are marvelously undone: for a virgin bears, and the maiden nourishes without knowing wedlock, having conceived the Creator and Lord of all.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Їрмо́съ : Въ пещѝ а҆враа́мстїи ѻ҆́троцы, персі́дстѣй, любо́вїю бл҃гоче́стїа па́че, не́жели пла́менемъ ѡ҆пала́еми взыва́хꙋ : бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ въ хра́мѣ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ гдⷭ҇и .
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast appeared today" (Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ):*[^13] Having received from God a crown of victory from heaven, O exceedingly glorious Nikephoros: save them that honor thee with faith, as a sacred hierarch and teacher of Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Це́рковь тѧ̀ живꙋ́ бг҃а жива́гѡ вѣ́мы, внꙋ́трь ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣти́лника и҆мѣ́юща златоза́рна, трⷪ҇цы позна́нїе : бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ въ хра́мѣ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ гдⷭ҇и .
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Like a city of God called from heaven upon a mountain, the great hierarch appeared as an established pillar, preserving the world by his prayers; having conquered the ranks of the godless, he remained unharmed, unentangled by the arrows of the foes, carrying within his heart the King and Lord of all. Therefore he also gave clarity unto them that honor Christ on an icon: from the height of virtues and the pillar of deeds, with a sling he hurls against the ranks of the foes, and opens the doors unto the merciful, who in faith sing praise unto him as the hierarch and teacher of Christ.

items.slavonic_text: Е҆рети́чествꙋющихъ ꙗ҆зыкоболѣ́знїѧ низложи́лъ є҆сѝ, ᲂу҆вѣ́рѧѧ чти́ти і҆кѡ́нꙋ хрⷭ҇товꙋ ні́кифоре, взыва́ющымъ : бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ въ хра́мѣ сла́вы твоеѧ̀
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *In the Persian furnace the Children of Abraham, burning with the love of piety rather than with flame, cried aloud: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!*

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p13 === (Fol. 6r) твоеѧ̀ гдⷭ҇и .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* We know thee as a living church of the living God, having within, like a golden lamp, the knowledge of the Trinity: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Премꙋ́дрости бога́тство, и҆ житїѐ и҆мѣ́ѧ бж҃ественно, все́ преминꙋ́лъ є҆сѝ чꙋ́вство мы́сленнѡ, хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ нн҃ѣ бесѣ́дꙋеши : бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ въ хра́мѣ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ гдⷭ҇и .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst cast down the blasphemous babblings of the heretics, assuring [all] to honor the icon of Christ, O Nikephoros, as they cry aloud: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Їрмо́съ : Ѻ҆́троки бл҃гочести̑выѧ въ пещѝ, рождество̀ бг҃оро́дичо спасло́ є҆́сть : тогда̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ ѡ҆бразꙋ́емое, ны́нѣ же дѣ́йствꙋемое, вселе́ннꙋю всю̀ воздвиза́етъ пѣ́ти тебѣ̀ : гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having the wealth of wisdom and a divine life, thou didst pass beyond all sense spiritually; now dost thou converse with Christ: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:

Having the wealth of wisdom and a divine life, thou didst pass beyond all sense spiritually; now dost thou converse with Christ: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Кро́вїю хрⷭ҇товою и҆зба́вленъ, ра́зꙋмомъ и҆́же є҆гѡ̀ ра́ди пода́тъ сме́рть, совѣ́сти бо прине́слъ є҆сѝ мꙋче́нїе, и҆сповѣ́данїа бл҃года́тїю сїѧ́ѧ . гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, взыва́ѧ : и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Neither dividing the united nor confusing [them], we glorify the one Christ, the Word incarnate of thee, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тѣ́ломъ и҆ дꙋше́ю ѡ҆чище́нъ, сло́вꙋ въвиди́хꙋ, сло́вомъ поже́рлъ є҆сѝ, се́й пре́жде безпло́тно и҆ безначя́лно пока́зꙋѧ, и҆ ми́лостивна бы́вша чл҃вѣ́ка послѣ́жде . гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, взыва́ѧ : и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *The childbearing of the Theotokos saved the pious Children in the furnace: then indeed prefigured, but now in deed, it stirs up the whole universe to sing unto Thee: Hymn the Lord, O ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Да наслѣ́дїе нбⷭ҇ное, и҆ сла́вꙋ неизмѣ́ннꙋю ᲂу҆лꙋчи́ши сла́вне, сла́вꙋ ᲂу҆вѧда́емꙋю ѻ҆́ч҃е ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ, и҆згна́нїе и҆ ѡ҆ѕлобле́нїе терпѧ̀ добле́ственнѣ мꙋ́дре, взыва́ѧ : гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Delivered by the blood of Christ, with understanding he surrendered to death for His sake; for thou didst bring the martyrdom of conscience, shining with the grace of confession, crying aloud: Hymn the Lord, O ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Є҆ди́нꙋ голуби́цꙋ чи́стꙋ тѧ̀ жени́хъ мы́сленный ѡ҆брѣ́те всенепоро́чнаѧ, крі́нъ бл҃гово́ннѣйшій, цвѣ́тъ прекра́снѣйшій, и҆ свѣтоно́сенъ черто́гъ, невѣ́стꙋ приведѐ . тѣ́мже тѧ̀ дв҃ꙋ пое́мъ, и҆ превозно́симъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Cleansed in body and soul, the Word was seen in thee; with word didst thou offer sacrifice, showing Him Who of old was bodiless and without beginning, and Who afterward became merciful man, crying aloud: Hymn the Lord, O ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Їрмо́съ : Ка́мень нерꙋкосѣ́чный ѿ несѣко́мыѧ горы̀ тебѐ дв҃о, краеꙋго́лный ѿсѣче́сѧ, хрⷭ҇то́съ совокꙋпи́вый, разстоѧ́щаѧсѧ є҆стества̀ . тѣ́мъ весе́лѧщесѧ, тѧ̀ бцⷣе велича́емъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* That thou mightest attain the heavenly inheritance and unchangeable glory, O glorious one, thou didst leave behind fading glory, O father, manfully enduring exile and affliction, O wise one, crying aloud: Hymn the Lord, O ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ бл҃же́нній коне́цъ, преше́дшымъ зерца́лѡмъ, и҆́стинѣ ꙗ҆вле́нїѧ, видѣ́нїемъ нетлѣ́нныѧ доброты̀ : є҆ѧ́же ны́нѣ насыща́ѧсѧ, твои́ми моли́твами на́съ помина́й .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As a single pure dove did the spiritual Bridegroom find thee, O all-immaculate one; a most fragrant lily, a most comely blossom, and a light-bearing bridal chamber, He led thee in as His bride. Therefore do we hymn thee as Virgin, and exalt thee above all unto all ages.

items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *A cornerstone cut without hand from an uncut mountain,[^14] O Virgin, was Christ, Who joined together the severed natures. Therefore rejoicing, we magnify thee, O Theotokos.*

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p14 === (Fol. 6v) Всѧ́кꙋ добродѣ́тель ᲂу҆держа́въ, при кончи́нѣ подвигѡ́въ и҆сповѣда́нїа вѣнце́мъ сщ҃енномꙋ́чениче ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆кра́шенъ, и҆́мже ᲂу҆добре́нъ твое́мꙋ влⷣцѣ нн҃ѣ предстои́ши .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast found a blessed end, having passed beyond mirrors unto the manifestation of truth, by the vision of incorruptible beauty: feasting upon it now, remember us by thy prayers!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Ꙗ҆́кѡ ко́рень и҆ и҆сто́чникъ, и҆ винꙋ̀ нетлѣ́нїа, тѧ̀ дв҃о всѝ вѣ́рнїи вѣ́мы, хвала́ми почита́емъ : ты́ бо ᲂу҆поста́сное безсме́ртїе на́мъ и҆сточи́ла є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As we have seen the divine [memory] of the God-bearing Nikephoros shine forth, come, ye Christ-bearing people, with fervor let us hymn him as a victor, and with gladness let us celebrate his feast!

provenance.verbatim_source:

As we have seen the divine [memory] of the God-bearing Nikephoros shine forth, come, ye Christ-bearing people, with fervor let us hymn him as a victor, and with gladness let us celebrate his feast!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Ѡ҆́теческихъ не ѡ҆ста́вль нб҃съ, а҆́ще и҆ воплоти́лсѧ є҆сѝ ѿ дв҃ы гдⷭ҇и : и҆́бо спастѝ менѐ па́дшаго, преклони́въ нб҃са соше́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ и҆схити́ти хотѧ̀ ѿ ᲂу҆́стъ ѕвѣ́рѧ мы́сленнагѡ, и҆ є҆гѡ̀ ᲂу҆давле́нїѧ держи́маго . тѣ́мже и҆зба́влсѧ сла́влю твою̀ си́лꙋ .
items.english_text: Having held fast every virtue, at the conclusion of thy struggles thou didst appear adorned with the crown of confession, O hieromartyr; embellished with it, thou now standest before thy Master.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having held fast every virtue, at the conclusion of thy struggles thou didst appear adorned with the crown of confession, O hieromartyr; embellished with it, thou now standest before thy Master.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же, въ г҃ де́нь Ст҃а́гѡ мч҃енника лꙋкїллїа́на, и҆ и҆́же съ ни́мъ . Стїхи́ры, гла́съ, д҃ . Подо́бенъ : Всѣхва́льнїи мч҃єницы : Господобы́инственныѧ тѧ̀ * лю́тїи ѻ҆́троцы преда́ша, * за́вистїю тле́мїи сла́вне, * и҆ мꙋ́жествовавъ непобѣди́мѡ, * раѧ̀ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, Ѽ лꙋкїллїа́не наслажде́нїе . * тѣ́мже моли́сѧ, * дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ми́ръ, * и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость . Дѣ́ти всесвѧще́нныѧ, ꙗ҆́коже ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ повину́ющесѧ тебѣ̀, * съ тобо́ю пострада́ша тве́рдѡ, * и҆ сла́внаѧ и҆ прпⷣбнаѧ па́ѵла, * мꙋ́ченица досточꙋ́днаѧ : * съ ни́миже ны́нѣ живе́ши на нб҃сѣ́хъ, * хрⷭ҇та̀ молѝ, дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ми́ръ, * и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость . И҆сцѣле́нїй во́ды, твоѧ̀ ра́ка притека́ющымъ и҆сточа́етъ всегда̀, * мч҃енниче многострада́лне, * и҆ ѡ҆мыва́етъ стра̑сти, * и҆ потоплѧ́етъ полкѝ де́мѡнскїѧ, * дѣ́йствомъ дх҃а ст҃а́гѡ . * тѣ́мже моли́сѧ, * дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As the root and fountain and cause of incorruption do all we faithful know thee, O Virgin, and with praises do we honor thee; for thou hast gushed forth hypostatic immortality unto us.

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p15 === (Fol. 7r) дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ми́ръ, * и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость .
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion, Podoben: "While the disciples looked on" (Оу҆ченикѡ́мъ зрѧ́щымъ):*[^15] As an eminent victor over passions, O Nikephoros, thou didst receive a twofold crown from Christ the Savior, O hierarch and sufferer, as a champion of piety, O father, in that thou didst most wisely cast down the God-fighting heresy of them that reject the divine icons: pray therefore for us who honor thee, O blessed one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
