items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Стїхи̑ры бцⷣы, гла́съ и҆ подо́бенъ, то́йже . Ра́дꙋйсѧ стра́нное слы́шанїе чⷭ҇таѧ : * ра́дꙋйсѧ дре́во ст҃о́е * раѧ̀ бг҃осажде́нное : * ра́дꙋйсѧ потребле́нїе лꙋка́выхъ де́монѡвъ : * ра́дꙋйсѧ ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе ѻ҆бою́дꙋ ѻ҆́строе, * врага̀ главꙋ̀ ѿсѣ́кши, * стра́ннымъ ржⷭ҇тво́мъ твои́мъ, * всест҃а́ѧ пренепоро́чнаѧ, * ᲂу҆стра́ншыѧсѧ ны̀ воззовѝ . Недꙋ́говавшꙋю прест҃а́ѧ лю́тѣ, * дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ страстьмѝ лꙋка́выми, * и҆сцѣлѝ, ꙗ҆́же цѣли́телѧ и҆ сп҃са * всѣ́хъ хрⷭ҇та̀ ро́ждшаѧ, * всѧ́кꙋ ꙗ҆́звꙋ * и҆сцѣли́вшаго, * ᲂу҆ѧ́звленнаго * дїа́волскимъ ѕломы́слїемъ, * и҆ сме́рти на́съ и҆змѣ́ншаго . Прест҃ы́й хра́ме бж҃їй, * нб҃съ ши́ршій, * и҆ херꙋві́мъ ст҃ѣ́йшій бг҃ора́дованнаѧ, * всест҃а́ѧ ѻ҆трокови́це, * ᲂу҆́мъ моѝ ѡ҆бл҃года́ти, * и҆ просвѣтѝ серде́чнїи ѻ҆́чи, * подаю́щи мѝ, * благопрїѧ́тными * хода́тайствы твои́ми, * согрѣше́нїй всѣ́хъ проще́нїе .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Not leaving the Father's heavens, even though Thou didst take flesh from the Virgin, O Lord: to save me who was fallen, bowing the heavens Thou didst descend, wishing to snatch me from the mouth of the noetic beast and from his strangling hold. Therefore, delivered, I glorify Thy power.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Not leaving the Father's heavens, even though Thou didst take flesh from the Virgin, O Lord: to save me who was fallen, bowing the heavens Thou didst descend, wishing to snatch me from the mouth of the noetic beast and from his strangling hold. Therefore, delivered, I glorify Thy power.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе : Лꙋкїллїа́на мꙋ́чнка пою̀ сла́вꙋ . Гла́съ, и҃ . Пѣ́снь, а҃ . Їрмо́съ : Во́дꙋ проше́дъ ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́шꙋ, и҆ є҆гѵ́петскагѡ ѕла̀ и҆збѣжа́въ, і҆илі́тѧнинъ вопїѧ́ше, и҆зба́вителю и҆ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ пои́мъ . Сло́ва тѧ̀ бж҃їѧ ᲂу҆го́дника, мч҃енникѡвъ же сла́вꙋ воспѣва́ю лꙋкїллїа́не, тѣ́мже мнѣ̀ моли́твами твои́ми пода́ждь, ѡ҆чище́нїе ѕлы́хъ и҆ и҆сцѣле́нїе . Все́ю мы́слїю же и҆ дꙋше́ю, ве́сь прилѣпи́лсѧ є҆сѝ любвѝ хрⷭ҇товѣ̀, и҆ і҆́дѡлскїѧ пре́лести и҆ не́мѡщи мꙋ́дре пренебре́глъ є҆сѝ . Па́че всеѧ̀ сла́вы земны́ѧ, томи́телнагѡ безгла́вїа желла́ѧ, неистлѣва́емꙋю сла́вꙋ бг҃облаже́нне, нбⷭ҇нꙋю наслѣ́дилъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *The Holy Martyr Lucillian and Those with Him:*[^16]

provenance.verbatim_source: *The Holy Martyr Lucillian and Those with Him:*[^16]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Їрмо́съ : Ты̀ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе притека́ющихъ къ тебѣ̀ гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ ѡ҆мраче́нныхъ, и҆ пое́тъ тѧ̀ дх҃ъ мо́й .
items.english_text: Fierce youths, corrupt through envy, surrendered thee who wast a God-slayer,[^17] O glorious one; yet having acted manfully and invincibly, O Lucillian, thou didst receive the enjoyment of Paradise. Therefore pray thou that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Fierce youths, corrupt through envy, surrendered thee who wast a God-slayer,[^17] O glorious one; yet having acted manfully and invincibly, O Lucillian, thou didst receive the enjoyment of Paradise. Therefore pray thou that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: І҆ꙋ́да предадѐ и҆зба́вителѧ хрⷭ҇та̀, дре́вле бг҃оᲂу҆бі́йцамъ : ты́ же ны́нѣ беззако́ннымъ і҆ꙋде́ємъ пре́данъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ . Словесы̀ тѧ̀ льсте́цъ прельсти́ти, ласка́тельными покꙋша́ласѧ, ꙗ҆ви́сѧ твои́ми словесы̀, ꙗ҆́коже каме́нїемъ страда́лче бїе́мъ . Свѣти́лникъ пресвѣ́телъ, стра́ждꙋщымъ съ тобо́ю бы́лъ є҆сѝ, свѣ́тлѡ наставля́ѧ на бж҃ественныѧ стезѝ, та́мошнагѡ наслажде́нїа .
items.english_text: The all-consecrated children, obeying thee as a father, suffered steadfastly with thee, and the glorious and venerable Paula, the marvelously praised martyr; with whom thou now dwellest in the heavens: pray thou unto Christ that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: The all-consecrated children, obeying thee as a father, suffered steadfastly with thee, and the glorious and venerable Paula, the marvelously praised martyr; with whom thou now dwellest in the heavens: pray thou unto Christ that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Ми́лостивꙋ бы́ти мѝ молю́сѧ, твои́ми бл҃дце дерзнове́ньми, и҆з̾ тебѐ рожде́нномꙋ, въ де́нь сꙋ́да .
items.english_text: Thy reliquary ever goushes forth waters of healing unto them that hasten to it, O much-suffering martyr, and washes away passions and drowns demonic ranks by the operation of the Holy Spirit. Therefore pray thou that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy reliquary ever goushes forth waters of healing unto them that hasten to it, O much-suffering martyr, and washes away passions and drowns demonic ranks by the operation of the Holy Spirit. Therefore pray thou that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls!

items.section: Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника, и҆лѝ бг҃оро́диченъ : Оу҆пова́нїе хрⷭ҇тїа́нъ прест҃а́ѧ дв҃о, є҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ бг҃а, па́че ᲂу҆ма́ же и҆ сло́ва, непреста́ннѡ молѝ съ вы́шними си́лами, пода́ти ѡ҆ставле́нїе грѣхѡ́въ на́шихъ всѣ́хъ, и҆ и҆справле́нїе житїѧ̀, вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вїю при́снѡ тѧ̀ сла́вѧщымъ .
items.english_text: *Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same:*

provenance.verbatim_source: *Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same:*

items.section: Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ : Зрѧ́щи тѧ̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ всенепоро́чнаѧ мт҃и, ме́ртва на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ просте́рта, вопїѧ́ше : сн҃е моѝ собезнача́льне ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀, и҆ дх҃ꙋ, что̀ неизрече́нное твоѐ сїѐ смотре́нїе ? и҆́мже спа́слъ є҆сѝ, пречи́стыхъ рꙋ́къ твои́хъ ще́дрое созда́нїе .
items.english_text: Rejoice, marvelous hearing, O pure one! Rejoice, sacred tree of Paradise planted by God! Rejoice, destruction of deceitful demons! Rejoice, two-edged weapon that didst cut off the enemy's head by thy marvelous childbearing, O all-holy and all-immaculate one: call back us who have become estranged!

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, marvelous hearing, O pure one! Rejoice, sacred tree of Paradise planted by God! Rejoice, destruction of deceitful demons! Rejoice, two-edged weapon that didst cut off the enemy's head by thy marvelous childbearing, O all-holy and all-immaculate one: call back us who have become estranged!

items.section: Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Їрмо́съ : Оу҆слы́шахъ гдⷭ҇и смотре́нїа твоегѡ̀ та́инство, разꙋмѣ́хъ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, и҆ просла́вихъ твоѐ бж҃тво̀ . Блиста́еши словесы̀ твои́ми, и҆ просвѣща́еши мі́ръ страда́нїи твои́ми : мꙋчи́телей же сопротивле́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ мглу̀ ѿгонѧ́еши непостоѧ́ннꙋю . Но́вый ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ вѣ́рою а҆враа́мъ, и҆́же дре́вле ѡ҆пра́вдасѧ ѡ҆ хрⷭ҇тѣ̀ : позна́нїемъ бо зижди́телѧ твоегѡ̀, ѿве́рглъ
items.english_text: Heal my soul, O all-holy one, which is grievously sick with deceitful passions, O thou who didst bear Christ the Physician and Savior of all, Who healed every wound of him that was wounded by the devil's malice, and Who ransomed us from death!

provenance.verbatim_source: Heal my soul, O all-holy one, which is grievously sick with deceitful passions, O thou who didst bear Christ the Physician and Savior of all, Who healed every wound of him that was wounded by the devil's malice, and Who ransomed us from death!

items.section: Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p17 === (Fol. 8r) є҆сѝ всѐ сꙋетство̀ .
items.english_text: O most holy temple of God, broader than the heavens and holier than the Cherubim, O thou who art full of grace, all-holy Maiden: bestow grace upon my mind and enlighten the eyes of my heart, granting me by thy acceptable intercessions the forgiveness of all my sins!

provenance.verbatim_source: O most holy temple of God, broader than the heavens and holier than the Cherubim, O thou who art full of grace, all-holy Maiden: bestow grace upon my mind and enlighten the eyes of my heart, granting me by thy acceptable intercessions the forgiveness of all my sins!

items.section: Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Па́че ᲂу҆ма̀ та́инство ржⷭ҇тва̀ твоегѡ̀, приснодв҃о : во ᲂу҆тро́бѣ бо заче́нши бг҃а, неизрече́ннымъ сло́вомъ породи́ла є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: Woe is me, what shall become of me, having defiled mind and soul and body with transgressions! What shall I do? How shall I escape the unendurable flame, the insoluble and eternal bonds? But O all-immaculate one, before the end pray thou unto thy Son to grant me remission!

provenance.verbatim_source: Woe is me, what shall become of me, having defiled mind and soul and body with transgressions! What shall I do? How shall I escape the unendurable flame, the insoluble and eternal bonds? But O all-immaculate one, before the end pray thou unto thy Son to grant me remission!

items.section: Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Їрмо́съ : Просвѣтѝ на́съ повелѣ́нїи твои́ми гдⷭ҇и, и҆ мы́шцею твое́ю высо́кою, тво́й ми́ръ пода́ждь на́мъ человѣколю́бче .
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* When the Ewe-lamb and spotless Lady beheld her Lamb upon the Cross having neither form nor comeliness, weeping she said: Woe is me! Whither hath Thy beauty departed, O sweetest One? Whither Thy majesty? Whither the gleaming grace of Thy countenance, O my most beloved Son?

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
When the Ewe-lamb and spotless Lady beheld her Lamb upon the Cross having neither form nor comeliness, weeping she said: Woe is me! Whither hath Thy beauty departed, O sweetest One? Whither Thy majesty? Whither the gleaming grace of Thy countenance, O my most beloved Son?

items.section: Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́не врачꙋ̀ дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣле́съ хрⷭ҇тѐ, мꙋ́ченикѡвъ мольба́ми, страсте́й мои́хъ болѣ́зни и҆сцѣлѝ .
items.english_text: *Canon, whose acrostic is: "I sing the glory of the Martyr Lucillian." Tone 8.*[^18]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Canon, whose acrostic is: "I sing the glory of the Martyr Lucillian." Tone 8.*[^18]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тъ сщ҃е́ненъ дѣла́нїемъ дх҃а, показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ мꙋ́чениче сла́вне, благопло́дїа во страда́нїихъ предлага́ѧ .
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* *Traversing the water as dry land, and escaping from Egyptian evil, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1. Heirmos:*
*Traversing the water as dry land, and escaping from Egyptian evil, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Глаго́лы животныѧ въ се́рдцы и҆мѣ́ѧ мꙋ́дре, мꙋчи́телскаѧ преще́нїа, твои́мъ сопротивле́нїемъ ᲂу҆мертви́лъ є҆сѝ сла́вне .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As the servant of God the Word and the glory of martyrs do I sing thy praise, O Lucillian; therefore by thy prayers grant me cleansing from evils and healing.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
As the servant of God the Word and the glory of martyrs do I sing thy praise, O Lucillian; therefore by thy prayers grant me cleansing from evils and healing.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Стѣ́нꙋ неѡ҆бори́мꙋ, и҆ приста́нище и҆ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе, и҆ наде́ждꙋ бг҃ома́ти чи́стаѧ, и҆ бж҃твенное ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе и҆мꙋ́ще тѧ̀ спаса́емсѧ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With all thy mind and soul thou didst cleave entirely unto the love of Christ, and didst wisely despise the deception and impotence of idols.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With all thy mind and soul thou didst cleave entirely unto the love of Christ, and didst wisely despise the deception and impotence of idols.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Їрмо́съ : Ѡ҆чи́стимѧ сп҃се, мнѡ́га бо беззако́нїѧ моѧ̑, и҆ и҆з̾ глубины̀ ѕѡ́лъ возведѝ молю́сѧ, къ тебѣ́ бо возопи́хъ, и҆ ᲂу҆слы́ши мѧ̀, бж҃е спасе́нїа моегѡ̀ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring the tormentor's beheading rather than all earthly glory, O divinely blessed one, thou hast inherited incorruptible heavenly glory.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Desiring the tormentor's beheading rather than all earthly glory, O divinely blessed one, thou hast inherited incorruptible heavenly glory.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆крѣпи́вшисѧ мꙋ́нца мꙋ́драѧ па́ѵла, наказа́нїи твои́ми, мꙋ́жествовавши терпѣли́внѡ на льсти́ваго, и҆ вѣне́цъ прїѧ́тъ пра́вды, ѿ рꙋкѝ страстополо́жника хрⷭ҇та̀ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The ladder which Jacob saw, O Theotokos, art thou; for through thee the Word was united unto them that are upon the earth, and drew up human nature unto the height.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The ladder which Jacob saw, O Theotokos, art thou; for through thee the Word was united unto them that are upon the earth, and drew up human nature unto the height.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Зрѧ̀ твоѐ непрекло́нное, ꙗ҆́кѡ го́рꙋ сїѡ́нъ неподвижи́мꙋ, не терпѧ́ше вра́гъ : но ве́сь посрами́сѧ, и҆ къ землѝ попира́емь ѿ тебѐ бг҃омꙋ́дре, въ подвиѕѣ̀ страда́нїа .
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *Thou art the confirmation of them that flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the Light of the darkened, and my spirit sings praise unto Thee.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
*Thou art the confirmation of them that flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the Light of the darkened, and my spirit sings praise unto Thee.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Зачала̀ є҆сѝ вои́стиннꙋ бж҃ественное сло́во во ᲂу҆тро́бѣ твое́й, и҆ сего̀ па́че є҆стества̀ родила̀ є҆сѝ пречⷭ҇таѧ . є҆го́же моли́твами твои́ми мл҃тива сотворѝ, ѿ бѣ́дъ всѣ̑хъ и҆зба́вити рабы̑ твоѧ̑ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Judas of old betrayed the Deliverer Christ unto the murderers of God; and thou now hast been betrayed unto the lawless Jews.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Judas of old betrayed the Deliverer Christ unto the murderers of God; and thou now hast been betrayed unto the lawless Jews.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Їрмо́съ : Ѿ і҆ꙋде́и доше́дше ѻ҆́троцы, въ вавѷлѡ́нѣ и҆ногда̀, вѣ́рою трⷪ҇ческою пла́мень пе́щный попра́ша пою́ще : ѻ҆ц҃е́въ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When the deceiver attempted to beguile thee with flattering words, by thy words, O sufferer, he appeared as though struck with stones.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
When the deceiver attempted to beguile thee with flattering words, by thy words, O sufferer, he appeared as though struck with stones.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Съ па́ѵломъ вопїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ мч҃ениче, не разлꙋчи́тъ мѧ̀ ѿ любвѐ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A most radiant luminary wast thou unto them that suffered with thee, radiantly guiding [them] unto the divine paths of the enjoyment yonder.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
A most radiant luminary wast thou unto them that suffered with thee, radiantly guiding [them] unto the divine paths of the enjoyment yonder.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p18 === (Fol. 8v) ѿ любвѐ хрⷭ҇то́вы, ни бѣда̀, ни ско́рбь, ни ра̑ны, ни ме́чь . тѣ́мже и҆ взыва́лъ є҆сѝ : ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* I pray that He Who was born of thee may be merciful unto me through thy bold intercessions, O Lady, in the day of judgment.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
I pray that He Who was born of thee may be merciful unto me through thy bold intercessions, O Lady, in the day of judgment.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: На ка́мени ᲂу҆тверди́лъ є҆сѝ и҆сповѣ́данїа бж҃твеннагѡ, но́ги твоѧ̑, непоколеби́мъ ꙗ҆ви́всѧ мо́лвою бѣ́дъ . тѣ́мже взыва́лъ є҆сѝ : ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thy tomb, O Savior" (Гро́бъ тво́й сп҃се):*[^19] Drawing near unto the fire, thou wast by no means burned, O Lucillian, valiant-minded sufferer; for thou didst acquire divine dew that refreshed thee. Therefore, rejoicing, thou didst accomplish struggles beyond nature together with the holy children, with whom remember us!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thy tomb, O Savior" (Гро́бъ тво́й сп҃се):*[^19]
Drawing near unto the fire, thou wast by no means burned, O Lucillian, valiant-minded sufferer; for thou didst acquire divine dew that refreshed thee. Therefore, rejoicing, thou didst accomplish struggles beyond nature together with the holy children, with whom remember us!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Їрмо́съ : Цр҃ѧ нбⷭ҇наго, є҆го́же пою́тъ вѡ́и а҆́гг҃лстїи, хвали́те, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: O Hope of Christians, all-holy Virgin, whom thou didst bear as God beyond mind and word: unceasingly pray with the heavenly hosts to grant remission of all our sins and correction of life unto them that ever glorify thee in faith and love.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Hope of Christians, all-holy Virgin, whom thou didst bear as God beyond mind and word: unceasingly pray with the heavenly hosts to grant remission of all our sins and correction of life unto them that ever glorify thee in faith and love.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: При є҆же́ственныхъ ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ и҆сходи́щахъ, насажде́нъ бы́въ вѣ́рою гдⷭ҇нею, дре́во ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ преблаже́нне живоно́сное .
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee, O Christ, stretched out dead upon the Cross, the all-immaculate Mother cried aloud: O my Son, co-unoriginate with the Father and the Spirit, what is this Thine ineffable dispensation, whereby Thou hast saved the tender creation of Thine all-pure hands?

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
Beholding Thee, O Christ, stretched out dead upon the Cross, the all-immaculate Mother cried aloud: O my Son, co-unoriginate with the Father and the Spirit, what is this Thine ineffable dispensation, whereby Thou hast saved the tender creation of Thine all-pure hands?

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆краси́вшесѧ страда́лцы, добро́тою честна́гѡ хрⷭ҇това и҆сповѣда́нїа, вѣне́цъ съ нб҃се прїѧ́ша досто́йнѡ .
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation, I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Godhead.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation, I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Godhead.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Преклонша́госѧ болѣ́знями и҆ па́дшасѧ, возста́ви мѧ̀ бг҃ома́ти : ꙗ҆́кѡ да тѧ̀ сла́влю во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou dost shine forth by thy words and enlighten the world by thy sufferings; and the opposition of the tyrants thou dost drive away like an unsteady mist.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou dost shine forth by thy words and enlighten the world by thy sufferings; and the opposition of the tyrants thou dost drive away like an unsteady mist.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Їрмо́съ : Велича́емъ тѧ̀ всенепоро́чнꙋю мт҃рь хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а на́шегѡ, ю҆́же ѡ҆сѣнѝ дх҃ъ ст҃ы́й .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A new Abraham wast thou shown to be through faith, who of old was justified in Christ; for by the knowledge of thy Creator thou didst cast away

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
A new Abraham wast thou shown to be through faith, who of old was justified in Christ; for by the knowledge of thy Creator thou didst cast away

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Страсте́й болѣ̑зни, мл҃твами страстоте́рпецъ и҆сцѣли́вый, и҆ моѧ̑ ны́нѣ и҆сцѣлѝ болѣ́зни, человѣколю́бче .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having gained thee, O glorious martyr, as the destroyer of deceit and the expeller of painful passions, we, the faithful, are ever filled with healings.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having gained thee, O glorious martyr, as the destroyer of deceit and the expeller of painful passions, we, the faithful, are ever filled with healings.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Тебѐ стѣ́нꙋ и҆ покро́въ, и҆ ᲂу҆до́бное приста́нище всенепоро́чнаѧ, вѣ́рнїи стѧжа́хомъ : є҆́юже и҆ спаса́емсѧ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beyond understanding is the mystery of thy childbearing, O Ever-Virgin; for having conceived God in thy womb, by an ineffable word thou didst bring Him forth.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Beyond understanding is the mystery of thy childbearing, O Ever-Virgin; for having conceived God in thy womb, by an ineffable word thou didst bring Him forth.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же, въ д҃ де́нь . И҆́же во ст҃ы́хъ, ѻ҆ц҃а̀ на́шегѡ митрофа́на, патрїа́рха кѡнстанти́на гра́да . На гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ стїхи̑ры гла́съ, ѕ҃ . Подо́бенъ : Всѐ ѿло́жше : Ве́сь ѡ҆свѧще́нъ * бг҃оно́сецъ показа́лсѧ, * помаза́нїе бж҃їе сто̀ : * ст҃ы́мъ дх҃омъ ѡ҆бложе́нъ, * и҆ свѣ́тлѡ входа
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant us Thy peace, O Lover of mankind.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant us Thy peace, O Lover of mankind.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p19 === (Fol. 9r) вы́шнѧѧ * во ст҃а́ѧ ст҃ы́хъ, * бг҃онача́лными свѣ́тлостьми ѡ҆зарѧ́емь, * бл҃года́ти причаща́ѧсѧ * ст҃ы́хъ та́инъ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆́стинный ст҃и́тель пресла́венъ, * съ дерзнове́нїемъ молѧ́сѧ * ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Christ, only Physician of souls and bodies: by the supplications of the martyrs, heal the sicknesses of my passions!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
O Christ, only Physician of souls and bodies: by the supplications of the martyrs, heal the sicknesses of my passions!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣти́сѧ житїѐ твоѐ, * добродѣ́тельными свѣ́тлостьми, * вѣ́рныѧ просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ ле́сти тьмꙋ̀ рагна́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆́стинное бо ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ свѣ́тоза́рное сл҃нце, * ст҃лю преблаже́нне митрофа́не : * и҆ нн҃ѣ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * и҆де́же сїѧ́етъ свѣ́тъ невече́рный, * и҆ сн҃ъ днѐ бл҃года́тїю дх҃а ст҃а́гѡ бы́въ . * тѣ́мже твою̀ бж҃ественнꙋю па́мѧть и҆ свѣтоно́снꙋю, * че́стнѡ соверша́юще приснопа́мѧтне * любо́вїю почита́емъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A consecrated light by the operation of the Spirit wast thou revealed to be, O glorious martyr, offering forth fruitful virtues in thy sufferings.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
A consecrated light by the operation of the Spirit wast thou revealed to be, O glorious martyr, offering forth fruitful virtues in thy sufferings.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́мъ тво́й манове́нїемъ є҆́же къ бг҃ꙋ, * бг҃омꙋ́дре вѣ́рою ᲂу҆до́бремь * свѣ́телъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ всесла́вне, * въ ме́рственнемъ тѣ́лѣ и҆ тлѣ́ннемъ, * премꙋ́дре нетаѣ́нїю поꙋчи́всѧ, * притѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ безпло́тныхъ свѣ́тлости, * и҆ страсте́й внѣ̀ бы́въ, * безстра́стїемъ ᲂу҆краша́лсѧ митрофа́не, * ѻ҆́ч҃е ст҃лю премꙋ́дре, * свѣ́тлый свѣти́лниче, * и҆ мл҃твенниче ѡ҆ чтꙋ́щихъ * любо́вїю па́мѧть твою̀ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having the words of life in thy heart, O wise one, by thine opposition thou didst put to death the threats of the tyrants, O glorious one.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having the words of life in thy heart, O wise one, by thine opposition thou didst put to death the threats of the tyrants, O glorious one.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника, и҆лѝ бг҃оро́диченъ : Ра́дꙋйсѧ, зако́на и҆сполне́нїе . * ра́дꙋйсѧ, хра́ме свѧты́ѧ трⷪ҇цы, * невѣ́сто нетлѣ́ннаѧ . * ра́дꙋйсѧ, бж҃ественное носи́ло всѣ́хъ цр҃ѧ . * ра́дꙋйсѧ, ѻ҆́гню невеще́ственный, * ꙗ҆́кѡ клеща̀ носѧ́щи на рꙋкꙋ́хъ твои́хъ ᲂу҆́гля . * но́вый ра́ю, * вертогра́дъ затво́ренный, * трапе́за бж҃твеннаѧ пресвѣ́тлаѧ, * голуби́це нескве́рнаѧ, * прⷭ҇то́ле вы́шнягѡ, * ѻ҆́дръ бж҃ественный мы́сленный, * ю҆́же дх҃ъ ст҃ы́й ѻ҆трокови́це ѡ҆сѣнѝ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* An unassailable wall, and a haven, and confirmation, and hope, O pure Mother of God, and having thee as a divine armor, we are saved.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
An unassailable wall, and a haven, and confirmation, and hope, O pure Mother of God, and having thee as a divine armor, we are saved.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ : А҆́гница своего̀, * а҆́гница нескве́рнаѧ дре́вле, и҆ непоро́чна влⷣчца, * на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ воздви́жена ꙗ҆́кѡ ᲂу҆зрѣ̀, * ма́терски восклица́ше, * и҆ дивѧ́щисѧ вопїѧ́ше : * ча́до сладча́йшее, * что̀ видѣ́нїе сїѐ но́вое и҆ пресла́вное ? * ка́кѡ собо́ръ безблагада́тный * сꙋди́щꙋ пїла́товꙋ предаде́ тѧ, * и҆ ѡ҆сꙋжда́етъ на сме́рть * всѣ́хъ живота̀ ? * но вопѣва́ю твоѐ незрече́нное, сло́ве схожде́нїе .
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities; and lead me up from the abyss of evils, I pray Thee: for unto Thee have I cried, and hear me, O God of my salvation!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities; and lead me up from the abyss of evils, I pray Thee: for unto Thee have I cried, and hear me, O God of my salvation!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, д҃ . Пра́вило вѣ́ры и҆ ѻ҆́бразъ кро́тости, воздержа́нїа ᲂу҆чи́телѧ ꙗ҆ви́ тѧ ста́дꙋ твое́мꙋ, ꙗ҆́же веще́й и҆́стина . сегѡ̀ ра́ди стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ смире́нїемъ высо́каѧ, нището́ю бога́таѧ, ѻ҆́ч҃е сщ҃еннонача́льниче митрофа́не, молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having mentally elevated the divine desire of thy soul, thou didst boldly rush toward the tormentor's fire, and by the dew of the Spirit thou wast refreshed with the children, O all-blessed sufferer.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having mentally elevated the divine desire of thy soul, thou didst boldly rush toward the tormentor's fire, and by the dew of the Spirit thou wast refreshed with the children, O all-blessed sufferer.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе :
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Strengthened by thy teachings, the wise martyr Paula contended patiently against the deceiver, and received the crown of righteousness from the hand of Christ the Prize-giver.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Strengthened by thy teachings, the wise martyr Paula contended patiently against the deceiver, and received the crown of righteousness from the hand of Christ the Prize-giver.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p20 === (Fol. 9v) Вели́кагѡ митрофа́на пою̀ сла́вꙋ . Гла́съ, ѕ҃ . Пѣ́снь, а҃ . Їрмо́съ : Ꙗ҆́кѡ по сꙋ́хꙋ пѣ́шешествовавъ і҆и҃ль, по бе́зднѣ стопа́ми, гони́телѧ фараѡ́на, ви́дѧ потоплѧ́ема, бг҃ꙋ побѣ́дную пѣ́снь, пои́мъ вопїѧ́ше .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding thine unbending mind, immovable as Mount Zion,[^20] the enemy could not endure it; but he was put to shame and trampled unto the earth by thee, O divinely wise one, in the struggle of suffering.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Beholding thine unbending mind, immovable as Mount Zion,[^20] the enemy could not endure it; but he was put to shame and trampled unto the earth by thee, O divinely wise one, in the struggle of suffering.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Съ вы́шними ли́ки ꙗ҆́кѡ ст҃ль, ꙗ҆́кѡ бж҃їй служи́тель предстоѧ̀, ѡ҆ на́съ прилѣ́жнѡ моли́сѧ, полꙋчи́ти на́мъ вѣ́чнаѧ бл҃га́ѧ мл҃твами твои́ми .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Truly thou didst conceive the Divine Word in thy womb, and Him beyond nature didst thou bear, O all-pure one. Make Him merciful through thy prayers, to deliver thy servants from all tribulations.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Truly thou didst conceive the Divine Word in thy womb, and Him beyond nature didst thou bear, O all-pure one. Make Him merciful through thy prayers, to deliver thy servants from all tribulations.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆збра́нъ бы́въ гдⷭ҇еви служи́ти чⷭ҇тно́мꙋ є҆ѵл҃їю, блаже́нне митрофа́не, во благоразꙋ́мїи лю́ди, ᲂу҆че́нїи премꙋ́дрыми ѻ҆́ч҃е возрасти́лъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *The Children that came from Judea in Babylon of old, by faith in the Trinity trampled the flame of the furnace, singing: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*The Children that came from Judea in Babylon of old, by faith in the Trinity trampled the flame of the furnace, singing: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ра́зꙋмомъ бж҃їимъ ѡ҆бога́щсѧ, сло́во живо́тное ѿ се́рдца и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ, напоѧ́ѧ дꙋ́шы ѡ҆ладѣ́вшыѧ страстьмѝ, премꙋ́дре ст҃лю бж҃їй, митрофа́не бг҃облаже́нне .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With Paul didst thou cry aloud, O martyr: Neither tribulation, nor distress, nor wounds, nor the sword shall separate me from the love

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With Paul didst thou cry aloud, O martyr: Neither tribulation, nor distress, nor wounds, nor the sword shall separate me from the love

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Їрмо́съ : Нѣ́сть ст҃ъ ꙗ҆́коже ты̀ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е мо́й, вознесы́й ро́гъ вѣ́рныхъ твои́хъ бл҃же, и҆ ᲂу҆тверди́вый на́съ на ка́мени и҆сповѣ́данїа твоегѡ̀ .
items.english_text: of Christ![^21] Therefore didst thou also cry aloud: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

provenance.verbatim_source: of Christ![^21] Therefore didst thou also cry aloud: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆сточа́ѧ бж҃ественнꙋю сла́дость, и҆з̾ ᲂу҆сте́нъ твои́хъ ѻ҆́ч҃е, и҆ горька́гѡ безбо́жїа и҆зсꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ ка́пли, напои́въ бл҃гочести́выхъ питїе́мъ, бж҃їагѡ ра́зꙋма блаже́нне .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Upon the rock of divine confession thou didst establish thy feet, appearing unshakeable by the storm of tribulations. Therefore didst thou cry aloud: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*

To comprehend the ineffable depth of thy childbearing, O pure one, human mind is at a loss; for God, having humbled Himself out of tender mercies, in thy womb renewed me entirely.

items.slavonic_text: Та́же сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, и҃ . Подо́бенъ : Премꙋ́дрости : Надъ страстьмѝ цр҃твова́въ плотски́ми, ст҃и́тель ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the highest" (Вы́шнихъ и҆щѧ̀):*[^28] In that thou didst preach the faith of Christ and didst preserve it, thou didst truly increase thy faithful flock into a multitude; therefore with the Angels, O Metrophanes, thou rejoicest together, unceasingly praying unto Christ for all of us!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́здника, и҆лѝ бг҃оро́диченъ : Въ напа̑сти многоплете́нныѧ впа́дъ, ѿ вра̑гъ ви́димыхъ и҆ неви́димыхъ, бꙋ́рею ѡ҆держи́мь безчи́сленныхъ согрѣше́нїй мои́хъ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ къ те́пломꙋ застꙋпле́нїю и҆ покро́вꙋ моемꙋ̀ чи́стаѧ, ко приста́нищꙋ притека́ю твоеѧ̀ бл҃гости . тѣ́мже пречи́стаѧ, и҆́же и҆з̾ тебѐ воплоще́нномꙋ безъ сѣ́мене, моли́сѧ прилѣ́жнѡ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ рабѣ́хъ твои́хъ, непреста́ннѡ молѧ́щихтисѧ бцⷣе пречⷭ҇таѧ, молѧ́щи є҆го̀ при́снѡ, согрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, воспѣва́ющымъ досто́йнѡ сла́вꙋ твою̀ .
items.english_text: to be Godlike, and the imperial city didst thou gloriously shepherd, driving off the heretical ranks, O venerable one, with the staff of divinely-inspired words. Therefore after thy demise thou didst worthily inherit unending grace, O blessed hierarch! Therefore we cry unto thee: Pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto them that honor thy most honorable memory!

provenance.verbatim_source: to be Godlike, and the imperial city didst thou gloriously shepherd, driving off the heretical ranks, O venerable one, with the staff of divinely-inspired words. Therefore after thy demise thou didst worthily inherit unending grace, O blessed hierarch! Therefore we cry unto thee: Pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto them that honor thy most honorable memory!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃ . Їрмо́съ : Хрⷭ҇то́съ моѧ̀ си́ла бг҃ъ и҆ гдⷭ҇ь, чⷭ҇тна́ѧ цр҃ковь, бг҃олѣ́пнѡ пое́тъ взыва́ющи, ѿ смы́сла чи́ста, ѡ҆ гдⷭ҇ѣ пра́зднꙋющи .
items.english_text: Having fallen into multifaceted temptations from enemies visible and invisible, held fast by the tempest of mine unnumbered transgressions: as unto my fervent protection and shelter, O pure one, I flee unto the haven of thy goodness. Therefore, O all-immaculate one, earnestly pray unto Him Who was incarnate from thee without seed on behalf of all thy servants who unceasingly pray unto thee, O all-pure Birthgiver of God, ever beseeching Him to grant remission of transgressions unto them that worthily sing thy glory!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having fallen into multifaceted temptations from enemies visible and invisible, held fast by the tempest of mine unnumbered transgressions: as unto my fervent protection and shelter, O pure one, I flee unto the haven of thy goodness. Therefore, O all-immaculate one, earnestly pray unto Him Who was incarnate from thee without seed on behalf of all thy servants who unceasingly pray unto thee, O all-pure Birthgiver of God, ever beseeching Him to grant remission of transgressions unto them that worthily sing thy glory!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ и҆спо́лненъ ст҃а́гѡ дх҃а, сщ҃е́нный ѻ҆́ч҃е митрофа́не, лꙋка̑выѧ дꙋ́хи ѿ чл҃къ ѿгна́лъ є҆сѝ, вѣ́рны же дꙋхо́вными ᲂу҆че́нїи твои́ми сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding the Lamb and Shepherd and Deliverer upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb cried aloud, weeping and bitterly lamenting, she cried out: The world indeed rejoices, receiving deliverance through Thee; but my womb burns, beholding Thy crucifixion which Thou endurest for the tender mercy of compassion, O longsuffering Lord, bottomless abyss of mercy and inexhaustible fountain: have mercy and grant remission of transgressions unto them that in faith sing of Thy divine passions!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
Beholding the Lamb and Shepherd and Deliverer upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb cried aloud, weeping and bitterly lamenting, she cried out: The world indeed rejoices, receiving deliverance through Thee; but my womb burns, beholding Thy crucifixion which Thou endurest for the tender mercy of compassion, O longsuffering Lord, bottomless abyss of mercy and inexhaustible fountain: have mercy and grant remission of transgressions unto them that in faith sing of Thy divine passions!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́ницꙋ несозда́ннꙋю бг҃осло́вилъ є҆сѝ, тремѝ ли́цы раздѣли́мꙋ, непресѣ́комꙋ и҆ несмѣ́снꙋ, просвѣща́ѧ бл҃гочести̑выѧ сщ҃енными бг҃осло́вїи твои́ми .
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *Christ is my power, God and Lord, the venerable Church sings in a manner befitting God, crying aloud from a pure mind, keeping festival in the Lord.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*Christ is my power, God and Lord, the venerable Church sings in a manner befitting God, crying aloud from a pure mind, keeping festival in the Lord.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́въ пе́рвѣе плотска́ѧ мꙋдрова́нїѧ, воздержа́нїемъ и҆ трꙋды̀, ст҃ль бж҃е́ственъ показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ, и҆ предста́тель трⷪ҇цѣ всесщ҃е́нъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being filled with the Holy Spirit, O consecrated father Metrophanes, thou didst drive away evil spirits from men, and didst make the faithful steadfast by thy spiritual teachings.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Being filled with the Holy Spirit, O consecrated father Metrophanes, thou didst drive away evil spirits from men, and didst make the faithful steadfast by thy spiritual teachings.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Клѧ́тва разори́сѧ пра́бабнаѧ тобо́ю бг҃ома́ти, ты́ бо на́мъ пречⷭ҇таѧ и҆сто́чника породи́ла є҆сѝ ст҃ы́ни присносꙋ́щнаго живота̀ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst theologize the uncreated Unity, divided in three Persons, indivisible and unconfused, enlightening the pious by thy sacred theologies.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst theologize the uncreated Unity, divided in three Persons, indivisible and unconfused, enlightening the pious by thy sacred theologies.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃ . Їрмо́съ : Бж҃їимъ свѣ́томъ твои́мъ бл҃же, ᲂу҆́тренюющихъ тѝ дꙋ́шы
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having first put to death carnal mindsets by abstinence and labors, a divine hierarch wast thou revealed, and an all-consecrated advocate of the Trinity.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having first put to death carnal mindsets by abstinence and labors, a divine hierarch wast thou revealed, and an all-consecrated advocate of the Trinity.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p22 === (Fol. 10v) дꙋ́шы любо́вїю ѡ҆зарѝ молю́сѧ, тѧ̀ вѣ́дѣти сло́ве бж҃їй, и҆́стиннаго бг҃а, ѿ мра́ка грѣхо́внагѡ взыва́ющыѧ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The ancestral curse was destroyed through thee, O Mother of God; for unto us, O all-pure one, thou didst bring forth the fountain of holiness of ever-existing life.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The ancestral curse was destroyed through thee, O Mother of God; for unto us, O all-pure one, thou didst bring forth the fountain of holiness of ever-existing life.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃їа бж҃твеннѣ соверша́ѧ, и҆ чистѣ́йшымъ по́мысломъ чⷭ҇ты̑мъ прикаса́ѧсѧ, непоро́ченъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, слꙋжа̀ бг҃ꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бж҃їй ст҃и́тель сщ҃еннѣ́йшїй .
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *By Thy divine light, O Good One, the souls of them that rise early unto Thee with love do Thou illumine, I pray Thee,*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*By Thy divine light, O Good One, the souls of them that rise early unto Thee with love do Thou illumine, I pray Thee,*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃года́тїю призва́нъ бы́въ, разруши́лъ є҆сѝ безбѡ́жїа і҆́дѡлскаѧ, ѡ҆дожде́нїемъ слове́съ твои́хъ прпⷣбне, ѡ҆ладѣ́вшаѧ сердца̀ плодоно́сна содѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ, бж҃їею блг҃тїю .
items.english_text: to know Thee, O Word of God, as true God, calling [them] out from the gloom of sin.

provenance.verbatim_source: to know Thee, O Word of God, as true God, calling [them] out from the gloom of sin.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : По ржⷭ҇твѣ̀ твое́мъ стра́ннѣмъ, пребыла̀ є҆сѝ дв҃ою, ꙗ҆́коже пре́жде : бг҃ъ бо бѣ̀ рожде́йсѧ, и҆ претворѧ́ѧй всѧ̑ во́лею, безмꙋ́жнаѧ мр҃і́е бг҃оневѣ́стнаѧ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Accomplishing the things of God in a divine manner, and touching the holy things with purest contemplation, blameless wast thou shown to be, serving God as a most consecrated hierarch of God.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Accomplishing the things of God in a divine manner, and touching the holy things with purest contemplation, blameless wast thou shown to be, serving God as a most consecrated hierarch of God.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃ . Їрмо́съ : Жите́йское мо́ре воздвиза́емое зрѧ̀ напа́стей бꙋ́рею, къ ти́хомꙋ приста́нищꙋ твоемꙋ̀ прите́къ, вопїю́ ти : возведѝ ѿ тлѝ живо́тъ мо́й многоми́лостиве .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Servants of idols became servants unto God through thy venerable teachings; snatching them away from unworthy things, thou wast shown to be a worthy servant unto God the Almighty.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Servants of idols became servants unto God through thy venerable teachings; snatching them away from unworthy things, thou wast shown to be a worthy servant unto God the Almighty.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆зы́къ тво́й дх҃омъ и҆з̾ѡщре́нъ разꙋ́мнѡ, ꙗ҆́кѡ тро́сть скоропи́сца, написа̀ въ сердца̀ бл҃гочести́выхъ сло́во бл҃года́тное всесщ҃е́нне ѻ҆́ч҃е, бж҃їимъ манове́нїемъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Called by grace, thou didst destroy the godlessness of idols; by the shower of thy words, O venerable one, thou didst make hearts that had been possessed to be fruitful by the grace of God.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Called by grace, thou didst destroy the godlessness of idols; by the shower of thy words, O venerable one, thou didst make hearts that had been possessed to be fruitful by the grace of God.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃твеннымъ поꙋча́ѧсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ входа̀ въ мы́слєннаѧ ст҃а́ѧ ст҃ы́хъ, вѣ́рныхъ соверша́еши дх҃омъ, трⷪ҇ческою заре́ю, сщ҃енный ѻ҆́ч҃е всесоверше́ннѣйшїй митрофа́не .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* After thy strange childbearing, thou didst remain a virgin as before; for God was the One born, Who transforms all things by His will, O unwedded Mary, Bride of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
After thy strange childbearing, thou didst remain a virgin as before; for God was the One born, Who transforms all things by His will, O unwedded Mary, Bride of God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Струѧ́ми велѣ́ній твои́хъ, загради́въ мꙋ̑тнаѧ, нечести́выхъ велѣ́нїа, ꙗ҆́кѡ рѣка̀ показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ ми́рная, бл҃гоче́стїа напоѧ́ѧ соста́влєнїа вѣ́рныхъ, ст҃и́телю всече́стне .
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *Beholding the sea of life surging with the tempest of temptations, fleeing unto Thy calm haven, I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, O most Merciful One!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*Beholding the sea of life surging with the tempest of temptations, fleeing unto Thy calm haven, I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, O most Merciful One!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Сло́во во чре́вѣ твое́мъ всели́сѧ безъ сѣ́мене, и҆ чл҃къ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ соверше́нъ, ѡ҆бновлѧ́ѧ є҆стество̀ бг҃олѣ́пнѡ, ꙗ҆́коже са́мъ вѣ́сть є҆ди́нъ, бг҃опрїѧ́тнаѧ ѻ҆трокови́це всенепоро́чнаѧ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy tongue, wisely sharpened by the Spirit like the pen of a quickly writing scribe,[^30] inscribed the word of grace into the hearts of the pious, O all-consecrated father, by the divine nod.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thy tongue, wisely sharpened by the Spirit like the pen of a quickly writing scribe,[^30] inscribed the word of grace into the hearts of the pious, O all-consecrated father, by the divine nod.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, в҃ . Подо́бенъ : Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ дне́сь : Ѿ младе́нства ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ че́стенъ сосꙋ́дъ, ст҃ль бы́въ и҆збра́нъ бг҃ꙋ, є҆мꙋ́же съ весе́лїемъ взыва́лъ є҆сѝ : ра́венъ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇тѐ ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ дх҃ꙋ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Instructed in divine things, as entering into the noetic Holy of Holies, thou dost perfect the faithful by the Spirit with the radiance of the Trinity, O consecrated father, most perfect Metrophanes!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Instructed in divine things, as entering into the noetic Holy of Holies, thou dost perfect the faithful by the Spirit with the radiance of the Trinity, O consecrated father, most perfect Metrophanes!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ї́косъ : Тако́въ подоба́ше на́мъ а҆рхїере́й, и҆ та́инникъ сло́ва бж҃їа и҆ служи́тель, ꙗ҆́коже па́ѵлъ взываетъ, бж҃твенный ѻ҆рга́нъ хрⷭ҇то́въ, слꙋ́жбы приносѧ̀ всегда̀ бг҃ꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ непоро́ченъ и҆ че́стенъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having dammed the turbid decrees of the ungodly by the streams of thy commandments, thou wast revealed as a peaceful river, watering the congregations of the faithful with piety, O all-honorable hierarch!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having dammed the turbid decrees of the ungodly by the streams of thy commandments, thou wast revealed as a peaceful river, watering the congregations of the faithful with piety, O all-honorable hierarch!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p23 === (Fol. 11r) че́стенъ : тѣ́ломъ ᲂу҆́бѡ тлѣ́ннымъ ви́димь ѡ҆бложе́нъ, со безпло́тными же бесѣ́дꙋѧ въ слꙋже́нїи, и҆ лю́демъ согрѣше́нїа ѿе́млѧ, мѣ́риломъ пра́веднымъ, ꙗ҆́коже вели́кїй ст҃и́тель нн҃ѣ митрофа́нъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ на́мъ, проповѣ́давъ со дерзнове́нїемъ : ра́венъ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇тѐ ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ дх҃ꙋ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Word took up His dwelling in thy womb without seed, and appeared as perfect man, renewing nature in a manner befitting God, as He alone knows, O God-welcoming Maiden, all-immaculate one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The Word took up His dwelling in thy womb without seed, and appeared as perfect man, renewing nature in a manner befitting God, as He alone knows, O God-welcoming Maiden, all-immaculate one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃ . Їрмо́съ : Росода́тельнꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь содѣ́ла а҆́гг҃лъ, преподо́бнымъ ѻ҆трокѡ́мъ, халде́и же ѡ҆палѧ́ющее велѣ́нїе бж҃їе, мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆вѣща̀ вопи́ти : бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ .
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "Thou hast appeared today" (Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ дне́сь):*[^31] From infancy thou wast shown to be an honorable vessel, having been chosen as a hierarch unto God, unto Whom with gladness thou didst cry aloud: Equal art Thou, O Christ, unto the Father and the Spirit!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "Thou hast appeared today" (Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ дне́сь):*[^31]
From infancy thou wast shown to be an honorable vessel, having been chosen as a hierarch unto God, unto Whom with gladness thou didst cry aloud: Equal art Thou, O Christ, unto the Father and the Spirit!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣща́емь дх҃о́вною бл҃года́тїю ꙗ҆́же къ бж҃твенномꙋ манове́нїю причаще́нїи, свѣтода́тельнаѧ бы́лъ є҆сѝ ѕвѣзда̀, просвѣща́ѧ мꙋ́дре пою́щыѧ : бл҃гве́нъ бг҃ъ ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ .
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Such a High Priest became us,[^32] an initiate of the Word of God and a minister, as Paul calls out, a divine instrument of Christ, ever offering services unto God, as blameless and honorable,

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ikos:*
Such a High Priest became us,[^32] an initiate of the Word of God and a minister, as Paul calls out, a divine instrument of Christ, ever offering services unto God, as blameless and honorable,

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Дрема́нїе ѿ ѻ҆́чїю ѿри́нꙋвъ, бж҃твенными бо́дростьми, бж҃їа сїѧ́нїа прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ ѿ а҆́гг҃ла свѣ́та, сто́лпъ и҆ подпо́ръ вѣ́рнымъ, свѧти́телю и҆́стинна соверша́юща тѧ̀ .
items.english_text: honorable: visibly clothed indeed with a corruptible body, yet conversing with the bodiless in the ministry, and taking away the transgressions of the people by a righteous measure, as the great hierarch Metrophanes hath now appeared unto us, proclaiming with boldness: Equal art Thou, O Christ, unto the Father and the Spirit!

provenance.verbatim_source: honorable: visibly clothed indeed with a corruptible body, yet conversing with the bodiless in the ministry, and taking away the transgressions of the people by a righteous measure, as the great hierarch Metrophanes hath now appeared unto us, proclaiming with boldness: Equal art Thou, O Christ, unto the Father and the Spirit!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Сѣдѧ́й въ нѣ́дрѣхъ роди́телѧ неѡпи́санъ, въ нѣ́дрѣхъ твои́хъ пречⷭ҇таѧ нн҃ѣ сѣди́тъ ѡ҆пи́санъ, твои́мъ ѡ҆бложе́нъ зра́комъ, за сп҃се́нїе а҆да́ма ѡ҆пи́санъ бы́въ .
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *The Angel made the furnace pour forth dew for the venerable Children, while the command of God, consuming the Chaldeans, persuaded the tyrant to cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*The Angel made the furnace pour forth dew for the venerable Children, while the command of God, consuming the Chaldeans, persuaded the tyrant to cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃ . Їрмо́съ : И҆зъ пла́мене прпⷣбнымъ ро́сꙋ и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ првⷣнагѡ же́ртвꙋ водо́ю попали́лъ є҆сѝ, всѧ̑ бо твори́ши хрⷭ҇тѐ то́кмѡ є҆́же хотѣ́ти : тѧ̀ превозно́симъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Illumined by spiritual grace through participation in the divine nod, thou wast a light-giving star, enlightening them that wisely sing: Blessed is God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Illumined by spiritual grace through participation in the divine nod, thou wast a light-giving star, enlightening them that wisely sing: Blessed is God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Го́рдаго ѕмі́а, смире́нїемъ твои́мъ смири́лъ є҆сѝ блаже́нне, возвыша́емь къ бг҃ꙋ чи́стыми твои́ми ра́зꙋмы : тѣ́мже тѧ̀ чти́мъ, хрⷭ҇та̀ превозносѧ́ще во вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having become a shining church, illumined by virtuous deeds, thou didst have the uncreated Trinity dwelling within thee, O consecrated one, crying aloud: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having become a shining church, illumined by virtuous deeds, thou didst have the uncreated Trinity dwelling within thee, O consecrated one, crying aloud: Blessed is the God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Воплоще́нно сло́во бг҃осло́вилъ є҆сѝ, и҆ лю́ди ѿ рабо́тныѧ ле́сти спа́слъ є҆сѝ, ѿгонѧ́ѧ і҆́дѡлскаѧ нече́стїа, ѻ҆́ч҃е ст҃ителю митрофа́не, премꙋ́дре и҆ бг҃оно́се .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Casting away slumber from thine eyes by divine vigilance, thou didst receive divine splendors from the Angel of light, which made thee a pillar and support unto the faithful, O hierarch of the truth!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Casting away slumber from thine eyes by divine vigilance, thou didst receive divine splendors from the Angel of light, which made thee a pillar and support unto the faithful, O hierarch of the truth!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Житїѐ твоѐ лицꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ и҆мѣ́ѧ подо́бно, и҆ сло́во житїю̀ и҆мѣ́ѧ подоба́ющеесѧ : и҆спо́лненъ бы́въ дне́й дх҃овныхъ ѻ҆́ч҃е, въ вы́шнѧѧ преше́лъ є҆сѝ покѡ́ища .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who sits uncircumscribed in the bosom of the Father, now sits circumscribed in thy womb, O all-pure one, clothed in thy form, having become circumscribed for the salvation of Adam.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
He Who sits uncircumscribed in the bosom of the Father, now sits circumscribed in thy womb, O all-pure one, clothed in thy form, having become circumscribed for the salvation of Adam.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : И҆зба́вльшесѧ пе́рвыѧ клѧ́твы твои́мъ ржⷭ҇твомъ, пребл҃гослове́ннаѧ ѻ҆трокови́це бг҃ора́дованнаѧ, гла́съ гаврїи́ловъ возсыла́емъ тѝ : ра́дꙋйсѧ вина̀ всѣ́хъ спасе́нїа .
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *From the flame didst Thou pour forth dew for the venerable, and the sacrifice of the righteous one didst Thou consume with water; for Thou, O Christ, makest all things solely by willing: Thee do we exalt above all unto all ages!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*From the flame didst Thou pour forth dew for the venerable, and the sacrifice of the righteous one didst Thou consume with water; for Thou, O Christ, makest all things solely by willing: Thee do we exalt above all unto all ages!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p24 === (Fol. 11v) Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃ . Їрмо́съ : Бг҃а чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ невозмо́жно ви́дѣти, на него́же не смѣ́ютъ чи́ни а҆́гг҃лстїи взира́ти : тобо́ю бо всечⷭ҇таѧ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ, сло́во воплоще́нно : є҆го́же велича́юще, съ нбⷭ҇ными во́и тѧ̀ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The proud serpent didst thou humble by thy humility, O blessed one, being elevated unto God by thy pure thoughts; therefore do we honor thee, exalting Christ above all unto the ages.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The proud serpent didst thou humble by thy humility, O blessed one, being elevated unto God by thy pure thoughts; therefore do we honor thee, exalting Christ above all unto the ages.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Въ зе́млю кро́ткихъ ты̀ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ, ст҃и́телю, кро́токъ и҆ неѕло́бивъ бы́въ, съ вы́шними совѡкꙋплѧ́ѧсѧ во́инствы, ве́сь ᲂу҆кра́шенъ добродѣ́тельными свѣ́тлостьми, и҆ свѣ́томъ добродѣ́телей преѡдѣ́ѧнъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst theologize the incarnate Word, and didst save the people from the deceit of slavery, driving away the impiety of idols, O father and hierarch Metrophanes, all-wise and God-bearer!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst theologize the incarnate Word, and didst save the people from the deceit of slavery, driving away the impiety of idols, O father and hierarch Metrophanes, all-wise and God-bearer!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Зри́ши бж҃їа и҆ а҆́гг҃лскїѧ свѣ́тлѡсти, патрїа́рхъ, и҆ мч҃нкъ, и҆ а҆пⷭ҇лскїѧ красоты̀, молѧ̀ съ ни́ми чл҃вѣколю́бца, ѡ҆ставле́нїе грѣхѡ́въ, и҆ житїѧ̀ и҆справле́нїе, дарова́ти на́мъ прпⷣбне хва́лѧщымъ тѧ̀ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having thy life befitting thy countenance, and having speech befitting thy life: being filled with spiritual days, O father, thou didst pass over into the resting-places on high.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having thy life befitting thy countenance, and having speech befitting thy life: being filled with spiritual days, O father, thou didst pass over into the resting-places on high.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же престо́лъ пе́рвѣе ᲂу҆кра́силъ є҆сѝ свѣ́тлѡ, всѣ́хъ предсѣда́щихъ градѡ́въ, въ не́мже пожи́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гг҃лъ, и҆ ст҃и́тельствомъ се́й ᲂу҆крѣпи́въ, пома́завъ ѡ҆ст҃и́лъ є҆сѝ, соверши́въ лю́ди бг҃омꙋ́дры .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having been delivered from the first curse by thy childbearing, O all-blessed Maiden, full of the grace of God, we send up unto thee the voice of Gabriel: Rejoice, cause of the salvation of all!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having been delivered from the first curse by thy childbearing, O all-blessed Maiden, full of the grace of God, we send up unto thee the voice of Gabriel: Rejoice, cause of the salvation of all!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ленъ . Подо́бенъ : Же́ны ᲂу҆слы́шите : Звѣздꙋ̀ тѧ̀ многосвѣ́тлꙋю цр҃кве зна́емъ, митрофа́не ст҃и́телю, патрїа́рхѡвъ свѣ́тлость : а҆́рїево бо хꙋле́нїе собо́рнѣ низложи́лъ є҆сѝ, правосла́вными ᲂу҆че́нїи цр҃ковь ᲂу҆ꙗ҆сни́въ . тѣ́мже вѣ́рнѡ тѧ̀ пое́мъ .
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *It is not possible for men to see God, upon Whom the ranks of Angels dare not gaze; but through thee, O all-pure one, the incarnate Word appeared unto men: Whom magnifying, together with the heavenly hosts we call thee blessed.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
*It is not possible for men to see God, upon Whom the ranks of Angels dare not gaze; but through thee, O all-pure one, the incarnate Word appeared unto men: Whom magnifying, together with the heavenly hosts we call thee blessed.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ : Премꙋ́дрость ѵ҆поста́снꙋю, и҆ сло́во пресꙋ́щное, и҆ врача̀ дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣле́съ ро́ждшаѧ, гное́нїе и҆ ꙗ҆́звы дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ и҆сцѣлѝ лю̑тыѧ и҆ лѣ̑тныѧ, и҆ се́рдца моегѡ̀ ᲂу҆ста́ви болѣ́зни дв҃о .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Into the land of the meek didst thou take up thy dwelling, O hierarch, having been meek and guileless, joining together with the hosts on high, wholly adorned with virtuous splendors and clothed with the light of virtues.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Into the land of the meek didst thou take up thy dwelling, O hierarch, having been meek and guileless, joining together with the hosts on high, wholly adorned with virtuous splendors and clothed with the light of virtues.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же, въ є҃ . де́нь . Ст҃а́гѡ сщ҃енномч҃ника дѡроѳе́а, є҆пі́скопа тѵ́рскагѡ . Стїхи̑ры, гла́съ, и҃ . По: Мꙋ́ченицы твоѝ гдⷭ҇и : Оу҆чє́нїи бж҃їа дх҃а бг҃облаже́нне показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е, бж҃твеннаѧ ᲂу҆че́нїа, пи́сана носѧ̀ въ ра́зꙋмѣ бж҃е́ственнѣ : тѣ́хъ разигнꙋ́тїемъ просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ, неразꙋ́мїемъ бѣ́дствꙋющыѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou beholdest the splendors of God and of the Angels, the beauty of patriarchs, and of martyrs, and of Apostles, praying with them unto the Lover of mankind to grant remission of sins and correction of life unto us who praise thee, O venerable one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou beholdest the splendors of God and of the Angels, the beauty of patriarchs, and of martyrs, and of Apostles, praying with them unto the Lover of mankind to grant remission of sins and correction of life unto us who praise thee, O venerable one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p25 === (Fol. 12r) щыѧ . тѣ́мъ твои́ми мл҃твами, просѝ на́мъ всѣ́мъ ѻ҆́ч҃е ве́лїю ми́лость .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou who didst first brightly adorn the throne of the presiding of all cities, wherein having lived as an Angel, and having strengthened it by the hierarch's office, by anointing thou didst sanctify it, perfecting the people divinely-wise.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou who didst first brightly adorn the throne of the presiding of all cities, wherein having lived as an Angel, and having strengthened it by the hierarch's office, by anointing thou didst sanctify it, perfecting the people divinely-wise.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Крове́й бж҃твенными тече́нїи, ѡ҆багри́въ твою̀ сщ҃еннꙋю ѻ҆де́ждꙋ дѡроѳе́е, вше́лъ є҆сѝ ра́дꙋѧсѧ въ нбⷭ҇ный хра́мъ, ны́нѣ ꙗ҆ви́тисѧ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ, подаю́щемꙋ вѣнцы̑ страда́вшымъ . того̀ прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ, всѣ̑мъ низпосла́ти ве́лїю мл҃ть .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As a heavenly drop the rain came down into thy womb, O Virgin, and dried up the streams of corruption, O holy one: shower incorruption upon all men, and deliverance was granted through thee, O thou full of the grace of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
As a heavenly drop the rain came down into thy womb, O Virgin, and dried up the streams of corruption, O holy one: shower incorruption upon all men, and deliverance was granted through thee, O thou full of the grace of God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Житїе́ твоѐ равноа́гг҃льно, мꙋче́нїе же просвѣще́нно, и҆́мже сподо́билсѧ є҆сѝ со а҆́гг҃лы ликова́ти въ ра́дости, чꙋдесы̀ зе́млю ѻ҆́ч҃е дѡроѳе́е бж҃твенными ѡ҆зарѧ́ѧ и҆ ᲂу҆че́ньми : тѣ́мъ твои́ми мл҃твами просѝ дарова́ти всѣ̑мъ велїю мл҃ть .
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion, Podoben: "Give ear, ye women" (Же́ны ᲂу҆слы́шите):*[^33] As a much-radiant star of the Church do we know thee, O hierarch Metrophanes, splendor of patriarchs; for thou didst synodically cast down the blasphemy of Arius, making the Church clear by Orthodox teachings. Therefore in faith we sing thy praise.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Exapostilarion, Podoben: "Give ear, ye women" (Же́ны ᲂу҆слы́шите):*[^33]
As a much-radiant star of the Church do we know thee, O hierarch Metrophanes, splendor of patriarchs; for thou didst synodically cast down the blasphemy of Arius, making the Church clear by Orthodox teachings. Therefore in faith we sing thy praise.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: А҆́зъ є҆́смь дре́во непло́дное, всенепоро́чнаѧ, неплодѧ́щее плода̀ спаси́тельнагѡ . тѣ́мже и҆ трепе́щꙋ посѣче́нїа, да не ка́кѡ вве́рженъ бꙋ́дꙋ, во ѻ҆́гнь негаси́мый, ѡ҆каѧ́нный . тѣ́мже тѝ припа́даю, сегѡ̀ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀, и҆ плодоно́сна покажѝ чⷭ҇таѧ сн҃ꙋ твоемꙋ̀, хода́тайствомъ твои́мъ .
items.english_text: O thou who didst bear the hypostatic Wisdom, and the consubstantial Word, and the Physician of souls and bodies: heal the grievous and longstanding putrefaction and sores of my soul, and quiet the sicknesses of my heart, O Virgin!

provenance.verbatim_source: O thou who didst bear the hypostatic Wisdom, and the consubstantial Word, and the Physician of souls and bodies: heal the grievous and longstanding putrefaction and sores of my soul, and quiet the sicknesses of my heart, O Virgin!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p26 === (Fol. 12v) да́же до кро́ве, сщ҃енномꙋ́чениче дѡроѳе́е : молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ .
items.english_text: By the teachings of the divine Spirit wast thou shown, O divinely blessed father, bearing divine teachings inscribed in a divine understanding; by their unfolding thou didst enlighten them that were in peril through lack of understanding,

provenance.verbatim_source: By the teachings of the divine Spirit wast thou shown, O divinely blessed father, bearing divine teachings inscribed in a divine understanding; by their unfolding thou didst enlighten them that were in peril through lack of understanding,

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Да́ръ бг҃ꙋ всеблаже́нне тебеса́маго прине́слъ є҆сѝ чистѣ́йшїй, житїе́мъ соверше́ннымъ, и҆ чⷭ҇тны́мъ мꙋче́нїемъ дѡроѳе́е .
items.english_text: therefore by thy prayers ask great mercy for all of us, O father!

provenance.verbatim_source: therefore by thy prayers ask great mercy for all of us, O father!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже зрѣ́лъ гро́здъ ѻ҆́ч҃е, и҆згне́тъ мы́сль, весе́лїа ча́шꙋ вѣ́рнымъ ᲂу҆че́нїа предложи́лъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Having dyed thy sacred vesture with the divine streams of blood, O Dorotheus, rejoicing thou didst enter into the heavenly temple, now to appear before our God Who grants crowns unto them that have suffered. Earnestly beseech Him to send down great mercy upon all!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Having dyed thy sacred vesture with the divine streams of blood, O Dorotheus, rejoicing thou didst enter into the heavenly temple, now to appear before our God Who grants crowns unto them that have suffered. Earnestly beseech Him to send down great mercy upon all!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: То́ки ле̑стныѧ ᲂу҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ дѡроѳе́е, тече́ньми премꙋ́драгѡ твоегѡ̀ ꙗ҆́зыка, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ мы̑сли напои́лъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thy life was equal to the Angels, and thy martyrdom was enlightened, whereby thou wast accounted worthy to dance with the Angels in joy, illuminating the earth with divine wonders and teachings, O father Dorotheus; therefore by thy prayers ask that great mercy be granted unto all!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.section: Other Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃ . Їрмо́съ : Ты̀ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе, притека́ющихъ къ тебѣ́ гдⷭ҇и, ты̀ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ ѡ҆мраче́нныхъ, и҆ пое́тъ тѧ̀ дꙋ́хъ мо́й .
items.english_text: Snatch me, O Lady, from the hand of the manslaying serpent who strives deceitfully to swallow me up completely; crush his jaws, I pray thee, and destroy his subtleties, that having been delivered from his claws, I may magnify thy power!

provenance.verbatim_source: Snatch me, O Lady, from the hand of the manslaying serpent who strives deceitfully to swallow me up completely; crush his jaws, I pray thee, and destroy his subtleties, that having been delivered from his claws, I may magnify thy power!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Но́щь ѿгна́лъ є҆сѝ сꙋе́тства всѧ́кꙋ, блиста́нїи ѻ҆́ч҃е ст҃лю премꙋ́драгѡ проповѣ́данїа .
items.english_text: A barren tree am I, O all-immaculate one, bearing no fruit of salvation. Therefore do I tremble at the cutting down, lest I, the wretched one, be cast into the unquenchable fire. Therefore do I fall down before thee: deliver me from this, and by thine intercession show me fruitful unto thy Son, O pure one!

provenance.verbatim_source: A barren tree am I, O all-immaculate one, bearing no fruit of salvation. Therefore do I tremble at the cutting down, lest I, the wretched one, be cast into the unquenchable fire. Therefore do I fall down before thee: deliver me from this, and by thine intercession show me fruitful unto thy Son, O pure one!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋдесы̀ ᲂу҆тверди́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ сщ҃енными мꙋ́дре ᲂу҆че́нїи, вѣ́рныхъ всѣ́хъ мы̑сли, ꙗ҆́кѡ па́стырь сщ҃е́ненъ .
items.english_text: The deadly arrow of desire hath wounded my heart, and I was wounded through lack of understanding, and I am sick incurably. O Mother of God, despise not me who am despaired of, but grant me healing, as having borne the Lord and Savior, the only Merciful One!

provenance.verbatim_source: The deadly arrow of desire hath wounded my heart, and I was wounded through lack of understanding, and I am sick incurably. O Mother of God, despise not me who am despaired of, but grant me healing, as having borne the Lord and Savior, the only Merciful One!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Ѡ҆се́ се́рдце моѐ бж҃твеннымъ свѣ́томъ просвѣтѝ, две́ре свѣ́та, грѣхо́вное ѡ҆мраче́нїе ѿгонѧ́щи .
items.english_text: Impure are my thoughts, and deceitful my lips, and all my deeds are defiled, and what shall I do? How shall I meet the Judge? O good Virgin, pray unto thy Son and Creator and Lord, that He may receive my spirit in repentance, as the only Tender-hearted One!

provenance.verbatim_source: Impure are my thoughts, and deceitful my lips, and all my deeds are defiled, and what shall I do? How shall I meet the Judge? O good Virgin, pray unto thy Son and Creator and Lord, that He may receive my spirit in repentance, as the only Tender-hearted One!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone and Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, г҃ . Подо́бенъ : Бж҃твенныѧ вѣ́ры : Бж҃твенными до́гматы при́снѡ сїѧ́ющь да́ръ ст҃ы́и тебеса́маго прине́слъ є҆сѝ, без̾сме́ртномꙋ цр҃ю̀ пострада́въ дѡроѳе́е, и҆ ѡ҆бита́еши ны́нѣ при́снѡ весе́лѧсѧ, первородныхъ въ го́рнѣй митрополїи . ѻ҆́ч҃е преподо́бне, хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а молѝ, дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лїю мл҃ть .
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* The spotless Heifer, beholding the Young Bull willingly nailed upon the Tree, weeping piteously cried aloud: Woe is me, most beloved Child! What hath the ungrateful Jewish assembly rendered unto Thee, wishing to make me childless of Thee, O dearly Beloved?

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ : Бж҃ественнагѡ є҆стества̀ не ѿлꙋчи́сѧ, пло́ть бы́въ во чре́вѣ твое́мъ : но бг҃ъ вочл҃вѣ́чсѧ и҆ пребы́сть, и҆́же по рождествѣ̀ мт҃рь тѧ̀ дв҃ꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ пре́жде ржⷭ҇тва сохрани́въ всенепоро́чнꙋ, є҆ди́нъ гдⷭ҇ь : того̀ прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ, дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость .
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* And partaker of the character, and successor unto the thrones of the Apostles having become, thou didst find deed, O divinely inspired one, as an ascent unto contemplation: therefore rightly dividing the word of truth, for the faith's sake thou didst suffer even
