items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p27 === (Fol. 13r) мт҃рски подо́бнѡ рыда́ющи, вопїѧ́ше : ᲂу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ ча́до моѐ, ка́кѡ стра́ждеши во́лею ? хотѧ̀ и҆зба́вити ѿ страсте́й безче́стїа человѣ́ка .
items.english_text: unto blood, O hieromartyr Dorotheus: pray unto Christ God that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: unto blood, O hieromartyr Dorotheus: pray unto Christ God that our souls may be saved!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мро́зно́снꙋю ѡ҆плева́лъ є҆сѝ преподо́бне зи́мꙋ безбо́жїа, и҆ теплото́ю бж҃твеннагѡ дх҃а, невреди́мо се́рдце соблю́лъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* *Let us sing unto the Lord, Who led His people through the Red Sea, for He alone hath been gloriously glorified.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1. Heirmos:*
*Let us sing unto the Lord, Who led His people through the Red Sea, for He alone hath been gloriously glorified.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Скрꙋши́шасѧ дѡроѳе́е блаже́не пред̾ лице́мъ твои́мъ, го́ры но́жныѧ демо́нскїѧ, и҆ и҆ста́ѧша ѕлочести́выхъ чл҃къ шата́нїа .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a most pure gift unto God, O all-blessed one, thou didst offer thyself, by a perfect life and by venerable martyrdom, O Dorotheus.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
As a most pure gift unto God, O all-blessed one, thou didst offer thyself, by a perfect life and by venerable martyrdom, O Dorotheus.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Терпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ ѡ҆скорблѧ́емь, ѿ гра́да во гра́дъ и҆згони́мь : тѣ́мже бл҃же́ннꙋю ᲂу҆лꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ, мч҃никъ сла́вꙋ и҆ свѣ́тлость .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Like a ripe cluster of grapes, O father, having pressed thy mind, thou didst set forth the cup of gladness of teaching unto the faithful.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Like a ripe cluster of grapes, O father, having pressed thy mind, thou didst set forth the cup of gladness of teaching unto the faithful.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : И҆скꙋше́ній мѧ̀ спасѝ и҆ дꙋшетлѣ́нныхъ страсте́й бцⷣе, ꙗ҆́кѡ да вѣ́рою ᲂу҆блажа́ю тѧ̀, прест҃а́ѧ ѻ҆трокови́це мт҃и дв҃о .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst stop the deceitful streams, O Dorotheus, by the currents of thy most wise tongue, and didst water the minds of the faithful.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst stop the deceitful streams, O Dorotheus, by the currents of thy most wise tongue, and didst water the minds of the faithful.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃ . Їрмо́съ : Ѿ но́щи невѣ́дѣнїа, бг҃овѣ́дѣнїемъ просвѣти́вый концы̑, просвѣти́ мѧ ᲂу҆́тромъ чл҃вѣколю́бїа твоегѡ̀ гдⷭ҇и .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Shower upon me, O Virgin, I pray thee, drops of compunction that wash away the defilement that hath increased upon me, that I may glorify thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Shower upon me, O Virgin, I pray thee, drops of compunction that wash away the defilement that hath increased upon me, that I may glorify thee!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Смотрѧ́ѧ разꙋ́мнѡ, воздаѧ́нїа бж҃твеннаѧ дѡроѳе́е, вели̑кїѧ бѣ́ды и҆ напа̑сти претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *Thou art the confirmation of them that flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit sings praise unto Thee.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
*Thou art the confirmation of them that flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit sings praise unto Thee.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Е҆ди́нствомъ бж҃тва̀ проповѣ́даѧ трⷪ҇цꙋ, дѡроѳе́е, многобо́жнагѡ неи́стовства, сꙋ́етное погꙋби́лъ є҆сѝ шата́нїе .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst drive away every night of vanity by the splendors of thy most wise preaching, O father and hierarch!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst drive away every night of vanity by the splendors of thy most wise preaching, O father and hierarch!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Не поклони́всѧ мꙋ́нче дѣ́лѡмъ рꙋ́къ беззако́нныхъ, терпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ и҆скꙋше́нїа и҆ бѣ́ды, и҆ ра̑ны и҆ болѣ̑зни дѡроѳе́е .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By wonders thou didst confirm the thoughts of all the faithful, and by sacred teachings, O wise one, as a consecrated shepherd.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By wonders thou didst confirm the thoughts of all the faithful, and by sacred teachings, O wise one, as a consecrated shepherd.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Восто́къ со́лнца, пре́жде денни́цы возсїѧ́вшагѡ была̀ є҆сѝ : и҆́мже свѣ́тъ сꙋ́щїи во тмѣ̀ лю́тыхъ чⷭ҇таѧ ви́дѣша .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Lord anointed thee with sacred anointing, O father, and appointed thee chief-shepherd of His divine Church.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The Lord anointed thee with sacred anointing, O father, and appointed thee chief-shepherd of His divine Church.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃ . Їрмо́съ : Ри́зꙋ мнѣ̀ пода́ждь свѣ́тлꙋ, ѡ҆дѣѧ́йсѧ свѣ́томъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ри́зою, многоми́лостиве хрⷭ҇тѐ бж҃е на́шъ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Illumine this heart of mine with divine light, O portal of light, driving away the gloom of sin!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Illumine this heart of mine with divine light, O portal of light, driving away the gloom of sin!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Се́рдце разжже́но дыха́нїи дх҃а стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ, дꙋхѡ́въ дѡроѳе́е сопроти́вныхъ, стремле́нїе разрꙋша́ющо .
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Of the divine faith" (Бж҃твенныѧ вѣ́ры):*[^35] Ever shining with divine dogmas, a holy gift thou didst offer thyself, having suffered for the immortal King, O Dorotheus, and thou dwellest now, ever rejoicing, in the heavenly metropolis of the firstborn.[^36] O venerable father, pray unto Christ God to grant great mercy unto us!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Глагѡ́лъ твои́хъ вѣща́нїе, и҆ кра́сныхъ ᲂу҆че́ній си́ла, всю̀ ѡ҆бтечѐ преблаже́нне зе́млю, бж҃твенною блг҃тїю .
items.english_text: He was not separated from the divine nature, having become flesh in thy womb; but God, having become man, remained such, Who after childbearing preserved thee a Virgin Mother, as before childbearing, all-immaculate, the only Lord: earnestly beseech Him to grant great mercy unto us!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Е҆го́же родила̀ є҆сѝ бг҃а, чл҃вѣ́ка бы́вша, того̀ молѝ и҆зба́вити мѧ̀ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ и҆ мꙋ́ки .
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* The spotless Ewe-lamb of the Word, the incorrupt Virgin Mother, beholding Him Who sprouted forth from her without pain hanging upon the Cross, maternally

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p28 === (Fol. 13v) ѡ҆блиста́лъ є҆сѝ, просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ зе́млю дѡроѳе́е, ѿгна́въ мглу̀ многобо́жїа, и҆ лю́тыѧ є҆́реси . сегѡ̀ ра́ди па́мѧть твою̀ свѣ́тлѡ пра́зднꙋемъ .
items.english_text: maternally lamenting in fitting manner, cried aloud: Woe is me, my Child! How sufferest Thou willingly, wishing to deliver man from shameful passions?

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃ . Їрмо́съ : Ѻ҆́троцы є҆вре́йстїи въ пе́щи, попра́ша пла́мень дерзнове́ннѡ, и҆ на ро́сꙋ ѻ҆́гнь преложи́ша, вопїю́ще : бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation, I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Godhead.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation, I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Godhead.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Звѣзда̀ многосвѣ́тлаѧ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, свѣ́тлостьми страда́ній твои́хъ, просвѣща́ѧ дꙋ́шы, вѣ́рнѡ дѡроѳе́е вопїю́щихъ : бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The frost-bearing winter of godlessness didst thou spit upon, O venerable one, and by the warmth of the divine Spirit thou didst keep thy heart unharmed.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The frost-bearing winter of godlessness didst thou spit upon, O venerable one, and by the warmth of the divine Spirit thou didst keep thy heart unharmed.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Стезѧ́ми пра́выми хо́дѧ, низве́рглъ є҆сѝ де́бри льсти́вагѡ, и҆ къ пꙋте́мъ живо́тнымъ наставлѧ́ѧ вопїю́щыѧ : бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Demonic base mountains crumbled before thy face, O blessed Dorotheus, and the ragings of wicked men melted away.[^37]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Demonic base mountains crumbled before thy face, O blessed Dorotheus, and the ragings of wicked men melted away.[^37]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆гаси́лъ є҆сѝ тꙋ́чами крове́й твои́хъ всесла́вне, пе́щь преле́стнꙋю, и҆ на водѣ̀ жи́зни всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ, взыва́ѧ : бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst endure being wronged, being driven from city to city; therefore thou didst obtain the blessed glory and splendor of martyrs.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst endure being wronged, being driven from city to city; therefore thou didst obtain the blessed glory and splendor of martyrs.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : И҆зба́ви сою́зъ грѣха̀, ѡ҆каѧ́нную мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ бг҃ороди́тельнице, и҆ любвѝ бж҃їей припрѧзѝ соверше́ннѣ, да вѣ́рнѡ сла́влю тѧ̀ бцⷣе во вѣ́ки .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Save me from temptations and soul-corrupting passions, O Birthgiver of God, that in faith I may call thee blessed, O all-holy Maiden, Virgin Mother!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Save me from temptations and soul-corrupting passions, O Birthgiver of God, that in faith I may call thee blessed, O all-holy Maiden, Virgin Mother!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃ . Їрмо́съ : Бг҃оглаго́ливїи ѻ҆́троцы въ пе́щи, со ѻ҆гне́мъ пла́мень попира́юще поѧ́хꙋ : бл҃гослови́те дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а .
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *From the night of ignorance, having enlightened the ends [of the earth] with the knowledge of God, enlighten me by the dawn of Thy love for mankind, O Lord!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*From the night of ignorance, having enlightened the ends [of the earth] with the knowledge of God, enlighten me by the dawn of Thy love for mankind, O Lord!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Хва́лѧщагосѧ ѕмі́а въ ѕло́бѣ, смири́всѧ ѡ҆ гдⷭ҇ѣ ѻ҆́ч҃е, смири́лъ є҆сѝ вопїѧ̀ : бл҃гвите всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Discerningly beholding the divine rewards, O Dorotheus, thou didst endure great afflictions and temptations.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Discerningly beholding the divine rewards, O Dorotheus, thou didst endure great afflictions and temptations.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Во глꙋбо́цѣй тѧ̀ ста́рости, въ нестарѣ́ющихсѧ поко́йныхъ мѣ́стѣхъ зижди́тель вселѝ, сщ҃енный ѻ҆́ч҃е, мꙋ́ченикѡвъ ᲂу҆краше́нїе .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Proclaiming the Trinity in the unity of Godhead, O Dorotheus, thou didst destroy the vain raging of polytheistic madness.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Proclaiming the Trinity in the unity of Godhead, O Dorotheus, thou didst destroy the vain raging of polytheistic madness.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Житїѐ равноа́гг҃лно и҆мѣ́ѧ, со а҆́гг҃лы влⷣки твоегѡ̀ прⷭ҇то́лꙋ, ны́нѣ предстои́ши, вопїѧ̀ : бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Refusing to bow down, O sufferer, unto the works of lawless hands, thou didst endure temptations and afflictions, and stripes and sicknesses, O Dorotheus.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Refusing to bow down, O sufferer, unto the works of lawless hands, thou didst endure temptations and afflictions, and stripes and sicknesses, O Dorotheus.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Кра́снаѧ дв҃о ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ, прекра́сное сло́во поро́ждши, є҆мꙋ́же пое́мъ : бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The East of the Sun that shone forth before the morning star wast thou;[^38] through Whom, O pure one, they that were in the darkness of grievous things beheld light.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The East of the Sun that shone forth before the morning star wast thou;[^38] through Whom, O pure one, they that were in the darkness of grievous things beheld light.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃ . Їрмо́съ : Проѡбраже́нное на горѣ̀ законополо́жникꙋ во ѻ҆гнѝ и҆ кꙋпинѣ̀, ржⷭ҇тво̀ приснодв҃ы, въ на́ше вѣ́рныхъ сп҃се́нїе, пѣ́сньми немо́лчными велича́емъ .
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *Grant me a robe of light, Thou that clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, O most Merciful Christ our God!*[^39]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*Grant me a robe of light, Thou that clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, O most Merciful Christ our God!*[^39]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆спра́вилъ є҆сѝ ста́до хрⷭ҇то́во къ бж҃твеннымъ приста́нищемъ, невреди́мо соблю́дъ є҆̀ ѿ бꙋ́ри сопроти́вныхъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ преизрѧ́денъ ст҃и́тель, и҆ бж҃е́ственныхъ ѻ҆́ч҃е и҆сполни́тель мꙋ́дре повелѣ́ній .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst acquire a heart inflamed by the breathings of the Spirit, destroying the onslaught of adverse spirits, O Dorotheus.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst acquire a heart inflamed by the breathings of the Spirit, destroying the onslaught of adverse spirits, O Dorotheus.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ сщ҃еннодѣ́йственникъ чи́стъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ мꙋ́ченикъ до́бль, ꙗ҆́кѡ чꙋдодѣ́йственникъ чꙋ́денъ, а҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ бж҃твенныхъ слове́съ словописе́цъ,
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The lives of the saints didst thou make manifest by sacred writings, O divinely inspired father, enlightening the soul with divine understanding.[^40]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The lives of the saints didst thou make manifest by sacred writings, O divinely inspired father, enlightening the soul with divine understanding.[^40]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p29 === (Fol. 14r) словописе́цъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ вѣ́ры непоколеби́мъ сто́лпъ, сла́вꙋ вѣ́чнꙋю ѻ҆́ч҃е ᲂу҆лꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The proclamation of thy words and the power of thy beautiful teachings went out into all the earth, O all-blessed one, by divine grace.[^41]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The proclamation of thy words and the power of thy beautiful teachings went out into all the earth, O all-blessed one, by divine grace.[^41]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: На сꙋди́щи поде́мъ мно́ги трꙋды̀ и҆ болѣ̑зни, къ неболѣ́зненнѣй и҆ бж҃твеннѣй жи́зни, ра́дꙋѧсѧ преше́лъ є҆сѝ, ѡ҆боже́нїемъ ны́нѣ чи́стѡ прича́щаѧсѧ, мꙋ́чениче досточꙋ́дне дѡроѳе́е .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beseech Him Whom thou didst bear as God, Who became man, to deliver me from fire and torment!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Beseech Him Whom thou didst bear as God, Who became man, to deliver me from fire and torment!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣтоза́рнаѧ па́мѧть твоѧ̀, возсїѧ̀ мі́рꙋ, ѡ҆зарѧ́ющи вѣ̑рныѧ лꙋча́ми дарова́нїй : ю҆́же сла́вѧщыѧ ѡ҆́бщники ны̀ покажѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е, въ тебѣ̀ бж҃твенныѧ свѣ́тлости .
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2:* Shining with virtues, and more than the sun with divine teachings, and by sufferings, O blessed one, thou didst shine forth

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 2:*
Shining with virtues, and more than the sun with divine teachings, and by sufferings, O blessed one, thou didst shine forth

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же, въ ѕ҃ . де́нь . Преподо́бнагѡ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ на́шегѡ, виссарїѡ́на чꙋдотво́рца : И҆ преподо́бнагѡ і҆ларїѡ́на но́вагѡ, ѻ҆би́тели далма́тскїѧ . На гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ, Стїхи̑ры, гла́съ, и҃ . Подо́бенъ : Ѡ҆ пресла́внагѡ чꙋдесѐ ! Свѣ́тъ * мона́шествꙋющихъ * виссарїѡ́не мꙋ́дре, * ты̀ добродѣ́тельными зарѧ́ми, * и҆ сїѧ́нїемъ бл҃года́ти * пꙋсты́ни бы́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣти́ло пресвѣ́тло . * Страсте́й мглы̀ и҆ тмы̀ ѕлолю́тыхъ * тѧ̀ чтꙋ́щымъ те́плѣ и҆збавлѧ́ѧй, * и҆ всѧ́кїѧ ско́рби и҆ напа́сти, * вѣ́рнѡ пою́щымъ * твоѐ бж҃е́ственное ᲂу҆спе́нїе .
items.english_text: and didst enlighten the earth, O Dorotheus, driving away the gloom of polytheism and grievous heresies; therefore brightly do we celebrate thy memory.

provenance.verbatim_source: and didst enlighten the earth, O Dorotheus, driving away the gloom of polytheism and grievous heresies; therefore brightly do we celebrate thy memory.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Неизрече́нныхъ подви́гъ твои́хъ * ты̀ бж҃е́ственною любо́вїю, * терпѧ̀ стоѧ́нїе подъ кро́вомъ терпѣ́лъ, * показа́лъ є҆сѝ страда́лцемъ ра́вно, сопротивле́нїе . * горька́гѡ мо́рѧ ᲂу҆слажда́еши во́ды, * и҆ дꙋ́шы напоѧ́еши * въ жа́ждѣ премꙋ́дре . * преходи́ши вы́ше человѣ́чьихъ быстри́нъ, * творѧ̀ немо́креннѡ прехва́льне * на вода́хъ ше́ствїе .
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *The Hebrew Children boldly trampled the flame in the furnace, and changed the fire into dew, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*The Hebrew Children boldly trampled the flame in the furnace, and changed the fire into dew, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ подо́бника и҆лїѝ мꙋ́ромъ, * всѝ вѣ́дꙋще ꙗ҆́вѣ виссарїѡ́не восхваля́емъ, * ми́лостїю бж҃е́ственною тебѣ̀, * съ нб҃се ѡ҆дожди́лъ є҆сѝ вѡ́дныѧ стрꙋи̑, * и҆ дожде́вныѧ и҆сто́чники, * и҆ росꙋ̀ бж҃е́ственнꙋю, * твои́ми чⷭ҇тны́ми моли́твами, * подае́ши ᲂу҆́бѡ свы́ше
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A most radiant star wast thou revealed to be by the splendors of thy struggles, enlightening the souls of them that faithfully cry aloud, O Dorotheus: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
A most radiant star wast thou revealed to be by the splendors of thy struggles, enlightening the souls of them that faithfully cry aloud, O Dorotheus: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p30 === (Fol. 14v) свы́ше, * ѻ҆́ч҃е преблаже́нне всѣ́мъ вѣ́рнымъ, * бл҃гть же и҆ си́лꙋ, * и҆ покро́въ неѡбори́мъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Walking in the right paths, thou didst cast down the ravines of the deceiver, guiding unto the paths of life them that cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Walking in the right paths, thou didst cast down the ravines of the deceiver, guiding unto the paths of life them that cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры, преподо́бнагѡ і҆ларїѡ́на, Гла́съ, д҃ . Подо́бенъ : Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе : Житїѐ нескве́рно, * терпѣ́нїе и҆ кро́тость, * и҆ любо́вь нелицемѣ́рнꙋ, * воздержа́нїе безмѣ́рно, * всено́щное стоѧ́нїе, * ᲂу҆миле́нїе бж҃е́ственное, * вѣ́рꙋ и҆ наде́ждꙋ и҆́стиннꙋ, * съ милова́нїемъ ѻ҆́ч҃е стѧжа́въ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гглъ пожи́лъ є҆сѝ на землѝ съ тѣ́ломъ, * і҆ларїѡ́не блаже́нне, * мл҃твенниче ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By the showers of thy blood, O all-glorious one, thou didst quench the deceitful furnace, and didst take up thy dwelling by the water of life,[^42] crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By the showers of thy blood, O all-glorious one, thou didst quench the deceitful furnace, and didst take up thy dwelling by the water of life,[^42] crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Земны́й а҆́гглъ, * и҆ нбⷭ҇ный человѣ́къ бы́лъ є҆сѝ прпⷣбне : * и҆сто́чникъ ᲂу҆миле́нїа, * милова́нїа стрꙋѧ̀ : пꙋчи́на чꙋде́съ, * грѣ́шникѡвъ и҆спорꙋ́чникъ, * ма́слина вои́стиннꙋ бж҃їа плодови́та, * є҆ле́емъ трꙋдѡ́въ твои́хъ * ᲂу҆маща́ѧ ли́ца і҆ларїѡ́не чꙋ́дне, * вѣ́рнѡ восхвалѧ́ющихъ тѧ̀ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Deliver my wretched soul from the bond of sin, O Parent of God, and yoke it completely unto the love of God, that in faith I may glorify thee, O Birthgiver of God, unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Deliver my wretched soul from the bond of sin, O Parent of God, and yoke it completely unto the love of God, that in faith I may glorify thee, O Birthgiver of God, unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́мъ тво́й сїѧ̀, * бж҃твенными разꙋмѣ́нїи, * тѣле́сны превы́ше страсте́й бы́лъ є҆сѝ, * несмѣ́шенъ до́лними, * носѧ̀ начерта́нїе, * и҆ и҆зѡбража́ѧ въ себѣ̀ бж҃твеннꙋю добро́тꙋ, * и҆ познава́емь ве́сь свѣтови́денъ, * дѣ́йствомъ дх҃а і҆ларїѡ́не ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ, * мона́шествꙋющихъ ᲂу҆краше́нїе .
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *The divinely speaking Children in the furnace, trampling the flame together with the fire, sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*The divinely speaking Children in the furnace, trampling the flame together with the fire, sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, пра́: и҆лѝ бг҃оро́диченъ : Ра́дꙋйсѧ сл҃нцезра́чнаѧ лꙋча̀, * сл҃нца незаходи́магѡ престо́ле, * ꙗ҆́же со́лнце возсїѧ́вши недоꙋмѣ́нное : * ра́дꙋйсѧ ᲂу҆́ме ѡ҆блиста́ѧй бж҃твенными сїа́нїи, * зарѐ молні́йнаѧ, * ѡ҆свѣти́вшаѧ землѝ концы̑, * и҆́стинноє зла́та блиста́нїе, * вседо́браѧ и҆ пренепоро́чнаѧ, * свѣ́тъ невече́рнїй, * вѣ̑рнымъ ѡ҆блиста́вши .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having humbled thyself in the Lord, O father, thou didst humble the serpent boasting in malice, crying aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having humbled thyself in the Lord, O father, thou didst humble the serpent boasting in malice, crying aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ : Распина́ема хрⷭ҇та̀ чл҃колю́бца, * ви́дѧщи пречи́стаѧ, * и҆ ре́бра и҆скопава́ема копі́емъ, * пла́чꙋщи вопїѧ́ше : * что̀ сїѐ сн҃е мо́й ? * что̀ тѝ безбл҃года́тнїи лю́дїе возда́ша, * за ꙗ҆́же сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ дѡ́браѧ и҆̀мъ ? * и҆ тщѧ́тсѧ безча́дствовати ма̀ бл҃голюбе́знѣйшїй : * ᲂу҆дивла́юсѧ бл҃гоꙋтро́бне, * твое́мꙋ во́льномꙋ распѧ́тїю .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In thine advanced old age,[^43] the Creator settled thee in the ageless places of rest, O consecrated father, adornment of martyrs!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
In thine advanced old age,[^43] the Creator settled thee in the ageless places of rest, O consecrated father, adornment of martyrs!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, д҃ . Бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ, творѧ́й при́снѡ съ на́ми, по твое́й кро́тости, не ѡ҆ста́ви ми́лость твою̀ ѿ на́съ : но моли́твами и҆́хъ въ ми́рѣ ᲂу҆пра́ви живо́тъ на́шъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having an angelic life, together with the Angels thou now standest before the throne of thy Master, crying aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*

items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, ст҃а́гѡ виссарїѡ́на . Творе́нїе і҆ѡ́сифово . Гла́съ, в҃ . Пѣ́снь, а҃ . Їрмо́съ : Грѧди́те лю́дїе, пои́мъ пѣ́снь хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ бг҃ꙋ, раздѣ́льшемꙋ мо́ре, и҆ наста́вльшемꙋ лю́ди, ꙗ҆́же и҆зведѐ и҆з̾ рабо́ты є҆гѵ́петскїа, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ .
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* *Come, ye peoples, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the sea and guided the people whom He brought out of the bondage of Egypt, for He hath been glorified.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1. Heirmos:*
*Come, ye peoples, let us sing a song unto Christ God, Who divided the sea and guided the people whom He brought out of the bondage of Egypt, for He hath been glorified.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мⷭ҇ЦЪ ЇꙊ́НЇЙ . Ѕ҃ . ДЕ́НЬ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Church, keeping festival, sings unto God today on thy memory, O God-inspired Bessarion, and in faith glorifies thy great ascetic struggles, O father!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The Church, keeping festival, sings unto God today on thy memory, O God-inspired Bessarion, and in faith glorifies thy great ascetic struggles, O father!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: По́етъ бг҃ꙋ цр҃ковь ликꙋ́ющи * въ па́мѧти твое́й дне́сь, * бг҃одохнове́нне висарїѡ́не : * и҆ вѣ́рою сла́витъ, * вели́кїѧ ѻ҆́ч҃е по́двиги твоѧ̑ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having shown thyself a servant unto God, by the powers of the soul thou didst enslave the bodily passions, and didst show thyself free from every malice, O all-marvelous father!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having shown thyself a servant unto God, by the powers of the soul thou didst enslave the bodily passions, and didst show thyself free from every malice, O all-marvelous father!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ра́бъ бг҃ꙋ ꙗ҆́вльсѧ, * порабо́тилъ є҆сѝ дꙋше́вными си́лами, * стра̑сти тѣле́сныѧ, * и҆ свобо́дь всѧ́кїѧ ѕло́бы ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * ѻ҆́ч҃е всечꙋ́дне .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Adorned with the beauties at the consummation of thy struggles,[^52] thou didst show thyself a vessel well-pleasing to the divine Spirit, containing His operation, O blessed Bessarion!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Adorned with the beauties at the consummation of thy struggles,[^52] thou didst show thyself a vessel well-pleasing to the divine Spirit, containing His operation, O blessed Bessarion!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆краси́всѧ добро́тами * пѡ́двигъ кѡ́нъ, * сосꙋ́дъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ бл҃гопотре́бенъ бж҃твеннагѡ дх҃а, * тогѡ̀ дѣ́йствїа вмѣща́ющь, * висарїѡ́не блаже́нне .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The deceitful enemy drew me into the pit of destruction; but stretch out thy mighty hand unto me, and swiftly, O Birthgiver of God, lead me up unto the light!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The deceitful enemy drew me into the pit of destruction; but stretch out thy mighty hand unto me, and swiftly, O Birthgiver of God, lead me up unto the light!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Вра́гъ льсте́цъ мѧ̀ привле́че въ поги́белный ро́въ : * но мнѣ̀ прострѝ держа́внꙋю твою̀ рꙋ́кꙋ, * и҆ ско́рѡ бцⷣе къ свѣ́тꙋ возведѝ .
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* *Another Canon of the Venerable Hilarion, Tone 8.* *Having passed through the water as dry land, and escaped the evil of Egypt, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another Canon of the Venerable Hilarion, Tone 8.*
*Ode 1. Heirmos:*
*Having passed through the water as dry land, and escaped the evil of Egypt, the Israelite cried aloud: Let us sing unto our Deliverer and God!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ка́нѡнъ в҃-й . И҆́нъ канѡ́нъ преподо́бнагѡ і҆ларїѡ́на . Гла́съ, и҃ . Пѣ́снь, а҃ . Їрмо́съ : Во́дꙋ проше́дъ ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́шꙋ, * и҆ є҆гѵ́петскагѡ ѕла̀ и҆збѣжа́въ, * і҆ильтѧни́нъ вопїѧ́ше, * и҆зба́вителю и҆ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ пои́мъ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having run unto the immaterial and noetic light from the darkness of material things, O venerable Hilarion: by thy prayers unto God enlighten me!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having run unto the immaterial and noetic light from the darkness of material things, O venerable Hilarion: by thy prayers unto God enlighten me!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Къ свѣ́тъ невеще́ственный и҆ разꙋ́мный, * ѿ тмы̀ сꙋ́щихъ веще́й востекі́й, * і҆ларїѡ́не преподо́бне, * мл҃твами твои́ми къ бг҃ꙋ, мѧ̀ просвѣтѝ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* From infancy attaining all virtues, by the labors of abstinence and by fasting sweats, thou didst reach unto a full-grown man, and unto the spiritual measure of the stature of Christ.[^53]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
From infancy attaining all virtues, by the labors of abstinence and by fasting sweats, thou didst reach unto a full-grown man, and unto the spiritual measure of the stature of Christ.[^53]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ младе́нства всѣ́хъ добродѣ́тель, * воздержа́нїа болѣ́зньми, * и҆ поты̀ по́стными, * въ мꙋ́жа дости́глъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ въ мѣ́рꙋ дх҃о́внꙋю во́зраста хв҃а .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having passed through the abyss of passions, and escaped the tempestuous surging of demons, thou didst hasten dryshod into the haven of dispassion, O venerable father!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having passed through the abyss of passions, and escaped the tempestuous surging of demons, thou didst hasten dryshod into the haven of dispassion, O venerable father!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Страсте́й пꙋчи́нꙋ преше́дъ, * и҆ треволне́нїа де́монѡвъ и҆збѣ́гъ, * во приста́нище ᲂу҆стреми́лсѧ є҆сѝ немо́крено безстра́стїа, * ѻ҆́ч҃е прпⷣбне .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Word, Who is without mother from the Father, without father at the last thou didst bear God-manfully,[^54] O only Mother of God, as one who art higher than all creation!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The Word, Who is without mother from the Father, without father at the last thou didst bear God-manfully,[^54] O only Mother of God, as one who art higher than all creation!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Сло́во без̾ мт҃ре и҆з̾ ѻ҆ц҃а̀, * без̾ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ сего̀ напослѣ́докъ бг҃омꙋ́жнѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ, * є҆ди́на бг҃ома́ти, * ꙗ҆́кѡ превы́шши всеѧ̀ тва́ри .
items.english_text: *Ode 3 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:* *Having established me upon the rock of faith, Thou hast enlarged my mouth against mine enemies, for my spirit has rejoiced when singing: There is none holy as our God, and there is none righteous more than Thee, O Lord![^55]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:*
*Having established me upon the rock of faith, Thou hast enlarged my mouth against mine enemies, for my spirit has rejoiced when singing: There is none holy as our God, and there is none righteous more than Thee, O Lord![^55]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃ . Їрмо́съ : На ка́мени мѧ̀ вѣ́ры ᲂу҆тверди́въ, * разшири́лъ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆ста̀ моѧ̑ на врагѝ моѧ̑, * возвесели́ бо сѧ дх҃ъ мо́й внегда̀ пѣ́ти : * нѣ́сть ст҃ъ, ꙗ҆́коже бг҃ъ на́шъ, * и҆ нѣ́сть првⷣнъ, па́че тебѐ гдⷭ҇и .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst ascend unto the height of dispassion; thou didst enter into the darkness of the vision of God;[^56] thou didst receive in thy heart the divine Law; strengthening thyself thereby, thou wast a most radiant luminary of monastics, O venerable one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst ascend unto the height of dispassion; thou didst enter into the darkness of the vision of God;[^56] thou didst receive in thy heart the divine Law; strengthening thyself thereby, thou wast a most radiant luminary of monastics, O venerable one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Возше́лъ є҆сѝ на высотꙋ̀ безстра́стїа, * вше́лъ є҆сѝ во мра́къ бг҃овидѣ́нїа, * прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ въ срⷣцы твое́мъ бж҃твенный зако́нъ : * и҆́мже ᲂу҆крѣплѧ́ѧ, * свѣти́льникъ пресвѣ́телъ мона́шествꙋющихъ прпⷣбне бы́лъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a fruitful olive tree, openly planted in the divine house, thou didst show thyself, O father; with the oil of thy struggles make rich our faces, who praise thy wonders, O venerable Bessarion!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
As a fruitful olive tree, openly planted in the divine house, thou didst show thyself, O father; with the oil of thy struggles make rich our faces, who praise thy wonders, O venerable Bessarion!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Плодови́таѧ ма́слина, * въ домꙋ̀ бж҃твеннѣмъ, * ꙗ҆́вѣ насажде́нъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е, * є҆ле́емъ подвигѡ́въ твои́хъ ᲂу҆мастѝ на́ша ли́ца, * восхвалѧ́ющихъ твоѧ̑ висарїѡ́не преподо́бне чꙋдеса̀ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having lived a life of poverty, O blessed one, like unto the birds, O father, and clad with the wings of dispassion, rejoicing thou didst reach...

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having lived a life of poverty, O blessed one, like unto the birds, O father, and clad with the wings of dispassion, rejoicing thou didst reach...

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p32 === (Fol. 15v)
items.english_text: the heavenly mansions; therefore in faith we call thee blessed![^57]

provenance.verbatim_source: the heavenly mansions; therefore in faith we call thee blessed![^57]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мⷭ҇ЦЪ ЇꙊ́НЇЙ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having spent my life in slothfulness, and having defiled my heart with passions, I draw near unto thee, O Sovereign Lady, with compunction of soul; and I pray thee to have compassion and save me, establishing me in the patterns of repentance!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having spent my life in slothfulness, and having defiled my heart with passions, I draw near unto thee, O Sovereign Lady, with compunction of soul; and I pray thee to have compassion and save me, establishing me in the patterns of repentance!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: дости́глъ є҆сѝ ѻ҆би́тели ра́дꙋѧсѧ : * сегѡ̀ ра́ди вѣ́рою тѧ̀ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ .
items.english_text: *Ode 3 [Canon of Saint Hilarion]. Heirmos:* *Thou art the establishment of them that hasten unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit sings of Thee.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3 [Canon of Saint Hilarion]. Heirmos:*
*Thou art the establishment of them that hasten unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit sings of Thee.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Лѣ́ностнѡ живо́тъ мо́й и҆зжи́въ, * и҆ страстьмѝ се́рдце ѡ҆скверни́въ, * пристꙋпа́ю къ тебѣ̀ влⷣчце ᲂу҆миле́нїемъ дꙋшѝ : * и҆ молю́сѧ ᲂу҆ще́дрити и҆ спасти́ мѧ, * покаѧ́нїа ѻ҆́бразы мѧ̀ ᲂу҆твержда́ющи .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the coal of abstinence, O venerable one, thou didst burn up the thorns of the passions, and thou refreshest the minds of the faithful.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With the coal of abstinence, O venerable one, thou didst burn up the thorns of the passions, and thou refreshest the minds of the faithful.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃ . Їрмо́съ : Ты̀ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе притека́ющихъ къ тебѣ̀ гдⷭ҇и, * ты̀ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ ѡ҆мраче́нныхъ, * и҆ пое́тъ тѧ̀ дх҃ъ мо́й .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having acquired through the Spirit the sharpened arrows of virtue, like a mighty warrior thou didst wound the heart of the cruel adversary.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having acquired through the Spirit the sharpened arrows of virtue, like a mighty warrior thou didst wound the heart of the cruel adversary.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Попали́лъ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆́глемъ воздержа́нїа прпⷣбне, * страсте́й те́рнїе, * и҆ прохлажда́еши вѣ́рныхъ мꙋдрова́нїа .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Armed with the weapon of abstinence, and with prayer as a breastplate, O venerable one, thou didst conquer the hosts of invisible enemies.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Armed with the weapon of abstinence, and with prayer as a breastplate, O venerable one, thou didst conquer the hosts of invisible enemies.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Стрѣ́лы и҆зѡщре́ны добродѣ́тели стѧжа́въ дх҃омъ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ си́ленъ, * ᲂу҆язви́лъ є҆сѝ се́рдце лю́тагѡ ратобо́рца .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* I pray thee to be a mother unto me through thy bold intercessions, O Sovereign Lady, before Him Who was born of thee, in the Day of Judgment!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
I pray thee to be a mother unto me through thy bold intercessions, O Sovereign Lady, before Him Who was born of thee, in the Day of Judgment!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: ѻ҆рꙋ́жїемъ воздержа́нїа, * и҆ моли́твою ꙗ҆́кѡ брона́ми, * прпⷣбне воѡрꙋжи́всѧ, * врагѡ́въ неви́димыхъ побѣди́лъ є҆сѝ полкѝ .
items.english_text: *Kontakion of Saint Hilarion, Tone 2, Podoben: "The firm" (Тве́рдыѧ):* Within the fences of thy life-bearing pasture, like a shepherd thou didst preserve thy flock unharmed, and didst show thyself great by the height of thy deeds, O new Hilarion, having received many torments and tribulations for the sake of piety; therefore thou hast settled in the all-joyous life of the Sion on high: pray for us, O venerable one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of Saint Hilarion, Tone 2, Podoben: "The firm" (Тве́рдыѧ):*
Within the fences of thy life-bearing pasture, like a shepherd thou didst preserve thy flock unharmed, and didst show thyself great by the height of thy deeds, O new Hilarion, having received many torments and tribulations for the sake of piety; therefore thou hast settled in the all-joyous life of the Sion on high: pray for us, O venerable one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Ма́тнꙋ бы́ти мѝ тѧ̀ молю̀, * твои́ми влⷣчце дерзнове́нми, * и҆з̾ тебѐ ро́ждшемꙋсѧ, * въ де́нь сꙋ́дный .
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn of Saint Bessarion, Tone 1, Podoben: "Thy tomb" (Гро́бъ тво́й):* Having burned up the passions with the fire of abstinence, thou didst show thyself a radiant candle of dispassion, driving away the darkness of our souls by grace; therefore today we celebrate thy light-bearing memory with gladness of heart, O Bessarion our father!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn of Saint Bessarion, Tone 1, Podoben: "Thy tomb" (Гро́бъ тво́й):*
Having burned up the passions with the fire of abstinence, thou didst show thyself a radiant candle of dispassion, driving away the darkness of our souls by grace; therefore today we celebrate thy light-bearing memory with gladness of heart, O Bessarion our father!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ле, висарїѡ́на, гла́съ, а҃ . Подо́бенъ : Гро́бъ тво́й : Воздержа́нїа ѻ҆гне́мъ попали́въ стра̑сти, * свѣща̀ свѣ́тлаѧ безстра́стїа ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * тмꙋ̀ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ ѿгонѧ́щи бл҃гтїю . * тѣ́мже дне́сь свѣтоно́снꙋю твою̀ па́мѧть пра́зднꙋемъ, * весе́лїемъ срⷣца, * висарїѡ́не ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ .
items.english_text: Thou didst consecrate thy life unto God, O all-blessed one, having become an excellent minister of holy things, truly a priest of Christ; therefore after many sweats and labors, rejoicing thou didst pass over into the immaterial mansions, and now thou pourest forth for us streams of healings!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst consecrate thy life unto God, O all-blessed one, having become an excellent minister of holy things, truly a priest of Christ; therefore after many sweats and labors, rejoicing thou didst pass over into the immaterial mansions, and now thou pourest forth for us streams of healings!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, пра́ : и҆лѝ бг҃оро́диченъ : Дѣ́во всенепоро́чнаѧ, * ꙗ҆́же пресꙋ́щнаго бг҃а ро́ждшаѧ, * со безпло́тными того̀ непреста́ннѡ молѝ, * ѡ҆ставле́нїе прегрѣше́нїй, * и҆ и҆справле́нїе житїѧ̀ да́ти на́мъ пре́жде конца̀, * вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вїю пою́щымъ тѧ̀ по до́лгꙋ, * є҆ди́на всепѣ́таѧ .
items.english_text: O all-immaculate Virgin, who didst bear the transcendent God: with the bodiless powers ceaselessly pray unto Him to grant us remission of transgressions and amendment of life before the end, who in faith and love sing of thee as is meet, O only all-hymned one!

provenance.verbatim_source: O all-immaculate Virgin, who didst bear the transcendent God: with the bodiless powers ceaselessly pray unto Him to grant us remission of transgressions and amendment of life before the end, who in faith and love sing of thee as is meet, O only all-hymned one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p33 === (Fol. 16r)
items.english_text: O all-immaculate Virgin Mother of Christ God, a sword passed through thy most holy soul[^58] when thou didst behold thy Son and God voluntarily crucified; ceaselessly pray unto Him, O blessed one, to grant us forgiveness of transgressions!

provenance.verbatim_source: O all-immaculate Virgin Mother of Christ God, a sword passed through thy most holy soul[^58] when thou didst behold thy Son and God voluntarily crucified; ceaselessly pray unto Him, O blessed one, to grant us forgiveness of transgressions!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мⷭ҇ЦЪ ЇꙊ́НЇЙ . Ѕ҃ . ДЕ́НЬ .
items.english_text: *Ode 4 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:* *I sing unto Thee, for I have heard report of Thee, O Lord, and was afraid; for Thou comest unto me, seeking me who have gone astray; therefore I glorify Thy great condescension toward me, O Much-merciful One![^59]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:*
*I sing unto Thee, for I have heard report of Thee, O Lord, and was afraid; for Thou comest unto me, seeking me who have gone astray; therefore I glorify Thy great condescension toward me, O Much-merciful One![^59]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Дѣ́во пренепоро́чнаѧ мт҃и хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, * ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе про́йде твою̀ прест҃ꙋю дꙋ́шꙋ, * є҆гда̀ распина́ема ви́дѣла є҆сѝ во́лею, * сн҃а и҆ бг҃а твоего́ : * є҆го́же бл҃гослове́ннаѧ молѧ́щи не преста́й, * проще́нїе прегрѣше́нїй на́мъ дарова́ти .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Drops of healings thou didst receive from the abyss of grace, wherefrom by thy prayer, O wise one, thou didst turn the sea water into sweetness, curing the thirst of thy disciple, O right-marvelous one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Drops of healings thou didst receive from the abyss of grace, wherefrom by thy prayer, O wise one, thou didst turn the sea water into sweetness, curing the thirst of thy disciple, O right-marvelous one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃ . Їрмо́съ : Пою́ тѧ, * слꙋ́хомъ бо гдⷭ҇и ᲂу҆слы́шахъ и҆ ᲂу҆жасо́хсѧ, * до мене́ бо и҆́деши, * мене́ и҆щѧ̀ заблꙋ́ждшагѡ . * тѣ́мъ мно́гое твоѐ снизхожде́нїе, * є҆́же на мѧ̀ просла́влѧю многомлⷭ҇тиве .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In no wise even unto old age didst thou fail in life, O God-wise father, wandering voluntarily in the deserts and mountains,[^60] seeking God Who enlightened thee with splendors surpassing noetic wonders!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
In no wise even unto old age didst thou fail in life, O God-wise father, wandering voluntarily in the deserts and mountains,[^60] seeking God Who enlightened thee with splendors surpassing noetic wonders!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ка́пли и҆сцѣле́нїй прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ ѿ пꙋчи́ны бл҃гти, * ѿню́дꙋ преложи́лъ є҆сѝ во́дꙋ морскꙋ́ю, * мл҃твою твое́ю мꙋ́дре на сла́дость, * и҆сцѣлѧ́ѧ ᲂу҆чени́кꙋ твое́мꙋ жа́ждꙋ досточꙋ́дне .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast humble and abased, lifted up by dispassion; therefore thou didst dash down the haughtiness of the demons, having become a luminary of monastics, O father, who piously praise thee in faith!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou wast humble and abased, lifted up by dispassion; therefore thou didst dash down the haughtiness of the demons, having become a luminary of monastics, O father, who piously praise thee in faith!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ника́коже да́же до ста́рости ѡ҆скꙋдѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, * въ житїѝ бг҃омꙋ́дре ѻ҆́ч҃е, * въ пꙋсты́нѧхъ и҆ гора́хъ заблꙋжда́ѧ хотѣ́нїемъ, * и҆щѧ́и бг҃а, * свѣ́тлостьми па́че ᲂу҆́мныхъ чꙋде́съ, * тѧ̀ просвѣ́щша .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Heal the passions of my soul that grow within me most wretchedly; enlighten my thoughts, driving far away the darkness, O pure one, of the demons that afflict me and ever set snares for me!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Heal the passions of my soul that grow within me most wretchedly; enlighten my thoughts, driving far away the darkness, O pure one, of the demons that afflict me and ever set snares for me!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бы́лъ є҆сѝ смире́нъ и҆ ѡ҆хꙋжде́нъ, * возноси́мь безстра́стїемъ . * тѣ́мже разрази́лъ є҆сѝ возноше́нїа де́монѡвъ, * свѣти́льникъ мона́шествꙋющихъ ѻ҆́ч҃е бы́въ, * бл҃гоче́стнѡ вѣ́рою восхвалѧ́ющихъ тѧ̀ .
items.english_text: *Ode 4 [Canon of Saint Hilarion]. Heirmos:* *I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4 [Canon of Saint Hilarion]. Heirmos:*
*I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation; I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Divinity.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Стра̑сти дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ и҆сцѣлѝ, * возраста́ющїѧ мѝ преѡкаѧ́ннѡ : * по́мыслы просвѣтѝ, * дале́че ѿгонѧ́щи тмꙋ̀ чтⷭ҇аѧ, * де́монѡвъ ѡ҆скорблѧ́ющихъ мѧ̀, * и҆ всегда̀ сѣ̑ти дѣ́лающихъ мѝ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Planted by the waters of abstinence,[^61] O blessed father, thou didst show thyself a fair-branching vine, offering clusters of piety!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Planted by the waters of abstinence,[^61] O blessed father, thou didst show thyself a fair-branching vine, offering clusters of piety!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ . Їрмо́съ : Оу҆слы́шахъ гдⷭ҇и смотре́нїа твоегѡ̀ та́инство, * разꙋмѣ́хъ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, * и҆ просла́вихъ твоѐ бж҃тво̀ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having become wholly divine and Spirit-bearing, thou didst depart entirely unto God, O all-blessed Hilarion; therefore thou dancest ever with the Angels!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having become wholly divine and Spirit-bearing, thou didst depart entirely unto God, O all-blessed Hilarion; therefore thou dancest ever with the Angels!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Насажде́нъ бы́въ при вода́хъ воздержа́нїа, * ѻ҆́ч҃е блаже́нне, * лоза̀ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ бл҃горасле́на, * бл҃гоче́стїа гро́здїе предлага́ющаѧ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Upon the rock of faith thou didst set the steps of thy heart, and thou didst remain unshaken, not fearing the assaults of demons!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Upon the rock of faith thou didst set the steps of thy heart, and thou didst remain unshaken, not fearing the assaults of demons!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь бж҃твенъ бы́въ и҆ дх҃оно́сенъ, * ве́сь и҆зше́лъ є҆сѝ къ бг҃ꙋ і҆ларїѡ́не всеблаже́нне : * тѣ́мже со а҆́гглы ликꙋ́еши при́снѡ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee Who art higher than the Cherubim and the Seraphim we praise, O all-pure one; for Him before Whom they tremble, our God, thou didst bear in the flesh upon thine arms!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thee Who art higher than the Cherubim and the Seraphim we praise, O all-pure one; for Him before Whom they tremble, our God, thou didst bear in the flesh upon thine arms!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: На ка́мени вѣ́ры, * поста́вилъ є҆сѝ стѡпы̀ срⷣца твоегѡ̀, * и҆ непоколеби́мь пребы́лъ є҆сѝ, * прило́гъ де́монскихъ не ᲂу҆жаса́ѧсѧ .
items.english_text: *Ode 5 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:* *Enlightenment of them that lie in darkness, salvation of the despairing, O Christ my Savior: unto Thee do I rise early, O King of peace; enlighten me with Thy brightness, for other God beside Thee I know not!*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:*
*Enlightenment of them that lie in darkness, salvation of the despairing, O Christ my Savior: unto Thee do I rise early, O King of peace; enlighten me with Thy brightness, for other God beside Thee I know not!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Херꙋвї̑мъ превы́шшꙋю тѧ̀, * и҆ серафі́мъ, * пое́мъ пречи́стаѧ : * є҆гѡ́же бо трепе́щꙋтъ, * носи́ла є҆сѝ пло́тїю бг҃а на́шего, * на рꙋкꙋ̀ твое́ю .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The enlightenment of the Comforter, having taken up abode within thy soul, O all-blessed one, showed the path leading unto...

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The enlightenment of the Comforter, having taken up abode within thy soul, O all-blessed one, showed the path leading unto...

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Просвѣще́нїе всели́вшеесѧ преблаже́нне ᲂу҆тѣ́шителѧ, * внꙋ́трь дꙋшѝ твоеѧ̀, * ведꙋ́щꙋю къ црⷭ҇твꙋ
items.english_text: the Kingdom; walking wherein, thou didst turn aside from the affliction of demons and from spiritual darkness!

provenance.verbatim_source: the Kingdom; walking wherein, thou didst turn aside from the affliction of demons and from spiritual darkness!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p34 === (Fol. 16v)
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Shown forth as a new Joshua, O God-bearer,[^62] thou didst halt the course of the sun by light-shining supplication, adorned with divine words, O blessed one, illuminated by the radiant dawn of wonders, and beautified by many miracles of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Shown forth as a new Joshua, O God-bearer,[^62] thou didst halt the course of the sun by light-shining supplication, adorned with divine words, O blessed one, illuminated by the radiant dawn of wonders, and beautified by many miracles of God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мⷭ҇ЦЪ ЇꙊ́НЇЙ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In the book of life thou wast worthily inscribed,[^63] having accomplished all things written in the divine books; therefore I cry aloud unto thee: By thy supplications unto the all-seeing God, O father, tear in pieces the handwriting of mine evil deeds![^64]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
In the book of life thou wast worthily inscribed,[^63] having accomplished all things written in the divine books; therefore I cry aloud unto thee: By thy supplications unto the all-seeing God, O father, tear in pieces the handwriting of mine evil deeds![^64]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: къ црⷭ҇твꙋ показа̀ стезю̀ : * въ не́йже ше́ствова, * де́монѡвъ ѡ҆ѕлобле́нїа, * и҆ помраче́нїа дꙋше́внагѡ ᲂу҆клони́лсѧ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Following the steps of Him Who shone forth from thy womb by an ineffable birthgiving, O Virgin Mother, the choir of the venerable hath been joined unto the heavenly ranks; with whom pray, and ask cleansing for us who honor thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Following the steps of Him Who shone forth from thy womb by an ineffable birthgiving, O Virgin Mother, the choir of the venerable hath been joined unto the heavenly ranks; with whom pray, and ask cleansing for us who honor thee!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Но́въ ꙗ҆́вльсѧ і҆исꙋ́съ бг҃оно́се, * со́лнца тече́нїе ᲂу҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ мольбо́ю свѣтосїѧ́нною, * бж҃твенными словесы̀ ᲂу҆краша́емь блаже́нне, * и҆ чꙋде́съ зарю̀ просвѣща́емь, * и҆ бж҃їими чꙋдесы̀ мно́гими ᲂу҆добрѧ́емь .
items.english_text: *Ode 5 [Canon of Saint Hilarion]. Heirmos:* *Rising early we cry aloud unto Thee, O Lord: Save us! For Thou art our God, beside Thee we know no other.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5 [Canon of Saint Hilarion]. Heirmos:*
*Rising early we cry aloud unto Thee, O Lord: Save us! For Thou art our God, beside Thee we know no other.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Въ кни́зѣ живо́тнѣй написа́лсѧ є҆сѝ досто́йнѡ, * напи̑саннаѧ всѧ̑ сконча́въ въ бж҃е́ственныхъ кни́гахъ : * тѣ́мже вопїю́ ти : * рꙋкописа́нїе ѻ҆́ч҃е ѕѡ́лъ мои́хъ, * твои́ми расто́ргни, * ко всеви́дцꙋ бг҃ꙋ мольба́ми .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The eye of the heart thou didst keep sleepless in the divine commandments, blamelessly, O glorious one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The eye of the heart thou didst keep sleepless in the divine commandments, blamelessly, O glorious one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Стопа́мъ послѣ́дꙋѧ, собо́ръ преподо́бныхъ, * и҆з̾ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ возсїѧ́вшемꙋ неизрече́ннымъ рж҃тво́мъ дѣ́во мт҃и, * съ нбⷭ҇ными ли́ки сочта́сѧ : * съ ни́миже моли́сѧ, * и҆ и҆спросѝ на́мъ ѡ҆чище́нїе чтꙋ́щымъ тѧ̀ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Upon the mountain of virtues by abstinence, O God-bearer, actively didst thou ascend, unto ascents of the vision of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Upon the mountain of virtues by abstinence, O God-bearer, actively didst thou ascend, unto ascents of the vision of God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ . Їрмо́съ : Оу҆́тренююще вопїе́мъ тѝ гдⷭ҇и сп҃си́ ны : * ты́ бо є҆сѝ бг҃ъ на́шъ, * ра́звѣ тебѐ и҆но́гѡ не вѣ́мы .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Pouring out oil unto the poor from the heart, O venerable Hilarion, thou didst draw celestial riches!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Pouring out oil unto the poor from the heart, O venerable Hilarion, thou didst draw celestial riches!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: ѻ҆́ко серде́чное невсы́пно, * въ бж҃е́ственныхъ за́повѣдехъ соблю́лъ є҆сѝ, * незазо́рно сла́вне .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Lord of the Law showed thee forth as the ark of the Word, O Birthgiver of God, wherein He ineffably took up abode!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The Lord of the Law showed thee forth as the ark of the Word, O Birthgiver of God, wherein He ineffably took up abode!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: На го́рꙋ добродѣ́телей воздержа́нїемъ бг҃оно́се, * дѣ́телнѡ восте́клъ є҆сѝ, * къ бг҃овидѣ́нїю восхожде́нїа .
items.english_text: *Ode 6 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:* *Unto the Lord out of the whale Jonah cried aloud: Lead me up from the depths of hades, I pray; that as unto the Deliverer, in the voice of praise and in the spirit of truth, I may sacrifice unto Thee![^65]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:*
*Unto the Lord out of the whale Jonah cried aloud: Lead me up from the depths of hades, I pray; that as unto the Deliverer, in the voice of praise and in the spirit of truth, I may sacrifice unto Thee![^65]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ле́й расточи́въ ни́щымъ, * ѿ се́рдца і҆ларїѡ́не прпⷣбне, * бога́тство нбⷭ҇ное почерпа́лъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst not grow weary, drawing near unto many struggles; for forty nights and forty days, O venerable one, thou didst remain standing,[^66] unbent by the pressing necessities of nature!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst not grow weary, drawing near unto many struggles; for forty nights and forty days, O venerable one, thou didst remain standing,[^66] unbent by the pressing necessities of nature!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Сло́ва ковче́гъ тѧ̀ показа̀ бцⷣе зако́на гдⷭ҇ь, * во́ньже неска́заннѡ всели́сѧ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having mortified thy members which are upon the earth,[^67] O marvelous one, with the living operation of healings thou wast enriched, and thou livest in the heavens, ever healing the passions of our souls that bring death!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having mortified thy members which are upon the earth,[^67] O marvelous one, with the living operation of healings thou wast enriched, and thou livest in the heavens, ever healing the passions of our souls that bring death!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃ . Їрмо́съ : Ко гдⷭ҇ꙋ ѿ ки́та і҆ѡ́на возопѝ : * ты́ мѧ возведѝ и҆з̾ глꙋбины̀ а҆́да молю́сѧ . * да ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆зба́вителю во гла́сѣ хвале́нїѧ, * и҆́стины же дх҃омъ пожрꙋ̀ тебѣ̀ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst finish thy life ever weeping, for divine desire inflamed thee within, O father; and now in the heavens thou hast found comfort, joining with the choirs of the venerable!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst finish thy life ever weeping, for divine desire inflamed thee within, O father; and now in the heavens thou hast found comfort, joining with the choirs of the venerable!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:

items.slavonic_text: тваре́й содѣ́тель : * є҆го́же молѝ чи́стаѧ, * ѡ҆блада́ющагѡ и҆зба́вити врага̀, * дꙋ́шы на́ша .

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ . Їрмо́съ : Ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ̀ сп҃се, * мнѡ́га бо беззако́нїа моѧ̑, * и҆ и҆з̾ глꙋбины̀ ѕѡ́лъ возведѝ молю́сѧ : * къ тебѣ̀ бо возопи́хъ, * и҆ ᲂу҆слы́ши мѧ̀, * бж҃е сп҃се́нїа моегѡ̀ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Truly thou didst conceive the Word of God in thy womb, and Him beyond nature thou didst bear, O all-immaculate one; Whom entreat by thy prayers on behalf of them that truly praise thee as the Birthgiver of God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мы́сленнаго голїа́да ѕло́бою возносѧ́щагосѧ, * безѡрꙋ́жнымъ твои́мъ сплете́нїемъ, * вѣ́рнѡ пра́щею ᲂу҆би́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ сегѡ̀ и҆сто́ргъ побѣди́телнаѧ ѻ҆рꙋ́жїа, * ꙗ҆́кѡ вельмѝ хва́лѧщасѧ посѣ́клъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Kontakion of Saint Bessarion, Tone 2, Podoben: "The firm" (Тве́рдыѧ):* Emulating the powers on high, O venerable one, thou didst live after the manner of the birds, consigning temporal things unto oblivion, drawn with ceaseless desire toward the heavenly beauties of Christ the King, until thou didst attain unto Him, O Bessarion: pray ceaselessly for us all!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Вели́комꙋ въ добродѣ́телехъ поревнова́лъ є҆сѝ і҆ларїѡ́нꙋ, * и҆ сегѡ̀ дх҃о́внѡ стопа́мъ послѣ́дꙋѧ, * воздержа́нїемъ прпⷣбне, * верхо́венъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * и҆ ста́дꙋ воображе́нїе .
items.english_text: *Ode 7 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:* *The most wise children served not the golden image, but entered into the flame of their own accord, and mocked their gods; amid the flame they cried aloud, and an Angel bedewed them: The prayer of your mouth hath now been heard![^71]*

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Поты̀ воздержа́телными ᲂу҆́глїе стрѣ́лъ врага̀ погаси́лъ є҆сѝ до конца̀ : * и҆ ѻ҆́гнь вѣ́ры бж҃їѧ, * попали́лъ є҆сѝ невѣ́рїа є҆рети́ческагѡ шата́нїа .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having renewed thy soul with the pious plow of abstinence, O father, thou didst cultivate a fruitful ear of corn, preserved in the heavenly granaries, and thou feedest them that faithfully sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:

Having renewed thy soul with the pious plow of abstinence, O father, thou didst cultivate a fruitful ear of corn, preserved in the heavenly granaries, and thou feedest them that faithfully sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Зачала̀ є҆сѝ вои́стиннꙋ бж҃їа сло́ва во ᲂу҆тро́бѣ твое́й : * и҆ сего̀ па́че є҆стества̀ всенепоро́чнаѧ родила̀ є҆сѝ . * є҆го́же моли́твами ᲂу҆молѝ, * ѡ҆ и҆́же вои́стиннꙋ бцⷣꙋ воспѣва́ющихъ тѧ̀ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having mingled with the immaterial Light, thou wast a pure light, and thou didst pass through the rushing torrent of the river without wetting thy feet at all;[^72] and in upright paths thou didst walk, O God-wise Bessarion, escaping the turbid waters of sin!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, висарїѡ́на, гла́съ, в҃ . Подо́бенъ : Тве́рдыѧ : Вы́шнихъ си́лъ подража́въ прпⷣбне, * ѻ҆́бразомъ пти́цъ житїѐ пожи́лъ є҆сѝ, * вре́меннаѧ въ забы́тїи положи́въ, * непреста́ннымъ жела́нїемъ влеко́мъ къ нбⷭ҇нымъ добро́тамъ хрⷭ҇та̀ цр҃ѧ̀ : * до́ндеже тогѡ̀ дости́глъ є҆сѝ висарїѡ́не, * молѝ непреста́ннѡ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ на́съ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O fearful wonder! How thou didst make water that was formerly undrinkable to be potable by the divine sign of the Cross, and didst cross the torrent of the river...

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆бнови́въ дꙋ́шꙋ воздержа́нїа бл҃гочести́вымъ ѻ҆́че ра́ломъ, * кла́съ многопло́денъ воздѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ, * въ жи́тницахъ соблюда́емь нбⷭ҇ныхъ, * и҆ пита́еши вѣ́рнѡ воспѣва́ющыѧ : * бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ .
items.english_text: and didst hold back the course of the sun, O God-wise Bessarion, magnified with sacred tokens from God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тꙋ сраствори́всѧ невеще́ственномꙋ, * чи́стъ свѣ́тъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ быстри́нꙋ рѣчнꙋ́ю преше́лъ є҆сѝ, * ѡ҆мочи́въ ника́коже стѡпы̀ твоѧ̑ : * по стезѧ́хъ же пра́выхъ бг҃омꙋ́дре висарїѡ́не ходи́лъ є҆сѝ, * грѣха̀ мꙋ́тныѧ и҆збѣ́гъ во́ды .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Hypostatic Wisdom of God was born of thee, O pure one, and destroyed the evil-believing philosophers, and made wise the multitude of monastics and venerable ones to praise with grace the blessed one who bore God in the flesh!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ чꙋ́до, стра́шно ! * ка́кѡ непива́емыѧ и҆ногда̀ во́ды, * пїе́мы сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ, * бж҃е́ственнымъ назнамена́нїемъ, * и҆ рѣчнꙋ́ю быстри́нꙋ преше́лъ є҆сѝ :

items.slavonic_text: Мⷭ҇ЦЪ ЇꙊ́НЇЙ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Stretching forth the radiance of wonders, thou drivest away the gloom of the diseased; and thou dispensest today rays of health and cures unto them that cry: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: тече́нїе же ᲂу҆держа́лъ є҆сѝ сл҃чное, * висарїѡ́не бг҃омꙋ́дре, * бг҃озна́менїи свѧще́нными велича́емь .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst enter into the heavenly bridal banquet of Christ the King, clothed in a garment worthy of Him that called thee;[^73] therefore thou didst recline at table, crying aloud: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Мꙋ́дрость бж҃їа ѵ҆поста́снаѧ, * и҆з̾ тебѐ чтⷭ҇аѧ роди́сѧ, * и҆ ѕловѣ́рныѧ мꙋдрецы̀ потребѝ, * и҆ ᲂу҆мꙋдрѝ мно́жество мона́шествꙋющихъ и҆ преподо́бныхъ, * воспѣва́ти бл҃гтїю, * бл҃гве́ннаѧ ꙗ҆́же бг҃а пло́тїю ро́ждшаѧ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beyond nature and word thou didst bear the Master of all, and thou nourishest from thy breasts Him Who prepares in due season a table for all;[^74] Whom earnestly entreat on our behalf, O all-pure one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Beyond nature and word thou didst bear the Master of all, and thou nourishest from thy breasts Him Who prepares in due season a table for all;[^74] Whom earnestly entreat on our behalf, O all-pure one!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ . Їрмо́съ : Ѿ і҆ꙋде́и доше́дше ѻ҆́троцы, * въ вавѷлѡ́нѣ и҆ногда̀, * вѣ́рою трⷪ҇ческою пла́мень пе́щный попра́ша пою́ще : * ѻ҆ц҃е́въ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Ode 8 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:* *Unto God Who descended into the fiery furnace with the Hebrew children, and changed the flame into dew: sing, ye works, as the Lord, and highly exalt Him unto all ages!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Во ѕла́цѣ вы́шнагѡ црⷭ҇тва, * ста́до ѻ҆́ч҃е воспита́лъ є҆сѝ : * и҆ жезло́мъ ᲂу҆че́нїй, * ѕвѣ́ри ѿгна́въ є҆рети́ческїѧ, * пѣ́лъ є҆сѝ : * ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Light has shone forth clearly for thee as for a righteous man,[^75] and joy and gladness, because thou didst weep diligently upon the earth, O father, and wast a stranger thereto by lack of possessions and by every suffering of affliction!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Light has shone forth clearly for thee as for a righteous man,[^75] and joy and gladness, because thou didst weep diligently upon the earth, O father, and wast a stranger thereto by lack of possessions and by every suffering of affliction!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋде́съ зарю̀ просте́ръ, * разго́нѧеши недꙋ́гꙋющихъ мглꙋ̀ : * и҆ здра́вїа лꙋчы̑ подае́ши дне́сь, * и҆ цѣльбы̑, * зовꙋ́щымъ : * ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Wholly mingled from within with supreme desires, O venerable father, thou didst pass through cities and deserts in great compunction, until thou didst reach the Metropolis on high, radiantly adorned!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Wholly mingled from within with supreme desires, O venerable father, thou didst pass through cities and deserts in great compunction, until thou didst reach the Metropolis on high, radiantly adorned!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Въ вы́шнюю вше́лъ є҆сѝ бра́чнꙋю трапе́зꙋ цр҃ѧ̀ хрⷭ҇та̀, * во оде́ждꙋ ѡ҆дѣ́ѧнъ, * досто́йнѡ зовꙋ́щемꙋ . * тѣ́мъ и҆ возле́глъ є҆сѝ вопїѧ̀ : * ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As the dawn thou hast shone forth unto us, enlightening our thoughts ever with radiant virtues; therefore today we celebrate thy light-bearing memory, O father Bessarion!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
As the dawn thou hast shone forth unto us, enlightening our thoughts ever with radiant virtues; therefore today we celebrate thy light-bearing memory, O father Bessarion!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Па́че є҆стества̀ и҆ сло́ва, * влⷣкꙋ всѣ́хъ родила̀ є҆сѝ ; * и҆ пита́еши ѿ сосцꙋ̑ твое́ю, * всѣ̑мъ во бл҃го вре́мѧ гото́вѧщаго трапе́зꙋ : * є҆го́же прилѣ́жнѡ пречⷭ҇таѧ ѡ҆ на́съ молѝ .
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst bear a Son, O pure one, co-unoriginate with the unoriginate Father, and thou alone didst renew our nature which had grown old through grievous transgressions; therefore in unison we sing of thee, O Birthgiver of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:

Thou didst bear a Son, O pure one, co-unoriginate with the unoriginate Father, and thou alone didst renew our nature which had grown old through grievous transgressions; therefore in unison we sing of thee, O Birthgiver of God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тъ тебѣ̀ возсїѧ̀ ꙗ҆́вѣ, * ꙗ҆́коже првⷣникꙋ, * и҆ ра́дость и҆ весе́лїе, * ꙗ҆́кѡ пла́кавшꙋ ѻ҆́ч҃е на землѝ прилѣ́жнѡ, * и҆ стра́ннꙋ сеѧ̀ бы́вшꙋ нестѧжа́нїемъ, * и҆ всѧ́цемъ ѕлострада́нїемъ .
items.english_text: *Ode 8 [Canon of Saint Hilarion]. Heirmos:* *Sevenfold did the Chaldean tyrant frantically kindle the furnace for the pious; but seeing them saved by a greater power, he cried aloud unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, highly exalt Him unto all ages!*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь ѿню́дъ сраствори́всѧ коне́чными жела́нїи, * прпⷣбне ѻ҆́ч҃е . * гра́ды же и҆ пꙋсты́ни во ᲂу҆миле́нїи мно́зѣ прохожда́лъ є҆сѝ, * до́ндеже митропо́лїю дости́глъ є҆сѝ вы́шнюю, * свѣ́тлѡ ᲂу҆краша́емь .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With tearful streams thou didst drown the surgings of passions and restless thoughts; and thou wast an abyss of long-suffering, O venerable one, guiding unto a most peaceful haven them that cry aloud: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, highly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́тро возсїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ на́мъ, * свѣ́тлыми добродѣ́тели просвѣще́нїи, * на́ша мы́сли просвѣща́ѧ при́снѡ . * тѣ́мже твою̀ свѣтоно́снꙋю дне́сь, * ѻ҆́ч҃е висарїѡ́не, * соверша́емъ па́мѧть .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having thy teachings of abstinence, O venerable Hilarion, like a patient adamant we establish our hearts and conquer the legions of passions, crying aloud in faith with our tongue: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, highly exalt Him unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ : Тебѐ родила̀ є҆сѝ сн҃а, * собезнача́лна чи́стаѧ ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ безнача́льномꙋ, * и҆ ѡ҆бнови́ла є҆сѝ є҆ди́на, * ѡ҆бетша́вшее на́ше є҆стество̀, * лю́тыми престꙋпле́нїи . * тѣ́мже тѧ̀ согла́снѡ пое́мъ бцⷣе .
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By abstinence, O venerable one, wisely exhausting the voluptuousness of the flesh by self-restraint, thou didst fill the soul's operation with the Spirit, and didst attain unto the paths of dispassion, crying: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, highly exalt Him unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beneath the shelter of thy holy wings, O Sovereign Lady, all of us who are afflicted with grievous sins, trials, and tribulations flee; having thee as an intercessor, we cry aloud: Ye children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, highly exalt Him unto all ages!

items.english_text: *Ode 9 [Canon of Saint Bessarion]. Heirmos:* *God the Word of God, Who by ineffable wisdom came to renew Adam who through eating fell grievously into corruption, and Who for our sake was ineffably incarnate of the Holy Virgin: with one accord in hymns, ye faithful, let us magnify!*
