items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 6, Tone 4
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ нн҃ѣ, прⷪ, и҆лѝ бг҃оро́диченъ. Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Подо́бенъ: Все ѿло́жше: А҆́гница своего̀, а҆́гнца нескве́рнаѧ дре́вле, * и҆ непоро́чнаѧ влⷣчца, * на дре́вѣ крⷭ҇тнѣмъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ᲂу҆зрѣ̀, * мт҃рски восклица́ше, * и҆ дивѧ́щисѧ вопїѧ́ше: * ча́до сладча́йшее, * что̀ зрѣ́нїе сїѐ, но́вое и҆ пресла́вное? * ка́кѡ со́нмъ безбл҃года́тный, * суди́щу пїла́тову предаде́ тѧ, * и҆ ѡ҆сужда́етъ на сме́рть, живота̀ всѧ́ческихъ? * но воспѣва́ю твоѐ неизрече́нное, * сло́ве снизхожде́нїе.
items.english_text: Having enlightened thy mind with spiritual radiance, * thou wast a sun of radiant beams, * stretching forth the rays of doctrine * unto all ends, * and enlightening the fullness of the faithful, * O all-blessed one, * and driving away the darkness of heresies, O God-bearer, * by the power of Him Who shone forth from the Virgin!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having enlightened thy mind with spiritual radiance, * thou wast a sun of radiant beams, * stretching forth the rays of doctrine * unto all ends, * and enlightening the fullness of the faithful, * O all-blessed one, * and driving away the darkness of heresies, O God-bearer, * by the power of Him Who shone forth from the Virgin!

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 6, Tone 4
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ, ѻ҆ктѡ́иха: Сла́ва, гла́съ, ѕ҃. Человѣ́че бж҃їй, и҆ вѣ́рный ра́бе, * слуго̀ гдⷭ҇нь, му́жу жела́нїй, * сосу́де и҆збра́нный, столпѐ и҆ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе цр҃кве, * црⷭ҇твїѧ наслѣ́дниче,
items.english_text: By the eloquence of thy words, * O holy Cyril, * the whole Church is adorned * and piously embellished with fair beauties, * and sacredly honors * thy holy and renowned memory, * O praise of the Orthodox, * head of the fathers, * champion of the good at the Council![^130]

provenance.verbatim_source: By the eloquence of thy words, * O holy Cyril, * the whole Church is adorned * and piously embellished with fair beauties, * and sacredly honors * thy holy and renowned memory, * O praise of the Orthodox, * head of the fathers, * champion of the good at the Council![^130]

items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p52 === (Fol. 25v) наслѣ́дниче, не премолчѝ вопїѧ̀ за ны̀ ко гдⷭ҇у.
items.english_text: By thy fiery doctrines, * every brushwood matter of heresies * is consumed, O most wise one; * by thy depths of understanding, * the army of the disobedient and impious * is submerged; * while the Church of the faithful is ever glorified, * honoring thee with a loud voice!

items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, и҃. Правосла́вїѧ наста́вниче, * бл҃гоче́стїѧ ᲂу҆чи́телю и҆ чистоты̀, * вселе́нныѧ свѣти́льниче, * а҆рхїере́ѡвъ бг҃одꙋхнове́нное ᲂу҆добре́нїе, * курі́лле премꙋ́дре, * ᲂу҆че́ньми твои́ми всѧ̑ просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ: * цѣвни́це дх҃о́внаѧ, * молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а спасти́сѧ душа́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: O good and faithful servant, * laborer of the vineyard of Christ: * thou didst bear the burden of the day, * thou didst multiply the talent given unto thee, * and didst not envy them that came after thee;[^131] * therefore the heavenly gates have opened unto thee: * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord,[^132] * and pray for us, O Cyril our father!

provenance.verbatim_source: O good and faithful servant, * laborer of the vineyard of Christ: * thou didst bear the burden of the day, * thou didst multiply the talent given unto thee, * and didst not envy them that came after thee;[^131] * therefore the heavenly gates have opened unto thee: * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord,[^132] * and pray for us, O Cyril our father!

items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having laid aside all earthly hope" (Все ѿло́жше):* When the spotless and blameless Sovereign Lady of old * beheld her own Lamb upon the Wood of the Cross, * with a mother's voice she cried aloud, * and marveling shouted: * O sweetest Child, * what is this new and most marvelous sight? * How has the graceless council * delivered Thee unto the judgment seat of Pilate, * and condemned unto death the Life of all? * Yet I sing of Thine ineffable condescension, * O Word!

items.english_text: O man of God, and faithful servant, * minister of the Lord, man of desires,[^133] * chosen vessel, pillar and foundation of the Church,[^134] * heir of the Kingdom,...

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: О҆у҆крѣплѧ́емь ѡ҆ хрⷭ҇тѣ̀, * ко́зни лука́вагѡ ѕмї́ѧ, * тве́рдымъ ᲂу҆мо́мъ курі́лле, * ꙗ҆́коже тка́нїе паꙋчи́нное расто́ргнулъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: ...heir of the Kingdom, do not cease crying aloud for us unto the Lord!

items.slavonic_text: Побѣди́вша стра̑сти душетлѣ̑нныѧ, * и҆ по́мыслъ ᲂу҆держа́вша плотскі́й, * бг҃оно́сне курі́лле, * ви́дѣвъ хрⷭ҇то́съ, * бж҃е́ственныѧ тѧ̀ цр҃кве предсѣда́телѧ, ѻ҆́тче поста́ви.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having received light-bestowing grace from God, O Cyril, thou wast shown forth as a radiant luminary, flashing forth rational rays upon us by thy memory, that we may worthily hymn thee!

items.slavonic_text: Наслѣ́довавъ ꙗ҆́кѡ сн҃ъ возлю́бленъ, * ѻ҆те́ческую ма́ркову добродѣ́тель, * и҆ престо́ла бы́лъ є҆сѝ прїе́мникъ, * бж҃твеннагѡ стопа́мъ є҆ѵлїста послѣ́дуѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast filled with spiritual manifestation of light, O most wise Cyril, as a keeper of Christ's commandments, cleansed from passions; truly wast thou a dwelling place of the super-divine Trinity!

items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇та̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆вча̀ ᲂу҆пасе́нъ бы́въ, * ꙗ҆́коже па́стырь ᲂу҆па́слъ є҆сѝ ста́до ѻ҆́тче, * словесы̀ душенапита́тельными твои́ми, * ꙗ҆́кѡ трава́ми и҆ цвѣты̀, * бога́тнѡ напи́таѧ бл҃года́ти.

items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїю вои́стинну ѕѣ́лному, * наводнѧ́ющымъ рѣ́ки, * тво...
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Strengthened in Christ, O Cyril, with a steadfast mind thou didst rend asunder the wiles of the crafty serpent like a spider's web!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Strengthened in Christ, O Cyril, with a steadfast mind thou didst rend asunder the wiles of the crafty serpent like a spider's web!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p54 === (Fol. 26v) ѡ҆ курі́лле ᲂу҆подо́бисѧ сло́во, * ѕлосла́вныхъ ѡ҆браща́ѧ ᲂу҆хщре́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst shake off the darkness of passions from thy soul, O Cyril, casting down the exaltation of every thought that exalts itself against Christ![^138]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst shake off the darkness of passions from thy soul, O Cyril, casting down the exaltation of every thought that exalts itself against Christ![^138]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ра́внѣ ме́рзкое а҆́рїево раздѣле́нїе, * ѡ҆ курі́лле, скве́рное же саве́ллїево слїѧ́нїе, * и҆з̾ глубины̀ и҆зве́рглъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a successful combatant, O father, thou didst firmly turn away from all carnal voluptuousness, as vain and baneful!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
As a successful combatant, O father, thou didst firmly turn away from all carnal voluptuousness, as vain and baneful!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Да кропи́тъ не́бо весе́лїе, * и҆ бл҃года́ть на землѝ: * возда́стсѧ бо є҆́й ны́нѣ весе́лїе въ высотꙋ̀, * є҆ди́ну бг҃ома́терь.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee who alone among women art blessed, as the divine dwelling place, in all comeliness let all of us glorify with joy!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thee who alone among women art blessed, as the divine dwelling place, in all comeliness let all of us glorify with joy!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Пожрꙋ́ ти со гла́сомъ хвале́нїѧ гдⷭ҇и, * цр҃ковь вопїе́тъ тѝ, * ѿ бѣсо́вскїѧ кро́ве ѡ҆чи́щшисѧ, * ра́ди ми́лости ѿ ре́бръ твои́хъ и҆сте́кшею кро́вїю.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Beholding the beauty of thy virginity" (Красотѣ̀ дѣ́вства):* Having become a pillar and sacrifice of Christ's Church, O father, thou didst most wisely preserve her unshaken from the temptations of the crafty one; for thou didst overthrow all the malice of Nestorius,[^139] and didst proclaim the Birthgiver of God to be the Mother of God; therefore, having assembled, we honor thee, O Cyril, blessed of God! *Twice.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 3, Podoben: "Beholding the beauty of thy virginity" (Красотѣ̀ дѣ́вства):*
Having become a pillar and sacrifice of Christ's Church, O father, thou didst most wisely preserve her unshaken from the temptations of the crafty one; for thou didst overthrow all the malice of Nestorius,[^139] and didst proclaim the Birthgiver of God to be the Mother of God; therefore, having assembled, we honor thee, O Cyril, blessed of God! *Twice.*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Є҆динопредѣ́лныхъ ꙗ҆́кѡ самѱѡ́нъ и҆ноплеме́нники не потреби́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆норѡ́дныхъ же всѧ̑ и҆носла́вныхъ ᲂу҆че́нїа низложи́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ держа́ву правосла́внымъ да́лъ є҆сѝ курі́лле.
items.english_text: As the uncultivated vine, O Virgin, thou didst bud forth the most beautiful cluster of grapes, pouring out for us the wine of salvation, making glad the souls and bodies of all; therefore ever blessing thee as the cause of good things, with the Angel we cry aloud unto thee: Rejoice, thou who art full of grace!

provenance.verbatim_source: As the uncultivated vine, O Virgin, thou didst bud forth the most beautiful cluster of grapes, pouring out for us the wine of salvation, making glad the souls and bodies of all; therefore ever blessing thee as the cause of good things, with the Angel we cry aloud unto thee: Rejoice, thou who art full of grace!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Собо́ру бг҃оизбра́нномꙋ ꙗ҆́вѣ предводи́тельствовавъ, * ѕлоче́стїе нестѡ́рїево, * хрїстобо́рную де́рзость ѻ҆́тче низложи́лъ є҆сѝ, * ре́вностїю дх҃а, по и҆́стиннѣй бг҃ома́тери.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* The unwedded pure one and Thy Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee hanging dead upon the Cross, weeping with a mother's voice, said: What has the Jewish lawless and ungrateful assembly rendered unto Thee, which enjoyed so many and great of Thy gifts, O my Son? I sing of Thy divine condescension!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
The unwedded pure one and Thy Mother, O Christ, beholding Thee hanging dead upon the Cross, weeping with a mother's voice, said: What has the Jewish lawless and ungrateful assembly rendered unto Thee, which enjoyed so many and great of Thy gifts, O my Son? I sing of Thy divine condescension!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ра́зума нетлѣ́ннагѡ пло́дъ прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ бг҃ороди́тельнице, * мі́ру присноживо́тный, * хода́тай нетлѣ́нїѧ ꙗ҆влѧ́емь, * вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вїю пою́щихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *Beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Sun of Righteousness, the Church stood in her station, worthily crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^140]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*Beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Sun of Righteousness, the Church stood in her station, worthily crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^140]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, ѕ҃. Подо́бенъ: Е҆́же ѡ҆ на́съ: Бе́здну на́мъ ᲂу҆че́нїй бг҃осло́вїѧ и҆сточи́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́вѣ, * ѿ и҆сто́чникъ сп҃совыхъ, * є҆́реси погружа́ющꙋю, * бл҃же́нне курі́лле, * и҆ ста́до невреди́мо ѿ треволне́нїй сп҃са́ющꙋю: * страна́мъ бо є҆сѝ всѣ̑мъ наста́вникъ прпⷣбне, * ꙗ҆́кѡ бж҃е́ственнаѧ ꙗ҆влѧ́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding that thou hadst conquered soul-corrupting passions and restrained carnal thinking, O God-bearing Cyril, Christ appointed thee, O father, as president of His divine Church!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Beholding that thou hadst conquered soul-corrupting passions and restrained carnal thinking, O God-bearing Cyril, Christ appointed thee, O father, as president of His divine Church!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: І҆́косъ: Кра́сно при ᲂу҆́тренни показу́етсѧ вельмѝ со́лнце, * сщ҃е́нно свѣтоно́сно. Тма̀ ѿго́нитсѧ, * и҆ луна̀ ᲂу҆хожда́етсѧ, * но́щь бо не состои́тсѧ: ᲂу҆ѧснѧ́етъ де́нь, * просвѣща́етъ возду́хъ, * не́бо кра́сно показу́етъ на́мъ, * зе́млю ᲂу҆добрѧ́ѧ, * цвѣтѡ́мъ творѧ̀ и҆зраще́нїе: * мо́ре же ѡ҆блиста́етъ, * и҆ вку́пѣ ве́сь ᲂу҆краша́етъ мі́ръ, * є҆́же бо всѣ́мъ сегѡ̀ свѣтлѣ́йши курі́ллъ, * є҆гѡ́же мꙋ́драѧ ᲂу҆че́нїа сп҃са́ютъ поднебе́сную: * ѡ҆зарѧ́етъ бо то́й вѣ́рныхъ дꙋ́шы, * и҆ побѣжда́етъ бл҃гоче́стнѡ є҆́реси при́снѡ, * страна́мъ бо то́й наста́вникъ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ бж҃е́ственнаѧ ꙗ҆влѧ́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having inherited as a beloved son the paternal virtue of Mark,[^141] thou wast a successor unto his throne, following the footsteps of the divine Evangelist!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having inherited as a beloved son the paternal virtue of Mark,[^141] thou wast a successor unto his throne, following the footsteps of the divine Evangelist!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p55 === (Fol. 27r) Пѣ́снь, з҃. І҆рмо́съ: Въ пе́щи а҆враа́мстїи ѻ҆́троцы, персі́дстѣй, * любо́вїю бл҃гоче́стїѧ па́че, не́жели пла́менемъ ѡ҆пала́еми взыва́хꙋ: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ въ хра́мѣ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having been tended like a sheep of Christ, like a shepherd thou didst tend the flock, O father, with thy soul-nourishing words, as with grasses and flowers, richly feeding them with grace!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having been tended like a sheep of Christ, like a shepherd thou didst tend the flock, O father, with thy soul-nourishing words, as with grasses and flowers, richly feeding them with grace!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Въ сїна́йстѣй горѣ̀ во мра́къ дре́вле вше́дъ, * зако́нъ прїѧ́тъ бл҃же́нне курі́лле мѡѷсе́й, * ᲂу҆бива́ющїй писме́немъ: * ты́ же разгну́лъ є҆сѝ сокрове́нную добро́ту дх҃а.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having given birth unto the Word of God, incarnate Who was bodiless before, O all-hymned and favored one, thou didst renew the world; therefore, O Bride of God, with Orthodox faith we proclaim thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having given birth unto the Word of God, incarnate Who was bodiless before, O all-hymned and favored one, thou didst renew the world; therefore, O Bride of God, with Orthodox faith we proclaim thee!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Законоположе́нїа гада́ньми, * ꙗ҆́коже мла́нцемъ пе́рвѣе ѻ҆́че, * да́ннагѡ покрыва́ло покровенїѧ, * ꙗ҆́коже шки́пки разꙋмѣ́нїа ты̀ ѡ҆кры́лъ є҆сѝ, * сказа́въ ѻ҆́бразы ꙗ҆́вственнѣйше.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *Thou, my Lord, art come into the world as Light, a holy Light turning from gloomy ignorance them that hymn Thee in faith![^142]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*Thou, my Lord, art come into the world as Light, a holy Light turning from gloomy ignorance them that hymn Thee in faith![^142]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Въ несли́тномъ соединенїи бж҃твенномъ, * и҆ несѣко́момъ ꙗ҆́вѣ ѻ҆́че раздѣле́нїи, * трѝ ᲂу҆́бѡ бг҃осло́вствовалъ ѵ҆поста́си, * ре́клъ є҆сѝ курі́лле, * непремѣ́нныѧ же въ сꙋществѣ̀ є҆ди́номъ и҆ бж҃твѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto an exceedingly mighty torrent flooding rivers, thy...

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Unto an exceedingly mighty torrent flooding rivers, thy...

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ру́цѣ распросте́ръ дані́илъ, * львѡ́въ зїѧ̑нїѧ въ ро́вѣ затчѐ: * ѻ҆́гненную же си́лу ᲂу҆гаси́ша, * добродѣ́телїю препоѧ́савшесѧ, * бл҃гоче́стїѧ рачи́тели ѻ҆́троцы, взыва́юще: * бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: ...thy word, O Cyril, was likened, turning aside the subtilties of the ill-renowned.

provenance.verbatim_source: ...thy word, O Cyril, was likened, turning aside the subtilties of the ill-renowned.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ волна̀ морска́ѧ вои́стинну, * къ тебѣ̀ и҆стечѐ премꙋ́дрости и҆сто́чникъ: * и҆́бо приснотекꙋ́щыѧ потеко́ша рѣ́ки * ѿ чре́ва твоегѡ̀ ѻ҆́че ᲂу҆че́нїй бл҃гочести́выхъ, * ꙗ҆́коже прорече́ хрїсто́съ: * прехо́дѧтъ бо песка̀ твоѧ̑ словеса̀ бг҃оизбра́ннаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Alike the abominable division of Arius,[^143] O Cyril, and the foul confusion of Sabellius,[^144] thou didst cast out from the deep!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Alike the abominable division of Arius,[^143] O Cyril, and the foul confusion of Sabellius,[^144] thou didst cast out from the deep!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Па́стырь и҆ ᲂу҆чи́тель мꙋ́дръ цр҃кве ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * ѻ҆́блї курі́лле ꙗ҆́вѣ, * разгну́лъ є҆сѝ преподо́бне завѣ́ты. * Ꙗ҆́кѡ бо а҆́гкѵрꙋ, и҆ ѻ҆тє́ческаѧ наслѣ̑дїа твоѧ̑ и҆мꙋ́щи словеса̀, * вопїе́тъ: * бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Wealth-producing words like gold hast thou left unto the Church of Christ, O Cyril, and treasures as thy precious stones!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Wealth-producing words like gold hast thou left unto the Church of Christ, O Cyril, and treasures as thy precious stones!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сло́ва вопло́щшагѡсѧ на́съ ра́ди, всехитреца̀, * ты̀ неизрече́нномꙋ научи́леши соединенїю курі́лле нераздѣ́лное неслїѧ́нное, * по кое́йждо во́ли ра́внѣ ᲂу҆клони́лъ є҆сѝ, вопїѧ̀: * бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Let heaven drop down gladness and grace upon the earth;[^145] for gladness unto the height is now rendered unto her, the only Mother of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Let heaven drop down gladness and grace upon the earth;[^145] for gladness unto the height is now rendered unto her, the only Mother of God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Є҆стество́мъ непристꙋ́пный ви́дꙋ, * сн҃ъ и҆ сло́во бж҃їе въ тѧ̀ всели́сѧ чи́стаѧ, * и҆ ѡ҆болче́сѧ пречⷭ҇таѧ, * въ на́ше сꙋщество̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ млрⷣъ, * ꙗ҆ви́сѧ бл҃гопристꙋ́пенъ пло́тїю, * и҆ водвори́сѧ съ на́ми вопїю́щими: * бл҃гослови́те всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *I will sacrifice unto Thee with the voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries aloud unto Thee, cleansed from demonic blood by the blood that for mercy's sake flowed from Thy side![^146]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*I will sacrifice unto Thee with the voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries aloud unto Thee, cleansed from demonic blood by the blood that for mercy's sake flowed from Thy side![^146]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p56 === (Fol. 27v) Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Є҆́ѵа ᲂу҆́бѡ недꙋ́гомъ преслꙋша́нїѧ, * кла́тву всели́ла є҆́сть. * Ты́ же дв҃о бцⷣе, * прозѧбе́нїемъ чревоноше́нїѧ, * мі́рови бл҃гослове́нїе процвѣла̀ є҆сѝ. * Тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ всѝ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With the tongs the Seraph offered the coal unto the Prophet;[^147] but unto the Church of Christ by thine own hands, O initiate of sacred mysteries, thou dost dispense the coal of purification from the divine Fire!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With the tongs the Seraph offered the coal unto the Prophet;[^147] but unto the Church of Christ by thine own hands, O initiate of sacred mysteries, thou dost dispense the coal of purification from the divine Fire!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Возноше́нїе на хрⷭ҇то́въ вз̾е́млющеесѧ ра́зумъ, * и҆ сегѡ̀ бг҃ома́терь курі́лле, * всѧ́ку держа́ву низложи́лъ є҆сѝ, * нестѡ́рїа безбо́жнагѡ, * сно́вницею двои́цꙋ, * та́коже и҆ слїѧ́нїе безгла́вныхъ, * є҆сте́ствъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst not destroy neighboring foreigners like Samson;[^148] but all the alien doctrines of the heterodox thou didst overthrow, and gavest dominion unto the Orthodox, O Cyril!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst not destroy neighboring foreigners like Samson;[^148] but all the alien doctrines of the heterodox thou didst overthrow, and gavest dominion unto the Orthodox, O Cyril!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою ра́зума, и҆ просвѣще́нїемъ бл҃года́ти, * трⷵцу є҆диносꙋ́щную, * сн҃а же воплоще́нна бг҃а, * бг҃ослови́лъ є҆сѝ бл҃же́нне: * ꙗ҆ви́вжесѧ бцⷣы побо́рникъ, * въ вы́шнихъ ны́нѣ прославлѧ́ешисѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having manifestly led the God-chosen Council,[^149] the impiety of Nestorius, his Christ-fighting boldness, O father, thou didst cast down by the zeal of the Spirit, in honor of the true Mother of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having manifestly led the God-chosen Council,[^149] the impiety of Nestorius, his Christ-fighting boldness, O father, thou didst cast down by the zeal of the Spirit, in honor of the true Mother of God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Свы́ше ны̀ пѣвцы̀ приснопа́мѧтне назира́еши, * ѻ҆́че мл҃тивнѡ, * королю̀, побѣ́ды крⷭ҇тоно́сцꙋ подаѧ̀, * и҆ возвыша́ѧ моли́твами твои́ми ро́гъ правосла́вныхъ, * ᲂу҆ѧснѧ́ѧ же твою̀ па́мѧть велича́ющыѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst bud forth the Fruit of incorruptible understanding, O Mother of God, ever-living for the world, shown forth as the mediatress of incorruption for them that hymn thee in faith and love!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thou didst bud forth the Fruit of incorruptible understanding, O Mother of God, ever-living for the world, shown forth as the mediatress of incorruption for them that hymn thee in faith and love!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆тѣсне́ньми паде́нїи мно́гими препѧ́таѧ, * и҆ лю́тостїю бѣ́дъ, * ны́нѣ тебѣ̀ хвале́нїй же́ртву приноша́ю, * и҆ прилѣ́жнѡ взыва́ю тѝ: * ст҃а́ѧ бцⷣе помози́ ми: * тѧ́ бо сла́ва пѣ́нь скончава́ю.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 6, Podoben: "Fulfilling the dispensation for our sake" (Е҆́же ѡ҆ на́съ):*[^150] An abyss of teachings of theology hast thou manifestly poured forth unto us from the springs of the Savior,[^151] drowning heresy, O blessed Cyril, and preserving the flock unharmed from tempests; for thou art a guide unto all countries, O venerable one, manifesting divine things!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 6, Podoben: "Fulfilling the dispensation for our sake" (Е҆́же ѡ҆ на́съ):*[^150]
An abyss of teachings of theology hast thou manifestly poured forth unto us from the springs of the Savior,[^151] drowning heresy, O blessed Cyril, and preserving the flock unharmed from tempests; for thou art a guide unto all countries, O venerable one, manifesting divine things!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ленъ. Подо́бенъ: Оу҆ченикѡ́мъ: Чу́вство и҆ ра́зумъ преминꙋ́вшаго, * и҆ глубинѣ̀ дх҃а научи́лсѧ, * бж҃твеннаго таи́нница, * пребж҃твенныѧ трцы̀ воспое́мъ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ ст҃ла гдⷭ҇на, * и҆ побо́рника бл҃гоче́стїѧ.
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Fairly at morning the sun appears exceedingly sacred and light-bearing: darkness is driven away, and the moon withdraws, for night cannot endure; it brightens the day, illumines the air, shows us a fair sky, embellishing the earth, causing flowers to spring up; the sea gleams, and together it adorns the whole world: but brighter than all of this is Cyril, whose wise doctrines save the world under heaven; for he enlightens the souls of the faithful, and ever piously conquers heresies; for he is a guide unto all countries, manifesting divine things!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ikos:*
Fairly at morning the sun appears exceedingly sacred and light-bearing: darkness is driven away, and the moon withdraws, for night cannot endure; it brightens the day, illumines the air, shows us a fair sky, embellishing the earth, causing flowers to spring up; the sea gleams, and together it adorns the whole world: but brighter than all of this is Cyril, whose wise doctrines save the world under heaven; for he enlightens the souls of the faithful, and ever piously conquers heresies; for he is a guide unto all countries, manifesting divine things!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ, ѻ҆ктѡ́иха: Сла́ва, гла́съ, ѕ҃. Наслѣ́дниче бж҃їй, соприча́стниче хрⷭ҇то́въ, * служи́телю гдⷭ҇нь курі́лле ѻ҆́тче на́шъ, * по и҆́мени твоему̀ та́кѡ и҆ житїѐ твоѐ: * спросїѧ́ бо сѣди́нѣ ра́зумъ, * свидѣ́тельствоваше свѣ́тлость лица̀ твоегѡ̀, * душе́вное неѕло́бїе. и҆звѣ́ствоваше кро́тость, сло́во молчали́вое. * жи́знь твоѧ̀ сла́вна, и҆ ᲂу҆спе́нїе со ст҃ы́ми, * молѝ ѡ҆ душа́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *In the Persian furnace the children of Abraham, burned rather with love of piety than by flame, cried aloud: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord![^152]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*In the Persian furnace the children of Abraham, burned rather with love of piety than by flame, cried aloud: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord![^152]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ нн҃ѣ, бг҃о: и҆лѝ крⷭ҇тобг҃о: Подо́бенъ: Трїдне́венъ: Престоя́щи ᲂу҆ дре́ва и҆ногда̀ * во вре́мѧ распѧ́тїѧ дв҃а, * съ дѣ́вственнымъ ᲂу҆ченико́мъ, * и҆ пла́чущи вопїѧ́ше: * ᲂу҆вы́ мнѣ̀, * ка́кѡ стра́ждеши * всѣ́хъ хрⷭ҇тѐ сы́нъ безстра́стїе?
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having entered into the gloom of old upon Mount Sinai, Moses received the Law that kills by the letter;[^153] but thou, O blessed Cyril, didst unfold the hidden beauty of the Spirit!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having entered into the gloom of old upon Mount Sinai, Moses received the Law that kills by the letter;[^153] but thou, O blessed Cyril, didst unfold the hidden beauty of the Spirit!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p57 === (Fol. 28r) На літургі́и: Блаже́нна прⷪ, и҆лѝ ѻ҆ктѡ́иха: и҆ ст҃а́гѡ, пѣ́снь, г҃. Прокі́менъ, гла́съ, а҆: Оу҆ста̀ моѧ̑ возглаго́лютъ премꙋ́дрость. Сті́хъ: Оу҆слы́шите сїѧ̑ всѝ ꙗ҆зы́цы: А҆пⷭ҇лъ ко є҆вре́емъ, заⷱ҇ тлд҃. А҆ллилу́їа, гла́съ, в҃: Оу҆ста̀ првⷣднагѡ поуча́тсѧ премꙋ́дрости: Сті́хъ: Зако́нъ бг҃а є҆гѡ̀ въ се́рдцѣ є҆гѡ̀. Є҆ѵⷢлїе матѳе́а, зача́ло а҃і. Прича́стенъ: Въ па́мѧть вѣ́чную бу́детъ првⷣдникъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The veil of concealment given of old by enigmas of legislation as unto infants, O father,[^154] thou didst uncover like shards of understanding, explaining the types most clearly!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The veil of concealment given of old by enigmas of legislation as unto infants, O father,[^154] thou didst uncover like shards of understanding, explaining the types most clearly!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: [Декоративный накладной орнаментъ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In unconfused divine union and indivisible distinction, O father, thou didst theologize three Hypostases, O Cyril, immutable in one Essence and Godhead!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
In unconfused divine union and indivisible distinction, O father, thou didst theologize three Hypostases, O Cyril, immutable in one Essence and Godhead!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же, въ і҃. де́нь. Ст҃а́гѡ сщ҃енномч҃нка тїмоѳе́а, є҆пі́скопа прꙋ́сскагѡ. Стїхи̑ры, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* By thy childbearing, O Mother of God, the Angels beheld strange things: the corruptible nature of the earthborn race running back unto incorruptible life and heavenly glory!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
By thy childbearing, O Mother of God, the Angels beheld strange things: the corruptible nature of the earthborn race running back unto incorruptible life and heavenly glory!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Дѣ́тельными ᲂу҆чє́нїи твои́ми, * ѿ земны́хъ возвы́шенъ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆́блакъ ѡ҆душєвле́нъ бл҃же́нне, * гремѣ́нїи чꙋде́съ твои́хъ, * и҆ слове́съ стра́шными блиста́нїи, * лю́таго низложи́лъ є҆сѝ стропти́ваго ѕмї́а. * Бл҃гть прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, * ѕмї́евъ плотски́хъ попали́ти, * покрыва́ломъ бж҃е́ственнымъ врагѡ́въ му́чѧ вну́треннаѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *Stretching forth his hands, Daniel shut the lions' gaping mouths in the den; and girded with virtue, the youths, lovers of piety, quenched the power of the fire, crying aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^155]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*Stretching forth his hands, Daniel shut the lions' gaping mouths in the den; and girded with virtue, the youths, lovers of piety, quenched the power of the fire, crying aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^155]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃а́го тїмоѳе́е, првⷣдныхъ похвало̀, * вселе́нныѧ побо́рниче, * и҆ мі́ра свѣти́льниче, * цр҃кве ᲂу҆добре́нїе, * вѣ́ры же́ртва сщ҃е́ннаѧ, * и҆ мч҃нкѡвъ честно́е * и҆ свѣтоно́сное ᲂу҆краше́нїе, * молѝ ѿ тлѝ и҆ бѣ́дъ и҆зба́витисѧ, * вѣ́рою творѧ́щымъ всечⷭ҇тнꙋю па́мѧть твою̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Truly like a sea-wave did the fountain of wisdom flow forth unto thee; for ever-flowing rivers of pious doctrines ran from thy belly, O father,[^156] even as Christ foretold; for thy God-chosen words surpass the sand!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Truly like a sea-wave did the fountain of wisdom flow forth unto thee; for ever-flowing rivers of pious doctrines ran from thy belly, O father,[^156] even as Christ foretold; for thy God-chosen words surpass the sand!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Прекра́сную ѡ҆де́ждꙋ ѡ҆моче́нїи кро́вными * и҆стка́лъ є҆сѝ болѣ́знми твои́ми ѡ҆ тїмоѳе́е, * ѡ҆де́ждꙋ не́бную свы́ше, * нетлѣ́нна ѡ҆чище́нїа, * и҆ непрело́жныѧ жи́зни неизрече́ннѡ воспрїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ: * ю҆́же невеще́ственнѣ въ вы́шнихъ носѧ̀, * ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ моли́сѧ страстоте́рпче, * бл҃гоче́стнѡ восхвалѧ́ющихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast shown forth as a wise shepherd and teacher of the Church, O Cyril, manifestly unfolding the covenants, O venerable one; for holding thy words as an anchor and paternal inheritance, she cries: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou wast shown forth as a wise shepherd and teacher of the Church, O Cyril, manifestly unfolding the covenants, O venerable one; for holding thy words as an anchor and paternal inheritance, she cries: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры, бцⷣы, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: то́йже: О҆сужде́нїѧ и҆зба́ви прест҃а́ѧ бг҃оневѣ́сто * и҆ лю́тыхъ прегрѣше́нїй, * смире́нную мою̀ ду́шу, * и҆ сме́рти и҆змѣнѝ мл҃твами твои́ми, * и҆ да́руй ѡ҆правда́нїе получи́ти въ де́нь и҆спыта́нїѧ, * є҆́же получи́ша ст҃ы́хъ собо́ри: * покаѧ́нїемъ ѡ҆чи́щшисѧ мѧ̀ пре́жде конца̀ покажѝ, * и҆ сле́зными и҆злїѧ́нїи.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto the ineffable union of the Word Who was incarnate for our sake, the all-craftsman,[^157] indivisible and unconfused, thou didst instruct us, O Cyril, declining equally from either will,[^158] crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Unto the ineffable union of the Word Who was incarnate for our sake, the all-craftsman,[^157] indivisible and unconfused, thou didst instruct us, O Cyril, declining equally from either will,[^158] crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тꙋ́чами дх҃а прест҃а́гѡ пречⷭ҇таѧ, * мою̀ мы́сль ѡ҆росѝ, * ꙗ҆́же ка́плю ро́ждшаѧ хрⷭ҇та̀, * неисче́тно...
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Incomprehensible in nature unto sight, the Son and Word of God took up abode in thee, O pure one; and having clothed Himself in our essence, as Merciful He appeared approachable in the flesh, O all-immaculate one, and took up abode with us who cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Incomprehensible in nature unto sight, the Son and Word of God took up abode in thee, O pure one; and having clothed Himself in our essence, as Merciful He appeared approachable in the flesh, O all-immaculate one, and took up abode with us who cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Покаѧ́нїа и҆зрѧ́дное * и҆ спаси́тельное враче́вство, * ꙗ҆́же бг҃а ро́ждшаѧ сп҃са моего̀, * и҆ слеза́мъ то́ки, и҆ чл҃къ по́мыслъ гро́знагѡ и҆ стра́шнагѡ, * и҆ сꙋда̀ неумы́тнагѡ, * ты́ ми да́руй и҆збѣжа́ти моли́твами твои́ми ѡ҆ дв҃о, * муче́нїа тре́петнагѡ, * и҆ бж҃твенную ᲂу҆лучи́ти бл҃года́ть.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *Eve indeed, by the sickness of disobedience, brought in the curse; but thou, O Virgin Mother of God, by the blossoming of thy fruit-bearing, didst bud forth blessing unto the world; therefore all of us magnify thee![^159]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
*Eve indeed, by the sickness of disobedience, brought in the curse; but thou, O Virgin Mother of God, by the blossoming of thy fruit-bearing, didst bud forth blessing unto the world; therefore all of us magnify thee![^159]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ нн҃ѣ: Тьма́ми пречⷭ҇таѧ ѡ҆бѣща́хсѧ * покаѧ́нїе ѡ҆ мои́хъ сотвори́ти согрѣше́нїихъ: * но не ѡ҆ставлѧ́етъ мѧ̀ любве́ный ѕлы́хъ мои́хъ ѻ҆бы́чай. * Сегѡ̀ ра́ди тебѣ̀ вопїю̀, * и҆ припа́даю молѧ́сѧ: * ты́ мѧ влⷣчце и҆змѝ, такова́гѡ мучи́телства, * наставлѧ́ющи къ лу́чшымъ, * и҆ спасе́нїа близ̾ су́щихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The exaltation that lifts itself against the knowledge of Christ and His Mother,[^160] O Cyril, thou didst cast down in all its power: the duality of godless Nestorius as a dream-weaver, and likewise the confusion of the headless natures![^161]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The exaltation that lifts itself against the knowledge of Christ and His Mother,[^160] O Cyril, thou didst cast down in all its power: the duality of godless Nestorius as a dream-weaver, and likewise the confusion of the headless natures![^161]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: А҆́гница и҆ па́стырѧ тѧ̀, на дре́вѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ, * а҆́гница ро́ждшаѧ рыда́ше, * и҆ мт҃рски тѝ вѣща́ше: * сн҃е возжелѣ́нне, * ка́кѡ на дре́вѣ крⷭ҇тнѣмъ повѣ́шенъ є҆сѝ долготерпѣли́ве? * ка́кѡ ру́цѣ и҆ но́зѣ сло́ве, * пригвозди́шасѧ ѿ беззако́нныхъ? * и҆ кро́вь твою̀ и҆злїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ влⷣко.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By the power of understanding and the enlightenment of grace, thou didst theologize the consubstantial Trinity, and the Son as God incarnate, O blessed one; and having appeared as champion of the Birthgiver of God, thou art now glorified on high!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By the power of understanding and the enlightenment of grace, thou didst theologize the consubstantial Trinity, and the Son as God incarnate, O blessed one; and having appeared as champion of the Birthgiver of God, thou art now glorified on high!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, гла́съ, д҃. Пѣ́снь, а҆. І҆рмо́съ: Трїста́ты крѣ̑пкїѧ, * рожде́йсѧ ѿ дв҃ы, * безстра́стїѧ во глубинѣ̀, * душѝ трїча́стное потопѝ молю́сѧ: * да тебѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ въ тѷмпа́нѣ, * во ᲂу҆мерщвле́нїи тѣлесѐ побѣ́дное воспою̀ пѣ́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* From on high do thou mercifully watch over us thy singers, O ever-memorable father, granting victories unto the cross-bearing king,[^162] and by thy prayers exalting the horn of the Orthodox,[^163] brightening them that magnify thy memory!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
From on high do thou mercifully watch over us thy singers, O ever-memorable father, granting victories unto the cross-bearing king,[^162] and by thy prayers exalting the horn of the Orthodox,[^163] brightening them that magnify thy memory!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Непобѣди́мую крѣ́пость, неизмѣ́нную держа́ву, * и҆ непретво́рну ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆мѣ́ѧ бл҃гі́й, * неизрече́нною си́лою твое́ю, * ᲂу҆твердѝ моегѡ̀ ꙗ҆зы́ка не́мощь въ пѣ́снехъ твои́хъ, * и҆ моли́твами тїмоѳе́е ᲂу҆ще́дри.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Straitened and hindered by many falls and by the severity of perils, now do I offer unto thee a sacrifice of praise, and earnestly cry unto thee: O holy Mother of God, help me, for in thy praise do I conclude this hymn!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Straitened and hindered by many falls and by the severity of perils, now do I offer unto thee a sacrifice of praise, and earnestly cry unto thee: O holy Mother of God, help me, for in thy praise do I conclude this hymn!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́постїю бг҃одѣ́лною сщ҃е́ннагѡ сщ҃и коре́не, * и҆зрасти́лъ є҆сѝ свѧще́нный тїмоѳе́е са́дъ, * добродѣ́телей ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ бл҃гоᲂукраше́нїе: * процвѣ́лъ бо є҆сѝ страда́нїй плоды̀ ѻ҆би́лны, * и҆ всѣ́хъ бл҃цѣ прине́слъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion, Podoben: "While the disciples looked on" (Оу҆ченикѡ́мъ):*[^164] Having surpassed sensation and understanding, and learned the depths of the Spirit, as an initiate of divine mysteries let us sing of the initiate of the super-divine Trinity, as a luminary of the Lord and champion of piety!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Exapostilarion, Podoben: "While the disciples looked on" (Оу҆ченикѡ́мъ):*[^164]
Having surpassed sensation and understanding, and learned the depths of the Spirit, as an initiate of divine mysteries let us sing of the initiate of the super-divine Trinity, as a luminary of the Lord and champion of piety!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ѡ҆душевле́нный бж҃їй и҆ пресвѣ́тлый до́мъ, * бцⷣе бл҃га́ѧ, мі́ра ра́досте, * не ѿри́ни менѐ дале́че ѿ тебѐ: * ᲂу҆ще́дри же, и҆ всѣ́хъ и҆скуше́нїй и҆зба́ви, * ꙗ҆́кѡ да вну́трь ликꙋ́ю покро́ва твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: Whoso kisses not thine immaculate icon with love, O blameless Mother of God, is cast into the fire of Gehenna like foolish Nestorius; but we, O all-holy one, embrace thee with love!

provenance.verbatim_source: Whoso kisses not thine immaculate icon with love, O blameless Mother of God, is cast into the fire of Gehenna like foolish Nestorius; but we, O all-holy one, embrace thee with love!

items.section: At the Aposticha, of the Octoechos
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Въ мꙋ́ченики хр҃то́вы, мꙋ́нкъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ свѣ́телъ сла́вне, * во сщ҃е́нницѣхъ му́дрыхъ, * ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ сщ҃е́нникѡмъ ᲂу҆добре́нїе.
items.english_text: O heir of God, partaker of Christ, minister of the Lord, Cyril our father: according to thy name, such also was thy life; for understanding shone forth together with thy gray hairs, the brightness of thy countenance bore witness to the harmlessness of thy soul, and meekness and silent speech attested thy virtues; thy life was glorious and thy dormition with the saints: pray for our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source: O heir of God, partaker of Christ, minister of the Lord, Cyril our father: according to thy name, such also was thy life; for understanding shone forth together with thy gray hairs, the brightness of thy countenance bore witness to the harmlessness of thy soul, and meekness and silent speech attested thy virtues; thy life was glorious and thy dormition with the saints: pray for our souls!

items.section: At the Aposticha, of the Octoechos
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Мт҃и бж҃їа, вы́шшаѧ херуві́мъ чи́стаѧ, * и҆ всеѧ̀ землѝ влⷣчце, * спаси́ мѧ бж҃е́ственными твои́ми мольба́ми.
items.english_text: Standing by the Wood of old at the time of crucifixion, the Virgin with the virgin disciple weeping cried aloud: Woe is me! How sufferest Thou, O Christ, Son of all impassibility?

provenance.verbatim_source: Standing by the Wood of old at the time of crucifixion, the Virgin with the virgin disciple weeping cried aloud: Woe is me! How sufferest Thou, O Christ, Son of all impassibility?

items.section: At the Aposticha, of the Octoechos
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Видѣ́нїемъ и҆ дѣѧ́нїемъ ᲂу҆краша́емь, * въ леѵі́тїтѣ ѻ҆́бразѣ, * ѻ҆рꙋ́жїемъ ѻ҆бою́дꙋ ѻ҆́стрымъ, * ѕмї́а вну́треннаѧ ссѣца́еши ѡ҆ тїмоѳе́е, * хлѣ́бѡвъ сщ҃е́нныхъ покрыва́ломъ.
items.english_text: *Epistle to the Hebrews, pericope 318 [Heb. 7:26–8:2]:*[^167]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Epistle to the Hebrews, pericope 318 [Heb. 7:26–8:2]:*[^167]

items.section: At the Aposticha, of the Octoechos
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Пожрꙋ́ ти со гла́сомъ хвале́нїѧ гдⷭ҇и, * цр҃ковь вопїе́тъ тѝ, * ѿ бѣсо́вскїѧ кро́ве ѡ҆чи́щшисѧ, * ра́ди ми́лости ѿ ре́бръ твои́хъ и҆сте́кшею кро́вїю.
items.english_text: *The Holy Hieromartyr Timothy, Bishop of Prusa:*[^172]

provenance.verbatim_source: *The Holy Hieromartyr Timothy, Bishop of Prusa:*[^172]

items.section: At the Aposticha, of the Octoechos
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Зако́ннѡ сщ҃е́нный по́двигъ тво́рѧ, * со дерзнове́нїемъ бг҃омꙋ́дре, * царѧ̀ безꙋ́мїе и҆з̾ѡбличи́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ і҆́дѡлскаѧ разори́лъ є҆сѝ тре́бища тїмоѳе́е.
items.english_text: By thy active teachings, * lifted up from earthly things * like an animated cloud, O blessed one, * by the thunders of thy wonders * and the terrible flashes of thy words, * thou didst cast down the fierce, crooked serpent.[^173] * Grace didst thou receive * to consume the fleshly serpents,[^174] * burning the innards of the enemies' torturers by a divine veil!

provenance.verbatim_source: By thy active teachings, * lifted up from earthly things * like an animated cloud, O blessed one, * by the thunders of thy wonders * and the terrible flashes of thy words, * thou didst cast down the fierce, crooked serpent.[^173] * Grace didst thou receive * to consume the fleshly serpents,[^174] * burning the innards of the enemies' torturers by a divine veil!

items.section: At the Aposticha, of the Octoechos
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Пое́тсѧ гла́сы а҆́гглскими бг҃оневѣ́сто тво́й сн҃ъ, * всѣ́хъ созида́тель, * и҆ бг҃ъ сы́й пре́жде вѣ́къ, * и҆ съ ни́мъ ᲂу҆́бѡ цр҃твꙋющи, * спаси́ мѧ влⷣчце.
items.english_text: Holy Timothy, praise of the righteous, * champion of the universe * and luminary of the world, * adornment of the Church, * sacred sacrifice of the faith, * and honorable, * light-bearing embellishment of martyrs: * pray that they who in faith celebrate thy most honorable memory * may be delivered from corruption and perils!

provenance.verbatim_source: Holy Timothy, praise of the righteous, * champion of the universe * and luminary of the world, * adornment of the Church, * sacred sacrifice of the faith, * and honorable, * light-bearing embellishment of martyrs: * pray that they who in faith celebrate thy most honorable memory * may be delivered from corruption and perils!

items.section: At the Aposticha, of the Octoechos
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. І҆рмо́съ: Въ пе́щи а҆враа́мстїи ѻ҆́троцы, персі́дстѣй, * любо́вїю бл҃гоче́стїѧ па́че, не́жели пла́менемъ ѡ҆пала́еми взыва́хꙋ: * бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ въ хра́мѣ сла́вы твоеѧ̀ гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: A beautiful garment dyed in blood * thou didst weave by thy sufferings, O Timothy, * a heavenly garment from on high * of incorruptible purification; * and ineffably thou didst receive immutable life: * bearing it immaterially on high, * pray for all who piously praise thee, * O passion-bearer!

provenance.verbatim_source: A beautiful garment dyed in blood * thou didst weave by thy sufferings, O Timothy, * a heavenly garment from on high * of incorruptible purification; * and ineffably thou didst receive immutable life: * bearing it immaterially on high, * pray for all who piously praise thee, * O passion-bearer!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone 4, Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Достодолжно в добродѣтелехъ бога́тное тѧ̀ сокро́вище, * вѣнча́етъ пре́жде страда́нїй, * бл҃гть бг҃одѣ́лнаѧ, * и҆ чꙋде́сными дарова́нїи просвѣща́ющи, * свѣ́тла въ мі́рѣ совершѝ.
items.english_text: From condemnation deliver my humble soul, * O most holy Bride of God, * and from grievous transgressions, * and from death ransom me by thy prayers; * and grant me to obtain justification in the Day of Trial, * which the assemblies of the saints have obtained: * having cleansed me by repentance * and outpourings of tears, * show me forth before the end!

provenance.verbatim_source: From condemnation deliver my humble soul, * O most holy Bride of God, * and from grievous transgressions, * and from death ransom me by thy prayers; * and grant me to obtain justification in the Day of Trial, * which the assemblies of the saints have obtained: * having cleansed me by repentance * and outpourings of tears, * show me forth before the end!

items.english_text: With showers of the Most Holy Spirit, O all-pure one, * bedew my mind, * thou who didst bear the Drop, Christ, * Who innumerably...

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Достодолжно в добродѣтелехъ бога́тное тѧ̀ сокро́вище, * вѣнча́етъ пре́жде страда́нїй, * бл҃гть бг҃одѣ́лнаѧ, * и҆ чꙋде́сными дарова́нїи просвѣща́ющи, * свѣ́тла въ мі́рѣ совершѝ.
items.english_text: ...innumerably, with compassions, washed away the measureless iniquities of men; * dry up the fountain of my passions, * and vouchsafe me unto the torrent * of living food ever, * by thy prayers![^175]

items.english_text: *Sticheron of the Theotokos:* An excellent * and saving medicine of repentance, * O thou who didst bear God my Savior, * and streams of tears, and a human thought of the terrible and fearful, * unbribable judgment: * do thou grant me to escape by thy prayers, O Virgin, * from trembling torment, * and to obtain divine grace!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Theotokos, Tone 4, Podoben the same
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Достодолжно в добродѣтелехъ бога́тное тѧ̀ сокро́вище, * вѣнча́етъ пре́жде страда́нїй, * бл҃гть бг҃одѣ́лнаѧ, * и҆ чꙋде́сными дарова́нїи просвѣща́ющи, * свѣ́тла въ мі́рѣ совершѝ.
items.english_text: Ten thousand times, O all-pure one, have I promised * to make repentance for my sins; * but the habitual love of mine evil deeds leaves me not. * Therefore unto thee do I cry, * and falling down I pray: * do thou, O Sovereign Lady, deliver me from such tyranny, * guiding me unto better things, * and unto things that are near unto salvation!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Among the martyrs of Christ, Thou wast shown forth bright in torments, O glorious one; among wise hierarchs, Thou wast shown forth as the adornment of priests!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Troparion:* The temple of Christ, the treasure of wisdom, come today, ye faithful, let us hymn: the primate of the flock of Prusa!

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 5, Podoben: "The Word co-unoriginate" (Собезнача́льное сло́во):*[^178] Watered with showers of blood, O hieromartyr of the Lord, thou didst bring forth fruit in the good soil of thy heart,[^179] imperishable food which thou didst receive from God; therefore we pray thee: deliver from perils them that celebrate thy memory!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Достодолжно в добродѣтелехъ бога́тное тѧ̀ сокро́вище, * вѣнча́етъ пре́жде страда́нїй, * бл҃гть бг҃одѣ́лнаѧ, * и҆ чꙋде́сными дарова́нїи просвѣща́ющи, * свѣ́тла въ мі́рѣ совершѝ.
items.english_text: Having found thee as a haven, and wall, and refuge, and hope, and shelter, and fervent protection, we the faithful run unto thee, and cry aloud earnestly, calling faithfully: Have mercy, O Mother of God, upon them that trust in thee, and deliver us from transgressions!

provenance.verbatim_source: Having found thee as a haven, and wall, and refuge, and hope, and shelter, and fervent protection, we the faithful run unto thee, and cry aloud earnestly, calling faithfully: Have mercy, O Mother of God, upon them that trust in thee, and deliver us from transgressions!

items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* By the Cross of thy Son, O thou who art full of divine grace, all idolatrous deceit was abolished, and demonic power was trampled down; therefore, we the faithful, as is our duty, ever hymn and bless thee, and truly confessing thee to be the Mother of God, we magnify thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:

By the Cross of thy Son, O thou who art full of divine grace, all idolatrous deceit was abolished, and demonic power was trampled down; therefore, we the faithful, as is our duty, ever hymn and bless thee, and truly confessing thee to be the Mother of God, we magnify thee!

items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *Beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Sun of Righteousness, the Church stood in her station, worthily crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^180]*

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having acquired an unobscured life, and wholly flashing forth with the thunders of the Spirit, thou didst burn up the all-ruinous serpent, O glorious one, strengthened by divine grace!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ро: Ты̀ держа́щаго дла́нїю всѧ́ческаѧ м҃ти бж҃їѧ, * вну́трь во чре́вѣ и҆мꙋ́щи бг҃олѣ́пнѡ, * соблюда́ющи зовꙋ́щымъ: * бл҃гослове́на ты̀ въ жена́хъ є҆сѝ пренепоро́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Beholding the weapons of threat and the torturer of fire-bearing flame, having armed thy mind and soul with faith, and with a fearless understanding, thou didst proclaim Christ, thy Maker and Creator and Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
