items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p136 === (Fol. 67v) вдохнꙋ́въ, и҆ ꙗ҆зы́ческое те́рновное попали́лъ є҆сѝ безбо́жїе: хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а проповѣ́дниче молѝ, спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring to behold the glory of the Lord immaterially with unveiled face,[^495] he put off principalities and powers, having proclaimed the one tri-hypostatic Godhead.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Desiring to behold the glory of the Lord immaterially with unveiled face,[^495] he put off principalities and powers, having proclaimed the one tri-hypostatic Godhead.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Цр҃ь нбⷭ҇ный: Вхо́дъ. Прокі́менъ, днѐ. Чте́нїѧ, трѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst rejoice in thy confession, and the Savior worthily confessed thee before the Father;[^496] Whom entreat, O passion-bearer, that all who with faith magnify thy memory may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst rejoice in thy confession, and the Savior worthily confessed thee before the Father;[^496] Whom entreat, O passion-bearer, that all who with faith magnify thy memory may be saved.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Собо́рнагѡ посла́нїѧ їꙋ́дина чте́нїе. Глава̀, а҃. Їꙋ́да і҆исꙋ́съ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ ра́бъ, бра́тъ же їа́кѡвꙋ, сꙋ́щымъ ѡ҆ бз҃ѣ ѻ҆ц҃ѣ̀ ѡ҆свѧще́ннымъ, і҆исꙋ́съ хрⷭ҇то́мъ соблюде́ннымъ зва́ннымъ. Ми́лость ва́мъ, и҆ ми́ръ, и҆ любы̀ да ꙋ҆мно́житсѧ. Возлю́бленнїи, всѧ́ко тща́нїе творѧ̀ писа́ти ва́мъ, ѡ҆ ѻ҆́бщемъ спасенїи ва́шемъ, нꙋ́жда мѝ бы́сть писа́ти ва́мъ, молѧ̀ подвиза́тисѧ ѡ҆ преда́ннѣй вѣ́рѣ ст҃ы̑мъ є҆ди́ною. Прикрадо́ша бо нѣ́цыи чл҃вѣ́цы, (и҆́же дре́вле предꙋста́вленнїи на сїѐ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїе,) нечести́вїи, бг҃а на́шегѡ бл҃года́ть прелага́ющїи въ скве́рнꙋ, и҆ є҆ди́нагѡ влⷣки бг҃а, и҆ гдⷭ҇а на́шегѡ і҆исꙋ́са хрⷭ҇та̀ ѿмета́ющїисѧ. Воспомѧнꙋ́ти же ва́мъ хощꙋ̀, вѣ́дꙋщымъ и҆ ва́мъ є҆ди́ною сїѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ гдⷭ҇ь лю́ди ѿ землѝ є҆гѵ́петскїѧ спасѐ, послѣ́ди невѣ́ровавшыѧ погꙋбѝ. А҆́ггелы же не соблю́дшыѧ своего̀ нача́лства, но ѡ҆ста́вльшыѧ своѐ жили́ще, на сꙋ́дъ вели́кагѡ днѐ, ꙋ҆́злами вѣ́чными подъ мра́комъ соблюдѐ. Ꙗ҆́коже содо́ма и҆ гомо́рра, и҆ ѡ҆́крестныѧ и҆́хъ гра́ды, подо́бнымъ и҆́хъ ѻ҆́бразомъ преблꙋди́вша и҆ ходи́вша въ слѣ́дъ пло́ти и҆ны́ѧ, предлежа́тъ въ показа́нїе, ѻ҆гнѧ̀ вѣ́чнагѡ сꙋ́дъ поде́мше. Та́кожде ꙋ҆́бѡ и҆ сі́и сѡ́нїа ви́дѧще, пло́ть ꙋ҆́бѡ сквернѧ́тъ; гдⷭ҇ства же ѿмета́ютсѧ, сла́вы же хꙋ́лѧще (не трепе́щꙋтъ.) Мїхаи́лъ же а҆рха́ггелъ є҆гда̀ со дїа́воломъ разсꙋжда́ѧ глаго́лаше ѡ҆ мѡѷсе́овѣ тѣлесѝ, не смѣ́ѧше сꙋда̀ навестѝ хꙋ́лна, но речѐ: да запрети́тъ тебѣ̀ гдⷭ҇ь. Сі́и же, є҆ли̑ка ꙋ҆́бѡ не вѣ́дѧтъ, хꙋ́лѧтъ: є҆ли̑ка же по є҆стествꙋ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ безслове́снаѧ живо́тнаѧ вѣ́дѧтъ, въ си́хъ сквернѧ́тсѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou hast become higher than the heavenly ranks, O Virgin Mother of God, for thou alone wast known as the blessed dwelling-place of the Most High; therefore we all proclaim thee to be the Mother of God.

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Собо́рнагѡ посла́нїѧ їꙋ́дина чте́нїе. Го́ре и҆̀мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ въ пꙋ́ть ка́їновъ ходи́ша, и҆ въ ле́сть валаа́мовы мзды̀ пролїѧ́шасѧ, и҆ въ прерѣка́нїи коре́овѣ погибо́ша: Сі́и сꙋ́ть въ любве́хъ ва́шихъ, скверни́тели съ ва́ми ꙗ҆дꙋ́ще, безъ боѧ́зни себѐ пасꙋ́ще: ѻ҆́блацы безво́дни, ѿ вѣ́тръ преноси́ми: древеса̀ є҆се́нна безпло́дна, два́жды ꙋ҆ме́рша, и҆скорене́на. Вѡ́лны свирѣ́пыѧ мо́рѧ, воспѣнѧ́юще своѧ̑ стыдѣ́нїѧ: ѕвѣ́зды пре́лестныѧ, и҆̀мже мра́къ тмы̀ во вѣ́ки блюде́тсѧ. Прⷪ҇ро́чествова же и҆ ѡ҆ си́хъ се́дмый ѿ а҆да́ма є҆нѡ́хъ, глаго́лѧ: сѐ прїи́детъ гдⷭ҇ь во тма́хъ сты́хъ (а҆́гг҃лъ) свои́хъ. Сотвори́ти сꙋ́дъ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ...

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ, стїхи̑ры, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе: Прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ а҆́пⷭ҇ле * надъ де́моны непобѣди́мꙋю вла́сть и҆ си́лꙋ, * и҆ ѡ҆ и҆́мени хрⷭ҇то́вѣ * нача́ла тмы̀ ѿгони́ти, * проше́лъ є҆сѝ зе́млю, * просвѣща́ѧ ꙗ҆́ко со́лнце, * и҆ всѧ̑ стра́ны науча́ѧ, * пе́рвое сла́вне хрⷭ҇тово проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ, * спаси́тельное прише́ствїе. Стї́хъ: Во всю̀ зе́млю и҆зы́де вѣща́нїе и҆́хъ, и҆ въ концы̀ вселе́нныѧ глаго́лы и҆́хъ. Пе́рвѣй бл҃гости * и҆ є҆сте́ственномꙋ и҆ пресвѣ́тломꙋ * житїю̀ подо́бѧсѧ, * мꙋ́жъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ бла́гъ, * їꙋ́до по сꙋществꙋ̀, * и҆ бра́тъ гдⷭ҇нь и҆менꙋ́емь, * нра́ва твоегѡ̀ бл҃гтїю, * и҆ ѻ҆бы́чаѧ красото́ю, * хрⷭ҇то́въ показа́лся є҆сѝ * ꙋ҆чени́къ и҆́скренный. Стї́хъ: Нб҃са̀ повѣ́даютъ сла́вꙋ бж҃їю, творе́нїе же рꙋкꙋ̀ є҆гѡ̀ возвѣща́етъ тве́рдь. Ѻ҆рга́нъ до́брѣ соста́вленъ * бж҃е́ственнымъ ѡ҆кормле́нїемъ, * а҆́пⷭ҇ле їꙋ́до, * ꙗ҆зы́кѡмъ ꙗ҆вле́нїе...
items.english_text: ...Having been tried like gold by fire and torments, thou wast shown forth as a worthy gift of God Most High, O all-glorious passion-bearer: pray now for us!

provenance.verbatim_source: ...Having been tried like gold by fire and torments, thou wast shown forth as a worthy gift of God Most High, O all-glorious passion-bearer: pray now for us!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p138 === (Fol. 68v) звáнїю ты̀ ввѣ́рилсѧ є҆сѝ, * къ позна́нїю хрⷭ҇товꙋ наставлѧ́ѧ, * словесы̀ и҆ дѣѧ́нїи, * всѧ̑ просвѣща́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆сповѣ́дати и҆́стинное і҆и҃са бж҃тво̀, * сп҃са дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* By thy mighty protection, keep us, thy pure servants, unharmed from the assault of enemies; for we have acquired thee as our only refuge in necessities.

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried", Stichera on 8, Tone 4
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь: Таи́нниче нбⷭ҇ныхъ їꙋ́до всемꙋ́дре, ꙋ҆чени́че сп҃совъ, и҆ ѻ҆́бщниче и҆́стинныѧ жи́зни, ѧ҆зы́къ мо́й подви́гни, и҆ сло́во ꙋ҆пра́ви, на пѣ́нїе твоѐ всебл҃же́нне.
items.english_text: O all-lauded Jude, thy sound went forth like lightning unto the ends of all the earth, O wise one,[^498] guiding unto the never-setting Light those darkened by the deceit of godlessness; shining with Whom now, entreat great mercy for our souls! *(Thrice)*

provenance.verbatim_source: O all-lauded Jude, thy sound went forth like lightning unto the ends of all the earth, O wise one,[^498] guiding unto the never-setting Light those darkened by the deceit of godlessness; shining with Whom now, entreat great mercy for our souls! *(Thrice)*

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried", Stichera on 8, Tone 4
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь: Ле́гкїй сп҃совъ ꙗ҆ре́мъ а҆́пⷭ҇ле, и҆ браздꙋ̀ сѣкї́й, и҆ ѡ҆бно́вльша бл҃гтїю, сѣ́мѧ сѣ́ѧлъ є҆сѝ, и҆ мно́гъ пло́дъ прине́слъ є҆сѝ призва́вшемꙋ пресла́вне.
items.english_text: O marvelous Jude, having become as Christ's chariot, thou didst cast down idol-pride, and mystically didst lead captivity captive by the word of God unto incorruptible life, O glorious one;[^499] which enjoying now, entreat peace and great mercy for our souls! *(Thrice)*

provenance.verbatim_source: O marvelous Jude, having become as Christ's chariot, thou didst cast down idol-pride, and mystically didst lead captivity captive by the word of God unto incorruptible life, O glorious one;[^499] which enjoying now, entreat peace and great mercy for our souls! *(Thrice)*

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried", Stichera on 8, Tone 4
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь: Сло́ва вопло́щшагосѧ ѡ҆брѣ́тъ ꙋ҆чи́телѧ, и҆ сегѡ̀ бг҃ови́дче лꙋча́ми просвѣща́емь, бы́лъ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ вторы́й, пе́рвагѡ сїѧ́ньми соѡбразꙋ́ѧся досточꙋ́дне.
items.english_text: O Apostle of Christ Jude, having become a disciple of our incarnate God, by Whom thou wast truly sent as a sheep in the midst of wolves,[^500] by thy word transforming their malice unto piety and unto divine understanding of the Holy Trinity: therefore do we praise thee! *(Twice)*

provenance.verbatim_source: O Apostle of Christ Jude, having become a disciple of our incarnate God, by Whom thou wast truly sent as a sheep in the midst of wolves,[^500] by thy word transforming their malice unto piety and unto divine understanding of the Holy Trinity: therefore do we praise thee! *(Twice)*

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried", Stichera on 8, Tone 4
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа по ꙋ҆ста́вꙋ. Пѣ́снь, г҃. їрмо́съ: Водрузи́вый на ничесо́мже зе́млю повелѣ́нїемъ твои́мъ, и҆ повѣ́сивый неѡдержи́мѡ тѧготѣ́ющꙋю, на недви́жимѣмъ хрⷭ҇тѐ ка́мени, за́повѣдей твои́хъ, цр҃ковь твою̀ ꙋ҆твердѝ є҆ди́не бла́же, и҆ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Having received the manifold grace of the Holy Spirit, thou didst become a partaker of the sacred apostolic choir, O Apostle Jude; therefore, inhaling the fiery breath once borne from heaven with a fiery tongue...

provenance.verbatim_source: Having received the manifold grace of the Holy Spirit, thou didst become a partaker of the sacred apostolic choir, O Apostle Jude; therefore, inhaling the fiery breath once borne from heaven with a fiery tongue...

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried", Stichera on 8, Tone 4
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: === LEAF p140 === (Fol. 69v) вели́чества: сїи́ бо бы́ша є҆мꙋ̀ дрꙋ́зи же и҆ сво́йственні́и, и҆ сро́дницы, и҆ сосѣ́дницы, и҆ та́инъ сказа́тели.
items.english_text: ...inhaling it, thou didst burn up the thorny heathen godlessness: O preacher of Christ God, pray that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: ...inhaling it, thou didst burn up the thorny heathen godlessness: O preacher of Christ God, pray that our souls may be saved!

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried", Stichera on 8, Tone 4
items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. їрмо́съ: Бж҃е́ственное твоѐ разумѣ́въ и҆стоща́нїе, прозорли́вѡ а҆ввакꙋ́мъ, хрⷭ҇тѐ съ тре́петомъ вопїѧ́ше тебѣ̀: во спасе́нїе люде́й твои́хъ, спастѝ помꙋ́занныѧ твоѧ̑ прише́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: ...upon all, and to convict all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him. These are murmurers, complainers, a blemish-bearing portion, walking after their own lusts in ungodliness and transgression; and their mouth speaks great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.[^502]

provenance.verbatim_source: ...upon all, and to convict all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him. items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь: Вели́кїй сп҃совъ а҆по́столъ, * ꙗ҆вле́нїа дх҃а сподо́бленъ, * и҆ возлю́бленъ бы́сть, зрѣ́нїа...
items.english_text: Thou didst receive unconquerable authority and power over demons, O apostle, and in Christ's name to drive away the principalities of darkness; thou didst traverse the earth, enlightening it like the sun, and teaching all countries, O glorious one, thou didst proclaim Christ's first saving coming.[^504]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst receive unconquerable authority and power over demons, O apostle, and in Christ's name to drive away the principalities of darkness; thou didst traverse the earth, enlightening it like the sun, and teaching all countries, O glorious one, thou didst proclaim Christ's first saving coming.[^504]

items.english_text: Imitating the primal Goodness and the natural, all-radiant life, thou wast a good man, O Jude by nature, and called brother of the Lord; by the goodness of thy character and the beauty of thy conduct, thou wast shown forth as an intimate disciple of Christ.

items.english_text: An instrument well tuned by divine governance, O Apostle Jude, unto the manifestation...

provenance.verbatim_source: An instrument well tuned by divine governance, O Apostle Jude, unto the manifestation...

items.english_text: ...unto the manifestation of calling unto the nations thou didst commit thyself; guiding unto the knowledge of Christ by words and deeds, thou didst enlighten all to confess the true Godhead of Jesus, the Savior of our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: ...unto the manifestation of calling unto the nations thou didst commit thyself; guiding unto the knowledge of Christ by words and deeds, thou didst enlighten all to confess the true Godhead of Jesus, the Savior of our souls.

items.english_text: Filled with divine zeal, O Apostle Jude worthy of marvel, thou wast zealous with zeal for God the Almighty, and He showed thee forth filled with divine miracles; for possessing marvelous zeal, thou didst acquire conduct by action: therefore, being in the highest, taking up thine abode with the assemblies that were before, pray, O seer of God, unto Christ God the Word, to grant us great mercy.

items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 1:* Knowing thee as a kinsman of Christ, O Jude, and a firm martyr, we sacredly praise thee, who didst trample down delusion and keep the faith; therefore, celebrating today thy most holy memory, we receive remission of sins through thy prayers.

provenance.verbatim_source:

Knowing thee as a kinsman of Christ, O Jude, and a firm martyr, we sacredly praise thee, who didst trample down delusion and keep the faith; therefore, celebrating today thy most holy memory, we receive remission of sins through thy prayers.

items.english_text: ...with faith, and being as a fountain of spiritual waters, thou didst water the whole universe with grace; therefore we who have been saved through thee, O proclaimer of God, call thee blessed as a close friend of Christ, O Apostle Jude, crying unto thee: Pray unto Christ God, to grant remission of transgressions unto them that honor thy holy memory with love! *(Twice)*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь: Вели́кїй сп҃совъ а҆по́столъ, * ꙗ҆вле́нїа дх҃а сподо́бленъ, * и҆ возлю́бленъ бы́сть, зрѣ́нїа...
items.english_text: Of the Master Who was born, and became a Brother unto all the chosen, O blessed Jude, thou wast a brother; and from Him thou wast sent as an apostle unto all ends, O all-wise one, sowing the word of faith unto all, and enlightening them that were enslaved in the darkness of ignorance unto the evil ruler of this world: therefore we cry unto thee: Pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto them that honor thy holy memory with love! *(Twice)*

provenance.verbatim_source: Of the Master Who was born, and became a Brother unto all the chosen, O blessed Jude, thou wast a brother; and from Him thou wast sent as an apostle unto all ends, O all-wise one, sowing the word of faith unto all, and enlightening them that were enslaved in the darkness of ignorance unto the evil ruler of this world: therefore we cry unto thee: Pray unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto them that honor thy holy memory with love! *(Twice)*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь: Вели́кїй сп҃совъ а҆по́столъ, * ꙗ҆вле́нїа дх҃а сподо́бленъ, * и҆ возлю́бленъ бы́сть, зрѣ́нїа...
items.english_text: As all-immaculate bride of the Creator, as unwedded Mother of the Deliverer, as receptive dwelling of the Comforter, O all-hymned one: hasten to deliver me, who am an abominable dwelling-place of iniquity and who consciously became a plaything of demons, from their evildoing, and make me a radiant dwelling-place of virtues, O light-bearing and incorrupt one; drive away the cloud of passions, and account me worthy of the communion from on high and of the never-setting Light by thy prayers!

provenance.verbatim_source: As all-immaculate bride of the Creator, as unwedded Mother of the Deliverer, as receptive dwelling of the Comforter, O all-hymned one: hasten to deliver me, who am an abominable dwelling-place of iniquity and who consciously became a plaything of demons, from their evildoing, and make me a radiant dwelling-place of virtues, O light-bearing and incorrupt one; drive away the cloud of passions, and account me worthy of the communion from on high and of the never-setting Light by thy prayers!

items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *Perceiving Thy divine condescension foreseeingly, Habakkuk cried unto Thee with trembling, O Christ: For the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed ones, art Thou come![^512]*

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being filled with grace and with gifts bestowed by God, O apostle: guide unto the haven of salvation those who hymn thee in song!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Being filled with grace and with gifts bestowed by God, O apostle: guide unto the haven of salvation those who hymn thee in song!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃года́ти сы́й и҆спо́лненъ и҆ даро́въ, * ѿ бг҃а пода́нныхъ а҆́пл҃е, * на спаси́тельное приста́нище * тѧ̀ пѣсносло́вѧщыѧ наставлѧ́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Fenced about with the invincible power of the All-Holy Spirit, O minister of ineffable things: thou drivest away the spirits of wickedness by the word of grace!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Fenced about with the invincible power of the All-Holy Spirit, O minister of ineffable things: thou drivest away the spirits of wickedness by the word of grace!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Си́лою непобѣди́мою, * дх҃а прест҃а́гѡ ѡ҆гражда́емь, * слꙋжи́телю неизрече́нныхъ, * лꙋка́вствїѧ ѿгонѧ́еши дꙋ́хи, * сло́вомъ бл҃года́ти.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having ineffably conceived thy Creator and God, O all-immaculate one: pray that we be saved from afflictions, and that salvation of soul be granted unto them that piously hymn thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having ineffably conceived thy Creator and God, O all-immaculate one: pray that we be saved from afflictions, and that salvation of soul be granted unto them that piously hymn thee!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро: Несказаннѡ заче́нши всенепоро́чнаѧ, * творца̀ твоего̀ и҆ бг҃а, * молѝ спастѝ ны̀ ѿ бѣ́дъ, * и҆ дꙋше́вное спасе́нїе пода́ти, * пою́щымъ тѧ̀ бл҃гче.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, unto Thee I rise early, and unto Thee I cry: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as Thou alone art compassionate![^513]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, unto Thee I rise early, and unto Thee I cry: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as Thou alone art compassionate![^513]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Ѡ҆дѣѧ́йсѧ свѣ́томъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ри́зою, * к тебѣ̀ ᲂу҆́тренню, и҆ тебѣ̀ зовꙋ̀: * дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ просвѣтѝ ѡ҆мраче́ннꙋю хрⷭ҇тѐ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having left behind the shadows of the law, thou didst radiantly proclaim the image of truth, having acquired the Truth Himself as teacher.[^514]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having left behind the shadows of the law, thou didst radiantly proclaim the image of truth, having acquired the Truth Himself as teacher.[^514]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Зако́на ѡ҆ста́вль сѣ́ни, * и҆́стины ѡ҆́бразъ свѣ́тлѡ проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ, * са́мꙋю и҆́стинꙋ стѧжа́въ наста́вника.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Fulfilling the command of the Word, O apostle, teaching all nations by thy doctrines, thou didst traverse the earth, baptizing them by the invocation of the Trinity.[^515]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Fulfilling the command of the Word, O apostle, teaching all nations by thy doctrines, thou didst traverse the earth, baptizing them by the invocation of the Trinity.[^515]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сло́ва повелѣ́нїе и҆сполнѧ́ѧ а҆́пл҃е, * ꙗ҆зы́ки всѧ̑ ᲂу҆че́нїи твои́ми наꙋча́ѧ ѡ҆бте́клъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ си́хъ крестѧ̀, * тро́ическимъ призыва́нїемъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Like heavenly rain, as dew from on high, thy divine utterance, O preacher of God, dispelled the mist of polytheism through the preaching of the one God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Like heavenly rain, as dew from on high, thy divine utterance, O preacher of God, dispelled the mist of polytheism through the preaching of the one God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: До́ждь нб҃ны́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ роса̀ свы́ше, * бж҃твенное вѣща́нїе твоѐ бг҃опроповѣ́дниче, * мглу̀ разорѝ многобо́жїѧ, * є҆ди́нагѡ бг҃а проповѣ́данїемъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Put to death my passions, O Birthgiver of God, and raise up my soul which is slain by sinful pleasures, O Mother of the true Resurrection!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Put to death my passions, O Birthgiver of God, and raise up my soul which is slain by sinful pleasures, O Mother of the true Resurrection!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆мертвѝ стра̑сти моѧ̑, бг҃ороди́тельнице, * и҆ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ѡ҆ᲂу҆мерщвле́ннꙋю грѣхо́вными сластьмѝ, возста́ви, * мт҃и и҆́стиннагѡ воскрⷭ҇нїѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *Calm the sea of passions raging with a soul-corrupting tempest, O Master Christ, and lead me up from corruption, as Thou art compassionate![^516]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*Calm the sea of passions raging with a soul-corrupting tempest, O Master Christ, and lead me up from corruption, as Thou art compassionate![^516]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Неи́стовствꙋющеесѧ бꙋ́рею дꙋшетлѣ́нною вл҃ко хрⷭ҇тѐ, * страсте́й мо́ре ᲂу҆кротѝ, * и҆ ѿ тлѝ возведи́ мѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Radiantly shining by the teaching of contemplation and by the deeds of life, O apostle of Christ: thou didst enlighten them that were in the deep of ignorance!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Radiantly shining by the teaching of contemplation and by the deeds of life, O apostle of Christ: thou didst enlighten them that were in the deep of ignorance!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Видѣ́нїа ᲂу҆че́нїемъ, житїа̀ дѣ́лми, * свѣ́тлѡ хрⷭ҇то́въ а҆́пл҃е сїѧ́ѧ: * сꙋ́щыѧ во глꙋбинѣ̀ невѣ́дѣнїѧ просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou sendest forth unto all men an epistle radiant and filled with the teaching of the Spirit, O divinely revealed and all-marvelous one![^517]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou sendest forth unto all men an epistle radiant and filled with the teaching of the Spirit, O divinely revealed and all-marvelous one![^517]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆сыла́еши всѣ̑мъ чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ свѣ́тлое, * и҆ ᲂу҆че́нїа дх҃а и҆спо́лнено посла́нїе, * сщ҃енноѧвле́нне пречꙋ́дне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The beholder of God proclaims heavenly things, as it were declaring a certain spiritual glory of God, Who for our sake appeared in the flesh and by miracles.[^518]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The beholder of God proclaims heavenly things, as it were declaring a certain spiritual glory of God, Who for our sake appeared in the flesh and by miracles.[^518]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ови́децъ вѣща́етъ нб҃снаѧ, * ꙗ҆́коже слове́снꙋю нѣ́кꙋю бж҃їю сла́вꙋ повѣ́даѧ, * на́съ ра́ди пло́тїю ꙗ҆́вльшагосѧ и҆ чꙋдесы̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O all-holy Sovereign Lady, Mother of God: deliver me from corruption, and still the turbulence of passions, O thou who didst bear the Source of dispassion!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O all-holy Sovereign Lady, Mother of God: deliver me from corruption, and still the turbulence of passions, O thou who didst bear the Source of dispassion!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Прест҃а́ѧ вл҃чце бг҃омт҃и, * и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ тлѝ, * и҆ страсте́й смꙋще́нїе ᲂу҆толѝ, * ꙗ҆́же и҆сто́чникъ безстра́стїѧ ро́ждшаѧ.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "The firm" (Тве́рдыѧ):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 2:*
*Tone 2, Podoben: "The firm" (Тве́рдыѧ):*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, в҃. Подо́бенъ: Тве́рдыѧ: Тве́рдымъ ᲂу҆мо́мъ и҆збра́нъ ᲂу҆чени́къ ты̀ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * и҆ сто́лпъ неѡбори́мь цр҃кве хрⷭ҇товы. * ꙗ҆зы́кѡмъ проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ сло́во хрⷭ҇то́во, вѣ́ровати глаго́лѧ: * во є҆ди́но бж҃тво̀: ѿ негѡ́же просла́вльсѧ, прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ
items.english_text: With a firm mind thou wast shown forth as a chosen disciple, and an invincible pillar of the Church of Christ; unto the Gentiles thou didst preach the word of Christ, saying to believe in the one Godhead: glorified by Whom, thou hast received the gift of healings, to heal the infirmities of those who flee unto thee, O all-praised Apostle Jude!

provenance.verbatim_source:
With a firm mind thou wast shown forth as a chosen disciple, and an invincible pillar of the Church of Christ; unto the Gentiles thou didst preach the word of Christ, saying to believe in the one Godhead: glorified by Whom, thou hast received...
...the gift of healings, to heal the infirmities of those who flee unto thee, O all-praised Apostle Jude!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: є҆сѝ да́ръ и҆сцѣле́нїй, * цѣли́ти недꙋ́ги притека́ющымъ к̾ тебѣ̀, * а҆́пл҃е їꙋ́до всехва́льне.
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Let us worthily praise the preacher of true piety and mighty champion of truth, as an emulator and witness of Christ; for he manfully received His sufferings upon his body, as a disciple of the Word and all-praised apostle, Jude.[^519]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ikos:*
Let us worthily praise the preacher of true piety and mighty champion of truth, as an emulator and witness of Christ; for he manfully received His sufferings upon his body, as a disciple of the Word and all-praised apostle, Jude.[^519]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Ї҆́косъ: И҆́стиннаго бл҃гоче́стїѧ проповѣ́дника, и҆ держа́внаго и҆́стины побо́рника, досто́йнѡ восхва́лимъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ подо́бника хрⷭ҇тꙋ и҆ свидѣ́телѧ. стра́сти бо є҆гѡ̀ на тѣ́лѣ мꙋ́жески прїѧ́тъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ᲂу҆чени́къ словесѐ и҆ а҆́пл҃ъ їꙋ́да всехва́льный.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *The Lord God of our fathers, Who is supremely exalted, quenched the flame and bedewed the Children who sang in unison: Blessed art Thou, O God![^520]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*The Lord God of our fathers, Who is supremely exalted, quenched the flame and bedewed the Children who sang in unison: Blessed art Thou, O God![^520]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Превозноси́мый ѻ҆тце́въ гдⷭ҇ь, * пла́мень ᲂу҆гасѝ, ѻ҆́троки ѡ҆росѝ, * согла́снѡ пою́щыѧ: * бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having become an eye-witness of the holy Godhead, let us all hymn Jude, singing in unison: Blessed art Thou, O God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having become an eye-witness of the holy Godhead, let us all hymn Jude, singing in unison: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Бг҃ови́дна свѧты̑мъ бж҃ества̀ бы́вша, * всѝ їꙋ́дꙋ воспое́мъ, * согла́снѡ пою́ще: * бж҃е бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy tongue, moved by the Spirit and divinely inspired, converted the world through the preaching of Christ, unto Whom we all sing: Blessed art Thou, O God![^521]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thy tongue, moved by the Spirit and divinely inspired, converted the world through the preaching of Christ, unto Whom we all sing: Blessed art Thou, O God![^521]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Дх҃одви́жный и҆ бг҃одꙋкнове́нный ꙗ҆зы́къ тво́й, * мі́ръ ѡ҆братѝ хрⷭ҇товымъ проповѣ́данїемъ. * є҆мꙋ́же всѝ пое́мъ: * бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Lord gives thee the heavenly inheritance and an all-radiant throne; resting upon which, thou divinely singest: Blessed art Thou, O God![^522]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The Lord gives thee the heavenly inheritance and an all-radiant throne; resting upon which, thou divinely singest: Blessed art Thou, O God![^522]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Дае́тъ тебѣ̀ нбⷭ҇ное наслѣ́дїе гдⷭ҇ь, * и҆ престо́лъ пресвѣ́телъ. * на не́мже почива́ѧ, бж҃твеннѣ пое́ши: * бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With lips and understanding we joyfully proclaim thee as the Birthgiver of God and Sovereign Lady, for thou didst bear God, unto Whom we all sing: Blessed art Thou, O God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
With lips and understanding we joyfully proclaim thee as the Birthgiver of God and Sovereign Lady, for thou didst bear God, unto Whom we all sing: Blessed art Thou, O God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆сты̑ и҆ ра́зꙋмомъ тѧ̀ бцⷣꙋ вл҃чцꙋ, * проповѣ́дꙋемъ весе́лѧщесѧ: * бг҃а бо родила̀ є҆сѝ. * є҆мꙋ́же всѝ пое́мъ: * бж҃е бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *Unto Thee, the Creator of all, the Children in the furnace, having woven a universal choir, sang: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^523]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*Unto Thee, the Creator of all, the Children in the furnace, having woven a universal choir, sang: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^523]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Тебѣ̀ вседѣ́телю, въ пещѝ ѻ҆́троцы, всемї́рный ли́къ спле́тше поѧ́хꙋ: * дѣла̀ всѧ́каѧ гдⷭ҇а по́йте, * и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst receive the wealth of the Gentiles and the honor of kings as thy fair calling, crying aloud, O apostle: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst receive the wealth of the Gentiles and the honor of kings as thy fair calling, crying aloud, O apostle: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Бога́тство ꙗ҆зы́къ, и҆ цр҃ей по́честь, * бл҃гозва́нїе воспрїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, * вопїѧ̀ а҆́пл҃е: * всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а по́йте, * и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst receive this radiance of the Comforter that descended upon thee, O blessed one, crying, O glorious one: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^524]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst receive this radiance of the Comforter that descended upon thee, O blessed one, crying, O glorious one: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^524]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сїю̀ зарю̀ ᲂу҆тѣ́шителевꙋ бл҃же́нне, * прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ соше́дшꙋю, * зовы́й сла́вне: * всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а по́йте, * и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having hated corruptible things, thou didst choose the glory of heaven, knowing it to be abiding, O apostle; therefore thou didst cry aloud: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having hated corruptible things, thou didst choose the glory of heaven, knowing it to be abiding, O apostle; therefore thou didst cry aloud: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Вє́щи тлѣ́нныѧ возненави́дѣвъ, * нбⷭ҇ныхъ сла́вꙋ произво́лилъ є҆сѝ, * пребыва́ющꙋю вѣ́дый а҆́пл҃е. * тѣ́мже вопїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ: * всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а по́йте, * и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Come, let us hymn the beauty of Jacob, most pure Mary, singing in unison: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^525]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Come, let us hymn the beauty of Jacob, most pure Mary, singing in unison: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^525]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Прїиди́те добро́тꙋ ꙗ҆́кѡвлю воспои́мъ, * мр҃і́ю пречⷭ҇тꙋю, * согла́снѡ пою́ще: * всѧ̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а по́йте, * и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *Rejoice, O Isaiah! A Virgin hath conceived in her womb and borne a Son, Emmanuel, God and Man; the Dayspring is His name: Whom magnifying, we call the Virgin blessed![^526]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
*Rejoice, O Isaiah! A Virgin hath conceived in her womb and borne a Son, Emmanuel, God and Man; the Dayspring is His name: Whom magnifying, we call the Virgin blessed![^526]*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: И҆са́їе ликꙋ́й, * дв҃а и҆мѣ̀ во чре́вѣ, * и҆ родѝ сн҃а є҆мманꙋ́ила, * бг҃а же и҆ человѣ́ка, * восто́къ и҆́мѧ є҆мꙋ̀: * є҆го́же велича́юще, дв҃ꙋ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having been illumined, O glorious one, with the radiance of the light-pourings of the Spirit, thou sendest forth upon all supernatural flashings of miracles, as a disciple of Emmanuel: Whom magnifying, we call thee blessed, O beholder of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having been illumined, O glorious one, with the radiance of the light-pourings of the Spirit, thou sendest forth upon all supernatural flashings of miracles, as a disciple of Emmanuel: Whom magnifying, we call thee blessed, O beholder of God!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Со а҆́гг҃лскими чи́нми предстоѧ́ще бг҃ови́днїи самови́дцы, * и҆ зри́тели є҆диноро́днагѡ, * пло́тїю ѡ҆бнища́вшагѡ на́съ ра́ди, * сего̀ прилѣ́жнѡ вы́ну моли́те, * спастѝ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Standing with the angelic ranks, O divinely seeing eyewitnesses and beholders of the Only-begotten, Who for our sake became poor in the flesh: fervently pray ye ever unto Him to save our souls![^527]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Standing with the angelic ranks, O divinely seeing eyewitnesses and beholders of the Only-begotten, Who for our sake became poor in the flesh: fervently pray ye ever unto Him to save our souls![^527]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ро́ждши пречⷭ҇таѧ, * тва́рей содѣ́телѧ, * по всемꙋ̀ роди́телѧ носи́ши нача́ло, * несравни́телно и҆мѣ́ѧ прїѧ́тїе, и҆ превознесе́нно. * тѣ́мже ржⷭ҇твꙋ твоемꙋ̀ покланѧ́ющесѧ, * тѧ̀ прославлѧ́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having given birth to the Creator of creatures, O all-immaculate one, thou bearest the Principle of the Parent in every respect, having an acceptance incomparable and exalted; therefore, worshiping thy childbearing, we glorify thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having given birth to the Creator of creatures, O all-immaculate one, thou bearest the Principle of the Parent in every respect, having an acceptance incomparable and exalted; therefore, worshiping thy childbearing, we glorify thee!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ленъ. Подо́: Дꙋ́хомъ во ст҃или́щи: Тече́нїе кра́сныхъ твои́хъ но́гъ, їꙋ́до а҆́пл҃е возврати́въ, * къ ше́ствїю нбⷭ҇номꙋ возше́лъ є҆сѝ ра́дꙋѧсѧ, * и҆ трⷪ҇цѣ предста́въ: * во ѻ҆ц҃ѣ̀ ви́диши сн҃а, и҆ дх҃а бж҃твеннаго. * сегѡ̀ ра́ди вѣ́рою пресвѧще́нную твою̀, * и҆ бж҃твеннꙋю пра́зднꙋемъ па́мѧть. Два́жды:
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "In spirit in the sanctuary" (Дꙋ́хомъ во ст҃или́щи):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Exapostilarion:*
*Tone 2, Podoben: "In spirit in the sanctuary" (Дꙋ́хомъ во ст҃или́щи):*

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Стра́шнагѡ и҆спыта́нїѧ воспомѧна́ю ча́съ, * мно́жество ѕлы́хъ дѣ́лъ мои́хъ ᲂу҆жаса́етъ и҆ ᲂу҆страша́етъ мѧ̀. * но ᲂу҆ще́дри пречⷭ҇таѧ те́плою твое́ю моли́твою, * и҆ да́ждь мѝ спасе́нїе: * є҆ли́ка бо хо́щеши, мо́жеши.
items.english_text: Having turned back the course of thy fair feet, O Apostle Jude, thou didst ascend rejoicing unto the heavenly journey, and standing before the Trinity, in the Father thou beholdest the Son and the Divine Spirit; therefore in faith we celebrate thy most consecrated and divine memory! *(Twice)*[^528]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having turned back the course of thy fair feet, O Apostle Jude, thou didst ascend rejoicing unto the heavenly journey, and standing before the Trinity, in the Father thou beholdest the Son and the Divine Spirit; therefore in faith we celebrate thy most consecrated and divine memory! *(Twice)*[^528]

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Го́рꙋ и҆скапа́ющꙋ сла́дость, * бж҃твеннагѡ ра́зꙋма а҆́пл҃е їꙋ́до, тѧ̀ и҆менꙋ́емъ. * ми́рнꙋю рѣкꙋ̀, ᲂу҆стреми́вшꙋюсѧ ѿ дх҃о́вныхъ невеще́ственныхъ и҆сто́чникъ, * и҆ безбо́жїа и҆з̾исꙋша́ющꙋю мо́рѧ, * и҆ напоѧ́ющꙋю та́иннѡ бл҃гочести́выхъ срⷣца и҆ помышле́нїа. * трꙋбꙋ̀ доброгла́снꙋ, * гласѧ́щꙋ сло́ва бж҃твенное ꙗ҆вле́нїе, мі́ръ и҆збавлѧ́юща. * є҆го́же ны́нѣ молѝ, * є҆мꙋ́же помоли́сѧ всегда̀, * дарова́ти вселе́ннѣй є҆диномꙋ́слїе, * ми́ръ и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: I call to mind the hour of the dread trial; the multitude of my evil deeds terrifies and frightens me; but have compassion, O most pure one, through thy fervent prayer, and grant me salvation: for whatsoever thou desirest, thou canst do!

provenance.verbatim_source: I call to mind the hour of the dread trial; the multitude of my evil deeds terrifies and frightens me; but have compassion, O most pure one, through thy fervent prayer, and grant me salvation: for whatsoever thou desirest, thou canst do!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃же́нне їꙋ́до, * бра́тїа твоѧ̀ тѧ̀ восхвали́ша, * гдⷭ҇нѧ бра́та ꙗ҆́вльшасѧ, * и҆ бы́вша дх҃а прїѧ́телище бг҃олѣ́пно: * є҆гѡ́же свѣ́тлостми чи́стѡ просвѣ́щсѧ, * ᲂу҆́гль ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ [лѣ́сть попалѧ́ѧ, вѣ́рныѧ же бг҃а просвѣща́ѧ, чи́стыхъ ᲂу҆че́нїй сїѧ́нь]
items.english_text: Obeying the divine nod, O most blessed one, thou didst preach unto all the incarnate Word, Who was made like unto us without change; having become His venerable disciple, having become His brother according to the flesh, and having been accounted worthy to behold His glory with a pure, divine mind: therefore we honor thee, O Jude of divine voice, and we celebrate thy memory, faithfully crying unto thee: Pray ever unto Christ to grant the universe oneness of mind, peace, and great mercy! *(Twice)*[^529]

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* A mountain dropping down sweetness of divine understanding do we call thee, O Apostle Jude: a peaceful river rushing forth from spiritual, immaterial sources, drying up the seas of godlessness, and mystically watering the hearts and thoughts of the pious; a melodious trumpet proclaiming the divine manifestation of the Word Who delivers the world: Whom do thou now beseech, unto Whom pray thou ever, to grant the universe oneness of mind, peace, and great mercy![^530]

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* O blessed Jude, thy brethren praised thee, who wast shown forth as the brother of the Lord and didst become a God-befitting vessel of the Spirit: being purely enlightened with Whose brightnesses, thou wast revealed as a live coal burning up deceit, and enlightening the faithful with the flashings of pure doctrines therefore we honor thee as an unsetting morning star, and we celebrate thy holy memory, faithfully crying unto thee: Pray ever unto Christ to grant the universe oneness of mind, peace, and great mercy!

items.day_or_date: On the 1st Day: The Holy Martyr Justin the Philosopher; and Another Martyr Justin, and Those with Them:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, в҃. Ѡ҆ста́вивъ земна̑ѧ, послѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀, * и҆ зна́менавсѧ дꙋкнове́нїемъ ст҃а́гѡ дх҃а, * по́сланъ бы́въ ѿ негѡ̀ къ ꙗ҆зы́ки поги́бшыѧ, * ѡ҆браща́ти человѣ́ки во свѣ́тъ бг҃оразꙋ́мїѧ а҆́пл҃е їꙋ́до: * и҆ сконча́въ по́двиги бж҃твенныѧ твоеѧ̀ стра́сти, и҆ мꙋ́къ разли́чныхъ, * дꙋ́шꙋ твою̀ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ преда́лъ є҆сѝ. * того̀ молѝ всебл҃же́нне, * дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Having forsaken earthly things, thou didst follow Christ, and being sealed by the breathing of the Holy Spirit, thou wast sent by Him unto the perishing Gentiles, to turn men unto the light of the knowledge of God, O Apostle Jude; and having finished the struggles of thy divine passion and of diverse torments, thou didst commit thy soul unto Christ: Whom do thou beseech, O all-blessed one, to grant us great mercy![^531]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having forsaken earthly things, thou didst follow Christ, and being sealed by the breathing of the Holy Spirit, thou wast sent by Him unto the perishing Gentiles, to turn men unto the light of the knowledge of God, O Apostle Jude; and having finished the struggles of thy divine passion and of diverse torments, thou didst commit thy soul unto Christ: Whom do thou beseech, O all-blessed one, to grant us great mercy![^531]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Кровмѝ ѡ҆багри́лъ є҆сѝ * сщ҃еннꙋю ѻ҆де́ждꙋ твою̀, бг҃оно́се меѳо́дїе: * съ не́юже во ст҃а́ѧ ст҃ы́хъ бл҃же́нне * вмѣсти́лсѧ є҆сѝ ра́дꙋѧсѧ, и҆ зри́ши свѣ́тлѡ
items.english_text: *Stichera, Tone 4.*

provenance.verbatim_source: *Stichera, Tone 4.*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Кровмѝ ѡ҆багри́лъ є҆сѝ * сщ҃еннꙋю ѻ҆де́ждꙋ твою̀, бг҃оно́се меѳо́дїе: * съ не́юже во ст҃а́ѧ ст҃ы́хъ бл҃же́нне * вмѣсти́лсѧ є҆сѝ ра́дꙋѧсѧ, и҆ зри́ши свѣ́тлѡ
items.english_text: Having arrived for us as a saving mastery, O hierarch Methodius, we radiantly hymn thy memory in song, proclaiming thy radiant struggles and contests, whereby thou didst vanquish the crafty and wicked one, and didst weave a crown of victory, rejoicing![^538]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having arrived for us as a saving mastery, O hierarch Methodius, we radiantly hymn thy memory in song, proclaiming thy radiant struggles and contests, whereby thou didst vanquish the crafty and wicked one, and didst weave a crown of victory, rejoicing![^538]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Кровмѝ ѡ҆багри́лъ є҆сѝ * сщ҃еннꙋю ѻ҆де́ждꙋ твою̀, бг҃оно́се меѳо́дїе: * съ не́юже во ст҃а́ѧ ст҃ы́хъ бл҃же́нне * вмѣсти́лсѧ є҆сѝ ра́дꙋѧсѧ, и҆ зри́ши свѣ́тлѡ
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* With fair blossoms thou didst cause the fullness of the Church to flourish, O divinely blessed Methodius; and by the brightness of thy sufferings thou didst drive away the gloom of polytheism, and didst pass over unto the unsetting light, O hieromartyr; therefore we celebrate today thy most festal and light-bearing triumph, being illumined with piety!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* With blood thou didst dye thy sacred vesture, O God-bearing Methodius, with which thou didst enter rejoicing into the Holy of Holies, O blessed one, and thou beholdest radiantly radiantly the Trinitarian divine brightness, having been taught most clearly that which is beyond mind and understanding, and having been pre-eminently deified, O most wealthy hierarch![^539]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Скве́рнꙋ ѿмы́й стра́стнагѡ срⷣца моегѡ̀, * бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ, * и҆ всѧ̑ ꙗ҆́звы и҆ гное́нїа сегѡ̀, * ꙗ҆́же ѿ грѣха̀ ᲂу҆чисти чⷭ҇таѧ: * и҆ ᲂу҆ма̀ моегѡ̀ ᲂу҆ста́ви непостоѧ́нное, * ꙗ҆́кѡ да си́лꙋ твою̀, * и҆ вели́кое застꙋпле́нїе, * велича́ю ѻ҆каѧ́нный, и҆ непотрє́бный ра́бъ тво́й.
items.english_text: Rejoice, sun-like ray, throne of the unsetting Sun, who didst cause the unfathomable Sun to shine forth! Rejoice, lightning-like dawn shining with divine illuminations, who didst enlighten the ends of the earth, true gleaming of gold, all-good and all-immaculate one, who didst flash forth the unsetting light upon the faithful![^540]

provenance.verbatim_source: Rejoice, sun-like ray, throne of the unsetting Sun, who didst cause the unfathomable Sun to shine forth! Rejoice, lightning-like dawn shining with divine illuminations, who didst enlighten the ends of the earth, true gleaming of gold, all-good and all-immaculate one, who didst flash forth the unsetting light upon the faithful![^540]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Не́мощь и҆ разслабле́нїе, * дв҃о мт҃и всенепоро́чнаѧ, * дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ преложѝ въ крѣ́пость и҆ си́лꙋ, * стра́хомъ и҆ любо́вїю твори́ти же, * и҆ дѣ́ѧти ѡ҆правда́нїа хрⷭ҇то́ва: * ꙗ҆́кѡ да и҆збѣ́гнꙋ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ нестерпи́магѡ, * и҆ наслѣ́дїе нбⷭ҇ное, * и҆ жи́знь непреходи́мꙋю, * тобо́ю воспрїимꙋ̀ весе́лѧсѧ всегда̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Wash away the defilement of my passionate heart, O all-hymned Birthgiver of God, and cleanse all its wounds and corruptions that come from sin, O pure one; and still the instability of my mind, that I, thy wretched and unprofitable servant, may magnify thy power and great protection!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Wash away the defilement of my passionate heart, O all-hymned Birthgiver of God, and cleanse all its wounds and corruptions that come from sin, O pure one; and still the instability of my mind, that I, thy wretched and unprofitable servant, may magnify thy power and great protection!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже. Бѣсо́вскими преклоне́на прило́гми, * и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели вве́ржена, * ᲂу҆ще́дри вл҃чце, * и҆ ᲂу҆тверди́ мѧ на ка́мени добродѣ́телей: * и҆ навѣ́ты вра́жїѧ разори́ши, * сподо́би мѧ̀ твори́ти повелѣ́нїа, * твоегѡ̀ сн҃а и҆ бг҃а на́шегѡ: * ꙗ҆́кѡ да ᲂу҆лꙋчꙋ̀ * ѡ҆ставле́нїе въ де́нь сꙋ́да.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Turn the weakness and paralysis of my soul into strength and power, O Virgin Mother all-immaculate, with fear and love both to perform and to do the ordinances of Christ: that I may escape the unendurable fire, and through thee receive the heavenly inheritance and life unpassing, rejoicing ever!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Turn the weakness and paralysis of my soul into strength and power, O Virgin Mother all-immaculate, with fear and love both to perform and to do the ordinances of Christ: that I may escape the unendurable fire, and through thee receive the heavenly inheritance and life unpassing, rejoicing ever!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, д҃. Кро́вь твоѧ̀ мꙋ́дре та́иннѡ вопїе́тъ ѿ землѝ, * ꙗ҆́коже а҆́велева къ бг҃ꙋ, * бг҃омꙋ́дре ст҃ителю меѳо́дїе: * ꙗ҆́снѡ проповѣ́давый бж҃їе вочеловѣ́че́нїе. * тѣ́мже и҆ посрами́лъ є҆сѝ ѻ҆рїге́новꙋ ле́сть, * и҆ преста́вилсѧ є҆сѝ въ нбⷭ҇ный черто́гъ: * молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, да спасе́тъ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_text: Bowed down by demonic assaults and cast into the pit of destruction, have compassion on me, O Sovereign Lady, and establish me upon the rock of virtues; and destroying the snares of the enemy, account me worthy to perform the commandments of thy Son and our God, that I may obtain remission in the day of judgment!

provenance.verbatim_source: Bowed down by demonic assaults and cast into the pit of destruction, have compassion on me, O Sovereign Lady, and establish me upon the rock of virtues; and destroying the snares of the enemy, account me worthy to perform the commandments of thy Son and our God, that I may obtain remission in the day of judgment!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, творе́нїе ѳеофа́ново. Гла́съ, з҃. Пѣ́снь, а҆. Ї҆рмо́съ: Мані́емъ твои́мъ на земны́й ѡ҆́бразъ преложи́сѧ, пре́жде ᲂу҆добо-
items.english_text: Beholding Christ, the Lover of mankind, crucified, and His ribs pierced with a lance, the most pure one, weeping, cried aloud: What is this, O my Son? What have the ungrateful people rendered unto Thee for the good things Thou didst do for them? And art Thou hastening to leave me childless, O most beloved One? I marvel, O Compassionate One, at Thy voluntary crucifixion![^541]

items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Thy blood, O wise one, mystically cries unto God from the earth like that of Abel, O divinely wise hierarch Methodius, who didst clearly proclaim the divine Incarnation; therefore thou didst put to shame the deceit of Origen, and didst pass over into the heavenly bridal chamber: pray unto Christ God that He save our souls![^542]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Стези̑ ско̑рыѧ къ бг҃ꙋ мановѧ́щїѧ, * пока́зꙋѧ преходѧ́щымъ, * ст҃ли́телю, сщ҃еннотаи́нниче наꙋчѝ: * ꙗ҆́кѡ да безконе́чнꙋю ᲂу҆лꙋчꙋ̀ жи́знь, * мл҃твами твои́ми сла́вне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Showing the swift pathways beckoning toward God unto those who pass through, teach me, O hierarch and sacred initiate: that I may obtain unending life by thy prayers, O glorious one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
