items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆блиста́лъ є҆сѝ свѣтоно́снѡ бо, * хрⷭ҇то́вѣ цр҃кви, * сꙋгꙋ́быми сїѧ́ѧ сщ҃енноѧвле́нне благода́тми. * тѣ́мже сꙋгꙋ́быми тѧ̀ вѣнцы̀, * сщ҃еннолѣ́пнѡ хрⷭ҇то́съ вѣнча̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* For thou didst shine forth in a light-bearing manner unto the Church of Christ, beaming with twofold graces, O divinely revealed one; therefore with twofold crowns Christ sacredly crowned thee![^544]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
For thou didst shine forth in a light-bearing manner unto the Church of Christ, beaming with twofold graces, O divinely revealed one; therefore with twofold crowns Christ sacredly crowned thee![^544]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Вѣнце́мъ мꙋче́нїѧ, * сщ҃е́нства же ма́стїю бл҃же́нне ᲂу҆краша́емь, * ѻ҆бои́ми процвѣ́лъ є҆сѝ. * тѣ́мже и҆́стинное, и҆ бг҃ови́дное наслѣ́дїе полꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Adorned with the crown of martyrdom and with the anointing of the priesthood, O blessed one, thou didst flourish with both; therefore thou hast received the true and God-beholding inheritance!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Adorned with the crown of martyrdom and with the anointing of the priesthood, O blessed one, thou didst flourish with both; therefore thou hast received the true and God-beholding inheritance!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ непоро́чна же́ртва, * и҆ сщ҃е́нна вл҃цѣ, * и҆ жива̀ и҆ ѡ҆дꙋшевленна̀, * сщ҃еннодѣ́йствовасѧ сла́вне. * тѣ́мже же́ртвенникꙋ нбⷭ҇номꙋ прїѧ́тъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ меѳо́дїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a blameless sacrifice, and consecrated unto the Master, both living and ensouled, thou wast offered up, O glorious one; therefore thou wast received upon the heavenly altar, O Methodius![^545]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
As a blameless sacrifice, and consecrated unto the Master, both living and ensouled, thou wast offered up, O glorious one; therefore thou wast received upon the heavenly altar, O Methodius![^545]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро: И҆зба́вителѧ человѣ́ческагѡ ро́да, * и҆ свободи́телѧ и҆ сп҃са хрⷭ҇та̀ на́мъ родила̀ є҆сѝ, * дв҃о мт҃и чⷭ҇таѧ. * тѣ́мже ꙗ҆́вѣ тѧ̀ вѣ́дꙋще хода́таицꙋ живота̀ вѣ́чнагѡ сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst bear for us the Deliverer of mankind, the Liberator and Savior Christ, O Virgin pure Mother; therefore, clearly knowing thee to be the Mediatress of eternal life, we glorify thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thou didst bear for us the Deliverer of mankind, the Liberator and Savior Christ, O Virgin pure Mother; therefore, clearly knowing thee to be the Mediatress of eternal life, we glorify thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Въ нача́лѣ нб҃са̀, * всеси́льнымъ сло́вомъ твои́мъ ᲂу҆твержде́й гдⷭ҇и сп҃се, * и҆ вседѣ́тельнымъ и҆ бж҃їимъ дх҃омъ, * всю̀ си́лꙋ и҆́хъ: * на недви́жимѣмъ мѧ̀ ка́мени, и҆сповѣ́данїѧ твоегѡ̀ ᲂу҆твердѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *O Lord and Savior, Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens by Thy all-powerful Word, and all their host by the all-effective and Divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession![^546]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
*O Lord and Savior, Who in the beginning didst establish the heavens by Thy all-powerful Word, and all their host by the all-effective and Divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession![^546]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Распала́ющꙋюсѧ ви́дѣвъ ѻ҆рїге́новꙋ пре́лесть, * ꙗ҆́кѡ сы́й и҆зрѧ́денъ па́стырь, * бж҃твеннымъ ѻ҆гне́мъ ско́рѡ попали́лъ є҆сѝ всю̀ ѻ҆́нагѡ мглу̀, * блиста́ющꙋю лꙋчꙋ̀ бж҃їѧ премꙋ́дрости твоеѧ̀, бг҃опрїѧ́тне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Seeing the blazing delusion of Origen, as an excellent shepherd thou didst swiftly consume all his darkness with the divine fire, flashing forth the ray of God's wisdom within Thee, O divinely received one![^547]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Seeing the blazing delusion of Origen, as an excellent shepherd thou didst swiftly consume all his darkness with the divine fire, flashing forth the ray of God's wisdom within Thee, O divinely received one![^547]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Дѣ́йство честно́е, * и҆ чистоты̀ добро́тꙋ нра́вомъ сла́вне навы́къ, * премꙋ́дростїю твое́ю, и҆ слове́съ бл҃года́тїю, * всѣ́хъ си́хъ добро́тꙋ пока́зꙋеши бг҃омꙋ́дре, * и҆ вѣчнꙋ́ющꙋю свѣ́тлость.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having learned honorable conduct and the beauty of purity in character, O glorious one, by thy wisdom and the grace of thy words thou showest forth the beauty of all these, O divinely wise one, and their eternal brightness!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having learned honorable conduct and the beauty of purity in character, O glorious one, by thy wisdom and the grace of thy words thou showest forth the beauty of all these, O divinely wise one, and their eternal brightness!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Твои́хъ слове́съ мо́лнїа, * и҆ ра́зꙋма трꙋба̀, * и҆ ᲂу҆че́нїй бл҃гонаро́читое вѣща́нїе, * во всю̀ зе́млю и҆зы́де прпⷣбне, * всѧ̑ зовꙋ́щи вѣ́рныѧ, * къ прича́стїю пребл҃же́нне нбⷭ҇ныхъ наслажде́нїй.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The lightning of thy words, the trumpet of understanding, and the auspicious utterance of thy doctrines went forth into all the earth, O venerable one, summoning all the faithful, O most blessed one, unto the communion of heavenly delights![^548]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The lightning of thy words, the trumpet of understanding, and the auspicious utterance of thy doctrines went forth into all the earth, O venerable one, summoning all the faithful, O most blessed one, unto the communion of heavenly delights![^548]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Крѣпча́йшею пи́щею дх҃о́вныхъ напое́нїй * насы́щшесѧ премꙋ́дре твои́хъ, * и҆́стинною пи́щею ѻ҆́ною наслажда́ютсѧ, * пребыва́ющею приснотекꙋ́щею немимохо́днѡ, * и҆ растꙋ́щею прича́стникѡмъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being filled with the stronger meat of thy spiritual draughts, O all-wise one, they take delight in that true food which abides, ever flowing without ceasing and increasing for its partakers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Being filled with the stronger meat of thy spiritual draughts, O all-wise one, they take delight in that true food which abides, ever flowing without ceasing and increasing for its partakers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Съ бж҃твеннымъ гаврїи́ломъ, * бл҃гослове́ннаѧ дв҃о, * тебѣ̀ ра́дꙋйсѧ зове́мъ при́снѡ: * ра́дости бо на́мъ вина̀ была̀ є҆сѝ, * и҆ весе́лїа и҆́стиннагѡ, * и҆зба́вителѧ и҆ сп҃са всѣ́хъ, * пло́тїю ро́ждши.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With divine Gabriel, O blessed Virgin, we ever cry "Rejoice!" unto thee: for thou wast the cause of joy and true gladness for us, having borne in the flesh the Deliverer and Savior of all![^549]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
With divine Gabriel, O blessed Virgin, we ever cry "Rejoice!" unto thee: for thou wast the cause of joy and true gladness for us, having borne in the flesh the Deliverer and Savior of all![^549]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Вознесы́йсѧ:
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:*
*Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Же́ртвенникъ кра́сенъ, срⷣце твоѐ сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ, * безкро́вны сщ҃еннодѣ́йственне принеслъ є҆сѝ же́ртвы бг҃ꙋ. * пострада́въ же крѣ́пкѡ, и҆ поже́рсѧ принеслсѧ є҆сѝ же́ртва меѳо́дїе, * на́съ ра́ди поже́ршемꙋсѧ. * є҆го́же прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ при́снѡ всѧ̑ спастѝ * любо́вїю пою́щыѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: A fair altar didst thou make thy heart, sacredly offering unbloody sacrifices unto God; and having suffered manfully and having been sacrificed, thou wast offered as a victim, O Methodius, unto Him Who was sacrificed for our sake: Whom do thou fervently beseech ever to save all who hymn thee with love![^550]

provenance.verbatim_source: A fair altar didst thou make thy heart, sacredly offering unbloody sacrifices unto God; and having suffered manfully and having been sacrificed, thou wast offered as a victim, O Methodius, unto Him Who was sacrificed for our sake: Whom do thou fervently beseech ever to save all who hymn thee with love![^550]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃о: И҆́же ѿ безнача́лнагѡ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ рожде́ннаго, * напослѣ́докъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю ро́ждшаѧ, * на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ ви́сѧща зрѧ́щи хрⷭ҇тѐ, * ᲂу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ любе́знѣйшїй їн҃се, вопїѧ́ше: * ка́кѡ сла́вимый ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, * ѿ беззако́нныхъ ны́нѣ чл҃къ сн҃е хотѧ̀ распина́ешисѧ? * пою́ тѧ долготерпѣли́ве.
items.english_text: The multitude of my unclean thoughts and the surges of improper imaginations, who can declare, O all-immaculate one? And the assaults of my bodiless foes and their malice, who can tell? But by thy supplication, O good one, grant me deliverance from them all!

provenance.verbatim_source: The multitude of my unclean thoughts and the surges of improper imaginations, who can declare, O all-immaculate one? And the assaults of my bodiless foes and their malice, who can tell? But by thy supplication, O good one, grant me deliverance from them all!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Ѡ҆́ч҃а нѣ́дра не ѡ҆ста́вль, * и҆ соше́дъ на зе́млю хрⷭ҇тѐ бж҃е, * та́инꙋ ᲂу҆слы́шахъ смотре́нїа твоегѡ̀, * и҆ просла́вихъ тѧ̀ є҆ди́не человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* She who in the last times bore Thee in the flesh Who wast begotten of the unoriginate Father, beholding Thee hanging upon the Cross, O Christ, cried aloud: Woe is me, O most beloved Jesus! How art Thou, Who art glorified as God by the Angels, now willingly crucified by lawless men, O my Son? I hymn Thee, O Long-suffering One![^551]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
She who in the last times bore Thee in the flesh Who wast begotten of the unoriginate Father, beholding Thee hanging upon the Cross, O Christ, cried aloud: Woe is me, O most beloved Jesus! How art Thou, Who art glorified as God by the Angels, now willingly crucified by lawless men, O my Son? I hymn Thee, O Long-suffering One![^551]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Къ добродѣ́телей высотѣ̀, * мч҃нческїи сконча́всѧ бо́текъ є҆сѝ, * великодаро́вное воздаѧ́нїе, * сщ҃еннодѣ́йствїа твоегѡ̀ прїе́мъ пребл҃же́нне.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *Without leaving the Father's bosom and having descended unto earth, O Christ God: I heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, the only Lover of mankind![^552]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*Without leaving the Father's bosom and having descended unto earth, O Christ God: I heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, the only Lover of mankind![^552]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Престо́лъ и҆мѣ́ѧ ст҃ительскїй, * сщ҃еннꙋю же жи́знь стѧжа́въ, * правосла́внꙋю проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ вѣ́рꙋ всечⷭ҇тне, * и҆ наꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ твоѐ ста́до.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto the height of virtues, having finished the course of martyrdom, thou didst run, receiving the bountiful reward of thy sacred ministry, O most blessed one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Unto the height of virtues, having finished the course of martyrdom, thou didst run, receiving the bountiful reward of thy sacred ministry, O most blessed one!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́дость дꙋшеполе́знаѧ твои́хъ ᲂу҆че́нїй, * ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆сто́чникъ происхо́дитъ, * прича́стники веселѧ̀, * и҆ ᲂу҆слажда́ѧ дꙋше́внаѧ на́ша чꙋ́вства.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Occupying a hierarch's throne and possessing a holy life, thou didst proclaim the Orthodox faith, O all-venerable one, and didst instruct thy flock![^553]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Occupying a hierarch's throne and possessing a holy life, thou didst proclaim the Orthodox faith, O all-venerable one, and didst instruct thy flock![^553]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ѻ҆те́ческихъ нѣ́дръ не ѿстꙋ́пль, * и҆ ѿ дв҃ы вопло́щсѧ хрⷭ҇тѐ бж҃е, * сохранѝ ста́до твоѐ, * строе́нїа твоегѡ̀, * покланѧ́ющеесѧ бж҃е́ственнымъ ѡ҆бразѡ́мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The soul-profiting sweetness of thy doctrines issues forth like a fountain, gladdening the partakers and sweetening the senses of our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The soul-profiting sweetness of thy doctrines issues forth like a fountain, gladdening the partakers and sweetening the senses of our souls!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Гдⷭ҇и бж҃е мо́й, * ѿ но́щи ᲂу҆́треневавъ тебѣ̀ молю́сѧ, * пода́ждь мѝ ѡ҆ставле́нїе прегрѣше́нїй мои́хъ, * и҆ къ свѣ́тꙋ твои́хъ повелѣ́нїй пꙋти̑ моѧ̑ напра́ви, молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Without departing from the Father's bosom and having become incarnate of the Virgin, O Christ God: preserve Thy flock which venerats the divine representations of Thy dispensation![^554]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Without departing from the Father's bosom and having become incarnate of the Virgin, O Christ God: preserve Thy flock which venerats the divine representations of Thy dispensation![^554]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Ме́ртвостїю живоно́сною ѡ҆дѣ́ѧлсѧ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е, * пре́жде сконча́нїѧ твоегѡ̀, * и҆ мече́мъ ᲂу҆сѣче́нъ мꙋче́нїа твоегѡ̀, * къ жи́зни многоᲂу҆гꙋбле́нѣй преста́вилсѧ є҆сѝ, * сла́вне лꙋ́чшей.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *O Lord my God, rising early from the night unto Thee, I pray: Grant me remission of my transgressions, and unto the light of Thy commandments direct my pathways, I beseech Thee![^555]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*O Lord my God, rising early from the night unto Thee, I pray: Grant me remission of my transgressions, and unto the light of Thy commandments direct my pathways, I beseech Thee![^555]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Таи́нниче неизрече́нныхъ, * и҆ ѻ҆́бщниче вы́шнѧгѡ ликостоѧ́нїа, * любо́вїю чтꙋ́щыѧ тѧ̀ спасѝ пресла́вне, * и҆скꙋше́нїй лю́тыхъ наи́тїа, разорѧ́ѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst clothe thyself with life-bearing mortification, O father, before thy death; and being struck with the sword of thy martyrdom, thou didst pass over unto the manifoldly multiplied, better life, O glorious one![^556]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst clothe thyself with life-bearing mortification, O father, before thy death; and being struck with the sword of thy martyrdom, thou didst pass over unto the manifoldly multiplied, better life, O glorious one![^556]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Таи́нниче неизрече́нныхъ, * и҆ ѻ҆́бщниче вы́шнѧгѡ ликостоѧ́нїа, * любо́вїю чтꙋ́щыѧ тѧ̀ спасѝ пресла́вне, * и҆скꙋше́нїй лю́тыхъ наи́тїа, разорѧ́ѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O initiate of ineffable mysteries and partaker of the choir on high: save them that honor thee with love, O all-glorious one, destroying the onsets of grievous temptations by thy prayers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
O initiate of ineffable mysteries and partaker of the choir on high: save them that honor thee with love, O all-glorious one, destroying the onsets of grievous temptations...
...by thy prayers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: мл҃твами твои́ми.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having boldness before the Master, O father, Whose sufferings thou didst zealously emulate: by thy struggles entreat divine peace and tranquility for the faithful, O all-wise one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having boldness before the Master, O father, Whose sufferings thou didst zealously emulate: by thy struggles entreat divine peace and tranquility for the faithful, O all-wise one!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: И҆мѣ́ѧ ко вл҃цѣ дерзнове́нїе ѻ҆́ч҃е, * є҆гѡ́же и҆ стра̑сти ᲂу҆се́рднѡ поревнова́лъ є҆сѝ: * по́двиги твои́ми, вѣ́рнымъ бж҃е́ственный ми́ръ, * и҆ тишинꙋ̀ и҆спросѝ премꙋ́дре.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* First thou didst sacredly minister the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of the world; and afterwards, being slain, thou didst offer thyself unto Him as a spiritual and living sacrifice, O Father Methodius![^557]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
First thou didst sacredly minister the Lamb of God Who takes away the sins of the world; and afterwards, being slain, thou didst offer thyself unto Him as a spiritual and living sacrifice, O Father Methodius![^557]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пе́рвѣе сщ҃еннодѣ́йствовалъ є҆сѝ а҆́гнца бж҃їа, * грѣхѝ мі́ра взе́млющагѡ: * послѣди же закала́емь, * слове́сна и҆ жива̀ же́ртва семꙋ̀, * прине́слсѧ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е меѳо́дїе.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O pure Birthgiver of God, being the receptacle of the indestructible Light and temple of the divine radiance: enlighten my darkened soul with thy light, I beseech thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O pure Birthgiver of God, being the receptacle of the indestructible Light and temple of the divine radiance: enlighten my darkened soul with thy light, I beseech thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Чи́стаѧ бцⷣе, * мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ѡ҆мраче́ннꙋю, * прїѧ́телище сꙋ́щи неразори́магѡ свѣ́та, * и҆ хра́мъ бж҃твенныѧ зарѝ, * свѣ́томъ твои́мъ просвѣтѝ молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *Voyaging amid the tumult of the cares of life, sinking with the ship through sins, and cast before the soul-corrupting beast, as Jonah, O Christ, I cry aloud unto Thee: Lead me up from the death-bearing depths![^558]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*Voyaging amid the tumult of the cares of life, sinking with the ship through sins, and cast before the soul-corrupting beast, as Jonah, O Christ, I cry aloud unto Thee: Lead me up from the death-bearing depths![^558]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Пла́вающаго въ мо́лвѣ жите́йскихъ попече́нїй, * съ корабле́мъ потоплѧ́ема грѣхѝ, * и҆ дꙋшетлѣ́нномꙋ ѕвѣ́рю примета́ема, * ꙗ҆́кѡ їѡ́на хрⷭ҇тѐ вопїю́ ти: * и҆з̾ смертоно́сныѧ глꙋбины̀ возведи́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Slumber to thine eyelids and sleep to thine eyes thou didst not give, O most blessed one, until thou didst free thyself from all passions, and didst make thyself a spacious temple for the beam-shining lightning of the Spirit![^559]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Slumber to thine eyelids and sleep to thine eyes thou didst not give, O most blessed one, until thou didst free thyself from all passions, and didst make thyself a spacious temple for the beam-shining lightning of the Spirit![^559]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Дрема́нїа вѣ́ждамъ, и҆ ѻ҆чи́ма твои́ма сна̀, * пребл҃же́нне не да́лъ є҆сѝ: * до́ндеже всѣ́хъ страсте́й себѐ свободи́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ вмѣсти́теленъ хра́мъ содѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ * зарелꙋ́чнѣй мо́лнїи дх҃а.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Wholly united unto the divine and God-beholding radiance, O divinely wise one, thou wast a rule of the divine priesthood, and wast shown forth as an intercessor before God for the whole Church of the faithful, O Methodius!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Wholly united unto the divine and God-beholding radiance, O divinely wise one, thou wast a rule of the divine priesthood, and wast shown forth as an intercessor before God for the whole Church of the faithful, O Methodius!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь бж҃е́ственномꙋ и҆ бг҃ови́дномꙋ сїѧ́нїю, * бг҃омꙋ́дре соедини́лсѧ, * бж҃твеннагѡ сщ҃е́нства пра́вило бы́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ къ бг҃ꙋ хода́тай ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * все́й цр҃кви вѣ́рныхъ меѳо́дїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having joined the radiant revelation of beings unto a radiant life, O speaker of God, it showed Thee forth as a radiant luminary unto the world, driving away heretical mockery and the darkness of godlessness!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having joined the radiant revelation of beings unto a radiant life, O speaker of God, it showed Thee forth as a radiant luminary unto the world, driving away heretical mockery and the darkness of godlessness!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Къ свѣ́тломꙋ житїю̀, * свѣ́тлостное совокꙋпи́лсѧ сꙋ́щихъ ѿкрове́нїе бг҃оглаго́ливе: * свѣ́тлаго свѣти́льника мі́рꙋ тѧ̀ показа̀, * є҆рети́ческое глꙋмле́нїе, * и҆ безбо́жїа тмꙋ̀ ѿгонѧ́ща.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Knowing thee to be the Queen of all creatures, for thou didst bear God Who made all things out of nothing, O Mother of God: with the Angel Gabriel we cry a joyful song of praise unto thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Knowing thee to be the Queen of all creatures, for thou didst bear God Who made all things out of nothing, O Mother of God: with the Angel Gabriel we cry a joyful song of praise unto thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Цр҃и́цꙋ всѣ́хъ бы́вшихъ тѧ̀ вѣ́дѧще, * бг҃а бо родила̀ є҆сѝ бг҃ома́ти, * ѿ несу́щихъ всѧ̑ сотво́ршаго, * ра́достное пѣ́носло́вїе, * со а҆́гг҃ломъ гаврїи́ломъ тебѣ̀ зове́мъ.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 4:* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 4:*
*Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Вознесы́йсѧ: Сщ҃еннотаи́нникъ ст҃ы́ѧ тро́ицы, * и҆ ꙗ҆́же па́че ᲂу҆ма̀ повелѣ́нїй бж҃ественныхъ проповѣ́дникъ, * и҆ правосла́внымъ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе бы́лъ є҆сѝ меѳо́дїе, * ѕлосла́вныѧ ѡ҆бличи́лъ є҆сѝ смы́слы правовѣ́рїѧ ра́ди, * кро́вїю твое́ю сщ҃енномч҃никъ ꙗ҆вль́сѧ: * и҆ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ со а҆́гг҃лы предстоѧ̀, * молѝ спасти́сѧ на́мъ.
items.english_text: Thou wast a sacred initiate of the Holy Trinity, a preacher of the divine commands that surpass the mind, and an establishment for the Orthodox, O Methodius; for the sake of the right faith thou didst refute evil-minded notions, having been shown forth as a hieromartyr by thy blood: and standing before Christ with the Angels, pray that we be saved![^560]

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou wast a sacred initiate of the Holy Trinity, a preacher of the divine commands that surpass the mind, and an establishment for the Orthodox, O Methodius; for the sake of the right faith thou didst refute evil-minded notions, having been shown forth as a hieromartyr by thy blood: and standing before Christ with the Angels, pray that we be saved![^560]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Въ пе́щь ѻ҆́гненнꙋю вве́ржени прпⷣбнїи ѻ҆́троцы, * ѻ҆́гнь въ ро́сꙋ преложи́ша, * воспѣва́нїемъ си́це вопїю́ще: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *Cast into the fiery furnace, the venerable Children transformed the fire into dew, crying aloud in song thus: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers![^561]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*Cast into the fiery furnace, the venerable Children transformed the fire into dew, crying aloud in song thus: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers![^561]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь: Сщ҃е́нъ бг҃омꙋ́дре, и҆ мч҃никѡмъ и҆́стинны сїѧ́ѧ кро́вїю, * съ ни́ми пое́ши непреста́ннѡ: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Consecrated, O divinely wise one, and shining with the blood of martyrs of the truth, with them thou singest unceasingly: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Consecrated, O divinely wise one, and shining with the blood of martyrs of the truth, with them thou singest unceasingly: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Established in faith, thou didst extinguish the idolatrous flame by the streams of thy holy blood, O martyr, crying aloud thus: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers![^562]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Established in faith, thou didst extinguish the idolatrous flame by the streams of thy holy blood, O martyr, crying aloud thus: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers![^562]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆твержде́нъ вѣ́рою, * і҆́дѡльскїй ᲂу҆гаси́лъ є҆сѝ пла́мень, * то́ки ст҃ы́хъ крове́й твои́хъ мꙋ́нче, * си́це взыва́ѧ: * бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Revealed by the supreme divine vision, thou didst all-wisely clarify thine understanding, crying aloud with them that faithfully sing, O father: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Revealed by the supreme divine vision, thou didst all-wisely clarify thine understanding, crying aloud with them that faithfully sing, O father: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆вле́нъ бж҃твеннымъ видѣ́нїемъ превы́шнимъ, * ᲂу҆́мъ премꙋ́дрѡ ᲂу҆ѧсни́лъ є҆сѝ, * съ вѣ́рнѡ пою́щими ѻ҆́ч҃е взыва́ѧ: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With hymnody all creation glorifies thy childbearing, knowing Him indeed as God, and honorably worshiping Him it cries: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
With hymnody all creation glorifies thy childbearing, knowing Him indeed as God, and honorably worshiping Him it cries: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Пѣсносло́вїемъ сла́витъ твоѐ рождество̀ всѧ̀ тва́рь, * бг҃а ᲂу҆́бѡ вѣ́дѧщи, * и҆ че́стнѡ покланѧ́ющисѧ томꙋ̀ зове́тъ: * бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *The only unoriginate King of glory, Whom the heavenly powers bless and the ranks of Angels tremble before: praise Him, ye priests; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^563]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*The only unoriginate King of glory, Whom the heavenly powers bless and the ranks of Angels tremble before: praise Him, ye priests; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^563]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Є҆ди́наго безнача́лнаго цр҃ѧ̀ сла́вы, * є҆го́же бл҃гословѧ́тъ нбⷭ҇ныѧ си́лы, * и҆ трепе́щꙋтъ чи́ни а҆́гг҃лстїи, * по́йте сщ҃е́нницы, * лю́дїе превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As seeing the invisible One, the divinely wise one endured the wounds of the torturers, and was blessed with a crown, singing: Praise Him, ye priests; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^564]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
As seeing the invisible One, the divinely wise one endured the wounds of the torturers, and was blessed with a crown, singing: Praise Him, ye priests; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^564]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Ꙗ҆́кѡ неви́димаго ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѧ, * терпѧ́ше мꙋчи́телей ра̑ны бг҃омꙋ́дрый, * и҆ вѣнце́мъ ᲂу҆блаже́сѧ, поѧ̀: * по́йте сщ҃е́нницы, * лю́дїе превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Radiantly desiring the unshakable Kingdom of Christ, O hierarch, which was procured for thee by the straight path, crying unto Christ: Ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Radiantly desiring the unshakable Kingdom of Christ, O hierarch, which was procured for thee by the straight path, crying unto Christ: Ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Непрїе́млемое хрⷭ҇то́во црⷭ҇тво, * свѣ́тлѡ жела́ѧ ст҃ителю, * сїѐ тебѣ̀ и҆схода́таиствовавшꙋ пра́вою стезе́ю, * зовы́й хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀: * лю́дїе превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Christ granted thee a manifoldly multiplied reward for thy labors, O God-bearer, surpassing every thought, as thou piously singest: Supremely exalt His Kingdom unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Christ granted thee a manifoldly multiplied reward for thy labors, O God-bearer, surpassing every thought, as thou piously singest: Supremely exalt His Kingdom unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Многоᲂу҆гꙋ́бꙋ хрⷭ҇то́съ тебѣ̀ подадѐ, * твои̑мъ трꙋдѡ́мъ мзда̀ бг҃оно́се, * мы́сль преходѧ́щꙋю всѧ́кꙋ, * пою́щꙋ бл҃гоче́стнѡ, * тогѡ̀ црⷭ҇тво во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* We know thee to be an abyss of teachings, a tablet of instructions, a treasury of gracious contemplation, and a throne of the senses, as we piously sing: Supremely exalt Christ the King unto all ages![^565]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
We know thee to be an abyss of teachings, a tablet of instructions, a treasury of gracious contemplation, and a throne of the senses, as we piously sing: Supremely exalt Christ the King unto all ages![^565]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆че́нїй пꙋчи́нꙋ, * и҆ скрижа́ль наказа́нїй, * и҆ зрѣ́нїа благода́тнагѡ сокро́вище тѧ̀ зна́емъ, * и҆ чꙋ́вствъ престо́лъ: * пою́ще бл҃гоче́стнѡ, * хрⷭ҇та̀ цр҃ѧ̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As a servant, O all-immaculate one, I come unto thee in faith, who didst conceive the Master of all: save me now from persecutions and perils, as I piously hymn God Who became incarnate of thee, O Birthgiver of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
As a servant, O all-immaculate one, I come unto thee in faith, who didst conceive the Master of all: save me now from persecutions and perils, as I piously hymn God Who became incarnate of thee, O Birthgiver of God!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ра́бски пречⷭ҇таѧ тебѣ̀ прихождꙋ̀ вѣ́рою, * заче́ншаѧ всѣ́хъ вл҃кꙋ, * ны́нѣ спаси́ мѧ гоне́нїѧ и҆ бѣ́дъ, * пою́ща бл҃гоче́стнѡ, * бг҃а воплоще́ннаго и҆з̾ тебѐ бг҃ороди́тельнице.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *O Mother of God and Virgin, who gavest birth and yet remainest virgin: this is not a work of nature, but of divine condescension; therefore, as the only one accounted worthy of divine wonders, we unceasingly magnify thee![^566]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
*O Mother of God and Virgin, who gavest birth and yet remainest virgin: this is not a work of nature, but of divine condescension; therefore, as the only one accounted worthy of divine wonders, we unceasingly magnify thee![^566]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Ї҆рмо́съ: Мт҃и бж҃їа и҆ дв҃а, * ро́ждшаѧ и҆ дѣ́вствꙋющаѧ па́ки, * не є҆стества̀ дѣ́ло, * но бж҃їѧ снизхожде́нїѧ: * тѣ́мъ ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нꙋ, * бж҃їихъ чꙋде́съ сподо́бльшꙋюсѧ, * тѧ̀ при́снѡ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Pray ever unto Christ, O divinely blessed father, to halt the crafty plots of heresies against us, and drive away from our midst the present gloom: for as a powerful hierarch thou hast been an intercessor!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Pray ever unto Christ, O divinely blessed father, to halt the crafty plots of heresies against us, and drive away from our midst the present gloom: for as a powerful hierarch thou hast been an intercessor!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Всегда̀ хрⷭ҇та̀ молѝ бг҃обл҃же́нне ѻ҆́ч҃е, * є҆ресе́й ᲂу҆ста́вити є҆́же на ны̀ кова́рства, * и҆ ны́нѣшнїй мра́къ ѿ среды̀ ѿженѝ: * ꙗ҆́кѡ бо ст҃и́тель си́ленъ, * моли́твенникъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* From earth thou didst pass over unto the heavenly life, receiving the prize of thy ministry and suffering, where, having become a partaker of incorruptible life, thou wast accounted worthy to be with Christ forever![^567]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
From earth thou didst pass over unto the heavenly life, receiving the prize of thy ministry and suffering, where, having become a partaker of incorruptible life, thou wast accounted worthy to be with Christ forever![^567]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ѿ землѝ къ нбⷭ҇нѣй жи́зни преста́вилсѧ є҆сѝ, * слꙋже́нїа твоегѡ̀ по́честь прїе́мъ и҆ страда́нїѧ, * и҆дѣ́же жи́зни нетлѣ́нныѧ прича́стникъ бы́въ, * вѣ́чнѡ бы́ти со хрⷭ҇то́мъ сподо́билсѧ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst find the fruit of the tree of life O most blessed one, having gained the Author of immortal life for men; richly enjoying Whose joy, pray thou for them that hymn thee in faith![^568]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst find the fruit of the tree of life...
...O most blessed one, having gained the Author of immortal life for men; richly enjoying Whose joy, pray thou for them that hymn thee in faith![^568]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: пребл҃же́нне жи́зни, * чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ первонача́лника прїѡбрѣ́тъ. * є҆гѡ́же ра́дости наслажда́ѧсѧ бога́тнѡ, * ѡ҆ пою́щихъ тѧ̀ вѣ́рою, моли́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Stretching forth thine entire mind through the goodness of life, O venerable one, thou wast accounted worthy of the vision of Christ and of fair gladness, as a hieromartyr, an expounder of piety, and its champion!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Stretching forth thine entire mind through the goodness of life, O venerable one, thou wast accounted worthy of the vision of Christ and of fair gladness, as a hieromartyr, an expounder of piety, and its champion!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 20th Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь ᲂу҆́мъ простира́ѧ прпⷣбне бл҃гостїю житїѧ̀, * хрⷭ҇това зрѣ́нїѧ и҆ кра́снагѡ весе́лїѧ сподо́билсѧ є҆сѝ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ сщ҃енномꙋ́ченикъ, * и҆ сказа́тель бл҃гоче́стїѧ, и҆ побо́рникъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We call thee the Ark of the New Law and the God-inscribed tablet, wherein the Word of God was written, having become man in order to save the world from deceit, O thou who art full of grace, all-hymned Birthgiver of God![^569]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
We call thee the Ark of the New Law and the God-inscribed tablet, wherein the Word of God was written, having become man in order to save the world from deceit, O thou who art full of grace, all-hymned Birthgiver of God![^569]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бїе́нъ ра́нами, * и҆ лю́тѣ пора́влємъ, * и҆ въ темни́цѣ бл҃же́нне затво́рѧемь, * мѣ́ста премѣнѧ́ѧ ѡ҆скорблѧ́емь, * со ѕвѣрьмѝ заключа́емь, * и҆ глꙋбинѣ̀ приближа́ѧсѧ, * и҆ въ мо́ри потоплѧ́емь, * и҆ прїе́млѧ бл҃же́нную кончи́нꙋ, * не ѿве́рглсѧ є҆сѝ вл҃ки вл҃дческыхъ, * сла́ва мꙋ́нкѡвъ пребога́те.
items.english_text: *Stichera, Tone 4.*

provenance.verbatim_source: *Stichera, Tone 4.*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, в҃. Непоро́чныѧ вѣ́ры неистоща́емое питїе́ почерпъ бл҃же́не, * і҆́дѡльское слꙋже́нїе погаси́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ побѣди́телно преше́лъ є҆сѝ по́двигъ, * росо́ю просвѣти́всѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ незаходи́ма ѕвѣзда̀, * ѡ҆зарѧ́емь присносїѧ́ннаго сл҃нца хрⷭ҇та̀. * и҆ на кі́йждо гра́дъ зарѝ мꙋче́нїа ѿпꙋща́ѧ, * кончи́нꙋ мо́ремъ бл҃же́ннꙋю
items.english_text: Perceiving thee, O blessed martyr Julian, as a light-bearing sun illuminating the fullness of the world with noetic splendors and dispelling the night of godlessness: we celebrate thy light-bearing and divine memory, and we venerate the shrine of thy relics, drawing forth health for our souls![^571]

provenance.verbatim_source: Perceiving thee, O blessed martyr Julian, as a light-bearing sun illuminating the fullness of the world with noetic splendors and dispelling the night of godlessness: we celebrate thy light-bearing and divine memory, and we venerate the shrine of thy relics, drawing forth health for our souls![^571]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, в҃. Непоро́чныѧ вѣ́ры неистоща́емое питїе́ почерпъ бл҃же́не, * і҆́дѡльское слꙋже́нїе погаси́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ побѣди́телно преше́лъ є҆сѝ по́двигъ, * росо́ю просвѣти́всѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ незаходи́ма ѕвѣзда̀, * ѡ҆зарѧ́емь присносїѧ́ннаго сл҃нца хрⷭ҇та̀. * и҆ на кі́йждо гра́дъ зарѝ мꙋче́нїа ѿпꙋща́ѧ, * кончи́нꙋ мо́ремъ бл҃же́ннꙋю
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Beaten with stripes, grievously torn, shut up in prison, O blessed one, afflicted as thou wast dragged from place to place, enclosed with wild beasts, brought near unto the abyss and drowned in the sea, and receiving a blessed end: thou didst not deny the Master of masters, O glory of martyrs, most wealthy one![^572]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Beaten with stripes, grievously torn, shut up in prison, O blessed one, afflicted as thou wast dragged from place to place, enclosed with wild beasts, brought near unto the abyss and drowned in the sea, and receiving a blessed end: thou didst not deny the Master of masters, O glory of martyrs, most wealthy one![^572]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, в҃. Непоро́чныѧ вѣ́ры неистоща́емое питїе́ почерпъ бл҃же́не, * і҆́дѡльское слꙋже́нїе погаси́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ побѣди́телно преше́лъ є҆сѝ по́двигъ, * росо́ю просвѣти́всѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ незаходи́ма ѕвѣзда̀, * ѡ҆зарѧ́емь присносїѧ́ннаго сл҃нца хрⷭ҇та̀. * и҆ на кі́йждо гра́дъ зарѝ мꙋче́нїа ѿпꙋща́ѧ, * кончи́нꙋ мо́ремъ бл҃же́ннꙋю
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* When a venerable woman, guided by the Spirit, beheld thee being drawn forth from the bosom of the sea, she faithfully received thee, O Martyr Julian, and gave over unto burial thy blameless and much-suffering body, which had conquered the devil's tyranny by the operation of grace![^573]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
When a venerable woman, guided by the Spirit, beheld thee being drawn forth from the bosom of the sea, she faithfully received thee, O Martyr Julian, and gave over unto burial thy blameless and much-suffering body, which had conquered the devil's tyranny by the operation of grace![^573]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, в҃. Непоро́чныѧ вѣ́ры неистоща́емое питїе́ почерпъ бл҃же́не, * і҆́дѡльское слꙋже́нїе погаси́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ побѣди́телно преше́лъ є҆сѝ по́двигъ, * росо́ю просвѣти́всѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ незаходи́ма ѕвѣзда̀, * ѡ҆зарѧ́емь присносїѧ́ннаго сл҃нца хрⷭ҇та̀. * и҆ на кі́йждо гра́дъ зарѝ мꙋче́нїа ѿпꙋща́ѧ, * кончи́нꙋ мо́ремъ бл҃же́ннꙋю
items.english_text: Having drawn forth the inexhaustible drink of blameless faith, O blessed one, thou didst extinguish the service of idols, and victoriously didst accomplish thy contest; being enlightened by the dew as an unsetting star, illumined by the ever-shining Sun, Christ; and sending forth upon each city the rays of thy martyrdom, a blessed end by the sea thou didst receive, and as a crown-bearer thou didst outrun [all] before the face of Christ; Whom entreat, O most glorious Julian, that they who accomplish thy memory in faith may be saved![^574]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having drawn forth the inexhaustible drink of blameless faith, O blessed one, thou didst extinguish the service of idols, and victoriously didst accomplish thy contest; being enlightened by the dew as an unsetting star, illumined by the ever-shining Sun, Christ; and sending forth upon each city the rays of thy martyrdom, a blessed end by the sea...

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ ѻ҆ктѡ́иха. Сла́ва, гла́съ, ѕ҃. Прїиди́те мꙋчениколю́бцы, * хрⷭ҇то́ва страстоте́рпца, * и҆ па́ѵлꙋ сограждани́на, * и҆ ста́нника ꙗ҆́вльшасѧ, * и҆ вкꙋ́пѣ тече́нїе соверши́вша, * бл҃гоче́стнѡ просла́вимъ, * і҆ꙋлїа́на сла́внаго: * въ ко́дꙋ бо вше́дъ, съ водны́ми ѕвѣ́рьми, * ѕмі́евꙋ главꙋ̀ сокрꙋшѝ, * и҆ кровмѝ зе́млю, * и҆ ше́ствїемъ мо́ре ѡ҆свѧти́въ, * ѿ сꙋ́щихъ здѣ̀, преста́висѧ къ вѣ́чнымъ жили́щемъ, * и҆ ѿ вседержи́тельныѧ рꙋкѝ, подвигѡ́въ по́честь прїѧ́тъ, * про́ситъ ѡ҆чище́нїа дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ, * и҆ ве́лїѧ мл҃ти.
items.english_text: When the unblemished Ewe-lamb of old, the all-pure Lady, beheld her Lamb upon the Tree of the Cross, maternally crying aloud and marveling, she cried: O sweetest Child, what is this new and most glorious sight? How hath the ungrateful assembly delivered Thee unto Pilate's tribunal, and condemns unto death the Life of all? Yet I hymn Thine ineffable condescension, O Word![^575]

provenance.verbatim_source: When the unblemished Ewe-lamb of old, the all-pure Lady, beheld her Lamb upon the Tree of the Cross, maternally crying aloud and marveling, she cried: O sweetest Child, what is this new and most glorious sight? How hath the ungrateful assembly delivered Thee unto Pilate's tribunal, and condemns unto death the Life of all? Yet I hymn Thine ineffable condescension, O Word![^575]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, творе́нїе їѡа́нна мона́ха. Є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Ї҆ꙋлїа́на пѣ́сньми мꙋ́ченика вѣнча́ю. Гла́съ, д҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. Їрмо́съ: Ѡ҆́номꙋ бг҃ꙋ, * прове́дшемꙋ лю́ди своѧ̑ сквозѣ̀ че́рмное мо́ре, * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ, * сла́внѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: Come, ye lovers of the martyrs, let us piously glorify Christ's passion-bearer, who was shown forth as a fellow citizen with Paul, an inmate with him, and who finished the course together with him, the glorious Julian; for entering into the sack with the beasts of the water, he shattered the serpent's head; and having sanctified the earth with his blood, and the sea by his traversing, he passed over from the things here unto the eternal mansions, and received from the Almighty hand the prize of his struggles: he asks cleansing for our souls, and great mercy![^576]

provenance.verbatim_source: Come, ye lovers of the martyrs, let us piously glorify Christ's passion-bearer, who was shown forth as a fellow citizen with Paul, an inmate with him, and who finished the course together with him, the glorious Julian; for entering into the sack with the beasts of the water, he shattered the serpent's head; and having sanctified the earth with his blood, and the sea by his traversing, he passed over from the things here unto the eternal mansions, and received from the Almighty hand the prize of his struggles: he asks cleansing for our souls, and great mercy![^576]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Сщ҃е́нными да восхва́литсѧ пѣ́сньми, * страда́лецъ тво́й сла́вный, * и҆ пречестна́ѧ па́мѧть: * непристꙋ́пною бо сла́вою просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* *Tone 6, Podoben: "Having risen on the third day" (Трїдне́венъ):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
*Tone 6, Podoben: "Having risen on the third day" (Трїдне́венъ):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Поползне́нїемъ не па́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * подвиза́ѧсѧ мꙋ́ченически хрⷭ҇то́въ во́ине, * не́мощїю пло́ти да́же до кро́ве, * па́че
items.english_text: Standing of old by the Tree at the time of the Crucifixion, the Virgin, with the virgin disciple, weeping cried aloud: Woe is me! How dost Thou suffer, O Christ, Who art the impassibility of all?[^577]

provenance.verbatim_source: Standing of old by the Tree at the time of the Crucifixion, the Virgin, with the virgin disciple, weeping cried aloud: Woe is me! How dost Thou suffer, O Christ, Who art the impassibility of all?[^577]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Поползне́нїемъ не па́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * подвиза́ѧсѧ мꙋ́ченически хрⷭ҇то́въ во́ине, * не́мощїю пло́ти да́же до кро́ве, * па́че
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Thy martyr, O Lord, Julian, in his suffering received an incorruptible crown from Thee, our God; for possessing Thy strength, he cast down the tyrants and shattered the powerless insolence of demons: by his supplications, save our souls![^578]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion, Tone 4:*
Thy martyr, O Lord, Julian, in his suffering received an incorruptible crown from Thee, our God; for possessing Thy strength, he cast down the tyrants and shattered the powerless insolence of demons: by his supplications, save our souls![^578]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Поползне́нїемъ не па́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * подвиза́ѧсѧ мꙋ́ченически хрⷭ҇то́въ во́ине, * не́мощїю пло́ти да́же до кро́ве, * па́че
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* *Unto that God, Who led His people through the Red Sea, as the only One, let us sing, for He hath been gloriously glorified![^579]*

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Troparion:* With sacred songs let thy glorious sufferer and thy most honorable memory be praised: for with unapproachable glory hath he been glorified!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With sacred songs let thy glorious sufferer and thy most honorable memory be praised: for with unapproachable glory hath he been glorified!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Поползне́нїемъ не па́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * подвиза́ѧсѧ мꙋ́ченически хрⷭ҇то́въ во́ине, * не́мощїю пло́ти да́же до кро́ве, * па́че
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By stumbling thou didst not fall, striving as a martyr, O soldier of Christ, in the weakness of the flesh even unto blood more than the radiance of gold, thou wast adorned and didst shine forth with martyr's wounds, and with precious stone, O holy one![^580]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By stumbling thou didst not fall, striving as a martyr, O soldier of Christ, in the weakness of the flesh even unto blood...
...more than the radiance of gold, thou wast adorned and didst shine forth with martyr's wounds, and with precious stone, O holy one![^580]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: сїѧ́нїа зла́та, * мч҃нкими ра́нами ᲂу҆краси́лсѧ є҆сѝ ѡ҆блиста́ѧсѧ, * и҆ многоцѣ́ннагѡ ка́мене ст҃ый.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O pure Birthgiver of God, who above nature gavest birth unto the incarnate, ever-existing, and pre-eternal Word: we hymn thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O pure Birthgiver of God, who above nature gavest birth unto the incarnate, ever-existing, and pre-eternal Word: we hymn thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Чи́стаѧ бцⷣе, * ꙗ҆́же воплоще́нное присносꙋ́щное, * и҆ пре́ждеєсте́ственное сло́во, * па́че є҆стества̀ ро́ждши, * пое́мъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *Thou art the establishment of them that run unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit hymns Thee![^581]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
*Thou art the establishment of them that run unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit hymns Thee![^581]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Їрмо́съ: Ты̀ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе притека́ющихъ къ тебѣ̀ гдⷭ҇и, * ты̀ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ ѡ҆мраче́нныхъ, * и҆ пое́тъ тѧ̀ дꙋ́хъ мо́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* It was not commanded me to serve stones, the works of hands, as God: Julian answered the mind-damaged judge!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
It was not commanded me to serve stones, the works of hands, as God: Julian answered the mind-damaged judge!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Ка́менїю не повелѣ́но мѝ бы́сть, * ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ꙋ слꙋжи́ти, * рꙋчны́хъ дѣ́лъ: * і҆ꙋлїа́нъ ᲂу҆мовре́дномꙋ сꙋдїѝ ѿвѣщава́ше.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst stand before the tribunal of the tyrant, O martyr Julian, standing before Christ as the Judge of the living and the dead!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst stand before the tribunal of the tyrant, O martyr Julian, standing before Christ as the Judge of the living and the dead!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Стоѧ́лъ є҆сѝ пред̾ сꙋди́щемъ мꙋчи́телѧ, * хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ мꙋ́нче і҆ꙋлїа́не, * ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋдїѝ живы́хъ и҆ ме́ртвыхъ предстоѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I was not senseless in confessing God, said Julian, Who is one in Trinity, indivisibly hymned!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
I was not senseless in confessing God, said Julian, Who is one in Trinity, indivisibly hymned!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Безꙋ́менъ не бы́хъ и҆сповѣ́даѧ бг҃а, * речѐ і҆ꙋлїа́нъ, * є҆ди́наго въ трⷪ҇цѣ, * нераздѣ́лнѡ пѣва́ема.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Grant us help through thy prayers, O all-pure one, driving away the assaults of grievous tribulations!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Grant us help through thy prayers, O all-pure one, driving away the assaults of grievous tribulations!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Да́ждь на́мъ по́мощь моли́твами пречⷭ҇таѧ, * прило́ги ѿрѣва́ющи, * лю́тыхъ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїй.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:* *Tone 4, Podoben: "While the soldiers were guarding Thy tomb" (Гро́бъ тво́й):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:*
*Tone 4, Podoben: "While the soldiers were guarding Thy tomb" (Гро́бъ тво́й):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Гро́бъ тво́й: Во́дъ потопле́нїемъ, * бл҃же́ннꙋю кончи́нꙋ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ мꙋ́дре, * многоѻбра́знаго ѕмі́а въ си́хъ ᲂу҆дави́въ * побѣ́дꙋ взѧ́лъ є҆сѝ. * тѣ́мже любо́вїю твою̀ достохва́льнꙋю па́мѧть пра́зднꙋюще, * ѡ҆ на́съ молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀, мо́лимсѧ.
items.english_text: By the drowning of the waters thou didst receive a blessed end, O wise one, having suffocated the multifaceted serpent in them, thou didst take the victory; therefore celebrating with love thy praiseworthy memory, we pray: entreat Christ for us, we beseech thee![^582]

provenance.verbatim_source: By the drowning of the waters thou didst receive a blessed end, O wise one, having suffocated the multifaceted serpent in them, thou didst take the victory; therefore celebrating with love thy praiseworthy memory, we pray: entreat Christ for us, we beseech thee![^582]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Зрѧ́щи тѧ̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ всенепоро́чнаѧ мт҃и, * ме́ртва на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ просте́рта, вопїѧ́ше: * сн҃е мо́й собезнача́льне ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ дх҃ꙋ, * что̀ неизрече́нное твоѐ сїѐ смотре́нїе? * и҆́мже спа́слъ є҆сѝ, * пречⷭ҇тыхъ рꙋ́къ твои́хъ ще́дре созда́нїе.
items.english_text: Guide us into the path of repentance, who have ever turned aside unto paths of evil, and have provoked the most good Lord to anger, O unwedded, blessed Mary, refuge of despairing men, dwelling-place of God!

provenance.verbatim_source: Guide us into the path of repentance, who have ever turned aside unto paths of evil, and have provoked the most good Lord to anger, O unwedded, blessed Mary, refuge of despairing men, dwelling-place of God!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Їрмо́съ: Оу҆слы́шахъ гдⷭ҇и смотре́нїа твоегѡ̀ та́инство, * разꙋмѣ́хъ дѣла̀ твоѧ̑, * и҆ просла́вихъ твоѐ бж҃тво̀.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee dead, stretched out upon the Cross, O Christ, Thine all-unblemished Mother cried aloud: O my Son, co-unoriginate with the Father and the Spirit, what is this Thine ineffable dispensation, whereby Thou hast saved the creation of Thine all-pure hands, O Tender-hearted One?[^583]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
Beholding Thee dead, stretched out upon the Cross, O Christ, Thine all-unblemished Mother cried aloud: O my Son, co-unoriginate with the Father and the Spirit, what is this Thine ineffable dispensation, whereby Thou hast saved the creation of Thine all-pure hands, O Tender-hearted One?[^583]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Многоѡбра́знымъ ра́намъ і҆ꙋлїа́нъ тѣ́ло предаѧ́ше, * не чꙋ́вствова болѣ́зней, * хрⷭ҇то́вою бо любо́вїю сохранѧ́шесѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation, I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Godhead![^584]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*I have heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation, I have understood Thy works, and I have glorified Thy Godhead![^584]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ны́нѧ пресла́вне і҆ꙋлїа́не хлами́ды жела́ѧ, * гони́телемъ земнꙋ́ю, * ꙗ҆́кѡ хрⷭ҇то́въ ᲂу҆го́дникъ ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Julian surrendered his body unto manifold wounds, yet felt not the pains, for he was preserved by Christ's love!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Julian surrendered his body unto manifold wounds, yet felt not the pains, for he was preserved by Christ's love!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Побѣди́телѧ демо́нскїѧ ле́сти, * не тѣле́снаѧ си́ла пребога́те, * но жела́нїе непобѣди́мое, * хрⷭ҇товыхъ страсте́й тѧ̀ содѣ́ла.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring the heavenly robe, O most glorious Julian, thou didst leave the earthly one unto the persecutors, as a pleasing servant of Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Desiring the heavenly robe, O most glorious Julian, thou didst leave the earthly one unto the persecutors, as a pleasing servant of Christ!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ѡ҆чище́нїе
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Not bodily strength, O most wealthy one, but unconquerable longing for Christ's passions made Thee a vanquisher of demonic deceit!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Not bodily strength, O most wealthy one, but unconquerable longing for Christ's passions made Thee a vanquisher of demonic deceit!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: на́шымъ да́рꙋй невѣ́дѣнїємъ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ безгрѣ́шенъ: * и҆ ᲂу҆мирѝ мі́ръ тво́й бж҃е, * мл҃твами ро́ждшїѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* ...Grant cleansing unto our negligences, as Thou art without sin, and pacify Thy world, O God, through the prayers of her that bare Thee![^585]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
...Grant cleansing unto our negligences, as Thou art without sin, and pacify Thy world, O God, through the prayers of her that bare Thee![^585]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Їрмо́съ: Оу҆́тренююще вопїе́мъ тѝ гдⷭ҇и, * спаси́ ны: * ты́ бо є҆сѝ бг҃ъ на́шъ, * ра́звѣ тебѐ и҆но́гѡ не вѣ́мы.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *Rising early, we cry unto Thee, O Lord, save us: for Thou art our God, and beside Thee we know no other![^586]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*Rising early, we cry unto Thee, O Lord, save us: for Thou art our God, and beside Thee we know no other![^586]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Подоба́сѧ въ все́мъ вл҃цѣ, прехва́льне, * ста́лъ є҆сѝ пред̾ сꙋди́щемъ * беззако́ннꙋющихъ ѡ҆сꙋжда́емь.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Conforming thyself in all things unto the Master, O all-lauded one, thou didst stand before the tribunal of the lawless, being condemned!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Conforming thyself in all things unto the Master, O all-lauded one, thou didst stand before the tribunal of the lawless, being condemned!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Зако́ннѡ подвиза́всѧ, * закала́лсѧ є҆сѝ бл҃цѣ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гнѧ неѕло́биво, * рꙋка́ми беззако́нныхъ бл҃же́нне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having striven lawfully, thou wast slaughtered for the Master like an innocent lamb, by the hands of the lawless, O blessed one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having striven lawfully, thou wast slaughtered for the Master like an innocent lamb, by the hands of the lawless, O blessed one!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ни ро́дъ, ни са́нъ земны́й, вмѣни́лъ є҆сѝ, * проти́вꙋ твоемꙋ̀ мꙋ́нче сла́вне * хрⷭ҇тоимени́тствꙋ превы́шши.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Neither earthly lineage nor rank didst thou esteem higher than thy Christ-bearing name, O glorious martyr!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Neither earthly lineage nor rank didst thou esteem higher than thy Christ-bearing name, O glorious martyr!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Мр҃і́е бцⷣе безневѣ́стнаѧ, * ᲂу҆пова́нїе врагѡ́въ тщетно сотворѝ, * пою́щымъ же тѧ̀ возвеселѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Mary, unwedded Birthgiver of God, make vain the hope of enemies, and make glad them that hymn thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O Mary, unwedded Birthgiver of God, make vain the hope of enemies, and make glad them that hymn thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Їрмо́съ: Ри́зꙋ мнѣ̀ пода́ждь свѣ́тлꙋ, * ѡ҆дѣѧ́йсѧ свѣ́томъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ри́зою, * многоми́лостиве хрⷭ҇тѐ бж҃е на́шъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *Grant me a radiant robe, O Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, O plenteous in mercy, Christ our God![^587]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*Grant me a radiant robe, O Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, O plenteous in mercy, Christ our God![^587]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Ко дре́вꙋ пригвожде́на тѧ̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ, * сла́вный ᲂу҆го́дникъ тво́й не стыда́шесѧ, * но ꙗ҆́кѡ сла́вы сокро́вище непщева́ше.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thine illustrious servant was not ashamed of Thee nailed unto the Tree, O Christ, but accounted it a treasure of glory!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thine illustrious servant was not ashamed of Thee nailed unto the Tree, O Christ, but accounted it a treasure of glory!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆молко́ша пре́лести скве́рнаѧ, * бг҃огла́сными же ѧ҆зы́ки, * бж҃е́ственнаѧ та́инства, * мꙋ́ченикъ хрⷭ҇то́выхъ ᲂу҆краси́шасѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The defilements of deceit were silenced, and by God-proclaiming tongues the divine mysteries of Christ's martyrs were adorned!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The defilements of deceit were silenced, and by God-proclaiming tongues the divine mysteries of Christ's martyrs were adorned!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́нїа страсте́й всѧ́ческихъ, * и҆ согрѣше́нїй просѝ ѡ҆ставле́нїе сла́вне, * страда́лче хрⷭ҇то́въ пою́щымъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ask healing of all passions and remission of transgressions, O glorious sufferer of Christ, for them that hymn Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Ask healing of all passions and remission of transgressions, O glorious sufferer of Christ, for them that hymn Thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Принесѝ мольбꙋ̀ на́шꙋ, * сн҃ꙋ твое́мꙋ пречⷭ҇таѧ: * ты́ бо є҆сѝ похвала̀ ро́да на́шегѡ и҆ застꙋпле́нїе.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Offer our supplication unto thy Son, O all-pure one: for thou art the praise and protection of our race!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Offer our supplication unto thy Son, O all-pure one: for thou art the praise and protection of our race!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, в҃. Подо́бенъ: Въ мл҃твахъ: Бл҃гоче́стїа непобѣди́маго во́ина, * и҆ и҆́стинны согла́сника и҆ ѻ҆рꙋ́жника, * всѝ досто́йнѡ восхва́лимъ і҆ꙋлїа́на дне́сь, * и҆ къ немꙋ̀ возопїи́мъ: * молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "In prayer" (Въ мл҃твахъ):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 2:*
*Tone 2, Podoben: "In prayer" (Въ мл҃твахъ):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ї҆́косъ: Пꙋте́мъ гдⷭ҇нимъ ѿ младе́нства ше́ствовалъ є҆сѝ требл҃же́нне, * и҆ тогѡ̀ бл҃гоче́стнѡ свидѣ́нїа вожделѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ крⷭ҇тъ на ра́мо і҆ꙋлїа́не бг҃омꙋ́дре ᲂу҆се́рднѡ взе́мъ, * ле́сть лю́тꙋю і҆́дѡлонеисто́вства разори́лъ є҆сѝ, * сокрꙋши́въ ка́пища вра́жїа, * кѡ́зни же и҆ ласка̑нїа. * тѣ́мже вѣ́рою притека́емъ къ твое́мꙋ покро́вꙋ, * вопїю́ще пребога́те: * молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_text: An unconquerable soldier of piety, and a harmonizer and armor-bearer of truth, let us all worthily praise Julian today, and cry out unto him: Pray unto Christ God for us all![^588]

provenance.verbatim_source: An unconquerable soldier of piety, and a harmonizer and armor-bearer of truth, let us all worthily praise Julian today, and cry out unto him: Pray unto Christ God for us all![^588]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Їрмо́съ: О҆́троцы є҆вре́йстїи въ пещѝ, * попра́ша пла́мень дерзнове́ннѡ, * и҆ на ро́сꙋ ѻ҆́гнь преложи́ша, вопїю́ще: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ikos:* In the path of the Lord didst thou walk from infancy, O thrice-blessed one, and didst piously desire His testimonies; and having taken the Cross upon thy shoulder with zeal, O God-wise Julian, thou didst destroy the cruel deceit of idol-frenzy, shattering the temples of the enemy, and their snares and flatteries: therefore with faith we run unto thy protection, crying aloud, O most wealthy one: Pray unto Christ God for us all![^589]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ikos:*
In the path of the Lord didst thou walk from infancy, O thrice-blessed one, and didst piously desire His testimonies; and having taken the Cross upon thy shoulder with zeal, O God-wise Julian, thou didst destroy the cruel deceit of idol-frenzy, shattering the temples of the enemy, and their snares and flatteries: therefore with faith we run unto thy protection, crying aloud, O most wealthy one: Pray unto Christ God for us all![^589]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Їрмо́съ: О҆́троцы є҆вре́йстїи въ пещѝ, * попра́ша пла́мень дерзнове́ннѡ, * и҆ на ро́сꙋ ѻ҆́гнь преложи́ша, вопїю́ще: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *The Hebrew children in the furnace boldly trampled down the flame, and changed the fire into dew, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages![^590]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*The Hebrew children in the furnace boldly trampled down the flame, and changed the fire into dew, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages![^590]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Мѵ́ро бл҃гово́нно и҆ска́плетъ, * хва́льнаѧ и҆ сла́внаѧ твоѧ̀ па́мѧть, во́ине хрⷭ҇то́въ, * пою́щымъ непреста́ннѡ: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Sweet-smelling myrrh drops forth from thy praiseworthy and glorious memory, O soldier of Christ, unto them that unceasingly sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages![^591]

provenance.verbatim_source: Sweet-smelling myrrh drops forth from thy praiseworthy and glorious memory, O soldier of Christ, unto them that unceasingly sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages![^591]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Неизглаго́ланнаѧ сла́ва вѣнчава́етъ, * и҆̀же къ хвалѣ̀ твое́й со́бранныхъ, во́ине хрⷭ҇то́въ, * пою́щымъ непреста́ннѡ: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ineffable glory crowns them that are gathered unto thy praise, O soldier of Christ, who unceasingly sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Ineffable glory crowns them that are gathered unto thy praise, O soldier of Christ, who unceasingly sing: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Гл҃ꙋ мꙋчи́телѧ не повинꙋ́всѧ, * не послꙋжи́лъ є҆сѝ непобѣди́ме тва́ри. * но є҆ди́номꙋ бг҃ꙋ живꙋ̀ вопїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Not obeying the word of the torturer, thou didst not serve creation, O unconquerable one; but unto the one living God didst thou cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Not obeying the word of the torturer, thou didst not serve creation, O unconquerable one; but unto the one living God didst thou cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Разрѣши́ла є҆́ѵинꙋ кла́твꙋ, * въ пренепоро́чнꙋю всели́всѧ дв҃ꙋ, * бл҃гослове́нїа и҆сто́чникъ прозѧ́блъ вопїю́щымъ: * бл҃гослове́нъ вл҃чце пло́дъ твоегѡ̀ чре́ва.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst loose Eve's curse, having taken up Thy dwelling in the all-unblemished Virgin, O Spring of blessing, who didst bud forth unto them that cry: Blessed is the fruit of thy womb, O Lady![^592]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thou didst loose Eve's curse, having taken up Thy dwelling in the all-unblemished Virgin, O Spring of blessing, who didst bud forth unto them that cry: Blessed is the fruit of thy womb, O Lady![^592]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Їрмо́съ: Мꙋсікі́йскимъ ѻ҆рга́нѡмъ согласꙋ́ющымъ, * и҆ лю́демъ безчи́сленнымъ покланѧ́ющымсѧ, * ѻ҆́бразꙋ въ деи́рѣ, * трїѐ ѻ҆́троцы не повино́вшесѧ, * гдⷭ҇а воспѣва́хꙋ, * и҆ славосло́влѧхꙋ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *When the musical instruments sounded in harmony, and innumerable people bowed down unto the image in Dura, the three children, not obeying, hymned and glorified the Lord unto all ages![^593]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*When the musical instruments sounded in harmony, and innumerable people bowed down unto the image in Dura, the three children, not obeying, hymned and glorified the Lord unto all ages![^593]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ласка́ше ᲂу҆́бѡ ле́стецъ, * и҆ мꙋ́ками тѧ̀ призыва́ше къ пре́лести і҆ꙋлїа́не. * ты́ же вопїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ: * гдⷭ҇а по́йте, * и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The deceiver indeed flattered thee, and summoned thee by torments unto deceit, O Julian; but thou didst cry aloud: Sing unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The deceiver indeed flattered thee, and summoned thee by torments unto deceit, O Julian; but thou didst cry aloud: Sing unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Крѣпча́йше ꙗ҆́коже ле́въ, * по мꙋ́кахъ мꙋчи́телѧ низлага́ѧ і҆ꙋлїа́не, * взыва́ѧ весе́лѡ: * гдⷭ҇а по́йте, * и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* More mighty like a lion after torments, casting down the torturer, O Julian, thou didst cry out joyfully: Sing unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
More mighty like a lion after torments, casting down the torturer, O Julian, thou didst cry out joyfully: Sing unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Лю́тость ѻ҆гнѧ̀ не ѿлꙋчи́тъ мѧ̀, * ни сѣче́нїе меча̀ ѿто́ргнетъ ѿ содѣ́телѧ бг҃а, * вопїѧ́ше взыва́ѧ: * гдⷭ҇а по́йте, * и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The fury of the fire shall not separate me, nor shall the cutting of the sword tear me away from God the Creator! He cried, exclaiming: Sing unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^594]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The fury of the fire shall not separate me, nor shall the cutting of the sword tear me away from God the Creator! He cried, exclaiming: Sing unto the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^594]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ всѣ́хъ гдⷭ҇а ро́ждшꙋю, * и҆ дв҃ꙋ пребы́вшꙋю мр҃і́е и҆ по ржⷭ҇твѣ̀, * вѣ́рнїи досто́йнѡ воспѣва́юще: * ра́дꙋйсѧ тебѣ̀ вопїе́мъ, * и҆ превозно́симъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As her that bare the Lord of all, and who remained a virgin after childbearing, O Mary, the faithful worthily hymn: Rejoice! we cry unto thee, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
As her that bare the Lord of all, and who remained a virgin after childbearing, O Mary, the faithful worthily hymn: Rejoice! we cry unto thee, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Їрмо́съ: Чи́стꙋю сла́внѡ почти́мъ, * лю́дїе бцⷣꙋ, * ѻ҆́гнь бж҃ества̀ прїи́мшꙋю во чре́вѣ неѡпа́льнѡ, * пѣ́сньми велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *Let us people gloriously honor the pure Birthgiver of God, who received the fire of the Godhead in her womb without being consumed: let us magnify her with songs![^595]*

provenance.verbatim_source:

*Let us people gloriously honor the pure Birthgiver of God, who received the fire of the Godhead in her womb without being consumed: let us magnify her with songs![^595]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пре́взѧтое ѻ҆́ко низложи́лъ є҆сѝ бж҃їй во́ине, * безпло́тнаго лестца̀, * бра́вся съ пло́тїю мꙋ́жески: * хрⷭ҇та̀ же велича́ѧ при́снѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst cast down the haughty eye, O soldier of God, struggling manfully in the flesh against the bodiless deceiver, and ever magnifying Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Гнѣ́въ и҆збѣжа́лъ є҆сѝ ѕмі́а, * врага̀ ѕлонача́лника, * въ морскїѧ бл҃же́нне глꙋбины̀ вве́рженъ мꙋ́дре. * тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ пѣ́сньми велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst escape the wrath of the serpent, the author of evil, being cast into the depths of the sea, O blessed and wise one; therefore do we magnify thee with songs!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst escape the wrath of the serpent, the author of evil, being cast into the depths of the sea, O blessed and wise one; therefore do we magnify thee with songs!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́брѣ страда́ньми подвиза́лсѧ є҆сѝ по вл҃цѣ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ кра́снѡ вѣнча́лсѧ є҆сѝ десни́цею вл҃ки. * тѣ́мже тѧ̀ досто́йнѡ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As thou didst strive well through sufferings for the Master's sake, so wast thou fairly crowned by the right hand of the Ruler; therefore do we worthily call thee blessed!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Мѡѷсе́й въ кꙋпинѣ̀ тѧ̀ ви́дѣ чи́стаѧ въ горѣ̀, * прїе́млющꙋ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Moses beheld thee, O pure one, in the bush upon the mountain, receiving receiving the unendurable fire of the Godhead without being consumed; therefore do we all magnify thee![^596]

provenance.verbatim_source:

...receiving the unendurable fire of the Godhead without being consumed; therefore do we all magnify thee![^596]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: нестерпи́мый бж҃тва̀ ѻ҆́гнь неѡпа́льнѡ. * тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѝ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion:* Like a light-bearing sun with marvelous rays, thou dost guide all creation, O most glorious passion-bearer; therefore, as we accomplish thy memory, we ask to be delivered from all perils![^597]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 21st Day:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ленъ: Ꙗ҆́коже сл҃нце свѣтоно́сно чꙋде́сными зарѧ́ми, * наста́влѧеши всю̀ тва́рь, пресла́вне срⷭ҇тоте́рпче. * тѣ́мже твою̀ соверша́юще па́мѧть, * про́симъ ѿ бѣ́дъ всѧ̑ и҆зба́вити.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Establish Thine inheritance in warfare, O Word, granting victories unto the rulers over barbarians, through the supplications of the Birthgiver of God, whom Thou hast granted as a protectress unto Christians!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры, прест҃ыѧ бцⷣы, гла́съ, и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже. Стра́нно та́инство чи́стаѧ, * безсѣ́меннагѡ твоегѡ̀ ржⷭ҇тва̀ * ди́вно и҆ ᲂу҆жа́сно, * превосхо́дѧ вели́чествомъ всѧ́кꙋ мы́сль чл҃вѣ́чꙋ: * є҆гѡ́же бо не терпѧ́тъ зрѣ́ти
items.english_text: *Stichera, Tone 8.*

provenance.verbatim_source: *Stichera, Tone 8.*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры, прест҃ыѧ бцⷣы, гла́съ, и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже. Стра́нно та́инство чи́стаѧ, * безсѣ́меннагѡ твоегѡ̀ ржⷭ҇тва̀ * ди́вно и҆ ᲂу҆жа́сно, * превосхо́дѧ вели́чествомъ всѧ́кꙋ мы́сль чл҃вѣ́чꙋ: * є҆гѡ́же бо не терпѧ́тъ зрѣ́ти
items.english_text: What shall we name thee, O glorious one? A true hierarch and a sacred teacher, the confirmation of the Orthodox and the Tserkovne Oko, a luminary who shone forth noetic light, a fellow of the glorious martyrs, a champion of the truth, a great refuter of falsehood: pray that our souls may be saved![^602]

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* What shall we call thee, O hierarch? A river flowing forth from noetic Eden, watering the earth with spiritual dew, a cup full of divine water, submerging the like-minded partisans of Arius, a pillar of fire leading the new people by divine grace: pray that our souls may be saved![^603]

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* What shall I call thee, O Eusebius? A dispenser of piety and a destroyer of impiety, the beauty of passion-bearers and the rejoicing of priests, a sickle cutting down tares and gathering heavenly wheat, a fountain of miracles flowing forth, taking away the burning heat of diseases: pray that our souls may be saved![^604]

items.section: Other Stichera of the Most Holy Birthgiver of God, in the Same Tone and Podoben
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры, прест҃ыѧ бцⷣы, гла́съ, и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже. Стра́нно та́инство чи́стаѧ, * безсѣ́меннагѡ твоегѡ̀ ржⷭ҇тва̀ * ди́вно и҆ ᲂу҆жа́сно, * превосхо́дѧ вели́чествомъ всѧ́кꙋ мы́сль чл҃вѣ́чꙋ: * є҆гѡ́же бо не терпѧ́тъ зрѣ́ти
items.english_text: A strange mystery, O pure one, is that of thy seedless childbearing, marvelous and dread, surpassing by its greatness every human mind; for Him Whom the many-eyed [Cherubim] endure not to behold endure not to behold, and all the ranks of holy angels tremble at, thou didst bear in the flesh for us, yet not departing from the Father's essence: we glorify thee who gavest Him birth, O Bride of God![^605]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Unto whom hast thou become likened, O wretched soul, not rising up at all unto repentance, and fearing not the fire that awaits the wicked? Arise, and call upon her who alone is speedy unto protection, and cry aloud: O Virgin Mother, pray unto thy Son and our God, to deliver me from the snares of the crafty one![^606]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Комꙋ̀ ᲂу҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ ѻ҆каѧ́ннаѧ? * къ покаѧ́нїю ника́коже возничꙋ́щи дꙋшѐ, * и҆ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ не ᲂу҆жаса́ешисѧ ѕлы́хъ ждꙋ́щагѡ. * воста́ни, и҆ є҆ди́нꙋ къ застꙋпле́нїю * ско́рꙋю призовѝ. * и҆ возопі́й: дв҃о мт҃и * молѝ твоего̀ сн҃а, и҆ бг҃а на́шего, * и҆зба́вити мѧ̀ сѣ́тей льсти́вагѡ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* O protection of all, Lady, as I am held fast by an abyss of darkness and ever submerged by the grievous needs of life: send down a drop of thy mercy, and give me the hand of thy help, and account me worthy of the portion of the elect and venerable ones, as thou didst bear God, the Lover of mankind![^607]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.section: Other Stichera of the Most Holy Birthgiver of God, in the Same Tone and Podoben
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, гла́съ и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже. О҆́гнь ро́ждши нестерпи́мый, * попалѧ́ющь грѣхѝ, * и҆ ѡ҆роша́ющь вѣ̑рныѧ, * ве́щнаѧ согрѣше́нїѧ, попалѝ мл҃твами твои́ми, * и҆ росо́ю мл҃ти дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ прохладѝ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ да твою̀ велича́ю ми́лость и҆ си́лꙋ.
items.english_text: Having given birth unto the unendurable Fire that burns up sins and bedews the faithful: burn up the material [wood] of my transgressions by thy prayers, O all-unblemished one, and refresh my soul, [inflamed] with passions, with dew, that I may [praise] thy mercy and power![^608]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Крⷭ҇тобг҃о: подо́бенъ то́йже. А҆́гница а҆́гнца ꙗ҆́кѡ
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃о: подо́бенъ то́йже. А҆́гница а҆́гнца ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ на дре́вѣ * просте́рта во́лею крⷭ҇тнѣмъ, * вопїѧ́ше мт҃рски, * болѣ́знꙋющи съ пла́чемъ: * сн҃е мо́й, что̀ стра́нное сїѐ ви́дѣнїе? * всѣ̑мъ живо́тъ даѧ́й ꙗ҆́кѡ гдⷭ҇ь, * ка́кѡ ᲂу҆мерщвлѧ́ешисѧ долготерпѣли́ве, * земны̑мъ подаѧ̀ воскрⷭ҇нїе? * сла́влю твоѐ мно́гое бж҃е мо́й снизхожде́нїе.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion, in the Same Podoben:* When the Ewe-lamb beheld her Lamb stretched out voluntarily upon the Tree of the Cross, maternally crying aloud, she wept in anguish: O my Son, what is this strange sight? Thou Who as Lord givest life unto all, how dost Thou die, O Long-suffering One, granting resurrection unto the earthborn? I glorify Thy great condescension, O my God![^609]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Соверше́ннымъ свѣ́томъ ѡ҆сїѧ́емь, * и҆ сщ҃е́ннымъ ликѡ́мъ бл҃же́нне сочинѧ́емь, * и҆ мꙋ́ченическимъ бл҃госла́вїемъ ᲂу҆краша́емь, * вѣ́рою пра́зднꙋющымъ, * твою̀ є҆ѵсе́вїе бл҃же́нне па́мѧть сохранѧ́й, * хрⷭ҇та̀ ми́лостива творѧ̀.

Heirmos:* *That which was cut severed the uncut [sea], and the sun beheld the earth which it had not seen; the water drowned the cruel enemy, and Israel passed through the impassable: and a song was sung: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He hath been gloriously glorified![^610]*
