O blessed one who gavest birth unto God, bless them that now bless thee, O all-pure one, and guide [us] unto good entrances; and fill [us] with divine good things, strengthening [us] to sing: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He hath been gloriously glorified!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Крⷭ҇тобг҃о: подо́бенъ то́йже. А҆́гница а҆́гнца ꙗ҆́кѡ
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Бл҃гослове́ннаѧ бг҃а ро́ждшаѧ, * бл҃госло́вѧщыѧ тѧ̀ ны́нѣ пречⷭ҇таѧ бл҃гословѝ, * къ бл҃ги̑мъ вхо́дѡмъ рꙋководѝ. * и҆ и҆спо́лни бж҃е́ственныхъ бл҃гъ, * и҆ пѣ́ти ᲂу҆крѣпѝ: * гдⷭ҇ви пои́мъ, сла́внѡ бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *Plant Thy fear, O Lord, in the hearts of Thy servants, and be Thou our establishment, who in truth call upon Thee![^612]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
*Plant Thy fear, O Lord, in the hearts of Thy servants, and be Thou our establishment, who in truth call upon Thee![^612]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Крⷭ҇тобг҃о: подо́бенъ то́йже. А҆́гница а҆́гнца ꙗ҆́кѡ
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Їрмо́съ: Стра́хъ тво́й гдⷭ҇и всадѝ въ сердца̀ ра̑бъ твои́хъ, * и҆ бꙋ́ди на́мъ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе, * тѧ̀ вои́стинꙋ призыва́ющихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast meek and gentle, humble-minded and calm, and filled with divine love; at thine end thou wast adorned with the crowns of martyrdom!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou wast meek and gentle, humble-minded and calm, and filled with divine love; at thine end thou wast adorned with the crowns of martyrdom!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Крⷭ҇тобг҃о: подо́бенъ то́йже. А҆́гница а҆́гнца ꙗ҆́кѡ
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Бы́лъ є҆сѝ кро́токъ и҆ неѕло́бивъ, * смиреномꙋ́дръ же и҆ ти́хъ, * и҆ любвѐ бж҃е́ственныѧ и҆спо́лненъ, * мꙋ́ченическими при кончи́нѣ ᲂу҆краси́лсѧ є҆сѝ вѣнцы̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Shining in garments of blood, O sacred Eusebius, thou didst ascend into the holy places, radiantly crowned with the glory of the saints!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Shining in garments of blood, O sacred Eusebius, thou didst ascend into the holy places, radiantly crowned with the glory of the saints!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Крⷭ҇тобг҃о: подо́бенъ то́йже. А҆́гница а҆́гнца ꙗ҆́кѡ
items.slavonic_text: О҆де́ждами ꙗ҆́же ѿ кровѐ, * є҆ѵсе́вїе сщ҃е́нне сїѧ́ѧ, * во ст҃а̑ѧ восте́клъ є҆сѝ, * свѣ́тлѡ ст҃ы́хъ сла́вою вѣнча́емь.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Rebuking the like-minded partisans of Arius, O blessed one, thou didst endure persecutions and a violent death; therefore wast thou accounted worthy of immortal glory![^613]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Rebuking the like-minded partisans of Arius, O blessed one, thou didst endure persecutions and a violent death; therefore wast thou accounted worthy of immortal glory![^613]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Крⷭ҇тобг҃о: подо́бенъ то́йже. А҆́гница а҆́гнца ꙗ҆́кѡ
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆блича́ѧ а҆́рїевы є҆диномы́сленники, * гоне́нїа бл҃же́нне под̾ѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ нꙋ́жднꙋю сме́рть: * тѣ́мже безсме́ртныѧ сла́вы сподо́билсѧ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* By the Father's will didst thou bear the Word through the overshadowing of the Divine Spirit, O all-pure Virgin Mother, the glory of hierarchs; therefore do we hymn thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
By the Father's will didst thou bear the Word through the overshadowing of the Divine Spirit, O all-pure Virgin Mother, the glory of hierarchs; therefore do we hymn thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Во́лею ѻ҆́ч҃ею сло́во родила̀ є҆сѝ, * наи́тїемъ бж҃твеннагѡ дх҃а, * пречⷭ҇таѧ дв҃о мт҃и, * а҆рхїере́євъ сла́во. * тѣ́мже тѧ̀ пое́мъ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Speedily anticipate" (Ско́рѡ предварѝ):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:*
*Tone 4, Podoben: "Speedily anticipate" (Ско́рѡ предварѝ):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ско́рѡ предварѝ: Оу҆ѧсни́въ житїѐ твоѐ добродѣ́телей красота́ми, * па́стырь наре́клсѧ є҆сѝ, * и҆ ст҃и́тель че́стенъ, пребл҃же́нне є҆ѵсе́вїе: * кро́вїю же мꙋче́нїа себѐ ᲂу҆краси́лъ є҆сѝ, * горѣ̀ къ невеще́ственнымъ преста́вилсѧ є҆сѝ ликѡ́мъ. * съ ни́миже ѡ҆ на́съ хрⷭ҇та̀ ѻ҆́ч҃е молѝ, * поми́ловати дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_text: Having made bright thy life with the beauties of virtues, thou wast named a shepherd and an honorable hierarch, O most blessed Eusebius; and having adorned thyself with the blood of martyrdom, thou didst pass over on high unto the immaterial choirs; with them, O father, entreat Christ to have mercy on our souls![^614]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having made bright thy life with the beauties of virtues, thou wast named a shepherd and an honorable hierarch, O most blessed Eusebius; and having adorned thyself with the blood of martyrdom, thou didst pass over on high unto the immaterial choirs; with them, O father, entreat Christ to have mercy on our souls![^614]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: На крⷭ҇тѣ̀ тѧ̀ возвы́шена ꙗ҆́кѡ ᲂу҆зрѣ̀ пречⷭ҇таѧ мт҃и твоѧ̀ сло́ве бж҃їй, * мт҃рски рыда́ющи вѣща́ше: * что̀ но́вое и҆ стра́нное сїѐ чꙋ́до сн҃е мо́й? * ка́кѡ жи́знь всѣ́хъ вкꙋша́еши сме́рти, * ѡ҆живи́ти ме́ртвыѧ хотѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ милосе́рдъ?
items.english_text: O pure, all-unblemished, and unwedded one, who alone in time gavest birth unto the timeless Son and Word of God: entreat Him together with the holy and honorable patriarchs, martyrs, prophets, and venerable ones, to grant us cleansing and great mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: O pure, all-unblemished, and unwedded one, who alone in time gavest birth unto the timeless Son and Word of God: entreat Him together with the holy and honorable patriarchs, martyrs, prophets, and venerable ones, to grant us cleansing and great mercy!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Їрмо́съ: И҆з̾ горы̀ приѡсѣне́нныѧ сло́ве прⷪ҇ро́къ, * є҆ди́ныѧ бцⷣы, * хотѧ́ща воплоти́тисѧ, бг҃ови́днѡ ᲂу҆смотрѝ
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* When Thine all-pure Mother beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Word of God, maternally lamenting she said: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How dost Thou, the Life of all, taste of death, willing as Compassionate One to give life unto the dead?[^615]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
When Thine all-pure Mother beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O Word of God, maternally lamenting she said: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How dost Thou, the Life of all, taste of death, willing as Compassionate One to give life unto the dead?[^615]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Їрмо́съ: И҆з̾ горы̀ приѡсѣне́нныѧ сло́ве прⷪ҇ро́къ, * є҆ди́ныѧ бцⷣы, * хотѧ́ща воплоти́тисѧ, бг҃ови́днѡ ᲂу҆смотрѝ
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *From the overshadowing mountain, the Prophet foresaw Thee, the Word, intending to become incarnate of the only Birthgiver of God...* intending to become incarnate of the only Birthgiver of God, and with fear he glorified Thy power![^616]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*From the overshadowing mountain, the Prophet foresaw Thee, the Word, intending to become incarnate of the only Birthgiver of God...*
...intending to become incarnate of the only Birthgiver of God, and with fear he glorified Thy power![^616]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: и҆ со стра́хомъ славосло́влѧше си́лꙋ твою̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst halt the putrefaction of deceit, O wise one, by the salt of thine excellent teachings; and them that were sick with the heresy of evil faith thou didst heal, O blessed Eusebius!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst halt the putrefaction of deceit, O wise one, by the salt of thine excellent teachings; and them that were sick with the heresy of evil faith thou didst heal, O blessed Eusebius!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Оу҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ мꙋ́дре, * пре́лести гно́єнїе, * со́лїю твои́хъ и҆зра́дныхъ ᲂу҆че́нїй: * и҆ недꙋ́гꙋющыѧ є҆ресі́ю ѕловѣ́рїа, * бл҃же́нне и҆сцѣли́лъ є҆сѝ є҆ѵсе́вїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having directed the people unto the haven of salvation, thou didst submerge Arius's unbelief by the flooding of thy blood, O shepherd and martyr, adornment of hierarchs!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having directed the people unto the haven of salvation, thou didst submerge Arius's unbelief by the flooding of thy blood, O shepherd and martyr, adornment of hierarchs!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Напра́вивъ лю́ди къ приста́нищꙋ сп҃се́нїа, * а҆́рїево погрꙋзи́лъ є҆сѝ невѣ́рїе, * кро́внымъ наводне́нїемъ, * па́стырю и҆ мꙋ́чениче, * ст҃и́телей ᲂу҆добре́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A bright star didst thou shine forth in the world with sacred radiance, enlightening the thoughts of the Orthodox, O all-blessed one; therefore do we faithfully call thee blessed!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
A bright star didst thou shine forth in the world with sacred radiance, enlightening the thoughts of the Orthodox, O all-blessed one; therefore do we faithfully call thee blessed!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ѕвѣзда̀ свѣ́тлаѧ возсїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ въ мі́рѣ, * сїѧ́нїемъ сщ҃е́ннымъ, * ѡ҆зарѧ́ѧ мы̑сли пребл҃же́нне правосла́вныхъ. * тѣ́мже тѧ̀ вѣ́рнѡ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* With pure lips, tongue, and heart, I confess thee as the Mother of the Creator, and I pray thee: enlighten my soul, darkened by transgressions!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
With pure lips, tongue, and heart, I confess thee as the Mother of the Creator, and I pray thee: enlighten my soul, darkened by transgressions!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆сты̑ чи́стыми, * и҆ ѧ҆зы́комъ и҆ се́рдцемъ, * и҆сповѣ́даю тѧ̀ зижди́телѧ мт҃рь, * и҆ молю́ тѧ: * ѡ҆зарѝ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀, * ѡ҆мраче́ннꙋю согрѣше́ньми.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *Thou Who hast enlightened the ends [of the world] from the night of ignorance by the knowledge of God: enlighten me with the morning of Thy love for mankind, O Lord![^617]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*Thou Who hast enlightened the ends [of the world] from the night of ignorance by the knowledge of God: enlighten me with the morning of Thy love for mankind, O Lord![^617]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Їрмо́съ: Ѿ но́щи невѣ́дѣнїа, * бг҃овѣ́дѣнїемъ просвѣти́вый концы̀, * просвѣти́ мѧ ᲂу҆́тромъ человѣколю́бїа твоегѡ̀ гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Confirming the mind of the Orthodox by thy teachings, O blessed one, thou didst endure banishment for the sake of piety![^618]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Confirming the mind of the Orthodox by thy teachings, O blessed one, thou didst endure banishment for the sake of piety![^618]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Оу҆че́нїи твои́ми бл҃же́нне, * правосла́вныхъ ᲂу҆твержда́ѧ мꙋдрова́нїе, * за бл҃гоче́стїе заточѐнїе претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* We know thee as a pillar of Orthodoxy, a fountain of healings, O all-wise hierarch, and the confirmation of the Church!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
We know thee as a pillar of Orthodoxy, a fountain of healings, O all-wise hierarch, and the confirmation of the Church!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Правосла́вїа столпа̀, * и҆ и҆сцѣле́нїй и҆сто́чника тѧ̀ вѣ́мы, * премꙋ́дре ст҃ителю, * и҆ цр҃кве ᲂу҆твержде́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Confirming the lawless by divine ordinances, O Eusebius, thou didst endure an unjust death at the hand of the lawless![^619]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Confirming the lawless by divine ordinances, O Eusebius, thou didst endure an unjust death at the hand of the lawless![^619]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Законоположе́нїи бж҃твенными, * беззако́ннꙋющыѧ ᲂу҆твержда́ѧ є҆ѵсе́вїе, * ѿ рꙋкѝ беззаконнꙋ́ющихъ, * непра́веднꙋ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ сме́рть.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A radiant candlestick, O Birthgiver of God, bearing the Divine Candle that enlightens all the ends [of the earth], wast thou known to be!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
A radiant candlestick, O Birthgiver of God, bearing the Divine Candle that enlightens all the ends [of the earth], wast thou known to be!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Свѣ́телъ свѣ́щникъ, * бг҃ороди́тельнице, * бж҃твеннꙋю свѣщꙋ̀ носѧ́щи позна́ласѧ є҆сѝ, * всѧ̑ ѡ҆зарѧ́ющꙋю концы̀.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *I will pour out my prayer unto the Lord, and unto Him will I declare my griefs; for my soul is full of evils, and my life has drawn nigh unto hades; and like Jonah I pray: Lead me up from corruption, O God![^620]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*I will pour out my prayer unto the Lord, and unto Him will I declare my griefs; for my soul is full of evils, and my life has drawn nigh unto hades; and like Jonah I pray: Lead me up from corruption, O God![^620]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Їрмо́съ: Моли́твꙋ пролїю̀ ко гдⷭ҇ꙋ, * и҆ томꙋ̀ возвѣщꙋ̀ печа̑ли моѧ̑, * ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕѡ́лъ дꙋша̀ моѧ̀ и҆спо́лнисѧ, * и҆ живо́тъ мо́й а҆́дꙋ прибли́жисѧ. * и҆ молю́сѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ їѡ́на: * ѿ тлѝ бж҃е возведи́ мѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst proclaim the consubstantial Word and Son, co-unoriginate with the Father; thou didst destroy the worldly mindset of the abominable frenzy of Arius, O Eusebius, unshakeable and firm bulwark of the pious!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst proclaim the consubstantial Word and Son, co-unoriginate with the Father; thou didst destroy the worldly mindset of the abominable frenzy of Arius, O Eusebius, unshakeable and firm bulwark of the pious!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ є҆диносꙋ́щное сло́во, * и҆ собезна́чалнаго ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ сн҃а: * ме́рзскагѡ а҆́рїева неи́стовства потреби́лъ є҆сѝ свѣ́тное мꙋдрова́нїе, * є҆ѵсе́вїе, * бл҃гочести́выхъ неразсѣ́дное и҆ тве́рдое ѡ҆гражде́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By the sprinkling of thy precious blood, the Church dyed a purple robe for herself; thou didst enter with gladness, O father, into the heavenly Kingdom, to stand before the King of the ages, O all-blessed Eusebius!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By the sprinkling of thy precious blood, the Church dyed a purple robe for herself; thou didst enter with gladness, O father, into the heavenly Kingdom, to stand before the King of the ages, O all-blessed Eusebius!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Крапле́нїемъ честны́хъ твои́хъ крове́й, * порфѵ́рꙋ себѣ̀ ѡ҆багри́лъ є҆сѝ цр҃ко́вь. * вмѣсти́лсѧ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е съ весе́лїемъ, * въ бж҃е́ственное црⷭ҇твїе предстоѧ́ти цр҃ю̀ вѣкѡ́въ, * всебл҃же́нне є҆ѵсе́вїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Like a rose, like a sweet-smelling lily, like the paradise of God wast thou shown forth, having in the midst the Tree of Life, the Creator of all and Lord, O Eusebius: now thou fillest us with divine sweet fragrance!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Like a rose, like a sweet-smelling lily, like the paradise of God wast thou shown forth, having in the midst the Tree of Life, the Creator of all and Lord, O Eusebius: now thou fillest us with divine sweet fragrance!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Разꙋмѣва́ше бг҃оглаго́ливїи прⷪ҇ро́цы, * та́инства твоегѡ̀ безмѣ́рнꙋю глꙋбинꙋ̀, * сїѐ ꙗ҆́вѣ провозвѣсти́ша ѻ҆трокови́це, * гада́ньми и҆ бж҃твенными прорече́нїи: * сло́во бо ѻ҆́ч҃е па́че сло́ва чⷭ҇таѧ воплоти́ла є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Perceiving the immeasurable depth of thy mystery, the God-proclaiming prophets clearly foreannounced this, O Maiden, by riddles and divine prophecies; for above speech didst thou in the flesh give birth unto the Word of the Father, O pure one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Perceiving the immeasurable depth of thy mystery, the God-proclaiming prophets clearly foreannounced this, O Maiden, by riddles and divine prophecies; for above speech didst thou in the flesh give birth unto the Word of the Father, O pure one!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ дне́сь: Бл҃гоче́стнѡ бо ст҃и́тельствѣ пожи́въ, * и҆ мꙋче́нїа пꙋ́ть проше́дъ, * і҆́дѡльскїѧ ᲂу҆гаси́лъ є҆сѝ же́ртвы ст҃и́телю є҆ѵсе́вїе. * но ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆мѣ́ѧй дерзнове́нїе ко хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ бг҃ꙋ, * молѝ сп҃ти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 4:* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast appeared today" (Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ дне́сь):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 4:*
*Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast appeared today" (Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ дне́сь):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Їрмо́съ: О҆́троцы є҆вре́йстїи въ пещѝ, * попра́ша пла́мень дерзнове́ннѡ, * и҆ на ро́сꙋ ѻ҆́гнь преложи́ша, вопїю́ще: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Having piously lived in hierarchal ministry and completed the course of martyrdom, thou didst extinguish idol sacrifices, O hierarch Eusebius; but as thou hast boldness toward Christ God, pray that our souls may be saved![^622]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having piously lived in hierarchal ministry and completed the course of martyrdom, thou didst extinguish idol sacrifices, O hierarch Eusebius; but as thou hast boldness toward Christ God, pray that our souls may be saved![^622]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Пѣ́сньми ᲂу҆пражнѧ́ѧсѧ ст҃и́телю и҆ мольба́ми, * ᲂу҆сы́пилъ є҆сѝ стра̑сти, * и҆ на́мъ вѣ̑рнымъ бо́дръ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ храни́тель, * бл҃гоче́стнѡ пою́щымъ тѧ̀, * и҆ творѧ́щымъ твою̀ па́мѧть.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *The Hebrew children in the furnace boldly trampled down the flame, and changed the fire into dew, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages![^623]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*The Hebrew children in the furnace boldly trampled down the flame, and changed the fire into dew, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages![^623]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́ченикъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ и҆ ст҃ль, * не́бныѧ бж҃твеннѣ наслѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ прⷭ҇то́лꙋ предстоѧ̀ зижди́телѧ, вопїѧ̀: * бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, бж҃е во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Occupying thyself in songs and supplications, O hierarch, thou didst put passions to sleep, and wast shown forth unto us the faithful as a watchful guardian, who piously hymn thee and celebrate thy memory!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Occupying thyself in songs and supplications, O hierarch, thou didst put passions to sleep, and wast shown forth unto us the faithful as a watchful guardian, who piously hymn thee and celebrate thy memory!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́тро возсїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, * проповѣ́даѧ возсїѧ́вшаго ѿ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ пре́жде денни́цы, * хрⷭ҇та̀, свѣти́льниче цр҃ко́внїй, * ст҃и́телей ᲂу҆краше́нїе, * страда́льцевъ ᲂу҆добре́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Shown forth as a martyr and a hierarch, thou didst divinely inherit heavenly things, and standing before the throne of the Creator, thou didst cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Shown forth as a martyr and a hierarch, thou didst divinely inherit heavenly things, and standing before the throne of the Creator, thou didst cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Зако́ны є҆стества̀ дв҃о, * ржⷭ҇тво́мъ твои́мъ ѡ҆бновлѧ́еши пресла́внѡ, * и҆ и҆стлѣ́вшыѧ ны̀ ѕлы̑мъ престꙋпле́нїемъ ѡ҆чища́еши. * тѣ́мже тѧ̀ по до́лгꙋ восхвалѧ́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst shine forth as the morning, proclaiming Christ Who shone forth from the Father before the morning star, O luminary of the Church, adornment of hierarchs, beauty of sufferers![^624]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst shine forth as the morning, proclaiming Christ Who shone forth from the Father before the morning star, O luminary of the Church, adornment of hierarchs, beauty of sufferers![^624]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Їрмо́съ: Бг҃оглаго́ливїи ѻ҆́троцы въ пещѝ, * со ѻ҆гне́мъ пла́мень попира́юще поѧ́хꙋ: * бл҃гослови́те дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇нѧ гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou renewest the laws of nature most gloriously by thy childbearing, O Virgin, and cleansest us who were corrupted by evil transgression; therefore as is meet do we praise thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thou renewest the laws of nature most gloriously by thy childbearing, O Virgin, and cleansest us who were corrupted by evil transgression; therefore as is meet do we praise thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Со ст҃и́тели и҆ мꙋ́ники мл҃и, * ꙗ҆́кѡ ст҃и́тель и҆ мꙋ́нкъ, * сщ҃еннопроповѣ́дниче є҆ѵсе́вїе, * сп҃са всѣ́хъ, * ѡ҆брѣстѝ на́мъ ми́лость.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *The God-proclaiming children in the furnace, trampling upon the flame with the fire, sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^625]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*The God-proclaiming children in the furnace, trampling upon the flame with the fire, sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord![^625]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃ги́мъ нра́вомъ пожи́въ, * слове́сною па́лицею сщ҃е́нное твоѐ ста́до ᲂу҆па́слъ є҆сѝ, * и҆ є҆рети́чєскїѧ ѕвѣ́ри всебл҃же́нне ѿгна́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Together with the hierarchs and martyrs, entreat the Savior of all, as a hierarch and a martyr, O sacred proclaimer Eusebius, that we may find mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Together with the hierarchs and martyrs, entreat the Savior of all, as a hierarch and a martyr, O sacred proclaimer Eusebius, that we may find mercy!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆тѧгче́нныѧ пїѧ́нствомъ пре́лести, * є҆рети́чествꙋющыѧ всѣ̑, * ты̀ ѡ҆бличи́лъ є҆ѵсе́вїе. * ѿ тѣ́хъ ᲂу҆бїе́нъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, * страда́въ тве́рдѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having lived with a goodly disposition, thou didst shepherd thy sacred flock with the staff of the word, and didst drive away heretical beasts, O all-blessed one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having lived with a goodly disposition, thou didst shepherd thy sacred flock with the staff of the word, and didst drive away heretical beasts, O all-blessed one!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ вы́шши нбⷭ҇ныхъ си́лъ, * вы́шнее родила̀ є҆сѝ сло́во, * ѿ землѝ возвы́сившее па́дшее существо̀ чл҃вѣ́ческое, * всепѣ́таѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* All them that were weighed down with the drunkenness of deceit, the heretics, thou didst rebuke, O Eusebius; and by them wast thou slain, having suffered firmly![^626]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
All them that were weighed down with the drunkenness of deceit, the heretics, thou didst rebuke, O Eusebius; and by them wast thou slain, having suffered firmly![^626]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ вы́шши нбⷭ҇ныхъ си́лъ, * вы́шнее родила̀ є҆сѝ сло́во, * ѿ землѝ возвы́сившее па́дшее существо̀ чл҃вѣ́ческое, * всепѣ́таѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As higher than the heavenly powers, thou didst bear the most high Word, Who lifted up from the earth the fallen nature of mankind, O all-hymned one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
As higher than the heavenly powers, thou didst bear the most high Word, Who lifted up from the earth the fallen nature of mankind, O all-hymned one!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Їрмо́съ: Вои́стиннꙋ бцⷣꙋ тѧ̀ и҆сповѣ́дꙋемъ, * спасе́нїи тобо́ю дв҃о чи́стаѧ, * съ безпло́тными ли́ки тѧ̀ велича́юще.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *Truly we confess thee to be the Mother of God, who are saved through thee, O pure Virgin, magnifying thee with the bodiless choirs![^627]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
*Truly we confess thee to be the Mother of God, who are saved through thee, O pure Virgin, magnifying thee with the bodiless choirs![^627]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропари́: Ви́дѣти сподо́билсѧ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е да̑льнаѧ, * сщ҃е́ннѣй твое́й дꙋшѝ надъзе́мнаѧ, * и҆ къ невече́рнемꙋ сїѧ́нїю ра́дꙋѧсѧ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast accounted worthy, O father, to behold things far off, supernatural things for thy sacred soul; and rejoicing, thou didst take up thy dwelling in the never-setting radiance!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou wast accounted worthy, O father, to behold things far off, supernatural things for thy sacred soul; and rejoicing, thou didst take up thy dwelling in the never-setting radiance!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Кра́сенъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ бг҃оглагола́нїемъ, * и҆ бл҃ги́ми дѣѧ́нїи є҆ѵсе́вїе, * и҆ всечестны́ми страда́нїи, * бл҃же́не свѣ́тлостми.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Fair didst thou show thyself through divine speech and good deeds, O Eusebius, and through most honorable sufferings, O blessed one, [shining] with splendors!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Fair didst thou show thyself through divine speech and good deeds, O Eusebius, and through most honorable sufferings, O blessed one, [shining] with splendors!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Соста́вимъ ли́къ ра́достенъ, * сщ҃е́ннаго восхваля́юще є҆ѵсе́вїа, * бл҃гоче́стїа добро́тою ᲂу҆краше́на.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Let us form a joyful choir, praising the sacred Eusebius, who is adorned with the beauty of piety!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Let us form a joyful choir, praising the sacred Eusebius, who is adorned with the beauty of piety!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ра́ка твоѧ̀ дае́тъ бл҃года́ть и҆сцѣле́нїй, * ст҃а́ѧ же па́мѧть твоѧ̀ є҆ѵсе́вїе просвѣща́етъ мі́ръ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ вели́кое сл҃нце.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy shrine gives forth the grace of healings, and thy holy memory, O Eusebius, enlightens the world like a great sun!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thy shrine gives forth the grace of healings, and thy holy memory, O Eusebius, enlightens the world like a great sun!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 22nd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Бл҃голюби́ваѧ дв҃о, * ѡ҆ѕло́бленнꙋю грѣхмѝ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ᲂу҆бл҃жѝ, * ꙗ҆́же пребл҃га́го бг҃а пло́тїю ро́ждшꙋю.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Virgin lover of good, who gavest birth in the flesh unto the most good God: make good my soul, mistreated by sins!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O Virgin lover of good, who gavest birth in the flesh unto the most good God: make good my soul, mistreated by sins!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ноша́хꙋ на ра́менахъ тѧ̀ ва́сса и҆ па́ѵла, * повелѣ́нїемъ всѧ́чєскаѧ носѧ́щагѡ, * мѣ̑ста премѣнѧ́юще, * и҆ долготꙋ̀ пꙋчи́ны, * мꙋ́нце а҆грѵпі́но, * чꙋдодѣ́йствїа стра̑шнаѧ соверша́ющи, * бж҃твенною бл҃года́тїю: * почи́ла є҆сѝ на мѣ́стѣ, * и҆дѣ́же бг҃ъ ᲂу҆чинѝ, * ᲂу҆трꙋжде́ннымъ поко́й бы́вши всехва́лнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Stichera, Tone 4.*

provenance.verbatim_source: *Stichera, Tone 4.*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры бцⷣы, гла́съ и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже.
items.english_text: Rome offers thee as a flower-bearing, sweet-smelling rose, O much-suffering Agrippina, making fragrant the thought of the faithful with virtuous odors, and ever driving away the foul stench of passions by grace, O adornment of martyrs, confirmation of the Church, praise of virgins, and abyss of miracles![^629]

provenance.verbatim_source: Rome offers thee as a flower-bearing, sweet-smelling rose, O much-suffering Agrippina, making fragrant the thought of the faithful with virtuous odors, and ever driving away the foul stench of passions by grace, O adornment of martyrs, confirmation of the Church, praise of virgins, and abyss of miracles![^629]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры бцⷣы, гла́съ и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* As a precious treasure, Christ our God gives thee unto Sicily, who didst suffer in Rome; where, having arrived, O glorious martyr, thou drivest away the crafty multitude of demons by thy protection; therefore do we call thee blessed, and celebrate today thy holy suffering, O much-suffering Agrippina![^630]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
As a precious treasure, Christ our God gives thee unto Sicily, who didst suffer in Rome; where, having arrived, O glorious martyr, thou drivest away the crafty multitude of demons by thy protection; therefore do we call thee blessed, and celebrate today thy holy suffering, O much-suffering Agrippina![^630]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны стїхи̑ры бцⷣы, гла́съ и҆ подо́бенъ то́йже.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Bassa and Paula bore thee upon their shoulders by the command of Him Who upholds all things, traversing diverse places and the breadth of the deep, O martyr Agrippina, working dread miracles by divine grace: and thou didst come to rest in the place where God ordained, having become rest for the weary, O all-lauded one![^631]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Bassa and Paula bore thee upon their shoulders by the command of Him Who upholds all things, traversing diverse places and the breadth of the deep, O martyr Agrippina, working dread miracles by divine grace: and thou didst come to rest in the place where God ordained, having become rest for the weary, O all-lauded one![^631]

items.section: Other Stichera of the Birthgiver of God, in the Same Tone and Podoben
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: кг҃ де́нь
items.english_text: *When thou singest Alleluia, speak these stichera first:[^632]*

provenance.verbatim_source: *When thou singest Alleluia, speak these stichera first:[^632]*

items.section: Other Stichera of the Birthgiver of God, in the Same Tone and Podoben
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Є҆гда̀ пое́ши ꙗ҆ллилꙋ́їа, сїѧ̑ стїхи̑ры глаго́ли пре́жде.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Rejoice, sun-like ray, throne of the unsetting Sun, who didst dawn forth the inscrutable Sun; rejoice, illuminate the mind with divine splendors, O lightning flash that hast enlightened the ends of the earth, true radiance of gold, all-good and all-immaculate one, who hast shone forth the unwaning light upon the faithful!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Rejoice, sun-like ray, throne of the unsetting Sun, who didst dawn forth the inscrutable Sun; rejoice, illuminate the mind with divine splendors, O lightning flash that hast enlightened the ends of the earth, true radiance of gold, all-good and all-immaculate one, who hast shone forth the unwaning light upon the faithful!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Birthgiver of God, in the Same Tone and Podoben
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋйсѧ со́лнцезра́чнаѧ лꙋчѐ, * со́лнца незаходи́магѡ престо́ле, * ꙗ҆́же со́лнце возсїѧ́вши недоꙋмѣ́нное: * ра́дꙋйсѧ ᲂу҆мѐ ѡ҆блиста́й бж҃твенными сїѧ́нми, * зарѐ мо́лнїйнаѧ, * ѡ҆свѣти́вшаѧ землѝ концы̀, * и҆́стинное зла́та блиста́нїе, * вседо́браѧ и҆ пренепоро́чнаѧ, * свѣ́тъ невече́рнїй вѣ̑рнымъ ѡ҆блиста́вши.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Wash away the filth of my passionate heart, O all-hymned Birthgiver of God, and cleanse all the wounds and sores thereof which are from sin, O pure one, and stay the instability of my mind, that I, wretched and unprofitable servant of thine, may magnify thy power and great protection!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Wash away the filth of my passionate heart, O all-hymned Birthgiver of God, and cleanse all the wounds and sores thereof which are from sin, O pure one, and stay the instability of my mind, that I, wretched and unprofitable servant of thine, may magnify thy power and great protection!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Birthgiver of God, in the Same Tone and Podoben
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Скве́рнꙋ ѿмы́й стра́стнагѡ се́рдца моегѡ̀, * бцⷣе всепѣ́таѧ, * и҆ всѧ̑ ꙗ҆́звы и҆ гное́нїѧ сегѡ̀, * ꙗ҆̀же ѿ грѣха̀ ѡ҆чи́сти чⷭ҇таѧ, * и҆ ᲂу҆ма̀ моегѡ̀ ᲂу҆ста́ви непостоѧ́нїе: * ꙗ҆́кѡ да си́лꙋ твою̀, * и҆ вели́кое застꙋпле́нїе, * велича́ю ѻ҆каѧ́нный, * и҆ непотрє́бный ра́бъ тво́й.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* The weakness and paralysis of my soul, as all-immaculate Mother, turn into strength and might, through fear and love to keep and perform the statutes of Christ, that I may escape the unendurable fire, and through thee inherit the heavenly inheritance and life that passes not away, ever boasting in thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
The weakness and paralysis of my soul, as all-immaculate Mother, turn into strength and might, through fear and love to keep and perform the statutes of Christ, that I may escape the unendurable fire, and through thee inherit the heavenly inheritance and life that passes not away, ever boasting in thee!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Birthgiver of God, in the Same Tone and Podoben
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бѣсо́вскими преклоне́на прило́гми, * и҆ въ ро́въ поги́бели вве́ржена, * ᲂу҆ще́дри влⷣчце, * и҆ ᲂу҆тверди́ мѧ на ка́мени добродѣ́телей, * и҆ навѣ́ты вра́жїѧ разоршѝ, * сподо́би мѧ̀ твори́ти повелѣ́нїѧ, * твоегѡ̀ сн҃а и҆ бг҃а на́шегѡ: * ꙗ҆́кѡ да ᲂу҆лꙋчꙋ̀ * ѡ҆ставле́нїе въ де́нь сꙋда̀.
items.english_text: Bowed down by demonic assaults and cast into the pit of destruction, have compassion on me, O Sovereign Lady, and establish me upon the rock of virtues, and having destroyed the snares of the enemy, vouchsafe me to do the commandments of thy Son and our God, that I may obtain remission in the day of judgment!

provenance.verbatim_source: Bowed down by demonic assaults and cast into the pit of destruction, have compassion on me, O Sovereign Lady, and establish me upon the rock of virtues, and having destroyed the snares of the enemy, vouchsafe me to do the commandments of thy Son and our God, that I may obtain remission in the day of judgment!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Birthgiver of God, in the Same Tone and Podoben
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃о: Подо́бенъ то́йже:
items.english_text: *Staurotheotokion:* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Staurotheotokion:*
*Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast given a sign" (Да́лъ є҆сѝ зна́менїе):*

items.section: Other Stichera of the Birthgiver of God, in the Same Tone and Podoben
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Распина́ема хрⷭ҇та̀ чл҃вколю́бца ви́дѧщи пречⷭ҇таѧ, * и҆ ре́бра и҆скопова́ема копїе́мъ, * пла́чꙋщи вопїѧ́ше: * что̀ сїѐ сн҃е мо́й; * что́ ти безбл҃года́тнїи лю́дїе возда́ша; * за ꙗ҆̀же сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ дѡ́браѧ и҆̀мъ: * и҆ тщи́шисѧ безча́дствовати мѧ̀ вселюбве́знѣйшїй; * ᲂу҆дивлѧ́юсѧ бл҃гоꙋтро́бне, * твоемꙋ̀ во́льномꙋ распѧ́тїю.
items.english_text: Beholding Thee, Christ the Lover of mankind, lifted upon the cross, and Thy side pierced with a spear, the all-pure one wept and cried aloud: What is this, O my Son? What have the ungrateful people rendered unto Thee for all the good things that Thou didst unto them? And dost Thou hasten to leave me childless, O most beloved One? I marvel, O compassionate One, at Thy voluntary crucifixion!

provenance.verbatim_source: Beholding Thee, Christ the Lover of mankind, lifted upon the cross, and Thy side pierced with a spear, the all-pure one wept and cried aloud: What is this, O my Son? What have the ungrateful people rendered unto Thee for all the good things that Thou didst unto them? And dost Thou hasten to leave me childless, O most beloved One? I marvel, O compassionate One, at Thy voluntary crucifixion!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Birthgiver of God, in the Same Tone and Podoben
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, д҃.
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Thy lamb Agrippina, O Jesus, cries aloud with a great voice: Thee, O my Bridegroom, do I love, and seeking Thee I endure suffering, and am crucified and buried with Thy baptism; and I suffer for Thy sake, that I may reign in Thee, and I die for Thee, that I may also live with Thee; but as a blameless sacrifice, accept me who with love have sacrificed myself unto Thee.[^633] By her prayers, as Thou art merciful, save our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion, Tone 4:*
Thy lamb Agrippina, O Jesus, cries aloud with a great voice: Thee, O my Bridegroom, do I love, and seeking Thee I endure suffering, and am crucified and buried with Thy baptism; and I suffer for Thy sake, that I may reign in Thee, and I die for Thee, that I may also live with Thee; but as a blameless sacrifice, accept me who with love have sacrificed myself unto Thee.[^633] By her prayers, as Thou art merciful, save our souls!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Хрⷭ҇то́вꙋ невѣ́стꙋ а҆грѷпі́нꙋ хвалю̀. Гла́съ, д҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. Ї҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Ode 1, Tone 4. Heirmos:* *I will open my mouth, and it shall be filled with the Spirit, and I will utter a word...* *...unto the Queen and Mother, and I will appear radiantly keeping festival, and rejoicing I will sing her wonders.[^635]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1, Tone 4. Heirmos:*
*I will open my mouth, and it shall be filled with the Spirit, and I will utter a word...*
*...unto the Queen and Mother, and I will appear radiantly keeping festival, and rejoicing I will sing her wonders.[^635]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: мцⷭ҇ъ і҆ꙋ́нїй
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By the radiance of grace that shone upon thee from on high, drive away the darkness of my ignorance, and grant me grace by thy prayers, O Agrippina, to hymn thy wonders, O martyr!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By the radiance of grace that shone upon thee from on high, drive away the darkness of my ignorance, and grant me grace by thy prayers, O Agrippina, to hymn thy wonders, O martyr!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: ѿры́гнꙋ цр҃и́цѣ мт҃ри, * и҆ ꙗ҆влю́сѧ свѣ́тлѡ торжествꙋ́ѧ, * и҆ воспою̀ ра́дꙋѧсѧ тоѧ̀ чꙋдеса̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Brighter than the sun in truth didst thou shine forth upon the firmament of the Church of Christ, and with the rays of thy contest and thy miracles, O martyr, thou didst enlighten the ends of the world!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Brighter than the sun in truth didst thou shine forth upon the firmament of the Church of Christ, and with the rays of thy contest and thy miracles, O martyr, thou didst enlighten the ends of the world!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сїѧ́нїемъ бл҃года́ти ѡ҆блиста́вшимъ тебѐ свы́ше, * мра́къ ѿженѝ невѣ́дѣнїѧ моегѡ̀, * и҆ пода́ждь мѝ мл҃твами твои́ми а҆грѷпі́но бл҃года́ть, * воспѣ́ти твоѧ̑ мч҃нце чꙋдеса̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring the immortal Bridegroom, the Giver of life, thou didst offer suffering unto Him as a gift; and thou didst receive the heavenly kingdom and an incorruptible crown, O glorious martyr!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Desiring the immortal Bridegroom, the Giver of life, thou didst offer suffering unto Him as a gift; and thou didst receive the heavenly kingdom and an incorruptible crown, O glorious martyr!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнца свѣтлѣ́йши ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆́стиннѡ возсїѧ́ла є҆сѝ, * на тве́рди цр҃кве хрⷭ҇то́вы: * и҆ просвѣти́ла є҆сѝ зарѧ́ми подви̑гъ мч҃нице, * и҆ чꙋде́съ твои́хъ мі́ра концы̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Governed by the hand of thy Master, thou didst cross the unstable sea of impiety, O honorable one, and didst hasten to the haven of high splendor, O God-blessed Agrippina!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Governed by the hand of thy Master, thou didst cross the unstable sea of impiety, O honorable one, and didst hasten to the haven of high splendor, O God-blessed Agrippina!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Жениха̀ безсме́ртнагѡ, * жизнода́вца жела́ющи, * ꙗ҆́кѡ да́ръ страда́нїе семꙋ̀ принесла̀ є҆сѝ. * И҆ воспрїѧ́ла є҆сѝ нбⷭ҇ное црⷭ҇тво, * и҆ вѣне́цъ нетлѣ́ненъ мч҃нице сла́внаѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Daystar has shone forth in the hearts of them that with faith honor thee as the Mother of God, O all-immaculate one; and the light-bearing day, even Christ Who shone forth from thy womb, O all-hymned one, has illuminated them!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The Daystar has shone forth in the hearts of them that with faith honor thee as the Mother of God, O all-immaculate one; and the light-bearing day, even Christ Who shone forth from thy womb, O all-hymned one, has illuminated them!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Рꙋко́ю влⷣки твоегѡ̀ ѡ҆кормлѧ́ема, * преплыла̀ є҆сѝ непостоѧ́нное мо́ре нече́стїѧ, * честна́ѧ, * и҆ ᲂу҆стреми́ласѧ є҆сѝ ко приста́нищꙋ а҆грѷпі́но, * вы́шнїѧ свѣ́тлости бг҃обл҃же́ннаѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *The bow of the mighty has grown weak, and the feeble have girded themselves with power; therefore my heart is established in the Lord.[^636]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
*The bow of the mighty has grown weak, and the feeble have girded themselves with power; therefore my heart is established in the Lord.[^636]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being beaten with rods, thou didst rejoice, crushing thereby the bones of impiety and crying aloud: Nothing shall separate me from Thy love, O Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Being beaten with rods, thou didst rejoice, crushing thereby the bones of impiety and crying aloud: Nothing shall separate me from Thy love, O Christ!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Денни́ца возсїѧ̀ въ сердца́хъ, * пренепоро́чнаѧ, * вѣ́рою чтꙋ́щихъ тѧ̀ бж҃їю мт҃рь. * И҆ ѡ҆зарѝ де́нь свѣтоно́сный, * хрⷭ҇то́съ и҆́же и҆з̾ ложе́снъ твои́хъ возсїѧ̀ препѣ́таѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having exposed the nakedness of the enemies, O martyr, thou didst strip thyself of garments; therefore did Christ give thee the vesture of incorruption!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having exposed the nakedness of the enemies, O martyr, thou didst strip thyself of garments; therefore did Christ give thee the vesture of incorruption!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Ї҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The mouths that spoke lawlessly against thee were lawfully shut, O martyr of Christ, as thou didst proclaim the majesty of the Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The mouths that spoke lawlessly against thee were lawfully shut, O martyr of Christ, as thou didst proclaim the majesty of the Savior!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Лꙋ́къ си́льныхъ и҆знемо́же, * и҆ немощствꙋ́ющїи препоѧса́шасѧ си́лою: * сегѡ̀ ра́ди ᲂу҆тверди́сѧ, въ гдⷭ҇ѣ срⷣце моѐ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having stretched out thy body upon the earth, the minister of impiety raged with fury; but thou didst have thy mind stretched out toward the Master!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having stretched out thy body upon the earth, the minister of impiety raged with fury; but thou didst have thy mind stretched out toward the Master!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Жезлі́емъ бїе́ма ра́довашесѧ, * си́ми кѡ́сти нече́стїѧ сокрꙋша́ющи, * и҆ вопїю́щи: * твоеѧ̀ любвѐ ничто́же мѧ̀ разлꙋчи́тъ хрⷭ҇тѐ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The voice of Isaiah was piously fulfilled: for a Virgin gave birth to the incarnate Giver of life and Savior of our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The voice of Isaiah was piously fulfilled: for a Virgin gave birth to the incarnate Giver of life and Savior of our souls!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Врагѡ́въ наготꙋ̀ ѡ҆бличи́вши мꙋ́ченнице, * ри́зъ совлекла́сѧ є҆сѝ: * сегѡ̀ ра́ди нетлѣ́нїѧ ѡ҆де́ждꙋ тебѣ̀ хрⷭ҇то́съ дадѐ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Go thou before" (Ско́рѡ предвари́):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:*
*Tone 4, Podoben: "Go thou before" (Ско́рѡ предвари́):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆ста̀ глаго́лющаѧ беззако́ннѡ на тѧ̀, * зако́ннѡ хрⷭ҇то́ва мꙋ́чнице загради́шасѧ, * вели́чїѧ сп҃са проповѣ́дающей тѝ.
items.english_text: They that served stones through much delusion weighed thee down with stones as thou didst confess Christ, the unconquerable Rock; therefore having finished thy course, O glorious Agrippina, thou hast shone forth a ray of most marvelous wonders, enlightening the souls of us who praise thee![^637]

provenance.verbatim_source: They that served stones through much delusion weighed thee down with stones as thou didst confess Christ, the unconquerable Rock; therefore having finished thy course, O glorious Agrippina, thou hast shone forth a ray of most marvelous wonders, enlightening the souls of us who praise thee![^637]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о:
items.english_text: O only one who gavest birth to the Creator of all, only one who didst adorn humanity humanity by thy childbearing, O Bride of God: deliver me from the snare of the deceitful enemy, and establish me upon the rock of the desires of Christ, earnestly entreating Him Whom thou didst incarnate!

provenance.verbatim_source:
O only one who gavest birth to the Creator of all, only one who didst adorn humanity...
...humanity by thy childbearing, O Bride of God: deliver me from the snare of the deceitful enemy, and establish me upon the rock of the desires of Christ, earnestly entreating Him Whom thou didst incarnate!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: кг҃ де́нь
items.english_text: *Staurotheotokion:* When Thine all-pure Mother beheld Thee lifted up upon the cross, O Word of God, she wept maternally and spoke: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How dost Thou, the Life of all, taste death, desiring to bring the dead to life, as Thou art compassionate?

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Staurotheotokion:*
When Thine all-pure Mother beheld Thee lifted up upon the cross, O Word of God, she wept maternally and spoke: What is this new and strange wonder, O my Son? How dost Thou, the Life of all, taste death, desiring to bring the dead to life, as Thou art compassionate?

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: человѣ́чество, * ржⷭ҇тво́мъ твои́мъ бг҃оневѣ́сто, * и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ ѿ сѣ́ти льсти́вагѡ врага̀, * поста́ви мѧ̀ на ка́мени хрⷭ҇то́выхъ хотѣ́нїй, * того̀ молѧ́щи прилѣ́жнѡ, * є҆го́же воплоти́ла є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *Sitting in glory upon the throne of the Godhead, Jesus the most divine came upon a light cloud, by His incorruptible palm, and saved them that cry: Glory, O Christ, to Thy power![^638]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*Sitting in glory upon the throne of the Godhead, Jesus the most divine came upon a light cloud, by His incorruptible palm, and saved them that cry: Glory, O Christ, to Thy power![^638]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Performing the will of them that fear Him, by an angel the Master looses thee from bonds and distress, O martyr, who didst break all impiety by the bond of the love of Christ, thy Bridegroom!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Performing the will of them that fear Him, by an angel the Master looses thee from bonds and distress, O martyr, who didst break all impiety by the bond of the love of Christ, thy Bridegroom!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: На крⷭ҇тѣ́ тѧ возвы́шена ꙗ҆́кѡ ᲂу҆зрѣ̀ пречⷭ҇таѧ мт҃и твоѧ̀ сло́ве бж҃їй, * мт҃рски рыда́ющи вѣща́ше: * что̀ но́вое и҆ стра́нное сїѐ чꙋ́до сн҃е мо́й? * ка́кѡ жи́знь всѣ́хъ вкꙋша́еши сме́рти? * ѡ҆живи́ти ме́ртвыѧ хотѧ̀, * ꙗ҆́кѡ милосе́рдъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having been put to death for the sake of the love of Him Who put to death all the power of death by death, thou dost pour forth ever-living grace, healing them that are slain by passions, O Agrippina, adornment of Christ's martyrs!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having been put to death for the sake of the love of Him Who put to death all the power of death by death, thou dost pour forth ever-living grace, healing them that are slain by passions, O Agrippina, adornment of Christ's martyrs!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Ї҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having surpassed all carnal love through the love of thy Bridegroom, thou didst endure firmly when painfully beaten, crying aloud: The threat of torments shall not separate me from Thy love, O Christ!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having surpassed all carnal love through the love of thy Bridegroom, thou didst endure firmly when painfully beaten, crying aloud: The threat of torments shall not separate me from Thy love, O Christ!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Сѣдѧ́й въ сла́вѣ, * на прⷭ҇то́лѣ бж҃тва̀, * во ѡ҆́блацѣ ле́гцѣ, * прїи́де і҆н҃съ пребж҃е́ственный, * нетлѣ́нною дла́нїю, * и҆ спасѐ зовꙋ́щыѧ: * сла́ва хрⷭ҇тѐ си́лѣ твое́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Who shall declare the courage of Bassa and Agrippina, pure in mind, who established a blessed union through threefold desire? By which they mightily showed the power of idols to be weak!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Who shall declare the courage of Bassa and Agrippina, pure in mind, who established a blessed union through threefold desire? By which they mightily showed the power of idols to be weak!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Во́лю тогѡ̀ боѧ́щихъ творѧ́й, * а҆́гг҃ломъ мꙋ́ченице разрѣша́етъ тѧ̀ ᲂу҆́зъ, * и҆ стѣсне́нїѧ, * разорши́вшꙋю всѧ́кое нече́стїе, * сою́зомъ любвѐ хрⷭ҇та̀, * жениха̀ твоегѡ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Virgin Queen, adorned with a golden garment, now stands before the King, her Son, surpassing the angels beyond comparison, crying: Glory, O Christ, to Thy power!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The Virgin Queen, adorned with a golden garment, now stands before the King, her Son, surpassing the angels beyond comparison, crying: Glory, O Christ, to Thy power!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́вшисѧ любвѐ ра́ди, * ᲂу҆мертви́вшагѡ всю̀ крѣ́пость сме́ртнꙋю, * бл҃года́ть и҆сточа́еши присноживо́тнꙋю, * страстьмѝ ᲂу҆мерщвле́ннымъ и҆сцѣле́ни, * а҆грѷпі́но мꙋ́ченикѡвъ хрⷭ҇то́выхъ ᲂу҆добре́нїе.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *Thou, O my Lord, didst come as a light into the world, a holy light, turning back from gloomy ignorance them that hymn Thee with faith.[^639]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*Thou, O my Lord, didst come as a light into the world, a holy light, turning back from gloomy ignorance them that hymn Thee with faith.[^639]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Превозше́дши любо́вїю жениха̀ твоегѡ̀ всѧ́кꙋ плотскꙋ́ю любо́вь, * терпѣ́ла є҆сѝ тве́рдѡ внегда̀ бїе́мѣ бы́ти болѣ́зненнѣ, * вопїю́щи: * не разлꙋчи́тъ мѧ̀ любвѐ твоеѧ̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ, * мꙋ́къ преще́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The unsetting Light, having taken up His dwelling in thy body, showed thee unto them that beheld thee in the night as in the day, emitting a ray of miracles!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The unsetting Light, having taken up His dwelling in thy body, showed thee unto them that beheld thee in the night as in the day, emitting a ray of miracles!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃же́ннагѡ совокꙋпле́нїѧ, * тро́ичнымъ жела́нїемъ поста́вльшихъ, * ва́ссы и҆ а҆грѷпі́ны цѣломꙋ́дрыѧ, * кто̀ мꙋ́жество и҆зрече́тъ? * и҆́мже показа́ша немощнꙋ̀ і҆́дѡльскꙋю крѣ́пость, * держа́внѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* An undefiled lamb, following the footsteps of the Shepherd, as an immaculate sacrifice was she divinely offered unto Him!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
An undefiled lamb, following the footsteps of the Shepherd, as an immaculate sacrifice was she divinely offered unto Him!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having a radiant mind filled with prophecy, thou, O glorious Bassa, wast accounted worthy to foretell future things as though present!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having a radiant mind filled with prophecy, thou, O glorious Bassa, wast accounted worthy to foretell future things as though present!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: мцⷭ҇ъ і҆ꙋ́нїй
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* ...O Mother of God, heal the affliction of my soul, who didst bear the most good Word Who blesses all!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
...O Mother of God, heal the affliction of my soul, who didst bear the most good Word Who blesses all!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ мт҃и бж҃їѧ, * дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ ѡ҆ѕлобле́нїе и҆сцѣлѝ, * ро́ждшаѧ пребл҃га́го сло́ва, * всѣ́хъ ᲂу҆блажа́юща.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *I will sacrifice unto Thee with the voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries aloud unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the blood that flowed for mercy's sake from Thy side.[^640]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*I will sacrifice unto Thee with the voice of praise, O Lord, the Church cries aloud unto Thee, having been cleansed from the blood of demons by the blood that flowed for mercy's sake from Thy side.[^640]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Ї҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having shone forth from Rome like an unsetting sun, Sicily, having received the body of the holy martyr, is delivered from the fierce darkness of demons!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having shone forth from Rome like an unsetting sun, Sicily, having received the body of the holy martyr, is delivered from the fierce darkness of demons!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пожрꙋ́ ти со гла́сомъ хвале́нїѧ гдⷭ҇и, * цр҃ковь вопїе́тъ тѝ, * ѿ бѣсо́вскїѧ кро́ве ѡ҆чи́щшисѧ, * ра́ди ми́лости ѿ ре́бръ твои́хъ и҆сте́кшею кро́вїю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Courageously the thrice-rich holy women martyrs, who were dead before death in the contest of martyrdom, bore thy dead, life-bearing body![^641]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Courageously the thrice-rich holy women martyrs, who were dead before death in the contest of martyrdom, bore thy dead, life-bearing body![^641]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆блиста́вшее ѿ ри́ма, * ꙗ҆́кѡ незаходи́мое сл҃нце, * сїкелі́а тѣ́ло ст҃ы́ѧ мꙋ́ченницы прїе́мши, * мра́ка де́монскагѡ и҆збавлѧ́етсѧ лю́тости.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The weapon of the enemy grew weak against thee, for like a city having no foundation didst thou cast down his pride, O Agrippina, by the toil of thy glorious contests!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The weapon of the enemy grew weak against thee, for like a city having no foundation didst thou cast down his pride, O Agrippina, by the toil of thy glorious contests!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Доблє́ственнѡ трєбога́тыѧ ст҃ы́ѧ мч҃нцы, * ꙗ҆̀же пре́жде сме́рти ᲂу҆ме́ршыѧ, * въ ᲂу҆ла́нїи мꙋче́нїа, * ᲂу҆ме́ршее твоѐ живоно́сное тѣ́ло принесо́ша.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By the touch of thy body the woman with an issue of blood is healed, and lepers are cleansed as they run with faith; and every other sickness flees away at the invocation of thy holy name, O martyr!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By the touch of thy body the woman with an issue of blood is healed, and lepers are cleansed as they run with faith; and every other sickness flees away at the invocation of thy holy name, O martyr!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: О҆рꙋ́жїе врага̀, * на тебѣ̀ и҆знемо́же, * и҆́бо ꙗ҆́кѡ гра́дъ низложи́ла є҆сѝ, * не и҆мꙋ́щь ѡ҆снова́нїа, * сегѡ̀ гордꙑ́ню, * а҆грѷпі́но, * трꙋдо́мъ сла́вныхъ подви̑гъ твои́хъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having now received the words of Gabriel, O all-immaculate Virgin, we cry aloud: Rejoice, only blessed Mother! Rejoice, gate that hast the Sun of righteousness!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having now received the words of Gabriel, O all-immaculate Virgin, we cry aloud: Rejoice, only blessed Mother! Rejoice, gate that hast the Sun of righteousness!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣлѧ́етсѧ прикоснове́нїемъ тѣ́ла твоегѡ̀, * кровоточи́ваѧ, * прокаже́ннїи ѡ҆чища́ютсѧ вѣ́рою притека́юще. * ѿбѣга́етъ же и҆ и҆́нъ всѧ́къ недꙋ́гъ, * призыва́нїемъ ст҃а́гѡ твоегѡ̀ мꙋ́ченнице и҆́мене.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 4:* *Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast appeared today" (Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 4:*
*Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast appeared today" (Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: The light-bearing day of thy radiant contests has arrived, on which the divine Church, honoring them, summons all joyfully to cry aloud unto thee: Rejoice, O virgin and martyr Agrippina, all-honorable![^642]

provenance.verbatim_source: The light-bearing day of thy radiant contests has arrived, on which the divine Church, honoring them, summons all joyfully to cry aloud unto thee: Rejoice, O virgin and martyr Agrippina, all-honorable![^642]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Гла́сы гаврїи́ла дв҃о всенепоро́чнаѧ, * ны́нѣ прїе́мше, * вопїе́мъ: * ра́дꙋйсѧ мт҃и є҆ди́на бл҃гослове́ннаѧ. * Ра́дꙋйсѧ две́ре со́лнца пра́вды и҆мꙋ́щи.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *Thou Who didst save Thy children of Abraham in the fire, and didst slay the Chaldeans whom justice righteously ensnared: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned Lord God of our fathers![^643]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*Thou Who didst save Thy children of Abraham in the fire, and didst slay the Chaldeans whom justice righteously ensnared: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned Lord God of our fathers![^643]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Like a golden dove protected by the weapon of the Cross, thou didst destroy the Hagarenes who drew near by night unto thy city, saving the faithful from their foul murder, O martyr![^644]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Like a golden dove protected by the weapon of the Cross, thou didst destroy the Hagarenes who drew near by night unto thy city, saving the faithful from their foul murder, O martyr![^644]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́тлыхъ подви́гъ твои́хъ, * свѣтоно́сный наста̀ де́нь, * во́ньже почита́ющи си́хъ бж҃е́ственнаѧ цр҃ковь, * всѧ̑ созыва́етъ ве́селѡ вопи́ти тебѣ̀: * ра́дꙋйсѧ дв҃о и҆ мч҃нце а҆грѷпі́но всечестна́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having endured manifold afflictions for the sake of Christ, O martyr, thou didst find in Him painless and immortal delight, crying: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned Lord God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having endured manifold afflictions for the sake of Christ, O martyr, thou didst find in Him painless and immortal delight, crying: Blessed art Thou, O all-hymned Lord God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Ї҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The marvelous priest, shining with the working of miracles, beholding thy wonders, O Agrippina, magnified God and rejoicing sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The marvelous priest, shining with the working of miracles, beholding thy wonders, O Agrippina, magnified God and rejoicing sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Спасы́й во ѻ҆гнѝ а҆враа́мскїѧ твоѧ̑ ѻ҆́троки, * и҆ халдє́и ᲂу҆би́въ, * ꙗ҆̀же пра́вда пра́веднѡ ᲂу҆ловлѧ́ше. * Препѣ́тый гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With steadfast purpose bearing thy steadfast body unto sufferings, thou didst in no wise perceive womanly weakness, crying: virgin unto the Master: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With steadfast purpose bearing thy steadfast body unto sufferings, thou didst in no wise perceive womanly weakness, crying:...
...virgin unto the Master: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: кг҃ де́нь
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having given birth unto God, thou dost remain a virgin after childbearing, and dost maternally nourish with milk the Nourisher of the world, as is meet, O all-immaculate one; unto Whom singing we cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Having given birth unto God, thou dost remain a virgin after childbearing, and dost maternally nourish with milk the Nourisher of the world, as is meet, O all-immaculate one; unto Whom singing we cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: дв҃а влⷣцѣ: бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *The pious children in the furnace the childbearing of the Birthgiver of God saved; then indeed prefigured, but now in actuality, it moves the whole universe to sing unto Thee: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages![^645]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*The pious children in the furnace the childbearing of the Birthgiver of God saved; then indeed prefigured, but now in actuality, it moves the whole universe to sing unto Thee: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages![^645]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Night appeared as day unto them that bore thy relics, O martyr; every place that received thee became fragrant; the demonic host was greatly driven away; drops of healings are poured forth upon them that exalt Christ unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Night appeared as day unto them that bore thy relics, O martyr; every place that received thee became fragrant; the demonic host was greatly driven away; drops of healings are poured forth upon them that exalt Christ unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ро́ждшаѧ бг҃а, * пребыва́еши по ржⷭ҇твѣ̀ дв҃ою, * и҆ млеко́мъ пита́еши мт҃рски подо́бнѡ пита́телѧ мі́ра пренепоро́чнаѧ. * Е҆мꙋ́же пою́ще зове́мъ: * бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring the immortal Bridegroom, thou didst run after His sweet odors, imitating His passions and death, O glorious martyr, and crying aloud: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Desiring the immortal Bridegroom, thou didst run after His sweet odors, imitating His passions and death, O glorious martyr, and crying aloud: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Ї҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Possessing unhesitating faith, having trimmed thy lamp with the oil of thy blood, O martyr, thou didst enter within the bridal chamber, singing the heavenly joys: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Possessing unhesitating faith, having trimmed thy lamp with the oil of thy blood, O martyr, thou didst enter within the bridal chamber, singing the heavenly joys: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: О҆́троки бл҃гочести̑выѧ въ пещѝ, * ржⷭ҇тво бг҃оро́дичо спасло́ є҆́сть. * Тогда̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ ѡ҆бразꙋ́емое, * ны́нѣ же дѣ́йствꙋемое, * вселе́нную всю̀ воздвиза́етъ пѣ́ти тебѣ̀: * гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, * и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring to behold the beauty of the Lord and to visit His temple, having mounted as upon a chariot of thine own blood, thou didst attain unto this: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Desiring to behold the beauty of the Lord and to visit His temple, having mounted as upon a chariot of thine own blood, thou didst attain unto this: Hymn the Lord, all ye works, and exalt Him above all unto ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Но́щь ꙗ҆́кѡ де́нь зрѧ́шесѧ, * носѧ́щымъ мꙋ́ченице твоѧ̑ мо́щы. * Мѣ́сто бл҃гоꙋха́шесѧ, * всѧ́ко тѧ̀ прїе́млющее: * демо́нское ѡ҆полче́нїе вельмѝ ѿго́нѧшесѧ. * И҆сцѣле́нїй и҆злива́ютсѧ ка́пли, * превозносѧ́щымъ хрⷭ҇та̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The bush which of old prefigured the strange mystery of thy childbearing remained unconsumed, O all-immaculate one; for thou didst give birth to the fire of the Godhead, and didst remain unburnt, O Maiden; therefore do we hymn thee unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The bush which of old prefigured the strange mystery of thy childbearing remained unconsumed, O all-immaculate one; for thou didst give birth to the fire of the Godhead, and didst remain unburnt, O Maiden; therefore do we hymn thee unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Жениха̀ безсме́ртнаго жела́ющи, * въ слѣ́дъ бл҃гоꙋха́нїй сегѡ̀ текла̀ є҆сѝ. * Тогѡ̀ стра́стемъ и҆ сме́рти подо́бѧщисѧ, * мꙋ́ченице сла́внаѧ, * и҆ взыва́ющи: * гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, * и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *A stone cut without hands from the unquarried mountain, even thee, O Virgin, was cut off as the cornerstone, even Christ Who joined together the parted natures; therefore rejoicing do we magnify thee, O Birthgiver of God![^646]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
*A stone cut without hands from the unquarried mountain, even thee, O Virgin, was cut off as the cornerstone, even Christ Who joined together the parted natures; therefore rejoicing do we magnify thee, O Birthgiver of God![^646]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Несꙋмнѣ́ннꙋ и҆мꙋ́щи вѣ́рꙋ, * є҆ле́емъ просвѣ́трши крове́й твои́хъ, * мч҃нце свѣщꙋ̀ твою̀. * Внꙋ́трь вошла̀ є҆сѝ черто́га, * пою́щи, * нбⷭ҇ныѧ ра́дости: * гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, * и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By the nodding of Him Who creates all things, Agathonica, together with Bassa and Paula, earnestly hastening to the end of martyrdom, as truly befriended, found the summit of desire![^647]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By the nodding of Him Who creates all things, Agathonica, together with Bassa and Paula, earnestly hastening to the end of martyrdom, as truly befriended, found the summit of desire![^647]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Ви́дѣти красотꙋ̀ гдⷭ҇ню, * сегѡ́же цр҃ковь посѣща́ти жела́ющи, * ꙗ҆́кѡ на колесни́цѣ кро́ве своеѧ̀ взе́мшисѧ по́кщи, * къ семꙋ̀ дости́гла є҆сѝ: * гдⷭ҇а по́йте дѣла̀, * и҆ превозноси́те є҆го̀ во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having taken up thy dwelling in the heavenly bridal chambers, O virgin, and contemplating unseen beauties, receiving divine splendor, make things bright for them that hymn thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having taken up thy dwelling in the heavenly bridal chambers, O virgin, and contemplating unseen beauties, receiving divine splendor, make things bright for them that hymn thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A crown of graces was placed upon thy head, O Agrippina, for thou didst finish thy course and keep the faith faith unstolen; and the ranks of the righteous beautifully received thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
A crown of graces was placed upon thy head, O Agrippina, for thou didst finish thy course and keep the faith...
...faith unstolen; and the ranks of the righteous beautifully received thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: мцⷭ҇ъ і҆ꙋ́нїй
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As thou standest before the Creator and Master with boldness, O martyr Agrippina, together with all the saints from of old, ask forgiveness of transgressions for them that hymn thee, O good virgin!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
As thou standest before the Creator and Master with boldness, O martyr Agrippina, together with all the saints from of old, ask forgiveness of transgressions for them that hymn thee, O good virgin!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 23rd Day:
items.slavonic_text: вѣ́рꙋ соблю́дшей некра́домꙋ, * и҆ пра́ведныхъ чи́нове, * кра́снѡ тѧ̀ прїѧ́ша.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Carrying in thy hands Him Who upholds all things, maternally as is meet, O Virgin Mary: deliver me from the hands of the combatant, that, being saved, I may hymn thy majesty!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Carrying in thy hands Him Who upholds all things, maternally as is meet, O Virgin Mary: deliver me from the hands of the combatant, that, being saved, I may hymn thy majesty!

items.section: At Little Vespers, stichera on 4, Tone 4:*[^648]
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 24th Day: The Nativity of the Honorable and Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist John:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о:
items.english_text: *At Little Vespers, stichera on 4, Tone 4:*[^648]

provenance.verbatim_source: *At Little Vespers, stichera on 4, Tone 4:*[^648]

items.section: At Little Vespers, stichera on 4, Tone 4:*[^648]
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 24th Day: The Nativity of the Honorable and Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist John:
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же, въ к҃д де́нь. Ржⷭ҇тво̀, честна́гѡ сла́внагѡ, прⷪ҇ро́ка предте́чи, и҆ крⷭ҇ти́телѧ і҆ѡа́нна.
items.english_text: Thou wast born of a barren womb, having loosed the barrenness of our hearts, and granting the word of fruitful children in faith and truth unto barren souls, O glorious forerunner of the coming of Christ; the well-signifying voice of the Word, the loud-voiced foreteller of repentance, the divine mediator of the Old and New, manifestly recognized; whose nativity we celebrate with love, rejoicing![^649] *(Twice)*

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou wast born of a barren womb, having loosed the barrenness of our hearts, and granting the word of fruitful children in faith and truth unto barren souls, O glorious forerunner of the coming of Christ; the well-signifying voice of the Word, the loud-voiced foreteller of repentance, the divine mediator of the Old and New, manifestly recognized; whose nativity we celebrate with love, rejoicing![^649] *(Twice)*

items.section: At Little Vespers, stichera on 4, Tone 4:*[^648]
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 24th Day: The Nativity of the Honorable and Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist John:
items.slavonic_text: На ма́лѣй вече́рни, стїхи̑ры на д҃, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Зва́нный свы́ше:
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Now the fatted calf of self-control is born of the barren woman, showing unto us the Lamb born of the Virgin Maiden, Who takes away the sins of the world; the desert-loving turtledove has manifestly shone forth, announcing the divine spring, whereby the fierce winter of godlessness has ceased; and the close friend of the Bridegroom, John, has come radiantly, praying that our souls may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*

items.section: At Little Vespers, stichera on 4, Tone 4:*[^648]
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 24th Day: The Nativity of the Honorable and Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist John:
items.slavonic_text: И҆з̾ непло́дныѧ роди́лсѧ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆тро́бы, * разрѣши́вый непло́дїе срⷣцъ на́шихъ, * и҆ бл҃гоча́дїе въ вѣ́рѣ же и҆ и҆́стиннѣ * дꙋша́мъ непло́днымъ сло́во да́рꙋѧ, * сла́вный прⷪ҇те́че прише́ствїа хрⷭ҇то́ва: * гла́съ сло́ва бл҃гознамени́тый, * покаѧ́нїа прознамена́тель велегла́сный: * ве́тхагѡ же и҆ но́вагѡ бж҃е́ственный хода́тай, * ꙗ҆́вѣ познава́емь: * є҆гѡ́же ржⷭ҇тво̀ * любо́вїю пра́зднꙋемъ веселѧ́щесѧ. Два́жды.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Thou who wast born according to the divine promise: when the most marvelous and great Archangel in the temple announced thy birth unto thy father as he prayed, then unto the priest who did not believe and contradicted, as it is written, Gabriel brought speechless silence and deafness until the birth; but thou, O forerunner, having been born of thy father, didst loose the bond of his tongue, O blessed one, and dost pray for us all![^650]

provenance.verbatim_source:
