items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Нечи́стыми ꙋ҆стна́ми и҆ скве́рными, пречⷭ҇таѧ дв҃ы, всечⷭ҇тагѡ тѧ̀ сро́дника бл҃же́нне молю̀, нечи́стый и҆ скве́рный, и҆ ѻ҆каѧ́нный са́мъ сы́й, ѡ҆мы́й тѣ́ло, ѡ҆чи́сти дх҃ъ: и҆ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ѡ҆ст҃ѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With unclean and defiled lips do I, that am myself unclean, defiled, and wretched, entreat thee, the all-honorable kinsman of the all-pure Virgin, O blessed one: wash my body, cleanse my spirit, and sanctify my soul![^787]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With unclean and defiled lips do I, that am myself unclean, defiled, and wretched, entreat thee, the all-honorable kinsman of the all-pure Virgin, O blessed one: wash my body, cleanse my spirit, and sanctify my soul![^787]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Черто́га нбⷭ҇нагѡ таи́нниче, жениха̀ хрⷭ҇та̀ дрꙋ́же и҆́скреннїй: стоѧ́й и҆ гла́съ слы́ша ра́достный женихо́въ досто́йнѣ. покажѝ бл҃га́гѡ гла́са и҆ менѐ, со блгⷭ҇слове́нными наслѣ́дника црⷭ҇твїѧ, бг҃ꙋ зовꙋ́щꙋ въ наслѣ́дїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O initiate of the heavenly bridal chamber, true friend of the Bridegroom Christ, standing and worthily hearing the joyful voice of the Bridegroom: show me also to be a hearer of that good voice, an heir of the Kingdom with the blessed, when God summons unto the inheritance![^788]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
O initiate of the heavenly bridal chamber, true friend of the Bridegroom Christ, standing and worthily hearing the joyful voice of the Bridegroom: show me also to be a hearer of that good voice, an heir of the Kingdom with the blessed, when God summons unto the inheritance![^788]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пречⷭ҇таѧ дв҃о мт҃и бж҃їа, невеще́ственнѡ пала́ющаго ꙋ҆́глѧ, ве́щь дꙋшы́мѧ ѡ҆дꙋшевлѐнна, клеща̀ серафі́мскаѧ, и҆ пламеноно́сный престо́ле, носи́маго херꙋві́мы, ве́щь дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ ѻ҆гне́мъ невеще́ственнымъ попалѝ, и҆ негаси́магѡ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* ...O all-pure Virgin Mother of God, animate tongs of the immaterially burning Coal,[^789] and flame-bearing throne of Him Who is borne by the Cherubim: burn up the matter of my soul with the immaterial fire, and deliver me from the unquenchable fire![^790]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
...O all-pure Virgin Mother of God, animate tongs of the immaterially burning Coal,[^789] and flame-bearing throne of Him Who is borne by the Cherubim: burn up the matter of my soul with the immaterial fire, and deliver me from the unquenchable fire![^790]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́мъ бесѣ́довавши на́гимъ ѻ҆у҆мо́мъ, феврѡ́нїе бг҃омꙋ́драѧ, попра́ла є҆сѝ жела̑нїѧ до конца̀, и҆ кончи́нꙋ бл҃же́ннꙋю полꙋчи́ти сподо́биласѧ є҆сѝ: и҆ ны́нѣ црⷭ҇твꙋеши со хрⷭ҇то́мъ, свѣ́тлѡ съ твои́мъ женихо́мъ, въ неизрече́нныхъ черто́зѣхъ въ весе́лїи пребыва́ющи.
items.english_text: O divine dove of the Master, gilded with childish radiance, having enlightened thy body by fasting, gilded on thy wings with gold-like flashes of thy confession and of thy divine blood: enlighten them that hymn thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: O divine dove of the Master, gilded with childish radiance, having enlightened thy body by fasting, gilded on thy wings with gold-like flashes of thy confession and of thy divine blood: enlighten them that hymn thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́нїа и҆сточа́еши ꙗ҆́кѡ рѣ́ки, вѣ́рою притека́ющымъ къ твое́й честнѣ́й ра́цѣ, феврѡ́нїе бг҃ови́днаѧ, дѣ́вства столпъ, цвѣ́тъ є҆стества̀ кра́сенъ, дщѝ цр҃е́ва, ꙗ҆́же внꙋ́трь и҆мꙋ́щи бж҃ественныѧ сла́вы бл҃же́нство.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having conversed in mind with bare intellect, O God-wise Febronia, thou didst trample desires down unto the end, and wast accounted worthy to obtain a blessed end; and now thou reignest with Christ, radiantly with thy Bridegroom, abiding in gladness in ineffable bridal chambers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having conversed in mind with bare intellect, O God-wise Febronia, thou didst trample desires down unto the end, and wast accounted worthy to obtain a blessed end; and now thou reignest with Christ, radiantly with thy Bridegroom, abiding in gladness in ineffable bridal chambers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆спра́вила є҆сѝ дв҃о же́нъ поползнове́нїе, сло́ва ро́ждши, горѣ̀ воздви́жꙋщаго низпа́дшыѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃га, и҆ держа́внаго си́лахъ: є҆гѡ́же феврѡ́нїа сла́внаѧ, вожделѣ́вши ꙋ҆се́рднѡ, во слѣ́дъ тебѐ потечѐ, ра́дꙋющисѧ возопи́ла є҆́сть.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou pourest forth healings like rivers unto them that run with faith unto thy precious reliquary, O God-like Febronia, pillar of virginity, fair flower of nature, king's daughter, having within the blessedness of divine glory![^791]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou pourest forth healings like rivers unto them that run with faith unto thy precious reliquary, O God-like Febronia, pillar of virginity, fair flower of nature, king's daughter, having within the blessedness of divine glory![^791]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ленъ. Подо́бенъ: Жєны̀ ꙋ҆слы́шите: Прⷮе́чево дне́сь ра́достотво́рное рожде́нїе, сѣтова́нїе рѣши́тъ ѻ҆́тча безгла́сїѧ, и҆ ро́ждшїѧ непло́дство, возвѣща́етъ же настоѧ́щꙋю ра́дость и҆ весе́лїе: тѣ́мже и҆ всѧ̀ тва́рь свѣ́тлѡ того̀ пра́зднꙋетъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst right the stumbling of women, O Virgin, having given birth unto the Word, Who raises up on high them that have fallen, as He is good and mighty in powers; Whom glorious Febronia having fervently desired, ran after thee, and rejoicing cried aloud!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thou didst right the stumbling of women, O Virgin, having given birth unto the Word, Who raises up on high them that have fallen, as He is good and mighty in powers; Whom glorious Febronia having fervently desired, ran after thee, and rejoicing cried aloud!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Премꙋ́дрость ѵ҆поста́снꙋю, и҆ сло́во пресꙋ́щное, и҆ врача̀ дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣле́съ ро́ждшаѧ, гное́нїѧ и҆ ра́ны дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ и҆сцѣлѝ лю̑тыѧ и҆ време́нныѧ, и҆ се́рдца моегѡ̀ ꙋ҆ставѝ болѣ́зни дв҃о.
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "Hear, ye women" (Жєны̀ ꙋ҆слы́шите):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Exapostilarion:*
*Tone 2, Podoben: "Hear, ye women" (Жєны̀ ꙋ҆слы́шите):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ стїхи̑ры ѻ҆ктѡ́иха: Сла́ва, гла́съ, в҃: И҆́же ѿ прⷪ҇ро́ка прⷪ҇ро́ка, и҆ непло́днымъ прозѧбе́нїе: бг҃орожде́нныхъ жена́ми превы́шша всѣ́хъ: пꙋсты́ннаго граждани́на, і҆ѡа́нна сла́внаго, ѱалмы̑ и҆ пѣ́ньми и҆ пѣ́сньми дх҃о́вными восхва́лимъ, вопїю́ще къ немꙋ̀: крⷭ҇ти́телю сп҃совъ, и҆ прⷮе́че, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆мы́ѧ дерзнове́нїе, въ честне́мъ твое́мъ ржⷭ҇твѣ̀, ꙋ҆молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ дарова́ти ми́ръ мі́рꙋ, и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: The joyful birth of the forerunner today looses the sorrow of the father's speechlessness and the mother's barrenness, and announces present joy and gladness; therefore does all creation celebrate it brightly![^792]

provenance.verbatim_source: The joyful birth of the forerunner today looses the sorrow of the father's speechlessness and the mother's barrenness, and announces present joy and gladness; therefore does all creation celebrate it brightly![^792]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O thou that didst bear the hypostatic Wisdom, the transcendent Word, and the Physician of souls and bodies: heal the festering sores and wounds of my soul, grievous and temporal, and calm the pains of my heart, O Virgin![^793]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O thou that didst bear the hypostatic Wisdom, the transcendent Word, and the Physician of souls and bodies: heal the festering sores and wounds of my soul, grievous and temporal, and calm the pains of my heart, O Virgin![^793]

items.section: At the Aposticha, stichera from the Octoechos
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: The prophet from a prophet, the offspring of the barren woman, the highest of all born of women, the citizen of the wilderness, glorious John, let us praise with psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, crying unto him: O baptizer of the Savior and forerunner, having boldness in thine honorable nativity, entreat Christ to grant peace unto the world, and great mercy unto our souls![^794]

provenance.verbatim_source: The prophet from a prophet, the offspring of the barren woman, the highest of all born of women, the citizen of the wilderness, glorious John, let us praise with psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, crying unto him: O baptizer of the Savior and forerunner, having boldness in thine honorable nativity, entreat Christ to grant peace unto the world, and great mercy unto our souls![^794]

items.section: At the Aposticha, stichera from the Octoechos
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же, въ к҃ѕ де́нь. Прпⷣбнагѡ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ на́шегѡ дв҃да и҆́же въ селꙋ́нѣ. Стїхи̑ры, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Пресла́внагѡ чꙋдесѐ: О́тче даві́де всеблаже́нне, * воздержа́нїемъ ꙋ҆́мъ просвѣ́щь и҆зря́днѡ, * къ перворивно́вномꙋ до́брыхъ впери́лсѧ є҆сѝ. * И҆ сто́лпъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ свѣтови́денъ, * просвѣща́ѧ всѣ́хъ словесы̀ и҆ чꙋдесы̀, * пристꙋпа́ющихъ къ тебѣ̀, * ра́зꙋмомъ всегда̀ бг҃олѣ́пнымъ. * Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ * почита́емъ и҆ ꙋ҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: Beholding Thee nailed unto the wood of the Cross, O Jesus, the unwedded Maiden, weeping, said: O sweet Child, why hast Thou left me alone that gave Thee birth, O unapproachable Light of the pre-unoriginate Father? Hasten and be glorified, that they who glorify Thy divine passions may receive divine glory![^795]

provenance.verbatim_source: Beholding Thee nailed unto the wood of the Cross, O Jesus, the unwedded Maiden, weeping, said: O sweet Child, why hast Thou left me alone that gave Thee birth, O unapproachable Light of the pre-unoriginate Father? Hasten and be glorified, that they who glorify Thy divine passions may receive divine glory![^795]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, ѕ҃: Преподо́бне ѻ҆́тче, во всю̀ зе́млю и҆зы́де вѣща́нїе и҆справле́нїй твои́хъ: тѣ́мъ на нб҃сѣ́хъ ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ мздꙋ̀ трꙋдѡ́въ твои́хъ, де́мѡнскїѧ погꙋби́лъ є҆сѝ полкѝ, и҆ а҆́гг҃льскїѧ дости́глъ є҆сѝ
items.english_text: O all-blessed father David, having pre-eminently enlightened thine intellect by self-control, thou didst take wing unto the Primal Cause of good things; and thou wast shown forth as a light-bearing pillar, enlightening all that approach thee with words and wonders, with an understanding ever God-befitting; therefore do we honor and bless thee![^803]

provenance.verbatim_source: O all-blessed father David, having pre-eminently enlightened thine intellect by self-control, thou didst take wing unto the Primal Cause of good things; and thou wast shown forth as a light-bearing pillar, enlightening all that approach thee with words and wonders, with an understanding ever God-befitting; therefore do we honor and bless thee![^803]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, ѕ҃: Преподо́бне ѻ҆́тче, во всю̀ зе́млю и҆зы́де вѣща́нїе и҆справле́нїй твои́хъ: тѣ́мъ на нб҃сѣ́хъ ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ мздꙋ̀ трꙋдѡ́въ твои́хъ, де́мѡнскїѧ погꙋби́лъ є҆сѝ полкѝ, и҆ а҆́гг҃льскїѧ дости́глъ є҆сѝ
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Like a sweet-singing bird in the ascent of an orchard, thou didst pitch a shelter, O father, frozen by cold and scorched by heat; whence thou didst receive the golden wings of impassibility and perfection, and didst fly up unto the height on high, ever praying for us who praise thee![^804]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Like a sweet-singing bird in the ascent of an orchard, thou didst pitch a shelter, O father, frozen by cold and scorched by heat; whence thou didst receive the golden wings of impassibility and perfection, and didst fly up unto the height on high, ever praying for us who praise thee![^804]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, ѕ҃: Преподо́бне ѻ҆́тче, во всю̀ зе́млю и҆зы́де вѣща́нїе и҆справле́нїй твои́хъ: тѣ́мъ на нб҃сѣ́хъ ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ мздꙋ̀ трꙋдѡ́въ твои́хъ, де́мѡнскїѧ погꙋби́лъ є҆сѝ полкѝ, и҆ а҆́гг҃льскїѧ дости́глъ є҆сѝ
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Having burned up the carnal pleasures with the divine coal of impassibility, thou didst remain unburnt; holding the coal upon thy hand before the emperor's face, O God-inspired and venerable one, he marveled at thy radiance; therefore a great petition was granted unto thee by God, having acquired thee as an intercessor through grace, O blessed one![^805]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Having burned up the carnal pleasures with the divine coal of impassibility, thou didst remain unburnt; holding the coal upon thy hand before the emperor's face, O God-inspired and venerable one, he marveled at thy radiance; therefore a great petition was granted unto thee by God, having acquired thee as an intercessor through grace, O blessed one![^805]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, ѕ҃: Преподо́бне ѻ҆́тче, во всю̀ зе́млю и҆зы́де вѣща́нїе и҆справле́нїй твои́хъ: тѣ́мъ на нб҃сѣ́хъ ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ мздꙋ̀ трꙋдѡ́въ твои́хъ, де́мѡнскїѧ погꙋби́лъ є҆сѝ полкѝ, и҆ а҆́гг҃льскїѧ дости́глъ є҆сѝ
items.english_text: Venerable father, into all the earth went forth the report of thy right deeds; therefore in the heavens hast thou found the reward of thy labors; thou didst destroy the hosts of demons, and didst attain unto the angelic ranks: whose blameless life thou didst emulate; having boldness unto Christ God, ask peace for our souls![^806]

provenance.verbatim_source:
Venerable father, into all the earth went forth the report of thy right deeds; therefore in the heavens hast thou found the reward of thy labors; thou didst destroy the hosts of demons, and didst attain unto the angelic...
...ranks: whose blameless life thou didst emulate; having boldness unto Christ God, ask peace for our souls![^806]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ ѻ҆ктѡ́иха. Сла́ва, гла́съ, и҃: Мона́хѡвъ мно́жества наста́вника тѧ̀ почита́емъ ѻ҆́ч҃е на́шъ дв҃де: твое́ю бо стезѐю воисти́ннꙋ пра́вѡ ходи́ти позна́хомъ: бл҃же́нъ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ рабо́тавъ, и҆ вра́жїю ѡ҆бличи́лъ є҆сѝ си́лꙋ, а҆́гг҃лѡвъ собесѣ́дниче, прпⷣбныхъ соприча́стниче и҆ првⷣныхъ. съ ни́миже моли́сѧ гдⷭ҇ви, поми́ловатисѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Meditating upon Thy seedless conception and ineffable birth, I marvel greatly: how hast Thou thus, as an evildoer, been well pleased to die, O my Son? the all-pure one, weeping, cried aloud.[^807]

provenance.verbatim_source: Meditating upon Thy seedless conception and ineffable birth, I marvel greatly: how hast Thou thus, as an evildoer, been well pleased to die, O my Son? the all-pure one, weeping, cried aloud.[^807]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, творе́нїе і҆ѡ́сифово. Е҆гѡ́же краегране́сїе: Пою̀ бл҃же́нне твоѐ житїѐ бж҃е́ственными словесы̀. Гла́съ, є҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. і҆рмо́съ: Конѧ̀ и҆ вса́дника въ мо́ре чермно́е, сокрꙋша́ѧй бра̑ни, мы́шцею высо́кою, хрⷭ҇то́съ и҆стрѧсѐ, і҆и҃лѧ же спасѐ, побѣ́днꙋю пѣ́снь пою́ща.
items.english_text: The multitudes of monastics honor thee as instructor, our father David; for by thy path have we truly learned to walk uprightly; blessed art thou, having labored for Christ, and having exposed the power of the enemy, converser with angels, companion of the venerable and the righteous; with them pray unto the Lord, that our souls may be saved![^808]

provenance.verbatim_source: The multitudes of monastics honor thee as instructor, our father David; for by thy path have we truly learned to walk uprightly; blessed art thou, having labored for Christ, and having exposed the power of the enemy, converser with angels, companion of the venerable and the righteous; with them pray unto the Lord, that our souls may be saved![^808]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́ньми свѣтоно́снꙋю, и҆ бж҃твеннꙋю па́мѧть твою̀, соше́дшесѧ почти́мъ дв҃де пребл҃же́нне: свѣ́та позна́вше тѧ̀ и҆ днѐ преподо́бне наслѣ́дника, бж҃твеннымъ дх҃омъ.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* *Tone 8, Podoben: "O marvelous wonder" (Ѡ҆ пресла́внагѡ чꙋдесѐ):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
*Tone 8, Podoben: "O marvelous wonder" (Ѡ҆ пресла́внагѡ чꙋдесѐ):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́ды ꙋ҆мертви́въ ѻ҆́ч҃е на землѝ тѣле́сныѧ, жи́знь все́льшꙋюсѧ въ се́рдцы и҆мѣ́лъ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇та̀, ꙋ҆мори́вшагѡ дїа́вола си́лꙋ, ꙋ҆мертви́вшагѡ чл҃вѣ́чество.
items.english_text: The undefiled heifer, seeing the Calf willingly nailed upon the Tree, bitterly lamenting, cried out: Woe is me, O most beloved Child! What hath the thankless Hebrew assembly rendered unto Thee, desiring to leave me childless and bereaved of Thee, O most beloved One?[^809]

provenance.verbatim_source: The undefiled heifer, seeing the Calf willingly nailed upon the Tree, bitterly lamenting, cried out: Woe is me, O most beloved Child! What hath the thankless Hebrew assembly rendered unto Thee, desiring to leave me childless and bereaved of Thee, O most beloved One?[^809]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Зако́нѡмъ влⷣки повиновꙋ́ѧсѧ прпⷣбне, крⷭ҇тъ тво́й на ра́мо взѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ стопа́мъ сегѡ̀ послѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ, возноше́нїѧ лю́тагѡ, смири́въ врага̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 8:* In thee, O father, was preserved with certainty that which is according to the image; for taking up the cross, thou didst follow Christ, and by deed didst teach to despise indeed the flesh, for it passes away, but to care for the soul, an immortal thing; therefore with the angels rejoices thy spirit, O venerable David![^810]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion, Tone 8:*
In thee, O father, was preserved with certainty that which is according to the image; for taking up the cross, thou didst follow Christ, and by deed didst teach to despise indeed the flesh, for it passes away, but to care for the soul, an immortal thing; therefore with the angels rejoices thy spirit, O venerable David![^810]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With hymns having assembled, let us honor thy light-bearing and divine memory, O David most blessed, having known thee by the Divine Spirit as an heir of light and of the day, O venerable one!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With hymns having assembled, let us honor thy light-bearing and divine memory, O David most blessed, having known thee by the Divine Spirit as an heir of light and of the day, O venerable one!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having mortified thy bodily members upon earth, O father, thou didst have dwelling in thy heart the Life, Christ, Who destroyed the power of the devil that had put humanity to death!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having mortified thy bodily members upon earth, O father, thou didst have dwelling in thy heart the Life, Christ, Who destroyed the power of the devil that had put humanity to death!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Submitting unto the laws of the Master, O venerable one, thou didst take thy cross upon thy shoulder, and didst follow His footsteps, having humbled the haughtiness of the grievous enemy.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Submitting unto the laws of the Master, O venerable one, thou didst take thy cross upon thy shoulder, and didst follow His footsteps, having humbled the haughtiness of the grievous enemy.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ ꙋ҆кра́шена добро́тою добродѣ́телей, и҆ хрⷭ҇та̀ кра́снаго дв҃о породи́ла є҆сѝ, человѣ́ки ꙋ҆краси́вшаго кра́сными добро́тами бж҃ества̀, приснодв҃о.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst appear adorned with the beauty of virtues, and didst bear the fair Christ, O Virgin, Who adorned men with the fair beauties of the Godhead, O Ever-virgin.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thou didst appear adorned with the beauty of virtues, and didst bear the fair Christ, O Virgin, Who adorned men with the fair beauties of the Godhead, O Ever-virgin.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. і҆рмо́съ: Водрꙋзи́вый на ничесо́мже зе́млю повелѣ́нїемъ твои́мъ, и҆ повѣ́сивый неѡдержи́мѡ тѧготѣ́ющꙋю, на недви́жимемъ хрⷭ҇тѐ ка́мени за́повѣдей твои́хъ, цр҃ковь твою̀ ꙋ҆твердѝ є҆ди́не бл҃же, и҆ чл҃вѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *Thou Who didst establish the earth upon nothing by Thy command, and didst suspend it gravitationally unsupported: upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments establish Thy Church, O Christ, Who alone art good and the Lover of mankind![^814]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
*Thou Who didst establish the earth upon nothing by Thy command, and didst suspend it gravitationally unsupported: upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments establish Thy Church, O Christ, Who alone art good and the Lover of mankind![^814]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆вѧди́въ воздержа́нїемъ добро́тꙋ тѣле́снꙋю, зарю̀ прїѧ́лъ бж҃твеннагѡ дх҃а, и҆ безстра́стїа свѣтоза́рными ѡ҆блиста́лъ є҆сѝ лꙋча́ми, и҆ и҆сцѣле́нїй дарова́нїа ѻ҆́ч҃е, проро́кꙋ тезоимени́те.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having withered bodily beauty by self-control, thou didst receive the radiance of the Divine Spirit, and didst shine forth with the light-beaming rays of impassibility and gifts of healings, O father namesake of the prophet![^815]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having withered bodily beauty by self-control, thou didst receive the radiance of the Divine Spirit, and didst shine forth with the light-beaming rays of impassibility and gifts of healings, O father namesake of the prophet![^815]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃ы́хъ послѣ́дꙋѧ житїю̀ пребога́те, ве́сь ѡ҆ст҃и́лсѧ є҆сѝ бж҃е́ственными дѣѧ́нїи. тѣ́мже ѡ҆свѧща́еши та́йнѡ, вѣ́рою ст҃ое соверша́ющыѧ твоѐ торжество̀, ѻ҆́ч҃е бг҃оно́се, всебл҃же́нне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Following the life of the saints, O most rich one, thou wast wholly sanctified by divine actions; therefore dost thou mystically sanctify them that celebrate thy holy festival in faith, O God-bearing father, most blessed!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Following the life of the saints, O most rich one, thou wast wholly sanctified by divine actions; therefore dost thou mystically sanctify them that celebrate thy holy festival in faith, O God-bearing father, most blessed!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆спи́въ сла̑сти тѣле́сныѧ прпⷣбне, моли́твами и҆ бдѣ́нїи, и҆ по́двиги ѻ҆́ч҃е, въ ми́рѣ вои́стиннꙋ ꙋ҆сну́въ почи́лъ є҆сѝ. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ неꙋсы́пна стѧжа́хомъ храни́телѧ, любо́вїю чтꙋ́щїи тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having put the carnal pleasures to sleep, O venerable one, by prayers and vigils and struggles, O father, having fallen asleep in truth in peace, thou didst rest; therefore have we that honor thee with love acquired thee as an unsleeping guardian!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having put the carnal pleasures to sleep, O venerable one, by prayers and vigils and struggles, O father, having fallen asleep in truth in peace, thou didst rest; therefore have we that honor thee with love acquired thee as an unsleeping guardian!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: А҆́гг҃лѡвъ чтнѣ́йши ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ, ро́ждши тѣ́хъ дв҃о созда́телѧ. тѣ́мъ молю́ тѧ чи́стаѧ, ѡ҆ст҃ѝ ꙋ҆́мъ мо́й, и҆ се́рдце просвѣтѝ, ѻ҆́блакъ страсте́й ѿгонѧ́щи.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* More honorable than the angels hast thou appeared, O Virgin, having given birth unto their Creator; therefore I pray thee, O pure one: sanctify my mind and enlighten my heart, driving away the cloud of passions!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
More honorable than the angels hast thou appeared, O Virgin, having given birth unto their Creator; therefore I pray thee, O pure one: sanctify my mind and enlighten my heart, driving away the cloud of passions!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Премꙋ́дрости: Воздержа́нїемъ, стра̑сти плотскїѧ, дꙋшѝ повинꙋ́въ ѻ҆́ч҃е мꙋ́дре, ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ бл҃же́нне съ тѣ́ломъ а҆́гг҃лъ: сѣ́нь же водрꙋзи́лъ є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ пти́ца бл҃гопѣ́снива на садо́внѣ древѣ̀, на высотꙋ̀ ꙋ҆́мъ впери́лъ є҆сѝ. Тѣ́мже чꙋде́съ дѣ́йствомъ ѡ҆богати́всѧ, преше́лъ є҆сѝ ко гдⷭ҇ꙋ, є҆го́же ѿ младе́нства возлюби́лъ є҆сѝ, дв҃де пресла́вне. Молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, грѣхѡ́въ ѡ҆ставле́нїе пода́ти чтꙋ́щымъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Премꙋ́дрости):* By self-control having subjected the carnal passions unto the soul, O wise father, thou didst appear as an angel with a body, O blessed one; and having pitched a shelter like a sweet-singing bird upon an orchard tree, thou didst wing thine intellect unto the height; therefore enriched by the operation of wonders, thou didst pass over unto the Lord Whom thou didst love from infancy, O most glorious David; pray unto Christ God to grant forgiveness of sins unto them that honor thee![^816]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 8, Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Премꙋ́дрости):*
By self-control having subjected the carnal passions unto the soul, O wise father, thou didst appear as an angel with a body, O blessed one; and having pitched a shelter like a sweet-singing bird upon an orchard tree, thou didst wing thine intellect unto the height; therefore enriched by the operation of wonders, thou didst pass over unto the Lord Whom thou didst love from infancy, O most glorious David; pray unto Christ God to grant forgiveness of sins unto them that honor thee![^816]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: Having fallen into many-entangled temptations, buffeted by the tempest of visible and invisible enemies and of mine unnumbered transgressions, and as unto my fervent protection and shelter, O pure one, I run unto the harbor of thy goodness; therefore, O all-pure one, unto Him Who was incarnate of thee without seed pray fervently for all thy servants who unceasingly pray unto thee, O all-pure Birthgiver of God, praying Him ever to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto them that worthily sing thy glory![^817]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having fallen into many-entangled temptations, buffeted by the tempest of visible and invisible enemies and of mine unnumbered transgressions, and as unto my fervent protection and shelter, O pure one, I run unto the harbor of thy goodness; therefore, O all-pure one, unto Him Who was incarnate of thee without seed pray fervently for all thy servants who unceasingly pray unto thee, O all-pure Birthgiver of God, praying Him ever to grant forgiveness of transgressions unto them that worthily sing thy glory![^817]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: А҆́гнца и҆ па́стырѧ и҆ и҆зба́вителѧ, а҆́гница зрѧ́щи на крⷭ҇тѣ̀, восклица́ше пла́чꙋщи, и҆ го́рькѡ рыда́ющи, вопїѧ́ше: мі́ръ ꙋ҆́бѡ ра́дꙋетсѧ прїе́млѧ тобо́ю и҆збавле́нїе: ꙋ҆тро́ба же моѧ̀ гори́тъ зрѧ́щи твоѐ распѧ́тїе, є҆́же те́рпиши за млⷭ҇р́дїе мл҃ти, долготерпѣли́ве гдⷭ҇и, ми́лости бе́здно, и҆ и҆сто́чниче неисчерпа́емый, ꙋ҆млⷭ҇рдисѧ и҆ да́рꙋй согрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе, вѣ́рою пою́щымъ бж҃твенныѧ стра̑сти твоѧ̑.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding the Lamb and Shepherd and Deliverer upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb cried aloud weeping, and bitterly lamenting, cried: The world indeed rejoices, receiving redemption through Thee; but my womb burns, beholding Thy crucifixion which Thou endurest out of tender mercy of compassion, O longsuffering Lord, Abyss of mercy and unemptying Fountain! Have compassion and grant remission of transgressions unto them that with faith hymn Thy divine passions![^818]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
Beholding the Lamb and Shepherd and Deliverer upon the Cross, the Ewe-lamb cried aloud weeping, and bitterly lamenting, cried: The world indeed rejoices, receiving redemption through Thee; but my womb burns, beholding Thy crucifixion which Thou endurest out of tender mercy of compassion, O longsuffering Lord, Abyss of mercy and unemptying Fountain! Have compassion and grant remission of transgressions unto them that with faith hymn Thy divine passions![^818]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. і҆рмо́съ: Бж҃е́ственное твоѐ разꙋмѣ́въ и҆стоща́нїе, прозорли́вѡ а҆ввакꙋ́мъ, хрⷭ҇тѐ со тре́петомъ вопїѧ́ше тебѣ̀: во сп҃се́нїе люде́й твои́хъ, спастѝ пома̑занныѧ твоѧ̑ прише́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *Perceiving Thy divine emptying beforehand, O Christ, Habakkuk cried trembling unto Thee: For the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed, art Thou come![^819]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*Perceiving Thy divine emptying beforehand, O Christ, Habakkuk cried trembling unto Thee: For the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed, art Thou come![^819]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Гла́въ живото́чныхъ дх҃а послꙋ́шавъ, сла́ное житїѧ̀ ѡ҆ста́вль мо́ре, и҆ ка́плями сле́зъ, стрꙋ́ти и҆зсꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ пото́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having listened unto the life-flowing voices of the Spirit, having left behind the salty sea of life, with the drops of thy tears thou didst dry up the streams of passions![^820]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having listened unto the life-flowing voices of the Spirit, having left behind the salty sea of life, with the drops of thy tears thou didst dry up the streams of passions![^820]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ра́зꙋма и҆ блгⷣти и҆спо́лненъ бы́въ, ѻ҆́ч҃е дв҃де: въ безмо́лвїи поиска́лъ є҆сѝ бл҃годѣ́телѧ всѣ́хъ, и҆ сегѡ̀ сїѧ́нїа полꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having been filled with understanding and grace, O father David, in stillness didst thou seek the Benefactor of all, and didst receive His illuminations![^821]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having been filled with understanding and grace, O father David, in stillness didst thou seek the Benefactor of all, and didst receive His illuminations![^821]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Житїѐ твоѐ нꙋ́ждею є҆стества̀, свѣ́тлѡ показа́въ, и҆ содѣ́йствїемъ дх҃а ѿ нꙋ́ждъ ѕло́бныхъ чл҃вѣ́ки и҆зба́вилъ є҆сѝ преподо́бне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having radiantly shown forth thy life beyond the constraint of nature, by the co-operation of the Spirit thou didst deliver men from grievous distresses, O venerable one![^822]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having radiantly shown forth thy life beyond the constraint of nature, by the co-operation of the Spirit thou didst deliver men from grievous distresses, O venerable one![^822]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Пое́мъ тѧ̀ всепѣ́таѧ влⷣчце, препѣ́таго бг҃а несказа́ннѡ ро́ждшꙋю, и҆ ли́ки а҆́гг҃льскїа несравни́тельнѡ добро́тою преше́дшꙋю.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We sing of thee, O all-hymned Sovereign Lady, who didst ineffably give birth unto the most praised God, and incomparably excelled the angelic choirs in beauty!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
We sing of thee, O all-hymned Sovereign Lady, who didst ineffably give birth unto the most praised God, and incomparably excelled the angelic choirs in beauty!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. і҆рмо́съ: Ѡ҆дѣѧ́йсѧ свѣ́томъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ри́зою, къ тебѣ̀ ꙋ҆́треннюю, и҆ тебѣ̀ зовꙋ̀: дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ просвѣтѝ ѡ҆мраче́ннꙋю хрⷭ҇тѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *O Thou that clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, unto Thee do I rise early, and unto Thee do I cry: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as Thou alone art tenderhearted![^823]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*O Thou that clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, unto Thee do I rise early, and unto Thee do I cry: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as Thou alone art tenderhearted![^823]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Просте́ръ твои̑ ѻ҆́чи и҆ помышле́нїа, ко и҆́же на древѣ̀ просте́ршемꙋсѧ, на садо́внѣ древѣ̀ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, зно́емъ пожига́емь ѻ҆́ч҃е, и҆ стꙋде́нїю поме́рзлемь.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Stretching forth thine eyes and thoughts unto Him Who was stretched upon the Tree, thou didst endure upon an orchard tree, scorched by heat, O father, and frozen by cold![^824]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Stretching forth thine eyes and thoughts unto Him Who was stretched upon the Tree, thou didst endure upon an orchard tree, scorched by heat, O father, and frozen by cold![^824]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь молнїезра́ченъ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ прпⷣбне, ѻ҆́гнь дла́ньми дв҃де держа̀, и҆ црⷭ҇твꙋющаго кадѧ̀, чꙋ́днымъ всебл҃же́нне каже́нїемъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Wholly lightning-like didst thou appear, O venerable one, holding fire in thy hands, O David, and censing the emperor with a marvelous censing, O all-blessed one![^825]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Wholly lightning-like didst thou appear, O venerable one, holding fire in thy hands, O David, and censing the emperor with a marvelous censing, O all-blessed one![^825]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ны́нѣ не въ гада́нїихъ, нижѐ мечта́нїемъ, бж҃етвеннꙋю добро́тꙋ зри́ши всебл҃же́нне, лице́мъ же преподо́бне къ лицꙋ̀ па́че, разрѣ́шшымсѧ зерца́лѡмъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Now not in riddles, nor by imagination, dost thou behold the divine beauty, O all-blessed one, but face to face rather, O venerable one, the mirrors being done away![^826]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Now not in riddles, nor by imagination, dost thou behold the divine beauty, O all-blessed one, but face to face rather, O venerable one, the mirrors being done away![^826]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Гро́знъ прекра́сенъ, бж҃твеннагѡ дв҃де преподо́бне вїногра́да ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, и҆сточа́ѧ вїно̀ ꙋ҆миле́нїа, ѿ пїѧ́нства ѻ҆́ч҃е страсте́й, ѡ҆бюродѣ́вшымъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A most fair cluster of the divine vineyard wast thou shown forth, O venerable David, pouring forth the wine of compunction unto them that have grown foolish from the drunkenness of passions, O father![^827]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
A most fair cluster of the divine vineyard wast thou shown forth, O venerable David, pouring forth the wine of compunction unto them that have grown foolish from the drunkenness of passions, O father![^827]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Напра́ви жи́знь мою̀, и҆ движе́нїа ꙋ҆мна́ѧ бг҃ороди́тельнице, къ бж҃е́ственномꙋ хотѣ́нїю, и҆зъ тебѐ неизрече́ннѡ къ на́мъ прише́дшагѡ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Direct my life and intellectual movements, O Mother of God, unto the divine will of Him Who ineffably came unto us from thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Direct my life and intellectual movements, O Mother of God, unto the divine will of Him Who ineffably came unto us from thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. і҆рмо́съ: Неи́стовствꙋющеесѧ бꙋ́рею, дꙋшетлѣ́нною влⷣко хрⷭ҇тѐ, страсте́й мо́ре ꙋ҆кротѝ, и҆ ѿ тлѝ возведѝ мѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *Calm the sea of passions raging with a soul-corrupting tempest, O Master Christ, and lead me up from corruption, as Thou art tenderhearted![^828]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*Calm the sea of passions raging with a soul-corrupting tempest, O Master Christ, and lead me up from corruption, as Thou art tenderhearted![^828]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Хра́мъ бж҃е́ственнагѡ дх҃а позна́лсѧ є҆сѝ, преподо́бне дв҃де, въ ма́лѣ храми́нѣ затво́ренъ, и҆ тѣ́сною простра́ннꙋю и҆скꙋпꙋ́ѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast known as a temple of the Divine Spirit, O venerable David, shut up in a small dwelling, and by the narrow path purchasing the spacious![^829]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou wast known as a temple of the Divine Spirit, O venerable David, shut up in a small dwelling, and by the narrow path purchasing the spacious![^829]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Зако́нѡмъ влⷣки, преклони́лъ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е твою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ, и҆ свѣ́та и҆спо́лненъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ прїи́мникъ дарова́нїй дх҃а.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto the laws of the Master didst thou bow thy soul, O father, and wast filled with light, and becamest a receiver of the gifts of the Spirit![^830]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Unto the laws of the Master didst thou bow thy soul, O father, and wast filled with light, and becamest a receiver of the gifts of the Spirit![^830]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋдесы̀ житїѐ твоѐ бг҃оно́се ѻ҆́ч҃е, воисти́ннꙋ ꙋ҆кра́шено концє́мъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ. тѣ́мже вѣ́рнѡ восхвалѧ́емъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Adorned in truth with wonders did thy life appear unto the ends of the earth, O God-bearing father; therefore do we praise thee with faith![^831]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Adorned in truth with wonders did thy life appear unto the ends of the earth, O God-bearing father; therefore do we praise thee with faith![^831]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Ѿ чтнꙑ́хъ крове́й твои́хъ и҆стка́сѧ пло́ть, па́че є҆стества̀, созда́вшемꙋ чл҃вѣ́ка бцⷣе. тѣ́мже досто́йнѡ пое́мъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* From thy precious blood flesh was woven beyond nature for Him Who fashioned man, O Birthgiver of God; therefore do we worthily hymn thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
From thy precious blood flesh was woven beyond nature for Him Who fashioned man, O Birthgiver of God; therefore do we worthily hymn thee!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, в҃. Подо́бенъ: Ли́къ а҆́гг҃льскїй: Са́дъ присноцвѣтꙋ́щъ, добродѣ́телей плоды̀ приносѧ́й, ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ на садо́внѣ древѣ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гопѣ́сниваѧ пти́ца: ра́й же па́че, жи́зни дре́во гдⷭ҇а въ срⷣцы твое́мъ прїе́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ воздѣ́лавъ бг҃омꙋ́дре, и҆́мже пита́еши на́съ благода́тїю: при́снѡ молѝ ѡ҆ на́съ дв҃де всебл҃же́нне.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "The angelic choir" (Ли́къ а҆́гг҃льскїй):* An ever-blossoming orchard bringing forth the fruits of virtues didst thou appear upon an orchard tree, like a sweet-singing bird; or rather, having received paradise, the Tree of life, the Lord, into thy heart, as having cultivated it, O God-wise one, whereby thou dost nourish us with grace: ever pray for us, O David all-blessed![^832]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "The angelic choir" (Ли́къ а҆́гг҃льскїй):*
An ever-blossoming orchard bringing forth the fruits of virtues didst thou appear upon an orchard tree, like a sweet-singing bird; or rather, having received paradise, the Tree of life, the Lord, into thy heart, as having cultivated it, O God-wise one, whereby thou dost nourish us with grace: ever pray for us, O David all-blessed![^832]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: I҆́косъ: Сласте́й мои́хъ пе́щь, вжи́гаетъ мѝ вѣ́чный пла́мень, прпⷣбне дв҃де погасѝ мл҃твами твои́ми. ꙗ҆́коже многоте́кꙋщими слеза́ми твои́ми, вже́гъ ꙋ҆́глїе любвѐ бл҃же́нне зижди́телѧ моегѡ̀, ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле въ рꙋ́кꙋ твою̀ носи́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ же́ртвꙋ, и҆ цр҃ѧ ꙋ҆диви́лъ є҆сѝ. ꙗ҆́кѡ да пою̀ тебѐ свѣтоно́сче, дв҃де всебл҃же́нне.
items.english_text: *Ikos:* The furnace of my passions kindles for me eternal flame, O venerable David: quench it by thy prayers; as with thy copious tears, having kindled the coal of love of my Creator, O blessed one, as of old carrying it in thy hand like an offering, thou didst amaze the emperor; that I may sing of thee, O light-bearer, David all-blessed![^833]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ikos:*
The furnace of my passions kindles for me eternal flame, O venerable David: quench it by thy prayers; as with thy copious tears, having kindled the coal of love of my Creator, O blessed one, as of old carrying it in thy hand like an offering, thou didst amaze the emperor; that I may sing of thee, O light-bearer, David all-blessed![^833]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. і҆рмо́съ: Превозноси́мый ѻ҆тце́въ гдⷭ҇ь, пла́мень ꙋ҆гасѝ, ѻ҆́троки ѡ҆росѝ, согла́снѡ пою́щыѧ: бж҃е блгⷭ҇слове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *The supremely exalted Lord of the fathers quenched the flame and bedewed the youths, who sang in unison: Blessed art Thou, O God![^834]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*The supremely exalted Lord of the fathers quenched the flame and bedewed the youths, who sang in unison: Blessed art Thou, O God![^834]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Стоѧ́лъ є҆сѝ неꙋкло́ннѡ на вѣ́твехъ са́да прпⷣбне, напое́нїи сле́зъ твои́хъ, ча́стѡ напоѧ́ѧ, и҆ поѧ̀ немо́лчнѡ: бж҃е блг҃ве́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst stand unwavering upon the branches of the orchard, O venerable one, watered with the drinking of thy tears, often watering them, and singing unceasingly: Blessed art Thou, O God![^835]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst stand unwavering upon the branches of the orchard, O venerable one, watered with the drinking of thy tears, often watering them, and singing unceasingly: Blessed art Thou, O God![^835]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Всѐ твоѐ жела́нїе к бг҃ꙋ просте́рлъ є҆сѝ, всѐ се́рдце твоѐ прїѧ́телище сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ бж҃твенныхъ дарова́нїй бг҃оно́се, воспѣва́ѧ: бж҃е блг҃ве́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* All thy desire didst thou stretch forth unto God; all thy heart didst thou make a receptacle of divine gifts, O God-bearer, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God![^836]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
All thy desire didst thou stretch forth unto God; all thy heart didst thou make a receptacle of divine gifts, O God-bearer, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God![^836]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ свѣтови́дна ѻ҆́ч҃е бы́вша, ꙋ҆́глїе держа́ща въ рꙋкꙋ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ цр҃ь ꙋ҆диви́сѧ, и҆ нога́мъ твои̑мъ поклони́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Seeing thee become light-bearing, O father, holding the coal in thy hand, the emperor was amazed, and bowed down at thy feet![^837]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Seeing thee become light-bearing, O father, holding the coal in thy hand, the emperor was amazed, and bowed down at thy feet![^837]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Разрѣши́сѧ рождество́мъ твои́мъ кла́тва человѣ́ча, є҆ди́на всеблгⷭ҇слове́ннаѧ: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ славосло́вимъ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гꙋ́ю бцⷣе во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* By thy childbearing was the human curse loosed, O only all-blessed one; therefore do we glorify thee as good, O Birthgiver of God, unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
By thy childbearing was the human curse loosed, O only all-blessed one; therefore do we glorify thee as good, O Birthgiver of God, unto the ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: сплѐтше поѧ́хꙋ: дѣла̀ всѧ̑каѧ гдⷭ҇а по́йте, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *Unto Thee the Fashioner of all, the youths in the furnace having woven a worldwide choir sang: All ye works, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^838]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*Unto Thee the Fashioner of all, the youths in the furnace having woven a worldwide choir sang: All ye works, hymn the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^838]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́тро разꙋ́мное сꙋ́щымъ во тьмѣ̀ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ житїѧ̀ бл҃же́нне, свѣ́тъ разꙋмѣ́нїа всѣ̑мъ ѡ҆зарѧ́ѧ, любо́вїю тѧ̀ чтꙋ́щымъ, и҆ превозносѧ́щымъ хрⷭ҇та̀ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* An intellectual morning hast thou appeared unto them that are in the darkness of life, O blessed one, illuminating the light of understanding unto all that honor thee with love and supremely exalt Christ unto all ages![^839]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
An intellectual morning hast thou appeared unto them that are in the darkness of life, O blessed one, illuminating the light of understanding unto all that honor thee with love and supremely exalt Christ unto all ages![^839]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бы́лъ є҆сѝ пра́въ и҆ смире́нъ и҆ кро́токъ, дв҃да тезоимени́таго и҆з̾ѡбража́ѧ вѣ́рнѡ. тѣ́мже съ си́мъ зе́млю кро́ткихъ ѻ҆́ч҃е наслѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ, во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast upright, humble, and meek, faithfully imaging thy namesake David; therefore with him hast thou inherited the land of the meek, O father, unto all ages![^840]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou wast upright, humble, and meek, faithfully imaging thy namesake David; therefore with him hast thou inherited the land of the meek, O father, unto all ages![^840]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆твержде́нъ мона́шествꙋющихъ сто́лпъ, дв҃де блаже́нный. прⷪ҇ро́къ бж҃твенъ дрꙋгі́й ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, бꙋ́дꙋщаѧ предглаго́лѧ, бж҃твеннаѧ ꙗ҆вле́нїа дх҃а бж҃е́ственнагѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast confirmed as a pillar of monastics, O blessed David; a second divine prophet hast thou appeared, foretelling things to come, the divine manifestations of the Divine Spirit![^841]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou wast confirmed as a pillar of monastics, O blessed David; a second divine prophet hast thou appeared, foretelling things to come, the divine manifestations of the Divine Spirit![^841]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Тѧ̀ добро́тꙋ і҆а́кѡвлю дв҃о, бг҃ъ ю҆́же возлюбѝ, ю҆́же и҆збра̀, всѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нꙋ бл҃гве́ннꙋю, пѣсносло́вимъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, the beauty of Jacob which God loved, which He chose, O Virgin, do we all hymn as the only blessed one unto all ages![^842]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thee, the beauty of Jacob which God loved, which He chose, O Virgin, do we all hymn as the only blessed one unto all ages![^842]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. і҆рмо́съ: И҆са́їе ликꙋ́й, дв҃а и҆мѣ̀ во чре́вѣ, и҆ родѝ сн҃а є҆мманꙋ́ила, бг҃а же и҆ человѣ́ка, восто́къ и҆́мѧ є҆мꙋ̀: є҆го́же велича́юще, дв҃ꙋ ꙋ҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *Rejoice, O Isaiah! The Virgin was with child in the womb, and gave birth unto a Son, Emmanuel, God and man, whose Name is the Orient; Whom magnifying, we bless the Virgin.[^843]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
*Rejoice, O Isaiah! The Virgin was with child in the womb, and gave birth unto a Son, Emmanuel, God and man, whose Name is the Orient; Whom magnifying, we bless the Virgin.[^843]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нное торжество̀, соше́дшесѧ дне́сь вѣ́рнїи соверши́мъ, сщ҃еннагѡ всѝ ѻ҆тца̀ воздержа́нїемъ возсїѧ́вшагѡ, и҆ себѐ всего̀ бг҃ꙋ ѡ҆ст҃и́вшагѡ, житїе́мъ соверше́нїа.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having assembled today, ye faithful, let us all celebrate the sacred solemnity of the sacred father who shone forth by self-control, and wholly consecrated himself unto God by a life of perfection!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having assembled today, ye faithful, let us all celebrate the sacred solemnity of the sacred father who shone forth by self-control, and wholly consecrated himself unto God by a life of perfection!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́во насади́лсѧ є҆сѝ на вода́хъ прпⷣбне, то́ки дꙋхо́вныхъ добродѣ́телей носѧ̀ плоды̀. на садо́внѣ же древѣ̀ водрꙋзи́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆ре́лъ ѻ҆́ч҃е гнѣздо̀, къ нбⷭ҇нымъ тво́й ꙋ҆́мъ впери́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Like a tree wast thou planted beside the waters, O venerable one, bearing fruits of currents of spiritual virtues; and having pitched a nest like an eagle upon an orchard tree, O father, thou didst wing thine intellect unto the heavenly things![^844]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Like a tree wast thou planted beside the waters, O venerable one, bearing fruits of currents of spiritual virtues; and having pitched a nest like an eagle upon an orchard tree, O father, thou didst wing thine intellect unto the heavenly things![^844]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Тво́й прⷪ҇ро́чески ꙋ҆зрѣ́въ дв҃де и҆схо́дъ, провозглаша́еши сі́и лю́демъ: є҆гда̀ ꙋ҆толи́лъ, є҆́же на ни́хъ поста́вилъ є҆сѝ мꙋ́дре, царствꙋ́ющагѡ мно́гое негодова́нїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having prophetically foreseen thine own departure, O David, thou didst proclaim it unto these people, when thou hadst calmed the great indignation of the emperor which had come upon them, O wise one![^845]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having prophetically foreseen thine own departure, O David, thou didst proclaim it unto these people, when thou hadst calmed the great indignation of the emperor which had come upon them, O wise one![^845]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃а́ѧ па́мѧть твоѧ̀ ѡ҆сщ҃а́етъ дне́сь на́съ, творѧ́щихъ сїю̀ вѣ́рнѡ, преподо́бне дв҃де: ст҃ѡ бо препроводи́лъ є҆сѝ твою̀ ст҃е жи́знь, и҆ по ꙋ҆спе́нїи ра́дꙋешисѧ со ст҃ы́ми при́снѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy holy memory sanctifies us today that celebrate it with faith, O venerable David; for holily didst thou pass thy life, O holy one, and after thy falling asleep thou dost ever rejoice with the saints!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thy holy memory sanctifies us today that celebrate it with faith, O venerable David; for holily didst thou pass thy life, O holy one, and after thy falling asleep thou dost ever rejoice with the saints!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Свѣтоно́снꙋ две́рь тѧ̀, предзрѧ́ше і҆езекі́иль, є҆́юже про́йде свѣ́тъ и҆́стинный хрⷭ҇то́съ бг҃ъ на́шъ: є҆го́же прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ чи́стаѧ, покаѧ́нїа мѝ две́ри ѿве́рсти молю́сѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A light-bearing door did Ezekiel foresee thee to be, through which passed the true Light, Christ our God; Whom do thou earnestly entreat, O pure one, to open unto me the doors of repentance, I pray thee![^846]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
A light-bearing door did Ezekiel foresee thee to be, through which passed the true Light, Christ our God; Whom do thou earnestly entreat, O pure one, to open unto me the doors of repentance, I pray thee![^846]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ленъ. Подо́бенъ: Жєны̀ ꙋ҆слы́шите: Мірска́гѡ весе́лїа ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ скве́рны ꙋ҆клони́лсѧ є҆сѝ, и҆ неѧде́нїемъ пло́ть ꙋ҆вѧди́въ, ѡ҆бнови́лъ є҆сѝ дꙋшѝ крѣ́пость прпⷣбне, сла́вою ѡ҆богати́лсѧ є҆сѝ нбⷭ҇ною сла́вне. Тѣ́мже молѧ̀ не преста́й ѡ҆ на́съ гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "Hear, ye women" (Жєны̀ ꙋ҆слы́шите):*

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_text: From worldly gladness as from defilement didst thou turn aside, and having withered the flesh by abstinence, thou didst renew the strength of the soul, O venerable one, and wast enriched with heavenly glory, O glorious one; therefore cease not to pray unto the Lord for us![^847]

provenance.verbatim_source: From worldly gladness as from defilement didst thou turn aside, and having withered the flesh by abstinence, thou didst renew the strength of the soul, O venerable one, and wast enriched with heavenly glory, O glorious one; therefore cease not to pray unto the Lord for us![^847]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Вои́стиннꙋ бцⷣꙋ тѧ̀ и҆сповѣ́даемъ влⷣчце, тобо́ю спа́сшїисѧ: и҆́бо гдⷭ҇а неизрече́ннѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ разо́ршаго крⷭ҇то́мъ сме́рть, къ себѣ́ же привле́кша прпⷣбныхъ собо́ры. съ ни́миже тѧ̀ восхвалѧ́емъ дв҃о.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Truly do we confess thee to be the Birthgiver of God, O Sovereign Lady, who through thee have been saved; for ineffably didst thou bear the Lord Who destroyed death by the Cross, and drew unto Himself the assemblies of the venerable; with whom we praise thee, O Virgin![^848]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Truly do we confess thee to be the Birthgiver of God, O Sovereign Lady, who through thee have been saved; for ineffably didst thou bear the Lord Who destroyed death by the Cross, and drew unto Himself the assemblies of the venerable; with whom we praise thee, O Virgin![^848]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Мц҃а тогѡ́же, въ к҃з де́нь. Прпⷣбнагѡ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ на́шегѡ самѱѡ́на стра́ннопрїи́мца. Стїхи̑ры, гла́съ, а҃. Подо́бенъ: Всехва́льнїи мꙋ́ченницы: О́тче прехва́льне самѱѡ́не, * плотска́ѧ стремле́нїа * воздержа́тельными ꙋ҆вѧ́дилъ є҆сѝ запале́ньми. * Въ пꙋсты́ню всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆лїа̀ дре́вле: * ꙋ҆́мъ ѡ҆чи́стивъ * непреста́нными къ бг҃ꙋ манове́нїи. * И҆ ны́нѣ моли́сѧ, * дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ми́ръ, * и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: Venerable father, thou gavest no sleep unto thine eyes, nor slumber unto thine eyelids, until thou didst free soul and body from passions, and preparedst thyself as a dwelling for the Spirit; for Christ, coming with the Father, made an abode in thee; and having become a pleasing servant of the consubstantial Trinity, O great preacher, our father David, pray that we may be saved![^849]

provenance.verbatim_source: Venerable father, thou gavest no sleep unto thine eyes, nor slumber unto thine eyelids, until thou didst free soul and body from passions, and preparedst thyself as a dwelling for the Spirit; for Christ, coming with the Father, made an abode in thee; and having become a pleasing servant of the consubstantial Trinity, O great preacher, our father David, pray that we may be saved![^849]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: О́тче бг҃омꙋ́дре самѱѡ́не, * по́стникѡмъ приче́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * безстра́стїемъ ꙋ҆кра́шенъ, * и҆ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ во ѡ҆би́тели преподо́бныхъ, * и҆дѣ́же свѣ́тъ незаходи́мый, * и҆ и҆дѣ́же є҆́сть дре́во жи́зни. * И҆ ны́нѣ моли́сѧ, * дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ми́ръ, * и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: When thou, who art the vine, didst see the unplanted Cluster, Whom thou didst bring forth, hanging upon the Tree, and pierced in His divine ribs with a spear: What is this, cried she, O my Son and God? How dost Thou, Who healest all infirmities and passions, endure passions, being impassible according to Thy divine nature? What have the thankless people rendered unto Thee, the Benefactor, instead of good deeds? cried the all-pure one: but by His passions pray unceasingly that I may be freed from passions, that I may glorify thee![^850]

provenance.verbatim_source: When thou, who art the vine, didst see the unplanted Cluster, Whom thou didst bring forth, hanging upon the Tree, and pierced in His divine ribs with a spear: What is this, cried she, O my Son and God? How dost Thou, Who healest all infirmities and passions, endure passions, being impassible according to Thy divine nature? What have the thankless people rendered unto Thee, the Benefactor, instead of good deeds? cried the all-pure one: but by His passions pray unceasingly that I may be freed from passions, that I may glorify thee![^850]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: О́тче бг҃омꙋ́дре самѱѡ́не, * по́стникѡмъ приче́лсѧ є҆сѝ, * безстра́стїемъ ꙋ҆кра́шенъ, * и҆ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ во ѡ҆би́тели преподо́бныхъ, * и҆дѣ́же свѣ́тъ незаходи́мый, * и҆ и҆дѣ́же є҆́сть дре́во жи́зни. * И҆ ны́нѣ моли́сѧ, * дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ми́ръ, * и҆ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_text: O all-lauded father Sampson, with the burning heats of self-control thou didst wither the carnal impulses; thou didst take up thine abode in the wilderness like Elijah of old, having purified thine intellect by unceasing nods unto God; and now pray that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls![^852]

provenance.verbatim_source: O all-lauded father Sampson, with the burning heats of self-control thou didst wither the carnal impulses; thou didst take up thine abode in the wilderness like Elijah of old, having purified thine intellect by unceasing nods unto God; and now pray that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls![^852]

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* O God-wise father Sampson, thou wast numbered among the fasters, adorned with impassibility, and didst take up thine abode in the habitations of the venerable, where is the unsetting light, and where is the Tree of life; and now pray that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls![^853]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: к҃з де́нь Ѽ бг҃одохнове́нне самѱѡ́не, свѣти́льникъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, просвѣща́ѧ подсо́лнечнꙋю, чꙋде́съ сіѧ́ніи, дꙋшетлѣ́нныхъ недꙋ́гѡвъ ѿгонѧ́ѧ тмꙋ̀, демо́нскій ѿрѣва́ѧ мра́къ: и҆ ны́нѣ моли́сѧ, дарова́ти дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ми́ръ, и҆ ве́лію ми́лость.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* O God-inspired Sampson, thou wast a luminary, enlightening the world under the sun with the rays of miracles, driving away the darkness of soul-corrupting diseases, dispelling demonic gloom; and now pray that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls.[^854]

provenance.verbatim_source:

O God-inspired Sampson, thou wast a luminary, enlightening the world under the sun with the rays of miracles, driving away the darkness of soul-corrupting diseases, dispelling demonic gloom; and now pray that peace and great mercy be granted unto our souls.[^854]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: подо́бенъ то́йже. Своего̀ а҆́гнца, а҆́гница и҆ непоро́чнаѧ влдковица, на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ви́дѣ зра́ка не и҆мꙋ́ща, нижѐ добро́ты, оу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ рыда́ющи гл҃аше: гдѣ̀ доброта̀ твоѧ̀ за́йде сладча́йшій: гдѣ̀ благодѣ́піе? гдѣ̀ блгⷣть блиста́ющаѧ ѻ҆́браза твоегѡ̀, сн҃е мо́й любе́знѣйшій.
items.english_text: Woe is me! What shall become of me, having defiled my mind and soul and body with transgressions? What shall I do? And how shall I escape the unendurable flame, the unyielding and eternal bonds? But O all-immaculate [Lady], before the end pray to thy Son to grant me remission.

provenance.verbatim_source: Woe is me! What shall become of me, having defiled my mind and soul and body with transgressions? What shall I do? items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, и҃. Въ терпѣ́ніи твое́мъ
items.slavonic_text: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, и҃. Въ терпѣ́ніи твое́мъ стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ мздꙋ̀ твою̀ ѻ҆́ч҃е преподо́бне, въ мл҃твахъ непреста́ннѡ терпѣ́вый, ни́щыѧ возлюби́вый, и҆ сіѧ̀ оу҆довли́вый: но моли́сѧ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ бг҃ꙋ самѱѡ́не млⷭ҇тиве бл҃же́нне, спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion, the same Podoben:* When the ewe-lamb and undefiled Mistress beheld upon the Cross her Lamb, having neither form nor comeliness, woe is me! lamenting, she said: Whither hath Thy beauty departed, O sweetest One? Whither Thy fair comeliness? Whither the radiant grace of Thine image, O my most beloved Son?

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, и҃. Въ терпѣ́ніи твое́мъ
items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ, є҆гѡ́же краегране́сіе: Пою́ тѧ самѱѡ́не вѣ́рнѡ бж҃твенными словесы̀. І҆ѡ́сифъ. Гла́съ, в҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. І҆рмо́съ. Грѧди́те лю́діе, пои́мъ пѣ́снь хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ бг҃ꙋ, раздѣ́льшемꋋ мо́ре, и҆ наста́вльшемꋋ лю́ди, ꙗ҆́же и҆зведѐ и҆зъ рабо́ты є҆гѵ́петскіѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 8:* In thy patience thou didst acquire thy reward, O venerable father, persevering unceasingly in prayers, loving the poor and satisfying them; but pray to Christ God, O Sampson, merciful and blessed one, that our souls may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, и҃. Въ терпѣ́ніи твое́мъ
items.slavonic_text: Є҆ди́нꙋ жела́ѧ ꙗ҆́же къ жи́зни ведꙋ́щꙋю тѧ̀, мі́ра кра́снаѧ прете́клъ є҆сѝ, и҆ премі́рное наслѣ́діе стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ соше́дшесѧ самѱѡ́не почита́емъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* *Come, O ye peoples, let us sing a song to Christ God, Who divided the sea and guided the people whom He brought out of the bondage of Egypt, for He hath been glorified.[^855]*

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto me who strive to praise thy most radiant solemnity with songs, send down light, O all-blessed one, who standest crowned before the Master's throne.

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring only that which leads thee unto life, thou didst pass by the fair things of the world and didst acquire a supermundane heritage; therefore, having come together, O Sampson, we honor thee.

items.slavonic_text: Самѱѡ́на свѧщеннаго восхва́лимъ: бж҃ію бо подо́бѧсѧ бл҃гоꙋтро́бію, мл҃тивъ недꙋ́жнымъ бы́сть, наготꙋ́ющымъ же всѣ́мъ ѡ҆де́жда.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having spent thy divine life holy and honorably, thou wast united with the saints and didst reach the habitations of the venerable, being accounted worthy of ineffable illumination.
