items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, и҃. Въ терпѣ́ніи твое́мъ
items.slavonic_text: Свято и҆ че́стно бж҃е́ственное житіѐ твоѐ препроводи́въ, со ст҃ы́ми сочета́лсѧ є҆сѝ, и҆ ѻ҆би́тѣли прпⷣбныхъ дости́глъ є҆сѝ, просвѣще́нїѧ неизрече́ннагѡ сподоблѧ́емь.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Blessed art thou, and it shall be well with thee, who hast kept the divine laws of our Lord and God, O father; pray to Him that thy flock may be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Blessed art thou, and it shall be well with thee, who hast kept the divine laws of our Lord and God, O father; pray to Him that thy flock may be saved.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Тропа́рь, гла́съ, и҃. Въ терпѣ́ніи твое́мъ
items.slavonic_text: Блаже́нъ є҆сѝ ты̀, и҆ бл҃го тебѣ̀ бꙋ́детъ, бж҃твенныѧ соблю́дшꙋ ѻ҆́ч҃е зако́ны гдⷭ҇а и҆ бг҃а на́шегѡ: є҆го́же молѝ сп҃ти́сѧ ста́дꙋ твоемꙋ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Drive away the darkness of my soul and mind, O pure one, and grant me to live as in an appointed day, performing saving commandments.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Drive away the darkness of my soul and mind, O pure one, and grant me to live as in an appointed day, performing saving commandments.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ и҆ оу҆ма̀ чи́стаѧ тмꙋ̀ ѿженѝ, и҆ да́ждь ꙗ҆́кѡ въ де́нь наро́читъ пожи́ти, спаси́телнаѧ творѧ́щꙋ повелѣ́нїѧ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4. Podoben: "Speedily anticipate" (Ско́рѡ предварѝ):* Having shone forth through the Spirit as a radiant luminary, O all-blessed Sampson, thou dost honorably enlighten us in thy house; therefore, O father, thou dost distribute to those who are in diverse diseases the healings given thee by God. Therefore, by thy supplications deliver us from passions.[^857]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 4. Podoben: "Speedily anticipate" (Ско́рѡ предварѝ):*
Having shone forth through the Spirit as a radiant luminary, O all-blessed Sampson, thou dost honorably enlighten us in thy house; therefore, O father, thou dost distribute to those who are in diverse diseases the healings given thee by God. Therefore, by thy supplications deliver us from passions.[^857]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Ѡ҆бнови́ла є҆сѝ чи́стаѧ бж҃е́ственнымъ рождество́мъ твои́мъ, и҆стлѣ́вшее во страсте́хъ земноро́дныхъ ме́ртвенное сꙋщество̀: и҆ воздви́гла є҆сѝ всѧ̀ ѿ сме́рти къ живо́тꙋ нетлѣ́нїѧ. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ по до́лгꙋ бл҃жи́мъ всѝ дв҃о препросла́вленнаѧ, ꙗ҆́коже прорекла̀ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: By thy divine childbearing, O pure one, thou hast renewed the mortal nature of the earthborn that had decayed in passions, and hast raised up all from death unto the life of incorruption; therefore, as is due, all of us call thee blessed, O Virgin most glorified, even as thou didst foretell.

provenance.verbatim_source: By thy divine childbearing, O pure one, thou hast renewed the mortal nature of the earthborn that had decayed in passions, and hast raised up all from death unto the life of incorruption; therefore, as is due, all of us call thee blessed, O Virgin most glorified, even as thou didst foretell.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Дѣ́во пренепоро́чнаѧ мт҃и хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, ѻ҆рꙋ́жіе про́йде твою̀ прест҃ꙋю дꙋ́шꙋ, є҆гда̀ распина́ема ви́дѣла є҆сѝ во́лею, сн҃а и҆ бг҃а твоего̀: є҆го́же блгⷭ҇лове́ннаѧ молѧ́щи не преста́й, проще́нїе прегрѣше́нїй на́мъ дарова́ти.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* O all-immaculate Virgin, Mother of Christ God, a sword pierced thy most holy soul when thou didst behold thy Son and God being crucified willingly; whom cease not to implore, O blessed one, to grant us forgiveness of transgressions.[^858]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
O all-immaculate Virgin, Mother of Christ God, a sword pierced thy most holy soul when thou didst behold thy Son and God being crucified willingly; whom cease not to implore, O blessed one, to grant us forgiveness of transgressions.[^858]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆слы́шахъ гдⷭ҇и, слꙋ́хъ твоегѡ̀ смотре́нїѧ, и҆ просла́вихъ тѧ̀, є҆ди́не человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *I heard, O Lord, the report of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^859]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*I heard, O Lord, the report of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, O only Lover of mankind.[^859]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕвѣзда̀ пресвѣ́тлаѧ, всѣ́хъ на́съ просвѣща́еши сердца̀, достодо́лжнѡ бл҃жа́щихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As a most radiant star, thou dost enlighten the hearts of all of us who worthily call thee blessed.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
As a most radiant star, thou dost enlighten the hearts of all of us who worthily call thee blessed.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Дрема́нїе ѿ ѻ҆́чі́ю твое́ю ѿложи́въ, бдѣ́лъ є҆сѝ непреста́ннѡ: и҆ сла́сти тѣле́сныѧ оу҆спи́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having cast off slumber from thine eyes, thou didst watch unceasingly, and didst put bodily pleasures to sleep.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having cast off slumber from thine eyes, thou didst watch unceasingly, and didst put bodily pleasures to sleep.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ни́щымъ дово́ленъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ ра́ди: и҆ пріѧ́лъ є҆сѝ вы́шнее наслѣ́дїе, преподо́бне ра́дꙋѧсѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast sufficient unto the poor for Christ's sake, and didst receive the heritage on high, O venerable one, rejoicing.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou wast sufficient unto the poor for Christ's sake, and didst receive the heritage on high, O venerable one, rejoicing.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Тѧ̀ всенепоро́чнаѧ влⷣчце, свѣ́тлꙋю пала́тꙋ сло́ва, пѣсносло́вимъ и҆ оу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, O all-immaculate Mistress, radiant palace of the Word, do we hymn and call blessed.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thee, O all-immaculate Mistress, radiant palace of the Word, do we hymn and call blessed.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: к҃з де́нь Пѣ́снь, є҃. І҆рмо́съ: Свѣ́та пода́телю, и҆ вѣкѡ́въ тво́рче гдⷭ҇и, во свѣ́тѣ твои́хъ повелѣ́ній наста́ви на́съ: ра́звѣ бо тебѐ и҆но́гѡ бг҃а не зна́емъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *O Lord, Giver of light and Creator of the ages, guide us in the light of Thy commandments, for we know no other God beside Thee.[^860]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*O Lord, Giver of light and Creator of the ages, guide us in the light of Thy commandments, for we know no other God beside Thee.[^860]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пречⷭ҇тый свѣ́тъ почи́вшій въ тебѣ̀, всегѡ́ тѧ свѣтови́дна сотворѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е, просвѣща́юща вѣ́рныхъ, добродѣ́телей твои́хъ свѣ́тлыми сіѧ́ніи.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The most pure Light that rested in thee made thee entirely radiant, O father, enlightening the faithful with the bright rays of thy virtues.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The most pure Light that rested in thee made thee entirely radiant, O father, enlightening the faithful with the bright rays of thy virtues.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Милова́ніемъ мно́гимъ, ни́щымъ бога́тство бы́лъ є҆сѝ: и҆ вра́чь сꙋ́щымъ въ не́мощи воста́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́вѣ, си́хъ врачева́ніемъ ѿе́млѧ недꙋ́ги.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By much compassion thou wast wealth unto the poor, and manifestly didst arise as a physician unto those who were in infirmity, taking away diseases through the healing of them.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By much compassion thou wast wealth unto the poor, and manifestly didst arise as a physician unto those who were in infirmity, taking away diseases through the healing of them.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ хра́мъ чи́стъ, прест҃а́гѡ и҆ чⷭ҇тна́гѡ дх҃а, страсте́й ти́нꙋ ѡ҆чи́щь, са́мъ себѐ ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ ѻ҆́ч҃е бг҃оно́се. тѣ́мже восхвалѧ́емъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having cleansed the mire of passions, thou didst show thyself a pure temple of the most holy and honorable Spirit, thyself in truth, O God-bearing father; therefore we praise thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having cleansed the mire of passions, thou didst show thyself a pure temple of the most holy and honorable Spirit, thyself in truth, O God-bearing father; therefore we praise thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Тѧ̀ прест҃аѧ чⷭ҇таѧ, добро́тꙋ і҆а́кѡвлю, вѣ́рою бж҃твенными гла́сы пѣсносло́вимъ, ро́ждшꙋю на́мъ бг҃а плотоно́сца: є҆гѡ́же трепе́щꙋтъ всѧ́чєскаѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, O most holy and pure one, the comeliness of Jacob, do we hymn in faith with divine voices, who hast borne for us the flesh-bearing God, before Whom all things tremble.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thee, O most holy and pure one, the comeliness of Jacob, do we hymn in faith with divine voices, who hast borne for us the flesh-bearing God, before Whom all things tremble.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй валѧ́ѧсѧ, неизслѣ́днꙋю млⷭ҇рдїѧ твоегѡ̀ призыва́ю бе́зднꙋ, ѿ тлѝ бж҃е мѧ̀ возведѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *Wallowing in the abyss of sins, I call upon the fathomless abyss of Thy loving-kindness: from corruption, O God, lead me up.[^861]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*Wallowing in the abyss of sins, I call upon the fathomless abyss of Thy loving-kindness: from corruption, O God, lead me up.[^861]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сокро́вищи небе́сными ѡ҆богати́лсѧ є҆сѝ, лю́бѧ милова́ніе самѱѡ́не сла́вне, и҆ ѿве́рзлъ ни́щымъ твою̀ оу҆тро́бꙋ, соверше́ннымъ оу҆мо́мъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast enriched with heavenly treasures, loving compassion, O glorious Sampson, and with a mature mind didst open thy heart to the poor.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou wast enriched with heavenly treasures, loving compassion, O glorious Sampson, and with a mature mind didst open thy heart to the poor.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Созда́лъ є҆сѝ въ сла́вꙋ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꋋ хра́мъ ѡ҆сщ҃е́нъ: во́ньже притека́юще, ѿ многови́дныхъ ѡ҆чища́ютсѧ недꙋ́гъ вѣ́рнїи пребл҃же́нне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst erect a sanctified temple to the glory of our God, running unto which the faithful are cleansed from manifold diseases, O all-blessed one.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst erect a sanctified temple to the glory of our God, running unto which the faithful are cleansed from manifold diseases, O all-blessed one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Чи́сто житіѐ твоѐ препроводи́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ съ прпⷣбными преподо́бнѡ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ, ѡ҆ на́съ моли́сѧ, вѣ́рнѡ чтꙋ́щихъ тѧ̀ бг҃одохнове́нне.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst spend thy life purely, and didst take up thine abode venerably with the venerable; pray for us who honor thee in faith, O God-inspired one.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst spend thy life purely, and didst take up thine abode venerably with the venerable; pray for us who honor thee in faith, O God-inspired one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Не́бо высоко̀ была̀ є҆сѝ, всѣ́хъ цр҃ѧ бг҃а всенепоро́чнаѧ, и҆ чи́стаѧ пала́та, и҆ черто́гъ свѣ́телъ, бж҃е́ственною блгⷣтїю.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* A high heaven wast thou, O all-immaculate one, and a pure palace, and a radiant bridal chamber of God the King of all, by divine grace.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
A high heaven wast thou, O all-immaculate one, and a pure palace, and a radiant bridal chamber of God the King of all, by divine grace.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ нача́тки: Ꙗ҆́кѡ врача̀ всеизрѧ́дна, и҆ моли́твенника бл҃гопріѧ́тна, къ ра́цѣ твое́й бж҃е́ственнѣй притека́юще, самѱѡ́не бг҃омꙋ́дре прпⷣбне, соше́дшесѧ любо́вїю, ѱалмы̀ и҆ пѣ́сньми ра́дꙋющесѧ, хрⷭ҇та̀ прославлѧ́емъ, такову́ю тебѣ̀ блгⷣть подава́юща и҆сцѣле́ній.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 8. Podoben: "As first-fruits" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ нача́тки):* As unto an excellent physician and acceptable intercessor, running unto thy divine shrine, O God-wise, venerable Sampson, having come together in love, rejoicing with psalms and hymns, we glorify Christ Who grants thee such grace of healings.[^862]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 8. Podoben: "As first-fruits" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ нача́тки):*
As unto an excellent physician and acceptable intercessor, running unto thy divine shrine, O God-wise, venerable Sampson, having come together in love, rejoicing with psalms and hymns, we glorify Christ Who grants thee such grace of healings.[^862]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: І҆́косъ: Ста́рческое, кро́ткое, и҆ неѕло́бивое, непоро́чно житіѐ соверши́вшаго, слѣ́пнѡ блгⷣть пріи́мшаго чꙋде́съ, тве́рдꙋ и҆ неизрече́ннꙋ, самѱѡ́на преподо́бнаго восхва́лимъ, а҆́лчꙋщихъ пита́телѧ, и҆ сꙋ́щихъ въ нꙋ́ждахъ помо́щника, и҆ побо́рника вели́ка, недꙋ́гꙋющымъ воздви́гша бж҃твенный хра́мъ и҆сцѣле́ній.
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Let us praise the venerable Sampson, who accomplished an aged, gentle, meek, and blameless life, who splendidly received the firm and ineffable grace of miracles—the nourisher of the hungry, the helper of those in need, and a great defender, who erected for the sick a divine temple of healings.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ikos:*
Let us praise the venerable Sampson, who accomplished an aged, gentle, meek, and blameless life, who splendidly received the firm and ineffable grace of miracles—the nourisher of the hungry, the helper of those in need, and a great defender, who erected for the sick a divine temple of healings.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: мц҃ъ і҆ꙋ́нїй Пѣ́снь, з҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ѻ҆́бразꙋ злато́мꙋ на по́лѣ деи́рѣ слꙋжи́мꙋ, трі́е твоѝ ѻ҆́троцы небрего́ша безбо́жнагѡ велѣ́нїѧ: посредѣ́ же ѻ҆гнѧ̀ вве́ржени, ѡ҆роша́еми поѧ́хꙋ: блгⷭ҇ве́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *When the golden image was served on the plain of Dura, Thy three youths took no heed of the godless command; but cast into the midst of the fire, being bedewed, they sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^863]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*When the golden image was served on the plain of Dura, Thy three youths took no heed of the godless command; but cast into the midst of the fire, being bedewed, they sang: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^863]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Крѣ́пость хрⷭ҇та̀ держа́внꙋ, въ напа́стехъ и҆мѣ́ѧ пребл҃же́нне, житїѧ̀ преми́нꙋлъ є҆сѝ бꙋ́рю безъ и҆стопле́нїѧ прпⷣбне, и҆ къ ти́хомꙋ приста́нищꙋ, во спѣва́ѧ дости́глъ є҆сѝ: блгⷭ҇ве́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having the mighty strength of Christ in temptations, O all-blessed one, thou didst pass through the tempest of life without sinking, O venerable one, and singing didst reach the calm haven: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having the mighty strength of Christ in temptations, O all-blessed one, thou didst pass through the tempest of life without sinking, O venerable one, and singing didst reach the calm haven: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Премꙋ́дростїю мно́гою, и҆ любо́вїю дх҃о́вною подвиза́емь, хра́мъ созда́лъ є҆сѝ ѻ҆́ч҃е вели́къ: въ него́же притека́юще всегда̀, и҆сцѣле́нїе пріе́млютъ всѝ, вопію́ще, и҆ гл҃юще: блгⷭ҇ве́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Moved by much wisdom and spiritual love, thou didst build a great church, O father, running unto which at all times, all receive healing, crying out and saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Moved by much wisdom and spiritual love, thou didst build a great church, O father, running unto which at all times, all receive healing, crying out and saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣ́щникъ свѣ́телъ добродѣ́телей, бж҃е́ственнымъ свѣ́томъ просвѣща́емь, самѱѡ́не ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, и҆ ѡ҆зари́лъ є҆сѝ вселе́нныѧ концы̀. тѣ́мже соше́дшесѧ тѧ̀ вѣ́рою оу҆блажа́емъ, пою́ще: блгⷭ҇ве́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A radiant lampstand of virtues, enlightened by divine light, didst thou appear, O Sampson, and didst illumine the ends of the universe; therefore, having come together in faith, we call thee blessed, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
A radiant lampstand of virtues, enlightened by divine light, didst thou appear, O Sampson, and didst illumine the ends of the universe; therefore, having come together in faith, we call thee blessed, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Рꙋно̀ и҆ногда̀ пред̾ѧвлѧ́ше чи́стꙋю оу҆тро́бꙋ твою̀, пріе́мшꙋю небе́сныи до́ждь всѣ́хъ ѡ҆роша́ющь, ѡ҆держи́мыхъ жа́ждею грѣхо́вною всенепѣ́таѧ, бл҃гослове́на є҆сѝ бг҃а пло́тїю ро́ждшаѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The fleece of old prefigured thy pure womb, which received the heavenly rain that bedews all that are held by the thirst of sin, O all-hymned one; blessed art thou who in the flesh didst bear God.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The fleece of old prefigured thy pure womb, which received the heavenly rain that bedews all that are held by the thirst of sin, O all-hymned one; blessed art thou who in the flesh didst bear God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. І҆рмо́съ: Въ пе́щь ѻ҆́гненнꙋю к̾ ѻ҆́трокѡмъ є҆вре́йскимъ снизше́дшаго, и҆ пла́мень въ ро́сꙋ прело́жшаго бг҃а, по́йте дѣла̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *Unto God Who descended into the fiery furnace unto the Hebrew youths, and changed the flame into dew: hymn, ye works, as the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^864]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*Unto God Who descended into the fiery furnace unto the Hebrew youths, and changed the flame into dew: hymn, ye works, as the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^864]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆зы́къ дви́жа ра́достнѡ на бж҃їѧ ѻ҆́ч҃е самѱѡ́не пѣ̑сни, стра̑сти плѡтскі́ѧ воздержа́нїемъ порабо́тилъ є҆сѝ дꙋшѝ: и҆ ра́бъ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ и҆́скреннїй ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, и҆ вы́шнагѡ гра́да наслѣ́дникъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Moving thy tongue joyfully in divine songs, O father Sampson, by self-control thou didst enslave carnal passions unto the soul, and didst show thyself a sincere servant unto Christ and an heir of the city on high.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Moving thy tongue joyfully in divine songs, O father Sampson, by self-control thou didst enslave carnal passions unto the soul, and didst show thyself a sincere servant unto Christ and an heir of the city on high.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Чи́стый тво́й оу҆́мъ блиста́нїи бж҃е́ственными оу҆краше́нъ, пресвѣ́телъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ: и҆ пріѧ́тенъ чтны́хъ всебл҃же́нне бж҃твенныхъ сіѧ́нїй. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ чти́мъ самѱѡ́не во вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy pure mind, adorned with divine splendors, appeared most radiant, and receptive of honorable divine rays, O all-blessed one; therefore we honor thee, O Sampson, unto the ages.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thy pure mind, adorned with divine splendors, appeared most radiant, and receptive of honorable divine rays, O all-blessed one; therefore we honor thee, O Sampson, unto the ages.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Свѧще́ннꙋ и҆мѣ́ѧ жи́знь, пресла́вныи самѱѡ́не всебл҃же́нне, ꙗ҆́вѣ просла́вилсѧ є҆сѝ, къ бг҃ꙋ преше́дъ: се́ бо пребыва́етъ па́мѧть твоѧ̀ во вѣ́ки и҆ пра́вда.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having a holy life, O most glorious, all-blessed Sampson, thou wast manifestly glorified, having passed over unto God; for behold, thy memory and thy righteousness abide unto the ages.[^865]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having a holy life, O most glorious, all-blessed Sampson, thou wast manifestly glorified, having passed over unto God; for behold, thy memory and thy righteousness abide unto the ages.[^865]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆ста́ви страсте́й мои́хъ лю́тꙋю бꙋ́рю, чⷭ҇таѧ бл҃гослове́ннаѧ: и҆ возбранѝ всѣ̑мъ неща́днѡ мою̀ нищетꙋ̀ дѣвобо́рющымъ, врагѡ́мъ безналѡ́тны, ꙗ҆́кѡ да вѣ́рнѡ пою̀ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Calm the fierce tempest of my passions, O pure and blessed one, and restrain all the enemies that unsparingly war against my poverty without cause, that in faith I may sing to thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Calm the fierce tempest of my passions, O pure and blessed one, and restrain all the enemies that unsparingly war against my poverty without cause, that in faith I may sing to thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ѿ бг҃а бг҃а сло́ва, неизрече́нною мꙋ́дростїю, прише́дшаго ѡ҆бнови́ти а҆да́ма, ꙗ҆́дїю въ тлѣ́нїе па́дшаго лю́тѣ: ѿ ст҃ы́ѧ дв҃ы неизрече́ннѡ воплоти́вшагосѧ на́съ ра́ди, вѣ́рнїи
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *God the Word, Who from God with ineffable wisdom came to renew Adam, who through eating had grievously fallen into corruption, and Who for our sake was ineffably incarnate of the Holy Virgin: with one accord in faith...* with songs we magnify.[^866]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
*God the Word, Who from God with ineffable wisdom came to renew Adam, who through eating had grievously fallen into corruption, and Who for our sake was ineffably incarnate of the Holy Virgin: with one accord in faith...*
...with songs we magnify.[^866]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: к҃з де́нь вѣ́рнїи є҆диномꙋ́дреннѡ пѣ́сньми велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Behold, thy memory, O father, like the sun hath shone forth upon all, brightly enlightening those who therein glorify thee as a servant of Christ, an heir of His Kingdom, and a partaker with all the venerable.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Behold, thy memory, O father, like the sun hath shone forth upon all, brightly enlightening those who therein glorify thee as a servant of Christ, an heir of His Kingdom, and a partaker with all the venerable.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Се́ па́мѧть твоѧ̀ ѻ҆́ч҃е ꙗ҆́коже сл҃нце всѣ̑мъ возсїѧ̀, просвѣща́ющи свѣ́тлѡ въ не́й тѧ̀ сла́вѧщыѧ: ꙗ҆́кѡ слꙋжи́телѧ хрⷭ҇това и҆ наслѣ́дника, црⷭ҇твїѧ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ всѣ̑мъ преподо́бнымъ соприча́стника.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* How radiant is thy life, how great thy glory, how rich thy tomb, O wise one, wherein thy precious body lay! It pours forth health unto those who in faith have recourse unto it, and who at all times ask thine aid.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
How radiant is thy life, how great thy glory, how rich thy tomb, O wise one, wherein thy precious body lay! It pours forth health unto those who in faith have recourse unto it, and who at all times ask thine aid.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣтоза́рно житїѐ твоѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ве́лїѧ сла́ва, ꙗ҆́кѡ бога́тъ гро́бъ тво́й мꙋ́дре, и҆дѣ́же честно́е тѣ́ло твоѐ лежа́ше: здра́вїе и҆сточа́етъ притека́ющымъ вѣ́рнѡ, и҆ твоеѧ̀ просѧ́щымъ по́мощи всегда̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By thy most glorious healing, O father, which thou didst acquire through afflictions, we pray thee, fail not to visit us ever, unceasingly standing before us in great compassion, and lightening the illnesses and labors of our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
By thy most glorious healing, O father, which thou didst acquire through afflictions, we pray thee, fail not to visit us ever, unceasingly standing before us in great compassion, and lightening the illnesses and labors of our souls.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Твои́мъ пресла́внымъ ѻ҆́ч҃е враче́вствомъ, є҆́же болѣ́зньми стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ, посѣща́ти при́снѡ не ѡ҆скꙋдѣ́й мо́лимсѧ, во мно́зѣ милосе́рдїи непреста́ннѡ предстоѧ̀ на́мъ, и҆ ѡ҆блегча́ѧ болѣ̑зни и҆ трꙋды̀ дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Shining sun-like rays upon those who honor thee, O father, enlighten the senses of our souls, and make us partakers of divine brightness through thy prayers, O blessed one, we beseech thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Shining sun-like rays upon those who honor thee, O father, enlighten the senses of our souls, and make us partakers of divine brightness through thy prayers, O blessed one, we beseech thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Со́лнечныѧ ѡ҆блиста́ѧ чтꙋ́щымъ тѧ̀ ѻ҆́ч҃е зарѝ, просвѣтѝ на́ша дꙋшевнаѧ чꙋ́вства, и҆ свѣ́тлости бж҃твенныѧ прича́стники сподо́би ны̀, мл҃твами твои́ми бл҃же́нне бы́ти, мо́лимъ тѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Knowing thee as a radiant cloud of the unsetting Sun, O pure one, in faith we cry unto thee: Rejoice, glory of the apostles, crown of glorious martyrs, and salvation of the faithful, O unwedded Virgin!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Knowing thee as a radiant cloud of the unsetting Sun, O pure one, in faith we cry unto thee: Rejoice, glory of the apostles, crown of glorious martyrs, and salvation of the faithful, O unwedded Virgin!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Свѣтови́денъ тѧ̀ ѻ҆́блакъ, прⷭ҇нагѡ со́лнца вѣ́дꙋще чⷭ҇таѧ, ра́дꙋйсѧ вѣ́рнѡ тебѣ̀ взыва́емъ, а҆пл҃ѡвъ сла́ва, и҆ вѣне́цъ мꙋ́ченикѡвъ сла́вныхъ, и҆ вѣ́рныхъ сп҃се́нїе, дѣ́во неневѣ́стобра́чнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion. Podoben: "The sky with stars" (Не́бо ѕвѣзда́ми):* Thou didst distribute thy wealth to the poor in a manner pleasing unto God, and didst wholly dedicate thyself unto the Lord, O Sampson; pray to Him to deliver us from all passions.[^867]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Exapostilarion. Podoben: "The sky with stars" (Не́бо ѕвѣзда́ми):*
Thou didst distribute thy wealth to the poor in a manner pleasing unto God, and didst wholly dedicate thyself unto the Lord, O Sampson; pray to Him to deliver us from all passions.[^867]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ленъ: Подо́бенъ: Не́бо ѕвѣзда́ми: Расточи́лъ є҆сѝ твоѐ бога́тство ни́щымъ, бг҃оꙋго́днѡ, и҆ ве́сь возложи́лсѧ є҆сѝ самѱѡ́не гдⷭ҇ви, є҆го́же молѝ, всѧ́ческихъ страсте́й на́съ и҆зба́вити.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* By thy mighty protection, from the assault of enemies, preserve all of us, thy servants, unharmed, O pure one; for thee alone have we acquired as a refuge in needs.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
By thy mighty protection, from the assault of enemies, preserve all of us, thy servants, unharmed, O pure one; for thee alone have we acquired as a refuge in needs.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На лїтꙋргі́и, про: гла́съ, з҃. Чⷭ҇тна̀ пред̾ гдⷭ҇емъ сме́рть прпⷣбныхъ є҆гѡ̀. А҆́пⷭ҇лъ къ гала́тѡмъ, зача́ло, сг҃і. Є҆ѵⷢлїе лꙋкѝ, зача́ло, ѯ҃з. Прича́стенъ: Въ па́мѧть вѣ́чнꙋю:
items.english_text: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones.[^868]

provenance.verbatim_source: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones.[^868]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На лїтꙋргі́и, про: гла́съ, з҃. Чⷭ҇тна̀ пред̾ гдⷭ҇емъ сме́рть прпⷣбныхъ є҆гѡ̀. А҆́пⷭ҇лъ къ гала́тѡмъ, зача́ло, сг҃і. Є҆ѵⷢлїе лꙋкѝ, зача́ло, ѯ҃з. Прича́стенъ: Въ па́мѧть вѣ́чнꙋю:
items.english_text: In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be: he shall not be afraid of evil tidings.[^871]

provenance.verbatim_source: In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be: he shall not be afraid of evil tidings.[^871]

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, и҃. Дво́ица мꙋ́нкъ дне́сь возсїѧ̀ на́мъ, дꙋше́вныѧ болѣ̑зни на́ша и҆сцѣлѧ́юща, ку́ръ и҆ і҆ѡа́ннъ чꙋдодѣ́йственнїи: ѻ҆́въ оу҆́бѡ равноа́гг҃льное ѡ҆блобыза́въ є҆ди́нственное житїѐ, да́же до конца̀ пожи́въ, кро́вїю мꙋ́нческую присовокупи́сѧ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀: ѻ҆́въ же въ во́инницѣхъ проше́дъ сосло́вїихъ, небе́снымъ во́инствосло́вїѧмъ градопи́шетсѧ. тѣ́мже и҆ въ па́мѧти и҆́хъ и҆сцѣле́нїа подава́ютъ, вѣ́рою соверша́ющымъ: молѧ́щесѧ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: Let us all praise with songs the pair of combatant martyrs who possess Trinity-like brightness, the foundation of faith, breathing forth flowers, the true sweet fragrance of the knowledge of Christ: Cyrus and with him great John, as they pray unceasingly unto the Lord for us.

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us all praise with songs the pair of combatant martyrs who possess Trinity-like brightness, the foundation of faith, breathing forth flowers, the true sweet fragrance of the knowledge of Christ: Cyrus and with him great John, as they pray unceasingly unto the Lord for us.

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Подо́бенъ: Ѽ пресла́внагѡ чꙋдесѐ! Не терплю̀ ча́до ви́дѧщи тѧ̀ на дре́вѣ оу҆снꙋ́вша, бо́дрость всѣ̑мъ подаю́щаго, ꙗ҆́кѡ да дре́вле престꙋпле́нїѧ плодо́мъ, сно́мъ поги́бельнымъ оу҆снꙋ́вшымъ, бж҃е́ственнꙋю и҆ сп҃си́тельнꙋю бо́дрость пода́си, дв҃а глаго́лаше пла́чꙋщисѧ: ю҆́же велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* By brightness of life and fasting didst thou shine forth, and afterward by suffering didst thou adorn thy soul, O glorious Cyrus; and thou, O wise John, didst leave behind earthly warfare and didst find the heavenly, both of you imploring the Savior for those who call your memory blessed, O blessed ones.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
By brightness of life and fasting didst thou shine forth, and afterward by suffering didst thou adorn thy soul, O glorious Cyrus; and thou, O wise John, didst leave behind earthly warfare and didst find the heavenly, both of you imploring the Savior for those who call your memory blessed, O blessed ones.

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ ѻ҆ктѡ́иха. Сла́ва, гла́съ, в҃. Пріиди́те вѣ́рныхъ сосло́вїе дне́сь, пѣ́сньми вѣнча́емъ ку́ра со і҆ѡа́нномъ: ра́ла бл҃года́тнаѧ, и҆ да́тели просѧ́щымъ незави́стны: многообра́знѣ бо всѣ̑мъ ꙗ҆ви́шасѧ вра́чеве пресвѣ́тлїи.
items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Ye showed yourselves as physicians unto the infirm, O blessed ones, and unsetting luminaries, defenders agreeing in the confession of the divine faith, partakers with the martyrs, having truly received crowns from Christ, O glorious Cyrus and wise John; unceasingly pray to the Savior for those who praise you in faith.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron:*
Ye showed yourselves as physicians unto the infirm, O blessed ones, and unsetting luminaries, defenders agreeing in the confession of the divine faith, partakers with the martyrs, having truly received crowns from Christ, O glorious Cyrus and wise John; unceasingly pray to the Savior for those who praise you in faith.

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ ѻ҆ктѡ́иха. Сла́ва, гла́съ, в҃. Пріиди́те вѣ́рныхъ сосло́вїе дне́сь, пѣ́сньми вѣнча́емъ ку́ра со і҆ѡа́нномъ: ра́ла бл҃года́тнаѧ, и҆ да́тели просѧ́щымъ незави́стны: многообра́знѣ бо всѣ̑мъ ꙗ҆ви́шасѧ вра́чеве пресвѣ́тлїи.
items.english_text: Today the pair of martyrs hath shone forth upon us, healing our spiritual diseases, the wonderworking Cyrus and John: the one having embraced the solitary life equal to the angels, living therein unto the end, was joined unto Christ by martyr's blood; and the other, having passed his life in military ranks, is enrolled among the citizens of the heavenly host. Therefore in their memory they grant healings unto those who celebrate it in faith, praying for our souls.[^873]

provenance.verbatim_source: Today the pair of martyrs hath shone forth upon us, healing our spiritual diseases, the wonderworking Cyrus and John: the one having embraced the solitary life equal to the angels, living therein unto the end, was joined unto Christ by martyr's blood; and the other, having passed his life in military ranks, is enrolled among the citizens of the heavenly host. Therefore in their memory they grant healings unto those who celebrate it in faith, praying for our souls.[^873]

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ ѻ҆ктѡ́иха. Сла́ва, гла́съ, в҃. Пріиди́те вѣ́рныхъ сосло́вїе дне́сь, пѣ́сньми вѣнча́емъ ку́ра со і҆ѡа́нномъ: ра́ла бл҃года́тнаѧ, и҆ да́тели просѧ́щымъ незави́стны: многообра́знѣ бо всѣ̑мъ ꙗ҆ви́шасѧ вра́чеве пресвѣ́тлїи.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion. Podoben: "O most marvelous wonder!" (Ѽ пресла́внагѡ чꙋдесѐ!):* I cannot bear, O Child, to see Thee fallen asleep upon the Tree, Who grantest vigilance unto all, that unto those who of old through the fruit of transgression fell asleep in the sleep of perdition, Thou mightest grant divine and saving vigilance, the Virgin said, weeping: whom we magnify.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.english_text: Come, O ye company of the faithful, today let us crown with songs Cyrus and John: fertile fields of grace, and ungrudging givers unto those that ask; for in manifold ways they have appeared as most radiant physicians unto all...[^874] radiant; therefore do they also pray for our souls.[^875]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: к҃и де́нь свѣ́тлїи. тѣ́мже и҆ мо́лѧтъ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion. Podoben: "When from the Tree" (Є҆гда̀ ѿ дре́ва):* When the undefiled Ewe-lamb beheld her Lamb willingly drawn as a man unto the slaughter, weeping, she said: Dost Thou now hasten to make me childless, O Christ Who gavest birth unto me? What is this that Thou hast done, O Deliverer of all? Yet I hymn and glorify Thine extreme goodness which is beyond mind and word, O Lover of mankind.[^876]

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Подо́бенъ: Є҆гда̀ ѿ дре́ва: Є҆гда̀ нескве́рнаѧ а҆́гница, ви́дѣ своего̀ а҆́гнца, на заколе́нїе ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃вѣ́ка во́лею вле́кома, пла́чꙋщи гл҃аше: безча́дствовати мѧ̀ ны́нѣ тщи́шисѧ хрⷭ҇тѐ ро́ждшꙋю тѧ̀. что̀ сїѐ сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆зба́вителю всѧ́ческихъ? ѻ҆ба́че воспѣва́ю и҆ сла́влю, твою̀ ю҆́же па́че оу҆ма̀ и҆ сло́ва, кра́йнюю бл҃гость человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 5:* Thou Who hast granted us the wonders of Thy holy martyrs as an invincible rampart, O Christ God: by their supplications scatter the counsels of the heathen, strengthen the sceptres of the realm, for Thou alone art good and the Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion, Tone 5:*
Thou Who hast granted us the wonders of Thy holy martyrs as an invincible rampart, O Christ God: by their supplications scatter the counsels of the heathen, strengthen the sceptres of the realm, for Thou alone art good and the Lover of mankind.

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ве́ргшесѧ ны́нѣшнихъ, бꙋ́дꙋщихъ рачи́тели, кро́вми и҆́стинномꋋ рчи́телю подоба́ша: тѣ́мже и҆ ра́нахъ стра́ждꙋще, до́блественнѣ терпѣ́хꙋ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto Him Who showed forth in the world wonderworkers and physicians, honorable Cyrus and John the martyr, healing the passions of all by grace, let us sing, O ye faithful, and let us honor the memory of the martyrs.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Unto Him Who showed forth in the world wonderworkers and physicians, honorable Cyrus and John the martyr, healing the passions of all by grace, let us sing, O ye faithful, and let us honor the memory of the martyrs.

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆крѣ́пльшесѧ дерзнове́нїемъ, и҆ оу҆твер́ждше дꙋ́шꙋ, навчи́вшесѧ ѡ҆ хрⷭ҇тѣ̀, и҆ съ мꙋ́нки пострада́ша мꙋ́жески, и҆ вѣнцы̀ и҆сплето́ша зако́ннѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having rejected the present things, lovers of the future, by blood they were conformed unto the true Lover; therefore, suffering also in wounds, they bravely endured.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having rejected the present things, lovers of the future, by blood they were conformed unto the true Lover; therefore, suffering also in wounds, they bravely endured.

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Спаси́ мѧ мт҃и и҆́стинны, ѡ҆держи́ма лю́тѣ ѿ страсте́й, и҆ ча́стѡ погружа́ема: и҆ напра́ви мѧ̀ чⷭ҇таѧ, ко сп҃се́нїю ти́хагѡ приста́нища.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Strengthened with boldness and having established their soul, instructed in Christ, they suffered manfully with tortures, and lawfully wove crowns.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Strengthened with boldness and having established their soul, instructed in Christ, they suffered manfully with tortures, and lawfully wove crowns.

items.section: Stichera on 6, Tone 4. Podoben: "As noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. І҆рмо́съ: Нѣ́сть ст҃ъ ꙗ҆́кѡ гдⷭ҇ь, и҆ нѣ́сть пра́веденъ ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ на́шъ, є҆го́же пое́тъ всѧ̀ тва́рь: нѣ́сть пра́веденъ па́че тебѐ гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Save me, O Mother of truth, who am grievously held by passions and often submerged; and direct me, O pure one, unto the salvation of the calm haven.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Save me, O Mother of truth, who am grievously held by passions and often submerged; and direct me, O pure one, unto the salvation of the calm haven.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Вѣ́рою ѡ҆востри́лъ є҆сѝ срⷣца̀ твоѧ̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ, наде́ждею и҆скова́лъ є҆сѝ, любо́вїю разже́глъ є҆сѝ: тремѝ воѡрꙋже́нни, треплете́нный вѣне́цъ тѣ́мъ и҆спле́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *There is none holy like the Lord, and there is none righteous like our God, Whom all creation hymns: there is none righteous beside Thee, O Lord.[^878]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
*There is none holy like the Lord, and there is none righteous like our God, Whom all creation hymns: there is none righteous beside Thee, O Lord.[^878]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: До́блѣ сопроти́въ ста́ша къ мꙋчи́телемъ нечести́вымъ, непобѣди́мїи мꙋ́ченицы: пре́лести ловле́нїѧ невре́днѡ преше́дше. хрⷭ҇то́мъ бо воѡрꙋжи́вшесѧ, съ ни́мъ и҆ весе́лѧтсѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With faith Thou didst sharpen their hearts, O Christ, with hope Thou didst forge them, with love Thou didst enkindle them; armed with these three, Thou didst weave for them a thrice-woven crown.[^879]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
With faith Thou didst sharpen their hearts, O Christ, with hope Thou didst forge them, with love Thou didst enkindle them; armed with these three, Thou didst weave for them a thrice-woven crown.[^879]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ столпы̀ бг҃озда́ннїи, и҆ ѡ҆снова́нїа тве́рдаѧ, на ка́мени водрузи́ша восхожде́нїа вѣ́ры: ѿ ка́мене пи́вше во́дꙋ присноживо́тнꙋю, ꙗ҆́же ѿ ча́ши хрⷭ҇то́вы.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Nobly did the invincible martyrs stand against the ungodly tormentors, having passed unharmed through the snares of delusion; for having armed themselves with Christ, they also rejoice with Him.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Nobly did the invincible martyrs stand against the ungodly tormentors, having passed unharmed through the snares of delusion; for having armed themselves with Christ, they also rejoice with Him.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ столпы̀ бг҃озда́ннїи, и҆ ѡ҆снова́нїа тве́рдаѧ, на ка́мени водрузи́ша восхожде́нїа вѣ́ры: ѿ ка́мене пи́вше во́дꙋ присноживо́тнꙋю, ꙗ҆́же ѿ ча́ши хрⷭ҇то́вы.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As God-built pillars and firm foundations, they fixed the ascents of faith upon the rock, having drunk from the rock the ever-living water which is from the cup of Christ...[^880] thou becamest a dwelling for the Spirit, O pure one, having received the fullness of all the Godhead bodily; and having given birth unto the Savior and Lord, and the Deliverer of our race.[^881]

provenance.verbatim_source:

As God-built pillars and firm foundations, they fixed the ascents of faith upon the rock, having drunk from the rock the ever-living water which is from the cup of Christ...[^880]
...thou becamest a dwelling for the Spirit, O pure one, having received the fullness of all the Godhead bodily; and having given birth unto the Savior and Lord, and the Deliverer of our race.[^881]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: мц҃ъ і҆ꙋ́нїй Дх҃ꙋ бы́сть жили́ще чи́стаѧ, пріи́мши и҆сполне́нїе всегѡ̀ бж҃тва сно́внѣ: и҆ ро́ждши сп҃са и҆ гдⷭ҇а, и҆ и҆зба́вителѧ ро́да на́шегѡ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4. Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):* Having trampled underfoot the downward-dragging passions, unto the divine height of martyrdom, O passion-bearers, ye were brightly lifted up by grace, O Cyrus and John, luminaries of the universe; therefore we pray you: deliver us from the darkness of sin and from diseases, praying unto God Who is over all.[^882]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 4. Podoben: "Thou Who wast lifted up" (Вознесы́йсѧ):*
Having trampled underfoot the downward-dragging passions, unto the divine height of martyrdom, O passion-bearers, ye were brightly lifted up by grace, O Cyrus and John, luminaries of the universe; therefore we pray you: deliver us from the darkness of sin and from diseases, praying unto God Who is over all.[^882]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: И҆́же ѿ безна́чалнагѡ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ рожде́ннаго, на послѣ́докъ тѧ̀ пло́тїю ро́ждшаѧ, на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ ви́сѧща зрѧ́щи хрⷭ҇тѐ, оу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ любе́знѣйшій і҆и҃се вопїѧ́ше: ка́кѡ сла́вимый ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ ѿ а҆́гглъ, ѿ беззако́нныхъ ны́нѣ человѣ́кѡвъ сн҃е хотѧ̀ распина́ешисѧ? пою́ тѧ долготерпѣли́ве.
items.english_text: Being a lover of sin, I pray thee who didst bear the sinless God Who takes away the sins of the world, O all-pure one: have compassion upon my much-sinning soul, and cleanse my many sins; for unto sinners thou art cleansing, and salvation unto the faithful, and protection.

provenance.verbatim_source: Being a lover of sin, I pray thee who didst bear the sinless God Who takes away the sins of the world, O all-pure one: have compassion upon my much-sinning soul, and cleanse my many sins; for unto sinners thou art cleansing, and salvation unto the faithful, and protection.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, д҃. І҆рмо́съ: И҆зъ горы̀ приѡсѣне́нныѧ сло́ве, пррⷦ҇къ, є҆ди́ныѧ бцⷣы, хотѧ́ща воплоти́тисѧ, бг҃ови́днѡ оу҆смотрѝ, и҆ со стра́хомъ славосло́ваше си́лꙋ твою̀.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* Beholding Thee hanging upon the Cross, O Christ, she who at the last gave birth unto Thee in the flesh, Who wast born of the unoriginate Father, woe is me! cried aloud, O sweetest Jesus: How art Thou, Who art glorified as God by angels, now willingly crucified by lawless men, O Son? I hymn Thee, O longsuffering One!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
Beholding Thee hanging upon the Cross, O Christ, she who at the last gave birth unto Thee in the flesh, Who wast born of the unoriginate Father, woe is me! cried aloud, O sweetest Jesus: How art Thou, Who art glorified as God by angels, now willingly crucified by lawless men, O Son? I hymn Thee, O longsuffering One!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Тѣ́ло и҆ дꙋ́шꙋ и҆ оу҆́мъ, и҆ серде́чнаѧ всѧ̑, хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ пожро́сте вѣ́рою: и҆ мꙋчи́телей сꙋро́вство побѣ́ждше, зако́ннѡ ст҃і́и вѣнча́стесѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* *From the overshadowed mountain, the prophet foresaw Thee in divine vision, O Word, about to be incarnate of the only Birthgiver of God, and with fear he glorified Thy power.[^883]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
*From the overshadowed mountain, the prophet foresaw Thee in divine vision, O Word, about to be incarnate of the only Birthgiver of God, and with fear he glorified Thy power.[^883]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Мечꙋ̀ и҆ ѻ҆гню̀ тѣ́ло преда́вше, же́ртвы прїѧ́тны бы́сте бг҃ꙋ, и҆ въ воню̀ бл҃гоꙋха́нїѧ, на трапе́зѣ та́йнѣ принесо́стесѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Body and soul and mind, and all the faculties of the heart, did ye sacrifice unto Christ by faith; and having overcome the cruelty of the tormentors, lawfully were ye crowned, O holy ones.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Body and soul and mind, and all the faculties of the heart, did ye sacrifice unto Christ by faith; and having overcome the cruelty of the tormentors, lawfully were ye crowned, O holy ones.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Невгаси́ма зарѧ̀ возсїѧ̀ мі́рꙋ, мо́щы твои́хъ мꙋ́ченикъ бл҃годѣ́телю: є҆́юже ѿгна́сѧ тма̀ неразꙋ́мїѧ, и҆ въ тоѧ̀ мѣ́стѡ введе́сѧ бг҃оразꙋ́мїе.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having surrendered your body to sword and fire, ye became acceptable sacrifices unto God, and for a sweet-smelling savor ye were mystically offered upon the table.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having surrendered your body to sword and fire, ye became acceptable sacrifices unto God, and for a sweet-smelling savor ye were mystically offered upon the table.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Дв҃це чⷭ҇таѧ, сло́ва бж҃твеннагѡ две́ри, це́ркви твое́й совокꙋпле́нныѧ, и҆ тѧ̀ пречи́стꙋю пѣ́сньми хва́лѧщыѧ, покры́й и҆ соблюдѝ ѿ всѧ́кихъ ѕѡ́лъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* An unquenchable radiance hath shone forth upon the world: the relics of Thy martyrs, O Benefactor; whereby the darkness of folly was driven away, and in its place the knowledge of God was introduced.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
An unquenchable radiance hath shone forth upon the world: the relics of Thy martyrs, O Benefactor; whereby the darkness of folly was driven away, and in its place the knowledge of God was introduced.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆́тренююще вопіе́мъ тѝ, гдⷭ҇и спаси́ ны: ты́ бо є҆сѝ бг҃ъ на́шъ, ра́звѣ тебѐ и҆но́гѡ не вѣ́мы.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O pure Virgin, gate of the Divine Word: cover and preserve from all evils those who are gathered together in thy church and praise thee, the all-pure one, with songs.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O pure Virgin, gate of the Divine Word: cover and preserve from all evils those who are gathered together in thy church and praise thee, the all-pure one, with songs.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Спо́тники дв҃ы стѧжа́вше страстоте́рпцы, взѧ́сте соверше́нный вѣне́цъ побѣ́ды ра́дꙋющесѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* *Rising early, we cry unto Thee: O Lord, save us; for Thou art our God, beside Thee we know no other.[^884]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
*Rising early, we cry unto Thee: O Lord, save us; for Thou art our God, beside Thee we know no other.[^884]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Спо́тники дв҃ы стѧжа́вше страстоте́рпцы, взѧ́сте соверше́нный вѣне́цъ побѣ́ды ра́дꙋющесѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having acquired virgins as your fellow-travelers, O passion-bearers, ye took the perfect crown of victory, rejoicing...[^885] enlightened by the dawn of divine radiance, O all-lauded martyrs, ye ever enlighten the world.[^886]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having acquired virgins as your fellow-travelers, O passion-bearers, ye took the perfect crown of victory, rejoicing...[^885]
...enlightened by the dawn of divine radiance, O all-lauded martyrs, ye ever enlighten the world.[^886]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: к҃и де́нь Бж҃твеннагѡ сїѧ́нїѧ заре́ю просвѣ́щшесѧ, мч҃нцы прехва́льнїи, и҆ при́снѡ мі́ръ просвѣща́ете.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having become conformed unto the passions of the Lord, O passion-bearers, ye endured sufferings, invincible in noble-mindedness.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having become conformed unto the passions of the Lord, O passion-bearers, ye endured sufferings, invincible in noble-mindedness.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Страсте́мъ гдⷭ҇нимъ подо́блшесѧ страстоте́рпцы, болѣ̑зни претерпѣ́сте, доблемꙋ́дреннѡ непобѣди́мїи.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Calm the unsteady tempest of my passions, O thou that didst give birth unto God, the Helmsman and Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Calm the unsteady tempest of my passions, O thou that didst give birth unto God, the Helmsman and Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆ти́ши непостоѧ́ннꙋю бꙋ́рю, страсте́й мои́хъ, ꙗ҆́же бг҃а ро́ждши ко́рмчїю и҆ гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *Grant me a radiant robe, Thou that deckest Thyself with light as with a garment, O most merciful Christ our God.[^887]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
*Grant me a radiant robe, Thou that deckest Thyself with light as with a garment, O most merciful Christ our God.[^887]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ри́зꙋ мнѣ̀ пода́ждь свѣ́тлꙋ, ѡ҆дѣѧ́йсѧ свѣ́томъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ри́зою, многомлⷭ҇тиве хрⷭ҇тѐ бж҃е на́шъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having armed yourselves well with the armor of faith, O martyrs, ye firmly wounded the adversary, the enemy and foe.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having armed yourselves well with the armor of faith, O martyrs, ye firmly wounded the adversary, the enemy and foe.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Брона́ми вѣ́ры, до́брѣ воѡрꙋжи́вшесѧ мч҃нцы, тве́рдѡ оу҆язви́сте сопротиво́рца врага̀ и҆ сопоста́та.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The memory of Thy holy ones do we glorify in songs, O Christ; and in faith we offer adoration unto Thee, our God.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The memory of Thy holy ones do we glorify in songs, O Christ; and in faith we offer adoration unto Thee, our God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Па́мѧть ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ хрⷭ҇тѐ, въ пѣ́снехъ сла́вимъ: и҆ тебѣ̀ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꋋ поклоне́нїе вѣ́рою прино́симъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Emulating Thy passions, O Christ, the glorious martyrs endured tortures; by their supplications, O God, save all of us.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Emulating Thy passions, O Christ, the glorious martyrs endured tortures; by their supplications, O God, save all of us.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Страсте́мъ твои̑мъ ревнова́вше хрⷭ҇тѐ, сла́внїи мч҃нцы, мꙋче́нїѧ претерпѣ́ша: и҆́хже мл҃твами бж҃е, спасѝ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The church of God, and the ark, and the animate bridal chamber, and the heavenly gate, O Birthgiver of God, do we the faithful proclaim thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The church of God, and the ark, and the animate bridal chamber, and the heavenly gate, O Birthgiver of God, do we the faithful proclaim thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Це́рковь тѧ̀ бж҃їю и҆ ковче́гъ, и҆ черто́гъ ѡ҆дꙋшевле́нъ, и҆ две́рь нб҃нꙋю бцⷣе, вѣ́рнїи возвѣща́емъ.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 3. Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дв҃а дне́сь):* Having received the gift of wonders from divine grace, O holy ones, ye work wonders unceasingly in the world, invisibly cutting off all our passions by surgical craft, O God-wise Cyrus, with glorious John; for in truth ye are divine physicians.[^888]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 3. Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дв҃а дне́сь):*
Having received the gift of wonders from divine grace, O holy ones, ye work wonders unceasingly in the world, invisibly cutting off all our passions by surgical craft, O God-wise Cyrus, with glorious John; for in truth ye are divine physicians.[^888]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, г҃. Подо́бенъ: Дв҃а дне́сь: Ѿ бж҃твенныѧ благода́ти да́ръ чꙋде́съ воспрїе́мше ст҃і́и, чꙋдодѣ́йствꙋете въ мі́рѣ непреста́ннѡ, всѧ̑ на́ша стра̑сти рꙋкодѣ́йствїемъ и҆з̾сѣка́юще неви́димѡ, ку́ре бг҃омꙋ́дре, со і҆ѡа́нномъ сла́внымъ: вы́ бо сꙋ́щнѣ бж҃е́ственнїи вра́чеве є҆стѐ.
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Having dedicated yourselves unto God, O holy ones, for His sake ye endured every cruel trial, eagerly dying, O noble martyrs; and after your end ye pour forth divine gifts unto all that are in diverse diseases, and heal from many evils, whereof I the wretched one am one and the first: for in body and soul I suffer from cruel wounds, and in faith I cry unto you: Heal me, for ye are divine physicians![^889]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ikos:*
Having dedicated yourselves unto God, O holy ones, for His sake ye endured every cruel trial, eagerly dying, O noble martyrs; and after your end ye pour forth divine gifts unto all that are in diverse diseases, and heal from many evils, whereof I the wretched one am one and the first: for in body and soul I suffer from cruel wounds, and in faith I cry unto you: Heal me, for ye are divine physicians![^889]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: І҆́косъ: Са́ми себѐ бг҃ꙋ возло́жше ст҃і́и, всѐ и҆скꙋше́нїе лю́тое є҆гѡ̀ ра́ди претерпѣ́сте, оу҆ме́рше оу҆се́рднѡ мч҃нцы до́блїи, и҆ по кончи́нѣ всѣ̑мъ и҆сточа́ете бж҃е́ственнаѧ дарова́нїѧ, сꙋ́щымъ въ разли́чныхъ недꙋ́зѣхъ, и҆ ѿ мно́гихъ и҆сцѣлѧ́ете ѕѡ́лъ, ѿ ни́хже є҆ди́нъ и҆ пе́рвыи є҆́смь а҆́зъ ѻ҆каѧ́нный: тѣ́ломъ бо и҆ дꙋше́ю, ѿ ꙗ҆́звъ лю́тыхъ болю̀, и҆ вѣ́рою ва́мъ вопію̀: и҆сцѣли́те мѧ̀, вы́ бо бж҃твеннїи вра́чеве є҆стѐ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* *Thou Who didst save the youths from the fire by an angel, and didst change the thundering furnace into dew: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^890]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
*Thou Who didst save the youths from the fire by an angel, and didst change the thundering furnace into dew: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^890]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. І҆рмо́съ: А҆́гг҃ломъ ѻ҆́троки и҆з̾ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ спасы́й, и҆ гремѧ́щꙋю пе́щь преложи́вый на ро́сꙋ, блгⷭ҇ве́нъ є҆сѝ бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having become lovers of heavenly glory, Thy sufferers, O Lord, Cyrus and John, left behind temporary and perishing glory.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having become lovers of heavenly glory, Thy sufferers, O Lord, Cyrus and John, left behind temporary and perishing glory.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Небе́сныѧ сла́вы рачи́тели бы́вше страда́льцы твоѝ гдⷭ҇и, ку́ръ и҆ і҆ѡа́ннъ, вре́меннꙋю и҆ тлѣ́ющꙋю сла́вꙋ ѡ҆ста́виша.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Surrendering their body as a reasonable sacrifice, and pouring out blood unto Thee, O God, as a ministry, Thy sufferers, O Jesus, were made whole-burnt offerings.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Surrendering their body as a reasonable sacrifice, and pouring out blood unto Thee, O God, as a ministry, Thy sufferers, O Jesus, were made whole-burnt offerings.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ слове́снꙋю же́ртвꙋ преда́вше тѣ́ло, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ слꙋже́нїе и҆злива́юще тебѣ̀ бг҃ꙋ кро́вь, страда́льцы твоѝ і҆и҃се, всесожже́ни бы́ша.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* How fearful is the assembly of the martyrs, for even after death...[^891] it casts out spirits, and grants healing unto the sick.[^892]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
How fearful is the assembly of the martyrs, for even after death...[^891]
...it casts out spirits, and grants healing unto the sick.[^892]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: мц҃ъ і҆ꙋ́нїй по сме́рти дꙋ́хи прогонѧ́етъ, и҆ недꙋ́гꙋющымъ и҆сцѣле́нїе подава́етъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Beyond cause thou didst give birth unto the Cause of all things, Who through extreme goodness became man; therefore with one accord, O pure one, we call thee blessed.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Beyond cause thou didst give birth unto the Cause of all things, Who through extreme goodness became man; therefore with one accord, O pure one, we call thee blessed.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Па́че вины̀ ражда́еши всѧ́ческихъ вино́внаго, премно́гою бл҃гостїю человѣ́ка бы́вша. тѣ́мже согла́снѡ тѧ̀ чи́стаѧ оу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* *Him Who was begotten of the Father before the ages, and in the latter times was incarnate of the Mother: ye priests, bless; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^893]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
*Him Who was begotten of the Father before the ages, and in the latter times was incarnate of the Mother: ye priests, bless; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages![^893]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ѿ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ пре́жде вѣ́къ рожде́ннаго, и҆ ѿ мт҃ре въ послѣ́днаѧ воплоще́ннаго, сщ҃е́нницы бл҃гослови́те, лю́дїе превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having abhorred idol sacrifices, the noble martyrs by their suffering offered themselves as spiritual sacrifices upon the heavenly altar table.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having abhorred idol sacrifices, the noble martyrs by their suffering offered themselves as spiritual sacrifices upon the heavenly altar table.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆і҆́дѡльскихъ негодова́вше же́ртвахъ, дх҃о́вны принесо́ша себѐ же́ртвы, на небе́снѣй трапе́зѣ, до́блїи мꙋче́нїемъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Celebrating mystical services, they offered the consecration of their members unto Him as acceptable sacrifices: body and blood upon the altar table and cup.[^894]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Celebrating mystical services, they offered the consecration of their members unto Him as acceptable sacrifices: body and blood upon the altar table and cup.[^894]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Та́йныѧ слꙋ́жбы сщ҃еннодѣ́йствꙋюще, ѡ҆свѧще́нїе оу҆дѡ́въ томꋋ принесо́ша, ꙗ҆́кѡ прїѧ́тныѧ же́ртвы, тѣ́ло и҆ кро́вь на трапе́зѣ и҆ ча́ши.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having escaped the stumbling-block of the grandmother of our race, ye found the stream of delight, and tasted of the divine tree, O maidens, having adorned yourselves with sufferings.[^895]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having escaped the stumbling-block of the grandmother of our race, ye found the stream of delight, and tasted of the divine tree, O maidens, having adorned yourselves with sufferings.[^895]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Запина́телѧ врама́тере оу҆тли́вшесѧ, пи́щный ѡ҆брѣ́сте пото́къ, и҆ ѿ бж҃твеннагѡ дре́ва вкꙋси́сте дѣ́вцы, страда́льми оу҆краси́вшесѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The divine prophecies of the prophets received their fulfillment in thee, O most holy one, convincing the whole world worthily to sing to thee, O pure one.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The divine prophecies of the prophets received their fulfillment in thee, O most holy one, convincing the whole world worthily to sing to thee, O pure one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Прорѡ́къ прорече́нїѧ прест҃аѧ въ тебѣ̀ коне́цъ прїѧ́ша бж҃е́ственный, мі́ръ ве́сь до́лжнѡ тѧ̀ пѣ́ти чⷭ҇таѧ оу҆бѣжда́ютъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *We magnify thee, the Mother of God, and we glorify thee, O Virgin Birthgiver of God, as having given birth unto the Savior of our souls.[^896]*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
*We magnify thee, the Mother of God, and we glorify thee, O Virgin Birthgiver of God, as having given birth unto the Savior of our souls.[^896]*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Велича́емъ тѧ̀ мт҃рь бж҃їю, и҆ сла́вимъ тѧ̀ бцⷣе дв҃о, ꙗ҆́кѡ сп҃са ро́ждшꙋю дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The armor-bearers of Christ, physicians unto the sick, Cyrus and John, having received the grace of wonders from God, heal all of us.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The armor-bearers of Christ, physicians unto the sick, Cyrus and John, having received the grace of wonders from God, heal all of us.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇то́вы ѡ҆рꙋ́жницы недꙋ́гꙋющымъ вра́чеве, ку́ръ и҆ і҆ѡа́ннъ, чꙋде́съ бл҃года́ть ѿ бг҃а пріе́мше: и҆сцѣлѧ́ютъ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Standing before us, the invincible Cyrus and John completely drive away spiritual passions by faith and by the power of Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Standing before us, the invincible Cyrus and John completely drive away spiritual passions by faith and by the power of Christ.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Дꙋше́вныѧ стра̑сти, пред̾ста́вше ку́ръ и҆ і҆ѡа́ннъ, до конца̀ ѿгонѧ́тъ вѣ́рою, и҆ си́лою хрⷭ҇то́вою, непобѣди́мїи.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O God the Creator, Whom Cyrus and John preached of old: have compassion upon all who celebrate the memory of their martyrdom.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
O God the Creator, Whom Cyrus and John preached of old: have compassion upon all who celebrate the memory of their martyrdom.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃е зижди́телю, є҆го́же проповѣ́даша и҆ногда̀, ку́ръ и҆ і҆ѡа́ннъ, творѧ́щыѧ па́мѧть тѣ́хъ мꙋче́нїѧ, всѧ̑ оу҆ще́дри.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Let us all divinely honor the Mother of our God; for through her have we who hymn her been accounted worthy of honor on high.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Let us all divinely honor the Mother of our God; for through her have we who hymn her been accounted worthy of honor on high.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ленъ. Подо́бенъ: Не́бо ѕвѣзда́ми: Чꙋдодѣ́йственнїи свѣти́льницы, ку́ре со і҆ѡа́нномъ, дꙋше́вныѧ на́ша недꙋ́ги и҆ тѣле́сныѧ и҆сцѣли́те, ѿ гдⷭ҇а пріе́мше блгⷣть и҆сцѣле́нїй.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou wast the cause of the good things given by God unto the world, O Birthgiver of God; but even now pray for the common salvation unto God Who is easily reconciled.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thou wast the cause of the good things given by God unto the world, O Birthgiver of God; but even now pray for the common salvation unto God Who is easily reconciled.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На стїхо́внѣ ѻ҆ктѡ́иха. Сла́ва, гла́съ, д҃. Достохва́льными пѣ́сньми, вѣ́рнїи возвели́чимъ ку́ра, и҆ і҆ѡа́нна, и҆́же дх҃омъ є҆динокро́внымъ
items.english_text: With praiseworthy songs, O ye faithful, let us magnify Cyrus and John, who in spirit are blood-brothers...[^898] kinsmen and brotherly in mind according to the flesh; with whom, praising noble Athanasia and her offspring, Theodota, Eudoxia, and Theoctiste, passion-bearers and venerable ones, who pray to Christ for our souls.[^899]

provenance.verbatim_source: With praiseworthy songs, O ye faithful, let us magnify Cyrus and John, who in spirit are blood-brothers...[^898]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: кρώвнымъ, и҆ по пло́ти братомꙋ́дрымъ: * съ ни́миже а҆ѳанасі́ю до́блюю похваля́юще, * и҆ прозѧбе́ніе є҆ѧ̀, ѳеодо́тію, єv҆доѯі́ю, и҆ ѳеокті́стꙋ, * страстоте́рпницы и҆ прпⷣбны: * молѧ́щыѧ хрⷭ҇та̀ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Stavrotheotokion:* *Tone 4, Podoben: "As one noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Stavrotheotokion:*
*Tone 4, Podoben: "As one noble" (Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ):*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Крестобогоро́диченъ: Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ: Распина́ема хрⷭ҇та̀ чл҃вѣколю́бца, ви́дѧщи пречⷭ҇таѧ, * и҆ ре́бра и҆скопова́ема копіе́мъ, * пла́чꙋщи вопія́ше: * что̀ сіѐ сн҃е мо́й? * что́ ти безблагада́тніи лю́діе возда́ша? * за ꙗ҆̀же сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ дѡ́браѧ и҆̀мъ: * и҆ тщи́шисѧ безча́дствовати мѧ̀ вселюбве́знѣйшій: * ꙋ҆дивля́юсѧ бл҃гоꙋтро́бне, твоемꙋ̀ во́льномꙋ распятію.
items.english_text: Beholding Christ, the Lover of mankind, crucified, and His side pierced with a spear, the all-pure one wept and cried aloud: "What is this, O my Son? What have the thankless people rendered unto Thee in return for the good things Thou hast done for them? And dost Thou hasten to leave me childless, O most dearly beloved? I marvel, O Compassionate One, at Thy voluntary crucifixion!"

items.slavonic_text: скꙋю пре́лесть ѿгонѧ́ще: * тѣ́мже тайноводи́ми ѿ ѻ҆бои́хъ, * пое́мъ тѧ̀: і҆и҃се всеси́льне, сп҃се дꙋ́шъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: Thou hast given a pattern of conversion unto those who sin, in both of Thine Apostles: the one having denied Thee, indeed, in Thy Passion, and repented; the other having opposed Thy proclamation, and believed; and both being the foremost of the assembly of Thy friends, O all-powerful Jesus, Savior of our souls.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Кро́въ тво́й бг҃оро́дице дв҃о, * враче́вство є҆́сть дꙋхо́вное: * въ ѻ҆́нь бо прибѣга́юще, ѿ дꙋше́вныхъ недꙋ́гъ и҆збавля́емсѧ.
items.english_text: Thou wast an insulter and persecutor of the Church, O all-blessed Paul; but having been called from heaven, thou didst defend her most gloriously. Pray now for her,[^902] that she may be delivered from tribulations and that our souls may be saved.

items.slavonic_text: На стіхо́внѣ стіхи̑ры, гла́съ, в҃. Подо́бенъ: Є҆гда̀ ѿ дре́ва: Пе́тре а҆пⷭ҇лѡвъ ѡ҆снова́ніе, * ка́меню хрⷭ҇товы цр҃кве, * хрⷭ҇тіа́нѡвъ нача́ло, * пасѝ ѻ҆́вцы твоегѡ̀ двора̀ сла́внѡ. * а҆́гнцы твоѧ̑ сохранѝ, ѿ волкѡ́въ хи́щныхъ. * и҆зба́ви ста́до твоѐ ѿ напа́стей лю́тыхъ. * тѧ̀ бо моли́твенника къ бг҃ꙋ неꙋсы́пна стѧжа́хомъ вои́стиннꙋ, * и҆ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ хва́лѧщесѧ спаса́емсѧ всѝ.
items.english_text: Thy protection, O Virgin Mother of God, is a spiritual medicine-house; for fleeing unto it, we are delivered from spiritual infirmities.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy protection, O Virgin Mother of God, is a spiritual medicine-house; for fleeing unto it, we are delivered from spiritual infirmities.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, д҃. І҆ѡа́нна мона́ха: Хрⷭ҇то́съ тѧ̀ пе́рваго и҆збра́въ, пе́тре, ѡ҆снова́ніе вѣ́ры бг҃овѣнча́нна тѧ̀, и҆́же всѣ́хъ влⷣка тебѣ̀ предречѐ:
items.english_text: O Peter, foundation of the Apostles, rock of Christ's Church, beginning of Christians, shepherd the sheep of thy sheepfold gloriously; preserve thy lambs from predatory wolves; deliver thy flock from cruel misfortunes; for we have truly acquired thee as an unslumbering intercessor before God, and boasting in thee we all are saved.

items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* Their sound is gone out into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world. [Ps. 18:4 / LXX 18:5]

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 8, Tone 2. Automelon
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Вхо́дъ. Прокі́менъ днѐ.
items.english_text: With what crowns of praise shall we wreath Peter and Paul, divided in bodies and united in spirit, the foremost champions of the divine heralds: the one, indeed, as the leader of the Apostles, and the other as having labored more than the rest? For them truly, with crowns of immortal glory, Christ our God does crown, Who has great mercy.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Вхо́дъ. Прокі́менъ днѐ.
items.english_text: With what melodies of song shall we garland Peter and Paul: the wings of the knowledge of God, who flew across the ends of the earth and ascended unto heaven; the hands of the Gospel of grace; the feet of the true proclamation; the rivers of wisdom; the horns of the Cross, through which Christ cast down the demonic arrogance, He that has great mercy?

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 8, Tone 2. Automelon
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Вхо́дъ. Прокі́менъ днѐ.
items.english_text: By the threefold questioning, "Peter, lovest thou Me?", Christ repaired the threefold denial. Therefore Simon also said unto the Knower of secrets: "Lord, Thou knowest all things, Thou understandest all things; Thou knowest that I love Thee." Therefore the Savior said unto him: "Feed My sheep, feed My chosen ones, feed My lambs, which I have purchased with My blood unto salvation." Pray unto Him, O divinely blessed Apostle, that He grant us great mercy.

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 8, Tone 2. Automelon
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Собо́рнагѡ посла́ніѧ петро́ва чте́ніе. Бра́тіе, бл҃гослове́нъ бг҃ъ и҆ ѻ҆ц҃ъ гдⷭ҇а на́шегѡ і҆и҃са хрⷭ҇та̀, и҆́же по мно́зѣй свое́й мл҃ти порожде́й на́съ во ꙋ҆пова́ніе жи́во, воскресе́ніемъ і҆и҃съ хрⷭ҇то́вымъ ѿ ме́ртвыхъ. Въ наслѣ́діе нетлѣ́нно, и҆ нескве́рно, и҆ невѧда́емо, соблюде́но на нб҃сѣ́хъ ва́съ ра́ди. И҆́же си́лою бж҃іею соблюде́ни вѣ́рою, во сп҃се́ніе гото́вое ꙗ҆ви́тисѧ во вре́мѧ послѣ́днее. Ѡ҆ не́мже ра́дꙋйтеся, ма́лѡ ны́нѣ, а҆́ще лѣ́по є҆́сть, приско́рбни бы́вше въ разли́чныхъ напа́стехъ: Да и҆скꙋше́ніе ва́шеѧ вѣ́ры, многочестнѣ́йше зла́та ги́бнꙋща, ѻ҆гне́мъ же и҆скꙋше́на, ѡ҆брѧ́щетсѧ въ похвалꙋ̀ и҆ че́сть и҆ сла́вꙋ, во ѿкрове́ніи і҆и҃съ хрⷭ҇товѣ. Є҆го́же не ви́дѣвше лю́бите: и҆ на него́же ны́нѣ не зрѧ́ще, вѣ́рꙋюще же, ра́дꙋйтеся ра́достію неизглаго́ланною и҆ просла́вленною. Пріе́млюще кончи́нꙋ вѣ́рѣ ва́шей, сп҃се́ніе дꙋша́мъ.

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 8, Tone 2. Automelon
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Собо́рнагѡ посла́ніѧ петро́ва чте́ніе. Глава̀, а҃. Возлю́бленніи, препоѧ́савше чресла̀ помышле́ніѧ ва́шегѡ, трезвѧ́щеся соверше́ннѣ ꙋ҆пова́йте на приноси́мꙋю ва́мъ бл҃года́ть, ѿкрове́ніемъ і҆и҃съ хрⷭ҇товымъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ча́да послꙋша́ніѧ, непреѡбразꙋ́ющеся пе́рвыми невѣ́дѣніѧ ва́шегѡ похотѣ́ніи: Но по зва́вшемꙋ вы̀ ст҃о́мꙋ, и҆ са́ми ст҃и во все́мъ житіѝ бꙋ́дите. Зане́ пи́сано є҆́сть: ст҃и бꙋ́дите, ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ ст҃ъ є҆́смь. И҆ а҆́ще ѻ҆ц҃а̀ называ́ете нелицемѣ́рнѡ сꙋ́дѧща коемꙋ́ждо по дѣ́лꙋ, со стра́хомъ житіѧ̀ ва́шегѡ вре́мѧ жи́тельствꙋйте. Вѣ́дѧще ꙗ҆́кѡ не и҆стлѣ́ннымъ сребро́мъ, и҆лѝ зла́томъ и҆зба́витеся ѿ сꙋ́етнагѡ ва́шегѡ житіѧ̀ ѻ҆ц҃ы преда́ннагѡ: Но чтⷭ҇ною кро́вію, ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гнца непоро́чна, и҆ пречи́ста хрⷭ҇та̀.
items.english_text: Brethren: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, Who according to His great mercy has begotten us again unto a living hope, by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, unto an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fades not away, reserved in heaven for you, who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time. Wherein rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold trials: that the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perishes, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honor and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ; Whom having not seen, ye love; in Whom, though now ye see Him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory, receiving the end of your faith: the salvation of souls.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Собо́рнагѡ посла́ніѧ петро́ва чте́ніе. Глава̀, в҃. Возлю́бленніи, молю̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ прише́лцы и҆ стра́нники, ѿгреба́тися ѿ плотски́хъ похоте́й, ꙗ҆̀же вою́ютъ на дꙋ́шꙋ: житіѐ ва́ше и҆мꙋ́ще добро̀ во ꙗ҆зы́цѣхъ: да ѡ҆ не́мже клеве́щꙋтъ ва́съ, а҆́ки ѕлодѣ́євъ, ѿ до́брыхъ дѣ́лъ ви́дѣвше, просла́вѧтъ бг҃а въ де́нь посѣще́ніѧ. Повини́теся ꙋ҆́бѡ всѧ́комꙋ человѣ́чꙋ созда́нію, гдⷭ҇а ра́ди: а҆́ще царю̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ преѡблада́ющꙋ: А҆́ще ли же кнѧзе́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ негѡ̀ по́сланнымъ, во ѿмще́ніе ꙋ҆́бѡ ѕлодѣ́ємъ, въ похвалꙋ́ же бл҃готво́рцемъ. Ꙗ҆́кѡ та́кѡ є҆́сть во́лѧ бж҃іѧ, бл҃готворѧ́щымъ ѡ҆бꙋздова́ти безꙋ́мныхъ человѣ́къ невѣ́жество: Ꙗ҆́кѡ свобо́дни, а҆ не ꙗ҆́кѡ прикрове́ніе и҆мꙋ́ще ѕло́бы свобо́дꙋ, но ꙗ҆́кѡ рабѝ бж҃іи. Всѣ́хъ почита́йте: бра́тство возлюби́те:
items.english_text: Beloved: Having girded up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is being brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ; as obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts of your ignorance; but as He Who called you is holy, so be ye holy in all your manner of life. Because it is written: "Be ye holy, for I am holy." And if ye call on the Father, Who without respect of persons judges according to every man's work, pass the time of your dwelling here in fear; knowing that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver or gold, from your vain manner of life received by tradition from your fathers, but with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot.
