items.english_text: Beloved: I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul; having your conversation honest among the Gentiles, that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation. Submit yourselves therefore to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme, or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well. For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men: as free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God. Honor all men. Love the brotherhood.

items.slavonic_text: бг҃а бо́йтеся: царѧ̀ чти́те. Рабѝ, повину́йтеся во всѧ́комъ стра́сѣ влады́камъ, не то́кмѡ бл҃ги́мъ и҆ кро́ткимъ, но и҆ стропти́вымъ. Се́ бо є҆́сть ꙋ҆го́дно пред̾ бг҃омъ, а҆́ще со́вѣсти ра́ди бж҃іѧ те́рпитъ кто̀ скѡ́рби, стра́жда без̾ пра́вды. Ка́ѧ бо похвала̀ а҆́ще согрѣша́юще мꙋчи́ми те́рпите: но а҆́ще добро̀ творѧ́ще, и҆ стра́ждꙋще те́рпите: сіѐ ꙋ҆го́дно пред̾ бг҃омъ: На сіе́ бо и҆ зва́ни бы́сте. Зане́ и҆ хрⷭ҇то́съ пострада̀ по на́съ, на́мъ ѡ҆ста́вль ѡ҆́бразъ, да послѣ́дꙋемъ стопа́мъ є҆гѡ̀. И҆́же грѣха̀ не сотворѝ, ни ѡ҆брѣ́теся ле́сть во ꙋ҆стѣ́хъ є҆гѡ̀: И҆́же ꙋ҆карѧ́емь, проти́вꙋ не ꙋ҆карѧ́ше: стра́жда, не преща́ше: предава́ше же сꙋдѧ́щемꙋ пра́веднѡ. И҆́же грѣ́хи на́ша са́мъ вознесѐ на тѣ́лѣ свое́мъ на дре́во: да ѿ грѣ̑хъ и҆збы́вше, пра́вдою поживе́мъ.
items.english_text: Fear God. Honor the king. Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward. For this is thankworthy before God, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully. For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye take it patiently? But if, when ye do well and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God. For even hereunto were ye called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow His steps: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in His mouth; Who, when He was reviled, reviled not again; when He suffered, He threatened not; but committed Himself to Him that judges righteously; Who His own Self bore our sins in His own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness.

items.slavonic_text: Герма́ново: Пе́тре верхо́вне сла́вныхъ а҆по́столъ, * ка́меню вѣ́ры, * и҆ па́ѵле
items.english_text: Come today, ye assemblies of the faithful, a laudable and fair gathering: let us wreath the chosen craftsmen of grace, Peter and Paul, with fitting praises! For they ungrudgingly proclaimed the word unto all; and by these things they enriched the world with the gifts of the Spirit; and being branches of the true Vine, they cultivated for us a ripe cluster that gladdens our hearts. Unto them, with unveiled face and a pure conscience, let us cry aloud, saying: "Rejoice, destroyers of irrational things, and servants of reasonable things! Rejoice, fair chosen ones of the Creator and Provider of all! Rejoice, intercessors for good things and expellers of deceitful things; whom let us beseech to pray continually unto the Creator and Teacher, that He grant steadfast peace to the world, and to our souls great mercy!"

items.english_text: Let us praise the disciples of Christ and foundations of the Church: the true pillars and walls, and divine trumpets of Christ's teachings and sufferings, the preeminent Peter and Paul, as protectors of the whole world! For these, having traversed the breadth of the whole earth, as with a plow sowed the faith, and planted the knowledge of God in all, manifesting the word of the Trinity. O Peter, rock and foundation, and Paul, chosen vessel, who as yoked oxen of Christ drew all unto the knowledge of God: the nations, cities, and islands, and brought the Hebrews again unto Christ; and they pray that our souls may be saved!

items.slavonic_text: На стіхо́внѣ стіхи̑ры самогла́сны, Гла́съ, а҃. А҆ндре́а кри́тскагѡ: Ꙗ҆̀же по всѧ̑ гра́ды ꙋ҆́зы и҆ скѡ́рби твоѧ̑, * кто̀ ска́жетъ сла́вне а҆́пⷭ҇ле па́ѵле? * трꙋды̀ бѡлѣ́зни и҆ бдѣ́ніѧ, * ꙗ҆̀же во а҆́лчбѣ и҆ жа́ждѣ ѕлостра́стіѧ: * ꙗ҆̀же въ зимѣ̀ и҆ наготѣ̀, * ко́шницꙋ, и҆ жезлобіе́ніѧ: * каменномета́ніѧ, и҆ ѡ҆бхожде́ніѧ: * глꙋбины̀ и҆стопле́ніѧ: * позо́ръ бы́сть а҆́гг҃лѡвъ и҆ человѣ́кѡвъ. * всѧ̑ ꙋ҆́бѡ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, * ѡ҆ ꙋ҆крѣплѧ́ющемъ тѧ̀ хрⷭ҇тѣ̀: * да мі́ръ приѡбрѧ́щеши, * ѡ҆ хрⷭ҇тѣ̀ і҆и҃сѣ гдⷭ҇ѣ твое́мъ. * тѣ́мже мо́лимъ тѧ̀, * творѧ́щіи па́мѧть твою̀ вѣ́рнѡ, * непреста́ннѡ молѝ, спасти́ся дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.

O Peter, rock of the faith, and Paul, boast of the universe: confirm the flock which ye acquired by your teachings!

items.english_text: Who shall tell of thy bonds and tribulations in every city, O glorious Apostle Paul? The labors, afflictions, and vigils; the hardships in hunger and thirst; the trials in cold and nakedness; the basket, and the beatings with rods; the stonings, and the journeyings; the deeps of shipwreck? Thou wast a spectacle unto angels and men! All things, therefore, didst thou endure in Christ Who strengthened thee, that thou mightest win the world in Christ Jesus thy Lord. Therefore we beseech thee, who faithfully celebrate thy memory: pray unceasingly that our souls may be saved!

Ꙗ҆̀же по всѧ̑ гра́ды вѧза́ніѧ и҆ скѡ́рби твоѧ̑, * кто̀ и҆сповѣ́сть сла́вне а҆́пⷭ҇ле? * и҆лѝ кто̀ предста́витъ по́двиги и҆ трꙋды̀ твоѧ̑, * и҆́миже трꙋди́лся є҆сѝ во єv҆а́ггеліи хрⷭ҇то́вѣ, * да всѧ̑ приѡбрѧ́щеши, * и҆ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ приведе́ши це́рковь? * но сію̀ просѝ сохрани́ти до́брое твоѐ и҆сповѣда́ніе, * да́же до коне́чнагѡ и҆здыха́ніѧ, * па́ѵле а҆́пⷭ҇ле, и҆
items.english_text: Who shall recount thy bonds and tribulations in every city, O glorious Apostle? Or who shall set forth thy struggles and labors, wherewith thou didst labor in the Gospel of Christ, that thou mightest win all, and bring the Church unto Christ? But ask that she preserve thy good confession even unto her final breath, O Paul, Apostle and teacher of the churches.

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 8, Tone 2. Automelon
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* The heavens declare the glory of God, and the firmament proclaims the work of His hands. [Ps. 18:1 / LXX 18:2]
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, ѕ҃. Є҆фре́ма ка́ріа: Пра́здникъ ра́достенъ возсія̀ конце́мъ дне́сь, * всечⷭ҇тна́ѧ па́мѧть премꙋ́дрыхъ а҆́пⷭ҇лъ, * и҆ верхо́вныхъ, петра̀ и҆ па́ѵла. * тѣ́мже и҆ ри́мъ сра́дꙋетсѧ ликовствꙋ́ѧ, * въ пѣ́снехъ и҆ пѣ́ніихъ, * пра́зднꙋемъ и҆ мы̀ бра́тіе, всечестны́й сі́й де́нь соверши́вше: * ра́дꙋйсѧ пе́тре а҆́пⷭ҇ле, и҆́скренній дрꙋ́же, твоегѡ̀ ꙋ҆чи́телѧ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а на́шегѡ: * ра́дꙋйсѧ па́ѵле вселюбве́знѣйшій, * и҆ проповѣ́дниче вѣ́ры, и҆ ꙋ҆чи́телю вселе́нныя: * ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆мѣ́ѧ дерзнове́ніе, * сопрꙋ́же дво́ице ст҃оизбра́ннаѧ, * хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а на́шего моли́те спасти́ся дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_text: Let us praise Peter and Paul, the great beacons of the Church: for they shone forth more brightly than the sun upon the firmament of the faith, and with the rays of proclamation they raised up the nations from ignorance. The one, indeed, being nailed to the cross, made his journey unto heaven, where he received the keys of the Kingdom from Christ; the other, being beheaded with the sword, departed unto the Savior; worthily are they blessed, and they both proclaim unto Israel that they wrongfully stretched out their hands against the Lord Himself. Therefore, by their prayers, O Christ our God, cast down those who rage against us, and confirm the faith of the Orthodox, as Thou art the Lover of mankind.

items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera on 8, Tone 2. Automelon
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На ꙋ҆́трени, на Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь, тропа́рь а҆́пⷭ҇лѡвъ, два́жды: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Є҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка ꙋ҆тае́ное:
items.english_text: A joyful feast has shone forth unto the ends of the earth today: the all-venerable memory of the all-wise and preeminent Apostles, Peter and Paul! Therefore Rome also rejoices together, making festival in songs and chants; let us also, brethren, celebrate, having accomplished this all-honorable day: "Rejoice, O Apostle Peter, intimate friend of thy Teacher, Christ our God! Rejoice, O most dearly beloved Paul, herald of the faith and teacher of the universe!" As ye have boldness, O divinely chosen yoke-pair, pray unto Christ our God that our souls may be saved.

items.english_text: Written at Small Vespers: "O foremost enthroned...", and "O Virgin Mother of God, rejoice..." once; and a reading.

items.section: At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Apostles, twice
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Ка́мени запеча́танꙋ: Це́рковнаго ка́менѧ, всехва́льнаго петра̀, * и҆ побо́рника па́ѵла, мірскꙋ́ю мре́жꙋ, * досто́йнѡ восхва́лимъ вѣ́рніи, * ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆мꙋ́ща ключи̑ не́бнаѧ: * ѿ ни́хъ бо просвѣти́ся вселе́ннаѧ, * вѣ́рою
items.english_text: Having abandoned the chief part of bodily strength,[^910] receiving from the Father the divine revelation from heaven of the incarnation of the Word, thou didst faithfully cry aloud with boldness unto thy Creator: "I know Thee to be the consubstantial Son of God!" Therefore, according to thy worth, thou wast truly shown to be the rock of the faith, and keeper of the keys of grace, O Apostle Peter. Pray unto Christ God that He grant forgiveness of sins unto those who celebrate thy holy memory with love.

items.english_text: Let us the faithful worthily praise Peter, the rock of the Church, the all-praised, and Paul the defender, the worldly net, as possessing the heavenly keys; for by them the universe was enlightened with faith with faith in the Trinity. Glory to Him Who has glorified you! Glory to Him Who has strengthened you! Glory to Him Who for your sake has granted eternal life!

items.section: At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Apostles, twice
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Рꙋ́цѣ твоѝ бж҃е́ственніи, * и҆́миже созда́телѧ понесла̀ є҆сѝ дв҃о пречⷭ҇таѧ, вопло́щшагосѧ бл҃госты́нею: * просте́рши ꙋ҆молѝ є҆го̀, * и҆зба́вити на́съ ѿ и҆скꙋше́ній, и҆ страсте́й, и҆ бѣ́дъ, * хва́лѧщихъ тѧ̀ любо́вію, и҆ вопію́щихъ: * сла́ва все́льшемꙋся въ тѧ̀: * сла́ва проше́дшемꙋ и҆з̾ тебѐ: * сла́ва и҆зба́вльшемꙋ на́съ рождество́мъ твои́мъ.
items.english_text: Thy divine hands, wherewith thou didst bear the Creator, O all-pure Virgin, Who was incarnate in His goodness: stretch them forth and beseech Him to deliver us from temptations, passions, and tribulations, who praise thee with love and cry aloud: "Glory to Him Who dwelt in thee! Glory to Him Who came forth from thee! Glory to Him Who has delivered us through thy childbearing!"

items.section: At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Apostles, twice
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Те́плое застꙋпле́ніе сꙋ́щымъ въ бѣда́хъ, * и҆ помо́щницꙋ на́шꙋ, * и҆ къ бг҃ꙋ премѣне́ніе: * є҆́юже тлѝ и҆зба́вихомся, * бцⷣꙋ вѣ́рніи ꙋ҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: Having received the call from heaven from Christ, thou wast shown to be a herald of the light; thou didst graciously illumine all with thy teachings; for having stripped away the service of the letter of the Law, thou didst cause the understanding of the Spirit to shine forth upon the faithful. Therefore thou wast also worthily caught up on high unto the third heaven, and didst attain unto Paradise, O Apostle Paul: pray unto Christ God that He grant forgiveness of sins unto those who celebrate thy holy memory with love.

Therefore thou wast also worthily caught up on high unto the third heaven, and didst attain unto Paradise, O Apostle Paul: pray unto Christ God that He grant forgiveness of sins unto those who celebrate thy holy memory with love.

items.section: At Matins, at "God is the Lord," Troparion of the Apostles, twice
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ, бг҃оро́диченъ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ всенепоро́чнаѧ невѣ́сто тво́рцꙋ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ неискꙋсо­мꙋ́жнаѧ мт҃и и҆зба́вителѧ, * прія́телище ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́щи ꙋ҆тѣ́шителѧ препѣ́таѧ, * беззако́нію мѧ̀ сꙋ́ща скве́рное ѡ҆би́телище, * и҆ бѣ́сѡмъ и҆гра́лище въ ра́зꙋмѣ бы́вша: * потщи́ся ѿ тѣ́хъ ѕлодѣ́йства мѧ̀ и҆зба́вити: * и҆ свѣ́тлое жили́ще добродѣ́телей совершѝ, * свѣтоно́снаѧ нетлѣ́ннаѧ: * ѿженѝ ѻ҆́блакъ страсте́й
items.english_text: With light-beaming rays, like stars, ye illumine the ends of the earth with the teachings of the holy proclamation, O heavenly initiates of mysteries, Apostles of the Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: With light-beaming rays, like stars, ye illumine the ends of the earth with the teachings of the holy proclamation, O heavenly initiates of mysteries, Apostles of the Lord.

items.english_text: As a fervent protection for those in tribulations, and our helper, and reconciliation unto God, through whom we have been delivered from corruption: we the faithful bless the Mother of God.

items.english_text: Let us praise Peter and the all-wise Paul, who appeared as the preeminent among the disciples, the great and radiant beacons; for having shone forth with the fire of the divine Spirit, they burned up all the gloom of deception. Therefore they were also worthily shown to be armorbearers of the Kingdom on high, and enthroned companions of grace. For this cause we cry aloud: "O Apostles of Christ God, ask forgiveness of transgressions for those who celebrate your holy memory with love!" Twice.

items.english_text: As the all-immaculate bride of the Creator, as the unwedded Mother of the Redeemer, as the receptacle of the Comforter, O all-hymned one: seeing that I am a defiled dwelling-place of iniquity and have consciously become a plaything of demons, hasten to deliver me from their evildoing, and make me a radiant dwelling-place of virtues, O light-bearing and incorruptible one! Drive away the cloud of passions passions, and vouchsafe me communion with the things on high and with the unwaning light, by thy prayers.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* Praise God in His saints. [Ps. 150:1]
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Го́рꙋ ст҃ꙋ́ю, превы́шнее носи́ло, * мт҃рь бж҃ію, * и҆ дв҃ꙋ и҆́стиннꙋю по рождествѣ̀ воспои́мъ.
items.english_text: The true heralds of piety and most radiant stars of the Church, let us honor with laudable songs: Peter the rock of the faith, and Paul the true teacher and initiate of Christ's mysteries; for having sown the true word in the hearts of the faithful, they bestow fruitfulness upon all, and they pray unto Christ God that our souls may be saved.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ канѡ́нъ ст҃а́гѡ а҆́пⷭ҇ла па́ѵла, тропарѝ на ѕ҃. Гла́съ, ӣ. Пѣ́снь, а҃. І҆рмо́съ: О҆усѣче́наѧ несекѡ́маго пресѣче́, * и҆ ви́дѣ сл҃нце зе́млю, ю҆́же не ви́дѣ. * лю́таго врага̀ вода̀ потопѝ, * и҆ непроходи́мое про́йде і҆и҃ль. * пѣ́снь же воспѣва́шеся, * гдⷭ҇ви пои́мъ: сла́внѡ бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *Two Canons, the composition of John of Damascus.*[^911]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Two Canons, the composition of John of Damascus.*[^911]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́дꙋщее возвѣща́ѧ тебѣ̀ сіѧ́ніе, * бл҃гоче́стіѧ па́ѵле, * и҆ ле́сти ѡ҆чище́ніе, * хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́лся на горѣ̀ молніезра́ченъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* There is none like unto Thee, O all-glorious Lord, for with a strong hand Thou hast delivered the people whom Thou hast acquired, O Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1. Heirmos:*
There is none like unto Thee, O all-glorious Lord, for with a strong hand Thou hast delivered the people whom Thou hast acquired, O Lover of mankind.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́дꙋщее возвѣща́ѧ тебѣ̀ сіѧ́ніе, * бл҃гоче́стіѧ па́ѵле, * и҆ ле́сти ѡ҆чище́ніе, * хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́лся на горѣ̀ молніезра́ченъ:
items.english_text: Today, let us worthily hymn the foremost of the Apostles, as the first-called of Christ, with divinely inspired songs.

provenance.verbatim_source: Today, let us worthily hymn the foremost of the Apostles, as the first-called of Christ, with divinely inspired songs.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́дꙋщее возвѣща́ѧ тебѣ̀ сіѧ́ніе, * бл҃гоче́стіѧ па́ѵле, * и҆ ле́сти ѡ҆чище́ніе, * хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́лся на горѣ̀ молніезра́ченъ:
items.english_text: Knowing thee beforehand, the Pre-eternal One appointed thee, O all-blessed Peter, as protector of His Church, and foremost-enthroned.

provenance.verbatim_source: Knowing thee beforehand, the Pre-eternal One appointed thee, O all-blessed Peter, as protector of His Church, and foremost-enthroned.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́дꙋщее возвѣща́ѧ тебѣ̀ сіѧ́ніе, * бл҃гоче́стіѧ па́ѵле, * и҆ ле́сти ѡ҆чище́ніе, * хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́лся на горѣ̀ молніезра́ченъ:
items.english_text: Neither flesh nor blood, but the Father inspired thee, O Apostle, to declare Christ the true Son of the Most High God.

provenance.verbatim_source: Neither flesh nor blood, but the Father inspired thee, O Apostle, to declare Christ the true Son of the Most High God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́дꙋщее возвѣща́ѧ тебѣ̀ сіѧ́ніе, * бл҃гоче́стіѧ па́ѵле, * и҆ ле́сти ѡ҆чище́ніе, * хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́лся на горѣ̀ молніезра́ченъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Let us hymn the holy mountain, the most exalted chariot, the Mother of God, and true Virgin after childbirth.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Let us hymn the holy mountain, the most exalted chariot, the Mother of God, and true Virgin after childbirth.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́дꙋщее возвѣща́ѧ тебѣ̀ сіѧ́ніе, * бл҃гоче́стіѧ па́ѵле, * и҆ ле́сти ѡ҆чище́ніе, * хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́лся на горѣ̀ молніезра́ченъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* *Another Canon, of the Holy Apostle Paul, Troparia on 6. Tone 8.* That which was cut severed the unseverable, and the sun beheld the earth which it had not seen; the water drowned the fierce enemy, and Israel traversed the impassable; and a song was sung: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He is gloriously glorified!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another Canon, of the Holy Apostle Paul, Troparia on 6. Tone 8.*
*Ode 1. Heirmos:*
That which was cut severed the unseverable, and the sun beheld the earth which it had not seen; the water drowned the fierce enemy, and Israel traversed the impassable; and a song was sung: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He is gloriously glorified!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́дꙋщее возвѣща́ѧ тебѣ̀ сіѧ́ніе, * бл҃гоче́стіѧ па́ѵле, * и҆ ле́сти ѡ҆чище́ніе, * хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́лся на горѣ̀ молніезра́ченъ:
items.english_text: Calling things that are not as though they were, Christ, by His divine intellect, O all-blessed Paul, chose thee from thy mother's womb to bear His divine Name, which is above every name, before the nations; for He is gloriously glorified!

provenance.verbatim_source: Calling things that are not as though they were, Christ, by His divine intellect, O all-blessed Paul, chose thee from thy mother's womb to bear His divine Name, which is above every name, before the nations; for He is gloriously glorified!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́дꙋщее возвѣща́ѧ тебѣ̀ сіѧ́ніе, * бл҃гоче́стіѧ па́ѵле, * и҆ ле́сти ѡ҆чище́ніе, * хрⷭ҇то́съ ꙗ҆ви́лся на горѣ̀ молніезра́ченъ:
items.english_text: Proclaiming beforehand unto thee the future radiance of piety, O Paul, and the cleansing of deception, Christ appeared on the mount shining like lightning shining like lightning, darkening indeed the bodily eyes, but enlightening those of the soul with the understanding of the Trinity; for He is gloriously glorified!

provenance.verbatim_source:
Proclaiming beforehand unto thee the future radiance of piety, O Paul, and the cleansing of deception, Christ appeared on the mount shining like lightning...
...shining like lightning, darkening indeed the bodily eyes, but enlightening those of the soul with the understanding of the Trinity; for He is gloriously glorified!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: ꙋ҆́чи ꙋ҆́бѡ помрача́етъ плотскі́ѧ: * дꙋше́вныѧ же вра́зꙋмлѧетъ трⷪ҇ческимъ ра́зꙋмомъ: * Сла́внѡ бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: Accomplishing, indeed, the circumcision on the eighth day, and being a zealot for the ancestral traditions, O Paul, of the seed of the Hebrews, of the tribe of Benjamin, and appearing according to the Law as a Pharisee: thou didst count all things as refuse, and didst gain Christ; for He is gloriously glorified!

provenance.verbatim_source: Accomplishing, indeed, the circumcision on the eighth day, and being a zealot for the ancestral traditions, O Paul, of the seed of the Hebrews, of the tribe of Benjamin, and appearing according to the Law as a Pharisee: thou didst count all things as refuse, and didst gain Christ; for He is gloriously glorified!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆брѣ́заніе ꙋ҆́бѡ соверша́ѧ ѻ҆смодне́вное, * и҆ ревни́тель ѻ҆те́ческихъ па́ѵле преда́ній: * ѿ се́мене є҆вре́йска, * колѣ́на веніамі́нова, * по зако́нꙋ же фарісе́й ꙗ҆ви́лся: * вмѣни́лъ є҆сѝ всѧ̑ ꙋ҆ме́ты, * и҆ хрⷭ҇та̀ приѡбрѣ́лъ є҆сѝ: * Сла́внѡ бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O pure Mother of God the Almighty, having sprung from a royal tribe, O Sovereign Lady, and having borne in the flesh, beyond nature, the one God Who reigns over all: deliver me from misfortunes, who sing unto thy Son; for He is gloriously glorified!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O pure Mother of God the Almighty, having sprung from a royal tribe, O Sovereign Lady, and having borne in the flesh, beyond nature, the one God Who reigns over all: deliver me from misfortunes, who sing unto thy Son; for He is gloriously glorified!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Чⷭ҇таѧ мт҃и бг҃а вседержи́телѧ, * ѿ црⷭ҇кагѡ колѣ́на влⷣчце и҆зра́стши: * и҆ є҆ди́на бг҃а всѣ́ми црⷭ҇твꙋющаго, * ро́ждшаѧ пло́тію па́че є҆стества̀, * ѿ бѣ́дъ мѧ̀ спасѝ, * сн҃ꙋ твоемꙋ̀ пою́ща: * Сла́внѡ бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* I shall open my mouth...[^912]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Katavasia:* I shall open my mouth...[^912]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Катава́сіа: Ѿве́рзꙋ ꙋ҆ста̀ моѧ̑:
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* We boast not in wisdom, nor in power, nor in wealth, but in Thee, the Father's hypostatic Wisdom, O Christ; for there is none holy save Thee, O Lover of mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
We boast not in wisdom, nor in power, nor in wealth, but in Thee, the Father's hypostatic Wisdom, O Christ; for there is none holy save Thee, O Lover of mankind.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ бл҃же́нна, * сла́ддкаѧ ꙋ҆ста̀ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, * и҆ сокро́вище тве́рдо црⷭ҇твіа показа́ша: * тѣ́мже воспѣва́емъ тѧ̀, пе́тре а҆́пⷭ҇ле.
items.english_text: The sweet lips of Christ God showed thee to be blessed and a firm treasure of the Kingdom; therefore we hymn thee, O Apostle Peter.

provenance.verbatim_source: The sweet lips of Christ God showed thee to be blessed and a firm treasure of the Kingdom; therefore we hymn thee, O Apostle Peter.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На ка́мени твоегѡ̀ бг҃осло́віѧ, * водрꙋзѝ влⷣка і҆и҃съ цр҃ковь непрекло́ннꙋ: * въ не́йже тѧ̀ а҆́пⷭ҇ле пе́тре сла́вимъ.
items.english_text: Upon the rock of thy theology the Master Jesus established the Church unshakable, wherein we glorify thee, O Apostle Peter.

provenance.verbatim_source: Upon the rock of thy theology the Master Jesus established the Church unshakable, wherein we glorify thee, O Apostle Peter.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ пребо́льши а҆́гг҃лъ, пе́тръ въ тѣлесѝ: * во свѣ́тломъ бо прише́ствіи сегѡ̀ хрⷭ҇то́съ бг҃ъ, * сꙋді́ю же и҆ сосѣда́телѧ бы́ти речѐ.
items.english_text: As greater than angels, Peter was in the flesh; for Christ God said that in His radiant coming he should be a judge and an assessor.

provenance.verbatim_source: As greater than angels, Peter was in the flesh; for Christ God said that in His radiant coming he should be a judge and an assessor.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ бг҃а пло́тію ро́ждшаѧ, * стра́стными прило́ги преклоне́на мѧ̀ ꙋ҆твердѝ: * нѣ́сть бо чи́стаѧ, ра́звѣ тебѐ помо́щницы.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O unwedded one, who didst bear God in the flesh: establish me who am bowed down by passionate assaults; for there is none pure, save thee, as a helper.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O unwedded one, who didst bear God in the flesh: establish me who am bowed down by passionate assaults; for there is none pure, save thee, as a helper.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ, І҆рмо́съ: Ты̀ є҆сѝ ꙋ҆твержде́ніе притека́ющихъ къ тебѣ̀ гдⷭ҇и, * ты̀ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ ѡ҆мраче́нныхъ, * и҆ пое́тъ тѧ̀ дꙋ́хъ мо́й.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos:* Thou art the confirmation of those who flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of those in darkness, and my spirit hymns Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another [Canon]. Heirmos:*
Thou art the confirmation of those who flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of those in darkness, and my spirit hymns Thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Па́ѵле всебл҃же́нне, * на ѡ҆снова́ніи твое́мъ, молю́ся, * добродѣ́телей всехва́льныхъ, * назида́тисѧ свѣ́тлости.
items.english_text: Thou wast laid as a foundation stone for faithful souls, precious and cornerstone, of the Savior and Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou wast laid as a foundation stone for faithful souls, precious and cornerstone, of the Savior and Lord.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Всегда̀ ме́ртвость і҆и҃совꙋ, * на твое́мъ тѣ́лѣ соверше́ннѡ па́ѵле ѡ҆бносѧ̀, * сподо́бился є҆сѝ и҆́стинныѧ жи́зни.
items.english_text: O all-blessed Paul, upon thy foundation of all-praised virtues, I pray that the brightness of the soul may be builded.

provenance.verbatim_source: O all-blessed Paul, upon thy foundation of all-praised virtues, I pray that the brightness of the soul may be builded.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Тѧ̀ всѝ стѧжа́хомъ прибѣ́жище, * и҆ стѣ́нꙋ на́шꙋ хрⷭ҇тіа́не: * тѧ̀ славосло́вимъ немо́лчнѡ безневѣ́стнаѧ.
items.english_text: Ever carrying about in thy body the dying of Jesus in perfection, O Paul, thou wast counted worthy of the true life.

provenance.verbatim_source: Ever carrying about in thy body the dying of Jesus in perfection, O Paul, thou wast counted worthy of the true life.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ѵ҆пакоѝ, гла́съ, ӣ: Ка́ѧ темни́ца не и҆мѣ̀ тебѐ ꙋ҆́зника? * ка́ѧ же цр҃ковь не и҆́мать тѧ̀ виті́ю? * дама́скъ великомꙋ́дрствꙋетъ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ па́ѵле, * ви́дѣ бо тѧ̀ запя́та свѣ́томъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* We Christians have acquired thee as a refuge and our wall; we unceasingly glorify thee, O unwedded one.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
We Christians have acquired thee as a refuge and our wall; we unceasingly glorify thee, O unwedded one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ѵ҆пакоѝ, гла́съ, ӣ: Ка́ѧ темни́ца не и҆мѣ̀ тебѐ ꙋ҆́зника? * ка́ѧ же цр҃ковь не и҆́мать тѧ̀ виті́ю? * дама́скъ великомꙋ́дрствꙋетъ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ па́ѵле, * ви́дѣ бо тѧ̀ запя́та свѣ́томъ:
items.english_text: *Hypakoe, Tone 8:* What prison had thee not as a captive? What church has thee not as an orator? Damascus boasts greatly of thee, O Paul, for it saw thee overcome by the light light: Rome, receiving thy blood, also boasts; but Tarsus rejoices yet more, and loves to venerate thy swaddling bands.[^913] O Peter, rock of faith, O Paul, boast of the universe, having come together from Rome, confirm us!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Hypakoe, Tone 8:*
What prison had thee not as a captive? What church has thee not as an orator? Damascus boasts greatly of thee, O Paul, for it saw thee overcome by the light...

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: свѣ́томъ: ри́мъ твое́ю кро́вь прїе́мый, и҆ то́й хва́лится: но и҆ та́рсъ мно́жае ра́дуется, и҆ лю́битъ почита́я твоя̑ пелены̑. пе́тре вѣ́ры ка́меню, па́ѵле похвало̀ вселе́нныя, ѿ ри́ма соше́дшеся оу҆тверди́те на́съ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* This is our God, incarnate from the Virgin, and having deified our nature, unto Whom singing we cry: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
This is our God, incarnate from the Virgin, and having deified our nature, unto Whom singing we cry: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Чл҃кѡмъ ловца́ тѧ, ꙗ҆́коже ѡ҆бѣща́ хрⷭ҇то́съ, содѣ́ла бж҃твенна своеѧ̀ цр҃кве, пе́рвомꙋ врꙋчи́въ корми̑ла.
items.english_text: As a fisher of men, as Christ promised, He made thee of His divine Church, having entrusted the helm to thee, the foremost.

provenance.verbatim_source: As a fisher of men, as Christ promised, He made thee of His divine Church, having entrusted the helm to thee, the foremost.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Тобо́ю оу҆моля́емъ жизнода́вєцъ і҆и҃съ, вяза́ти же и҆ рѣши́ти да́вый тебѣ̀ вла́сть пе́тре: да бꙋ́детъ мѝ млⷭ҇тивъ.
items.english_text: Through thee we entreat Jesus the Giver of Life, Who gave thee authority, O Peter, to bind and to loose:[^914] may He be merciful unto me!

provenance.verbatim_source: Through thee we entreat Jesus the Giver of Life, Who gave thee authority, O Peter, to bind and to loose:[^914] may He be merciful unto me!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇тово црⷭ҇твїе ѿве́рсти, прилѣ́жнѡ моли́ся пе́тре: бж҃твенную твою̀ па́мять, вѣ́рою неꙋмнѣ́нною чтꙋ́щымъ.
items.english_text: O Peter, fervently pray to open the Kingdom of Christ unto those who venerate thy divine memory with unhesitating faith.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Peter, fervently pray to open the Kingdom of Christ unto those who venerate thy divine memory with unhesitating faith.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Гжⷭ҇е всепѣ́тая бг҃ороди́тельнице, моѧ̑ помышле́нїа твои́ми мл҃твами ѡ҆чи́стивши: покажи́ мя бл҃гопло́дна, мт҃и всѣ́хъ бг҃а.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Lady, all-hymned Birthgiver of God, having cleansed my thoughts by thy prayers, show me to be fruitful, O Mother of God of all.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O Lady, all-hymned Birthgiver of God, having cleansed my thoughts by thy prayers, show me to be fruitful, O Mother of God of all.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: Всѣ́лъ є҆сѝ на ко́ни, а҆пл҃ы твоѧ̑ гдⷭ҇и, и҆ прїя́лъ є҆сѝ рꙋка́ма твои́ма оу҆́зды и҆́хъ. и҆ сп҃се́нїе бы́сть ꙗ҆жде́нїе твоѐ, вѣ́рнѡ пою́щымъ: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos:* Thou didst mount Thine horses, Thine Apostles, O Lord, and Thou didst take their reins into Thy hands; and Thy riding became salvation unto those who faithfully sing: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another Canon. Heirmos:*
Thou didst mount Thine horses, Thine Apostles, O Lord, and Thou didst take their reins into Thy hands; and Thy riding became salvation unto those who faithfully sing: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Хотѧ́й просвѣти́ти вселе́нную ѡ҆мраче́тся: а҆нані́а же къ семꙋ̀ посыла́ется, дꙋше́вное же просвѣще́нїе да́ти и҆ тѣле́сное: ѿ бж҃е́ственнагѡ ꙗ҆вле́нїа, сосꙋ́дъ и҆збра́нъ показа́въ того̀.
items.english_text: Crouching like a lion, fiercely destroying Christ's Church, Saul of old: but having been arrested by the divine voice of the Lamb of God, Whom he was persecuting, He entrusts the flock unto him as shepherd.

provenance.verbatim_source: Crouching like a lion, fiercely destroying Christ's Church, Saul of old: but having been arrested by the divine voice of the Lamb of God, Whom he was persecuting, He entrusts the flock unto him as shepherd.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́домъ досто́йнѡ дама́скъ напоя́ется: ѿ сегѡ́ бо ꙗ҆́коже ѿ рая̀ и҆ногда̀ во́дъ бж҃е́ственныхъ се́й произы́де вели́кїй и҆сто́чникъ: и҆ оу҆поѝ всю̀ бг҃оразꙋ́мїемъ и҆звѣ́стнѡ зе́млю.
items.english_text: He that was to enlighten the universe is darkened; and Ananias is sent unto him, to give enlightenment of soul and body, from the divine manifestation having shown him to be a chosen vessel.

provenance.verbatim_source: He that was to enlighten the universe is darkened; and Ananias is sent unto him, to give enlightenment of soul and body, from the divine manifestation having shown him to be a chosen vessel.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Низложѝ си́льныѧ со престо́лъ гдⷭ҇ь, дв҃а и҆ мт҃и ꙗ҆́коже речѐ. а҆́лчꙋщыѧ же бж҃твенныхъ бл҃гъ и҆спо́лни, вѣ́рою зовꙋ́щымъ: сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_text: Damascus is worthily watered with a miracle: for from him, as of old from Paradise, this great fountain of divine waters went forth, and manifestly watered the whole earth with the knowledge of God.

provenance.verbatim_source: Damascus is worthily watered with a miracle: for from him, as of old from Paradise, this great fountain of divine waters went forth, and manifestly watered the whole earth with the knowledge of God.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. І҆рмо́съ: Стяжа́вый ны̀ и҆збра́нныя лю́ди, кро́вїю твое́ю гдⷭ҇и, тво́й ми́ръ да́ждь на́мъ, во є҆диноми́слїи сохраня́ѧ ста́до твоѐ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Lord hath put down the mighty from their seats, as the Virgin and Mother said; and He hath filled with divine good things those who hunger, crying in faith: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The Lord hath put down the mighty from their seats, as the Virgin and Mother said; and He hath filled with divine good things those who hunger, crying in faith: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ѿ любвѐ прїи́мъ дерзнове́нїе къ бг҃ꙋ, досто́йнѡ чꙋди́мъ быва́ше, лове́цъ и҆ невѣ́жда: чꙋдодѣ́йствꙋѧ пресла́внѡ бл҃года́тїю.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Having acquired us as a chosen people by Thy blood, O Lord, grant Thy peace unto us, preserving Thy flock in oneness of mind.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 5. Heirmos:*
Having acquired us as a chosen people by Thy blood, O Lord, grant Thy peace unto us, preserving Thy flock in oneness of mind.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ни зла́та себѣ̀ ра́ди, ни сребра̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ, бж҃твенный тво́й
items.english_text: Having received boldness toward God out of love, he was worthily marvelled at, a fisherman and an unlettered man, working wonders most gloriously by grace.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having received boldness toward God out of love, he was worthily marvelled at, a fisherman and an unlettered man, working wonders most gloriously by grace.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ни зла́та себѣ̀ ра́ди, ни сребра̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ, бж҃твенный тво́й
items.english_text: Neither gold for himself, nor silver, O Christ, did Thy divine

provenance.verbatim_source: Neither gold for himself, nor silver, O Christ, did Thy divine

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: тво́й а҆по́столъ: но добродѣ́тель стяжа́въ, чꙋде́съ ѡ҆богати́ся си́лою.
items.english_text: Apostle [desire];[^915] but having acquired virtue, he was enriched with the power of wonders.

provenance.verbatim_source: Apostle [desire];[^915] but having acquired virtue, he was enriched with the power of wonders.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆справля́хꙋся стѡпы̀, и҆ глє́знѣ хромы́хъ, дѣ́йственнымъ твои́мъ гла́сомъ: бж҃твеннымъ бо дх҃омъ соверша́хꙋся пресла̑внаѧ ве̑щы.
items.english_text: The feet and ankle bones of the lame were made straight by thy effectual voice: for by the Holy Spirit most glorious things were accomplished.

provenance.verbatim_source: The feet and ankle bones of the lame were made straight by thy effectual voice: for by the Holy Spirit most glorious things were accomplished.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Сплоти́ся бг҃ъ по ѵ҆поста́си чи́стая, и҆з̾ тебѐ пло́тїю соединя́емь: пребы́въ неизмѣ́ненъ: по бж҃твенномꙋ сꙋществꙋ̀ безпло́тенъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* God was united according to hypostasis, O pure one, being joined in flesh from thee, remaining immutable, bodiless according to His divine essence.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
God was united according to hypostasis, O pure one, being joined in flesh from thee, remaining immutable, bodiless according to His divine essence.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: Просвѣти́ на́съ повелѣ́нїи твои́ми гдⷭ҇и, и҆ мы́шцею твое́ю высо́кою, тво́й ми́ръ пода́ждь на́мъ человѣколю́бче.
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos:* Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant Thy peace unto us, O Lover of Mankind.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another Canon. Heirmos:*
Enlighten us by Thy commandments, O Lord, and by Thy high arm grant Thy peace unto us, O Lover of Mankind.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ є҆́же жи́ти, хрⷭ҇то́съ, и҆ є҆́же оу҆мре́ти, приѡбрѣ́тенїе и҆зра́дно: любо́вїю бо сра́спялся є҆сѝ распе́ншемꙋся на́съ ра́ди, па́ѵле пресла́вне.
items.english_text: Thou hast chosen the true boast, O Paul, ever bearing the cross of Christ the King as a trophy of victory, O Apostle.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast chosen the true boast, O Paul, ever bearing the cross of Christ the King as a trophy of victory, O Apostle.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дꙋешися вои́стиннꙋ ѡ҆ гдⷭ҇ѣ, па́ѵле чⷭ҇тны́й, и҆зше́дъ и҆з̾ тѣлесѐ, и҆ ѿше́дъ ко хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ жизнода́вцꙋ бг҃ꙋ.
items.english_text: For thee to live was Christ, and to die an exceeding gain: for out of love thou wast co-crucified with Him Who was crucified for our sake, O all-glorious Paul.

provenance.verbatim_source: For thee to live was Christ, and to die an exceeding gain: for out of love thou wast co-crucified with Him Who was crucified for our sake, O all-glorious Paul.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Молѝ при́снѡ сн҃а твоего̀ и҆ бг҃а на́шего, неискꙋсобра́чная мр҃їе чⷭ҇таѧ, посла́ти на́мъ вѣ́рнымъ ми́лость.
items.english_text: Truly thou rejoicest in the Lord, O venerable Paul, having departed from the body and gone unto Christ God the Giver of Life.

provenance.verbatim_source: Truly thou rejoicest in the Lord, O venerable Paul, having departed from the body and gone unto Christ God the Giver of Life.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Въ ки́тѣ хрⷭ҇тѐ трїдне́вновавъ і҆ѡ́на, прописа́ тя безсме́ртнаго, ꙗ҆́кѡ ме́ртва во́лею, въ срⷣцѣ земне́мъ трїдне́вновавша.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Ever pray thy Son and our God, O unwedded Mary pure, to send mercy unto us the faithful.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Ever pray thy Son and our God, O unwedded Mary pure, to send mercy unto us the faithful.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ћкоже дре́вле хрⷭ҇тѐ, десни́цею твое́ю по водѣ̀ пѣ́ша ходя́ща, петра̀ спа́слъ є҆сѝ: и҆ менѐ потопля́ема бꙋ́рею лю́тыхъ напа́стей спасѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇рдъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Jonah, spending three days in the whale, prefigured Thee the Immortal One, O Christ, as dead of Thine own will, spending three days in the heart of the earth.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 6. Heirmos:*
Jonah, spending three days in the whale, prefigured Thee the Immortal One, O Christ, as dead of Thine own will, spending three days in the heart of the earth.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆скꙋша́ти безꙋ́мнѡ поꙋчи́вшыѧся, дх҃а прест҃а́го, пе́тре оу҆мертви́лъ є҆сѝ: є҆го́же бг҃осло́вилъ є҆сѝ ты̀ пе́рвѣе, ꙗ҆́вѣ и҆сповѣ́давъ бг҃а всебл҃же́нне.
items.english_text: As of old, O Christ, by Thy right hand Thou didst save Peter walking upon the water on foot: save me also who am submerged by the tempest of grievous temptations, as Thou art compassionate.

provenance.verbatim_source: As of old, O Christ, by Thy right hand Thou didst save Peter walking upon the water on foot: save me also who am submerged by the tempest of grievous temptations, as Thou art compassionate.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Вся́кагѡ вы́шша сꙋщества̀, сло́во бж҃їе родила̀ є҆сѝ, воплоще́нно на́мъ. тѣ́мже бцⷢ҇ꙋ тя̀, оу҆стна́ми же и҆ дꙋше́ю проповѣ́даемъ.
items.english_text: Thou didst leave behind the things that are not, O Peter, and didst attain unto the things that are, like a certain merchant: and manifestly didst catch the Pearl of great price, Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst leave behind the things that are not, O Peter, and didst attain unto the things that are, like a certain merchant: and manifestly didst catch the Pearl of great price, Christ.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: Моли́твꙋ пролїю̀ ко гдⷭ҇ꙋ, и҆ томꙋ̀ возвѣщꙋ̀ печа̑ли моѧ̑, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕѡ́лъ дꙋша̀ моѧ̀ и҆спо́лнися, и҆ живо́тъ мо́й а҆́дꙋ прибли́жися, и҆ молю́ся ꙗ҆́кѡ і҆ѡ́на, ѿ тлѝ бж҃е возведи́ мя.
items.english_text: Those who foolishly conspired to tempt the Holy Spirit, O Peter, thou didst put to death:[^916] Whom thou hadst first theologized, manifestly confessing Him as God, O all-blessed one.

provenance.verbatim_source: Those who foolishly conspired to tempt the Holy Spirit, O Peter, thou didst put to death:[^916] Whom thou hadst first theologized, manifestly confessing Him as God, O all-blessed one.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Вся̑ пренебре́гъ кра̑снаѧ мі́ра, оу҆я́звенъ влⷣчне́ю любо́вїю, и҆ ѻ҆́бщагѡ сп҃се́нїа жела́нїемъ, свидѣ́тельствовати томꙋ̀, и҆зболе́въ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou gavest birth to the Word of God, higher than every essence, incarnate for us; therefore we proclaim thee as Mother of God with lips and soul.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thou gavest birth to the Word of God, higher than every essence, incarnate for us; therefore we proclaim thee as Mother of God with lips and soul.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Вся̑ пренебре́гъ кра̑снаѧ мі́ра, оу҆я́звенъ влⷣчне́ю любо́вїю, и҆ ѻ҆́бщагѡ сп҃се́нїа жела́нїемъ, свидѣ́тельствовати томꙋ̀, и҆зболе́въ
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos:* I will pour out my prayer unto the Lord, and to Him will I proclaim my sorrows, for my soul is filled with evils, and my life has drawn near unto hades, and I pray like Jonah: Lead me up from corruption, O God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another Canon. Heirmos:*
I will pour out my prayer unto the Lord, and to Him will I proclaim my sorrows, for my soul is filled with evils, and my life has drawn near unto hades, and I pray like Jonah: Lead me up from corruption, O God!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Вся̑ пренебре́гъ кра̑снаѧ мі́ра, оу҆я́звенъ влⷣчне́ю любо́вїю, и҆ ѻ҆́бщагѡ сп҃се́нїа жела́нїемъ, свидѣ́тельствовати томꙋ̀, и҆зболе́въ
items.english_text: Having disregarded all the beautiful things of the world, wounded with love for the Master and with desire for the common salvation, having suffered with infirmities to bear witness unto Him,

provenance.verbatim_source: Having disregarded all the beautiful things of the world, wounded with love for the Master and with desire for the common salvation, having suffered with infirmities to bear witness unto Him,

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ћкѡ и҆зра́дный влⷢ҇цѣ подо́бникъ, и҆ въ того̀ ѡ҆дѣ́ѧнъ па́ѵле, вои́стиннꙋ всѣ̑мъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ вся̑ка, да вся̑ приѡбрѧ́щеши, и҆ спасе́ши лю́ди: и҆ спа́слъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ, хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ оу҆лови́въ концы̑.
items.english_text: As an excellent imitator of the Master, and clothed in Him, O Paul, thou wast truly made all things to all men, that thou mightest gain all and save the people; and thou didst truly save them, catching the ends of the earth for Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source: As an excellent imitator of the Master, and clothed in Him, O Paul, thou wast truly made all things to all men, that thou mightest gain all and save the people; and thou didst truly save them, catching the ends of the earth for Christ.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йнѡ тебѣ̀ дарова̀ хрⷭ҇то́съ житїѐ а҆́пле па́ѵле на нб҃сѣ́хъ: пребыва́ющагѡ бо здѣ̀ не возжела́лъ є҆сѝ гра́да, бл҃же́нне: вѣ́ренъ слꙋжи́тель бы́въ, и҆ строи́тель та́инъ є҆гѡ̀.
items.english_text: Worthily did Christ grant thee citizenship in heaven, O Apostle Paul; for thou didst not desire the city that abides here, O blessed one, having been a faithful minister and steward of His mysteries.

provenance.verbatim_source: Worthily did Christ grant thee citizenship in heaven, O Apostle Paul; for thou didst not desire the city that abides here, O blessed one, having been a faithful minister and steward of His mysteries.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Призрѣ̀ на тѧ̀ гдⷭ҇ь, моѐ ѡ҆бновля́я сꙋщество̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ си́ленъ: вели́чїя сотво́рь бг҃ороди́тельнице, ꙗ҆́коже рекла̀ є҆сѝ всенепоро́чная: и҆ спасе́ мя тобо́ю и҆з̾ тлѝ бг҃ъ мо́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇рдъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Lord looked upon thee, renewing my nature, as the Mighty One, having done great things [for thee], O Mother of God, as thou didst say, O all-immaculate one; and my God saved me through thee from corruption, as He is compassionate.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The Lord looked upon thee, renewing my nature, as the Mighty One, having done great things [for thee], O Mother of God, as thou didst say, O all-immaculate one; and my God saved me through thee from corruption, as He is compassionate.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Конда́къ, гла́съ, в҃. Твє́рдыя и҆ бг҃овѣща̑нныя проповѣ́датели, ве́рхъ а҆́плѡвъ твои́хъ гдⷭ҇и прїя́лъ є҆сѝ, въ наслажде́нїе бл҃ги́хъ твои́хъ и҆ поко́й: болѣ́зни бо ѻ҆́нѣхъ и҆ сме́рть прїя́лъ є҆сѝ, па́че вся́кагѡ всепло́дїя, є҆ди́не свѣ́дый серде̑чная.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2:*[^917] The firm and God-proclaimed preachers, the summit of Thine Apostles, O Lord, Thou hast received into the enjoyment of Thy good things and into rest; for Thou hast accepted their labors and death above every whole burnt offering, O Thou Who alone knowest what is in the heart.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 2:*[^917]
The firm and God-proclaimed preachers, the summit of Thine Apostles, O Lord, Thou hast received into the enjoyment of Thy good things and into rest; for Thou hast accepted their labors and death above every whole burnt offering, O Thou Who alone knowest what is in the heart.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: I҆́косъ: Оу҆ясни́ мо́й ꙗ҆зы́къ сп҃се мо́й, разшири́въ моѧ̑ оу҆ста̀, и҆ и҆спо́лнивъ я҆̀, оу҆мили́ се́рдце моѐ, да ꙗ҆́же глаго́лю послѣ́дꙋю. и҆ ꙗ҆́же оу҆́бѡ оу҆чꙋ̀, сотворю̀ пе́рвѣе. вся́къ бо творя́й и҆ оу҆ча́й, речѐ, се́й вели́къ є҆́сть. а҆́ще бо глаго́лю, и҆ не творю̀: ꙗ҆́кѡ мѣ́дь звѣня́щая вмѣню́ся. тѣ́мже рещи́ ми подѡ́бнаѧ, и҆ твори́ти поле́знаѧ да́рꙋй, є҆ди́не свѣ́дый серде̑чная.
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Make clear my tongue, O my Savior, having opened wide my mouth and filled it; soften my heart, that I may follow what I say, and that what I teach I may first do. For every one who does and teaches, He said, this one is great. For if I speak and do not do, I am accounted as sounding brass. Therefore grant me to speak what is fitting and to do what is profitable, O Thou Who alone knowest what is in the heart.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ikos:*
Make clear my tongue, O my Savior, having opened wide my mouth and filled it; soften my heart, that I may follow what I say, and that what I teach I may first do. For every one who does and teaches, He said, this one is great. For if I speak and do not do, I am accounted as sounding brass. Therefore grant me to speak what is fitting and to do what is profitable, O Thou Who alone knowest what is in the heart.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. І҆рмо́съ: Въ нача́лѣ безнача́льное сло́во, со ѻ҆ц҃е́мъ и҆ дх҃омъ, сн҃ъ є҆диноро́дный, бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ и҆ превозноси́мый бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* In the beginning the unoriginate Word, with the Father and the Spirit, the Only-begotten Son: Blessed art Thou and exalted above all, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos:*
In the beginning the unoriginate Word, with the Father and the Spirit, the Only-begotten Son: Blessed art Thou and exalted above all, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Тебѣ̀ хрⷭ҇то́съ первозва́нномꙋ, и҆ ѕѣлѡ̀ возлю́бленному, ꙗ҆́кѡ предсѣда́телю бл҃госла́внꙋ а҆́плѡвъ пе́рвомꙋ ꙗ҆вля́етсѧ, воскре́съ ѿ гро́ба.
items.english_text: Instructed by the divine providence of Christ to emulate the Merciful One, thou wast permitted, before the Passion, O Peter, to fall under the surge of denial.

provenance.verbatim_source: Instructed by the divine providence of Christ to emulate the Merciful One, thou wast permitted, before the Passion, O Peter, to fall under the surge of denial.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Твоѐ трикра́тное є҆́же пре́жде ст҃рти и҆сцѣля́ѧ ѿверже́нїе влⷢ҇ка: трикра́тнымъ бг҃овѣща́ннымъ пе́тре вопроше́нїемъ, оу҆твержда́етъ любо́вь.
items.english_text: Unto thee, the first-called and greatly beloved, as the glorious president of the Apostles, does Christ appear first, having risen from the tomb.

provenance.verbatim_source: Unto thee, the first-called and greatly beloved, as the glorious president of the Apostles, does Christ appear first, having risen from the tomb.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ћже ко хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ пе́тре любле́нїа, предлага́лъ є҆сѝ свидѣ́теля, и҆ всеви́дящаго ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃а сло́ва. тѣ́мже и҆ любви́ моѐ врꙋча́етъ тебѣ̀ ста́до.
items.english_text: Healing thy threefold denial which took place before the Passion, the Master by a threefold God-spoken question, O Peter, confirms [thy] love.[^918]

provenance.verbatim_source: Healing thy threefold denial which took place before the Passion, the Master by a threefold God-spoken question, O Peter, confirms [thy] love.[^918]

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: И҆́же во оу҆тро́бѣ превѣ́чное ѿ ѻ҆ц҃а̀, возсїя́вша бг҃а сло́ва
items.english_text: As witness of thy love for Christ, O Peter, thou didst offer the all-seeing Word as God; therefore in love He entrusts His flock unto thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: As witness of thy love for Christ, O Peter, thou didst offer the all-seeing Word as God; therefore in love He entrusts His flock unto thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: И҆́же во оу҆тро́бѣ превѣ́чное ѿ ѻ҆ц҃а̀, возсїя́вша бг҃а сло́ва
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who shone forth before the ages from the Father, God the Word incarnate from thee, all we bless, as the Mother of God of all.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
He Who shone forth before the ages from the Father, God the Word...
incarnate from thee, all we bless, as the Mother of God of all.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: сло́ва, пло́тїю заче́ншꙋю, всѝ оу҆блажа́емъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ мт҃рь всѣ́хъ бг҃а.
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos:* In the plain of Dura of old, the tyrant set up a furnace for the torment of the God-bearers; wherein the three youths hymned the one God, singing triply, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another Canon. Heirmos:*
In the plain of Dura of old, the tyrant set up a furnace for the torment of the God-bearers; wherein the three youths hymned the one God, singing triply, saying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бы́сть хрⷭ҇тѐ печа́ть и҆ вѣне́цъ а҆́плѡвъ твои́хъ, и҆́же напослѣ́докъ зва́нный време́нъ: тща́нїемъ же всѣ́хъ превозше́дъ: съ ни́мже лю́дїе цр҃ко́внїи пою́тъ тебѣ̀: ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: Thou wast, O Christ, the seal and crown of Thine Apostles, who at the last of times wast called, yet in diligence didst surpass all; with whom the people of the Church sing unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou wast, O Christ, the seal and crown of Thine Apostles, who at the last of times wast called, yet in diligence didst surpass all; with whom the people of the Church sing unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще и҆ гони́въ пе́рвѣе цр҃ковь твою̀, па́ѵлъ оу҆́зникъ, но преминꙋ̀ дре́внюю де́рзость, твое́ю ре́вностїю послѣдѝ. собра́ бо хрⷭ҇тѐ ꙗ҆зы́ки зовꙋ́щыѧ: ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: Even though he persecuted Thy Church at first, Paul the prisoner, yet he put aside his former boldness through Thy zeal in the end; for he gathered the nations, O Christ, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: Even though he persecuted Thy Church at first, Paul the prisoner, yet he put aside his former boldness through Thy zeal in the end; for he gathered the nations, O Christ, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ и҆з̾ і҆рлима проповѣ́давъ всѣ̑мъ є҆ѵлїе, ѡ҆б̾я́лъ же ѡ҆́крестъ всю̀ зе́млю па́ѵле, да́же до коне́цъ і҆ллѷ́рїка оу҆ча̀, взыва́лъ є҆сѝ: ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: Preaching the Gospel unto all from Jerusalem, and having traversed around all the earth, O Paul, even teaching unto the borders of Illyricum,[^919] thou didst cry out: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source: Preaching the Gospel unto all from Jerusalem, and having traversed around all the earth, O Paul, even teaching unto the borders of Illyricum,[^919] thou didst cry out: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Во оу҆́жасѣ взя́тъ бы́въ, тре́тїе дости́глъ є҆сѝ нб҃о пребога́те, и҆ оу҆слы́шавъ неизглаго́ланнаѧ словеса̀, вопїе́ши: сла́ва превы́шнемꙋ ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀, и҆ сн҃ꙋ: сїя́нїе же сопрⷭ҇то́лно, и҆спыта́ющагѡ ꙗ҆́вѣ дх҃а бж҃їа глꙋбины̑.
items.english_text: Taken up in ecstasy, thou didst reach the third heaven, O exceedingly rich one, and having heard unspeakable words,[^920] thou criest: Glory to the transcendent Father and to the Son, and to the co-enthroned Radiance of the Spirit of God Who manifestly searches the deep things!

provenance.verbatim_source: Taken up in ecstasy, thou didst reach the third heaven, O exceedingly rich one, and having heard unspeakable words,[^920] thou criest: Glory to the transcendent Father and to the Son, and to the co-enthroned Radiance of the Spirit of God Who manifestly searches the deep things!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Ћкоже на рꙋно̀ до́ждь, на тѧ̀ сни́де дв҃о хрⷭ҇то́съ бг҃ъ, и҆ плотоно́сецъ и҆з̾ тебѐ про́йде, соединя́я пре́жде разстоя̑щаѧ, ми́ръ на землѝ и҆ на нб҃си да́рꙋя, ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As rain upon the fleece, Christ God came down upon thee, O Virgin, and came forth bearing flesh from thee, uniting what before was separated, granting peace upon earth and in heaven: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
As rain upon the fleece, Christ God came down upon thee, O Virgin, and came forth bearing flesh from thee, uniting what before was separated, granting peace upon earth and in heaven: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. І҆рмо́съ: Бж҃е́скою непристꙋ́пною твое́ю си́лою хрⷭ҇тѐ, прпⷣбныя твоѧ̑ ѻ҆́троки въ пла́мени ѡ҆роси́лъ є҆сѝ зовꙋ́щыя: бл҃гвите вся̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* By Thy divine, unapproachable power, O Christ, Thou didst bedew Thy venerable youths in the flame, who cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
By Thy divine, unapproachable power, O Christ, Thou didst bedew Thy venerable youths in the flame, who cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гти сло́вомъ, є҆не́а оу҆́бѡ разсла́бленна лю́тѣ: таві́ѳꙋ же оу҆ме́ршꙋю, чꙋдодѣ́йствꙋя воскреси́лъ є҆сѝ, зовꙋ́щымъ: бл҃гвите вся̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: They shall stretch forth thy hands, and shall gird thee unto the cross,[^921] the Master foretold, O Peter, commanding thee to follow Him, as thou criest: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: They shall stretch forth thy hands, and shall gird thee unto the cross,[^921] the Master foretold, O Peter, commanding thee to follow Him, as thou criest: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же петрꙋ̀ ꙗ҆зы́ки ѡ҆чище́ны повѣ́давъ хрⷭ҇тѐ: дх҃овною заре́ю, и҆ мнѣ̀ помышле́нїа ѡ҆чи́сти, зовꙋ́щꙋ: бл҃гвите вся̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: By the word of grace, thou didst heal Aeneas who was grievously paralyzed, and by working a wonder didst raise Tabitha who was dead,[^922] crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: By the word of grace, thou didst heal Aeneas who was grievously paralyzed, and by working a wonder didst raise Tabitha who was dead,[^922] crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Свѣ́тлаѧ дв҃о, ꙗ҆́же бг҃а сло́ва ро́ждшая пло́тїю, дꙋшѝ моеѧ̀ мра́къ, твои́ми мл҃твами ѿгна́вши просвѣтѝ, взыва́юща: бл҃гвите вся̑ дѣла̀ гдⷭ҇на гдⷭ҇а.
items.english_text: O Christ Who didst declare the Gentiles cleansed unto Peter: by the spiritual dawn cleanse my thoughts also, as I cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Christ Who didst declare the Gentiles cleansed unto Peter: by the spiritual dawn cleanse my thoughts also, as I cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: На горѣ̀
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O radiant Virgin, who in the flesh gavest birth unto God the Word: having driven away the darkness of my soul by thy prayers, enlighten me as I cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O radiant Virgin, who in the flesh gavest birth unto God the Word: having driven away the darkness of my soul by thy prayers, enlighten me as I cry: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: На горѣ̀
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos:* Unto Him Who was glorified on the holy mountain, and in the bush through fire revealed the mystery of the Ever-Virgin unto Moses: sing ye and exalt the Lord above all unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another Canon. Heirmos:*
Unto Him Who was glorified
on the holy mountain, and in the bush through fire revealed the mystery of the Ever-Virgin unto Moses: sing ye and exalt the Lord above all unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Сраствори́ся любо́вїю твое́ю па́ѵлъ, до́брымъ же и҆змѣне́нїемъ и҆зстꙋпѝ, не себѣ́ бо живя́ше сла́вный. и҆́маше же ще́дре живꙋ́ща тя̀ въ себѣ̀, во вся̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Paul was mingled with Thy love, and by a good change was transported; for the glorious one lived no longer for himself, but had Thee, O Compassionate One, living in himself unto all ages.

provenance.verbatim_source: Paul was mingled with Thy love, and by a good change was transported; for the glorious one lived no longer for himself, but had Thee, O Compassionate One, living in himself unto all ages.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ ѡ҆брꙋчи́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́коже невѣ́стꙋ предста́вити, жени́хꙋ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ цр҃ковь, невѣстово́ждь бо сеѧ̀ показа́лся є҆сѝ па́ѵле бг҃оно́се. тѣ́мже тя̀ сла́витъ во вся̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: Thou didst betroth the Church to present her as a bride unto the Bridegroom Christ; for thou wast shown forth as her bridal leader, O God-bearing Paul: therefore she glorifies thee unto all ages.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou didst betroth the Church to present her as a bride unto the Bridegroom Christ; for thou wast shown forth as her bridal leader, O God-bearing Paul: therefore she glorifies thee unto all ages.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Подвиза́лся є҆сѝ до́брымъ подвиго́мъ, и҆ сконча́въ тече́нїе твоѐ зако́ннѡ, сокро́вище вѣ́ры соблю́лъ є҆сѝ. тѣ́мже вѣнце́въ па́ѵле сподо́бился є҆сѝ пра́вды.
items.english_text: Thou hast fought the good fight, and having finished thy course lawfully, thou hast kept the treasure of the faith; therefore, O Paul, thou hast been deemed worthy of the crowns of righteousness.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thou hast fought the good fight, and having finished thy course lawfully, thou hast kept the treasure of the faith; therefore, O Paul, thou hast been deemed worthy of the crowns of righteousness.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Ра́дꙋйся прⷭ҇то́ле ѻ҆гнезра́чный гдⷭ҇нь: ра́дꙋйся невѣ́сто неневѣ́стная дв҃о. ра́дꙋйся ѻ҆́блаче, сл҃нца возсїя́вшаѧ пра́вды. є҆го́же превозно́симъ во вся̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, O fiery throne of the Lord; rejoice, O Bride unwedded, Virgin; rejoice, O cloud that didst cause the Sun of Righteousness to dawn, Whom we exalt above all unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Rejoice, O fiery throne of the Lord; rejoice, O Bride unwedded, Virgin; rejoice, O cloud that didst cause the Sun of Righteousness to dawn, Whom we exalt above all unto all ages!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Тя̀ пресла́вную невѣ́стꙋ, и҆ всест҃ꙋю бцⷢ҇ꙋ, зижди́теля ро́ждшꙋю: неви́димыхъ же и҆ всѣ́хъ ви́димыхъ, пѣ́сньми велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* Thee, the all-glorious Bride and all-holy Mother of God, who didst give birth to the Creator of invisible and all visible things, in hymns we magnify.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
Thee, the all-glorious Bride and all-holy Mother of God, who didst give birth to the Creator of invisible and all visible things, in hymns we magnify.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Мечта́нми сі́мѡна волхва̀ бг҃обо́рца взя́та къ воздꙋ́шнѣй высотѣ̀, низложи́въ неизглаго́ланною бж҃твенною си́лою, пе́тръ оу҆блажа́ется.
items.english_text: Thy surpassing grace is worthily glorified: for thy shadow drove away the infirmities of the sick, O Peter;[^923] therefore we magnify thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy surpassing grace is worthily glorified: for thy shadow drove away the infirmities of the sick, O Peter;[^923] therefore we magnify thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Согрѣше́нїй разрѣше́нїе, моли́твами твои́ми пода́ждь: просвѣще́нїе же се́рдца, и҆ весе́лїе дх҃а, пою́щымъ па́мять твою̀ а҆по́столе.
items.english_text: Having cast down by ineffable divine power Simon the Sorcerer,[^924] the God-fighter, who by phantasms was lifted up into the heights of the air, Peter is called blessed.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having cast down by ineffable divine power Simon the Sorcerer,[^924] the God-fighter, who by phantasms was lifted up into the heights of the air, Peter is called blessed.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Твоѧ̑ вся̑ и҆спо́лнена сла́вы, ѡ҆свѧще́нїя же и҆ чꙋде́съ словеса̀, мо́щы, пе́рсть, и҆ вѣ́рою пе́тре покланя́емымъ и҆ любо́вїю, бж҃твеннымъ вери́гамъ.
items.english_text: Grant remission of sins by thy prayers, and enlightenment of heart and gladness of spirit, unto those who sing thy memory, O Apostle.

provenance.verbatim_source: Grant remission of sins by thy prayers, and enlightenment of heart and gladness of spirit, unto those who sing thy memory, O Apostle.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Твое́ намъ пло́дъ чре́ва, содѣ́ла лико́вника пѣ́снь пѣ́ти тебѣ̀, я́же ра́дость ро́ждши, велегла́снѡ ра́дꙋйся провѣщава́юща.
items.english_text: All that is thine is filled with glory, sanctification, and wonders: thy words, relics, dust, and the divine chains, which are venerated with faith and love, O Peter.

provenance.verbatim_source: All that is thine is filled with glory, sanctification, and wonders: thy words, relics, dust, and the divine chains, which are venerated with faith and love, O Peter.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆ста́вы прешла̀ є҆сѝ є҆стества̀, содѣ́теля заче́нши и҆ гдⷭ҇а, и҆ две́рь сп҃се́нїя мі́рови была̀ є҆сѝ. тѣ́мъ тя̀ бцⷢ҇е непреста́ннѡ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Fruit of thy womb made us choristers to sing a hymn unto thee, who gavest birth to Joy, loudly proclaiming: Rejoice!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
The Fruit of thy womb made us choristers to sing a hymn unto thee, who gavest birth to Joy, loudly proclaiming: Rejoice!

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Твои́мъ покланя́емся вери́гамъ, я́же за хрⷭ҇та̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕлодѣ́й носи́лъ є҆сѝ: я́звы же па́ѵле ѡ҆блобыза́емъ, я́же на сла́внѣмъ твое́мъ, и҆ побѣдоно́снѣмъ но́сиши тѣлесѝ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon. Heirmos:* Thou hast surpassed the ordinances of nature, having conceived the Creator and Lord, and hast become the door of salvation to the world; therefore, O Mother of God, unceasingly we magnify thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another Canon. Heirmos:*
Thou hast surpassed the ordinances of nature, having conceived the Creator and Lord, and hast become the door of salvation to the world; therefore, O Mother of God, unceasingly we magnify thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Твои́мъ покланя́емся вери́гамъ, я́же за хрⷭ҇та̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕлодѣ́й носи́лъ є҆сѝ: я́звы же па́ѵле ѡ҆блобыза́емъ, я́же на сла́внѣмъ твое́мъ, и҆ побѣдоно́снѣмъ но́сиши тѣлесѝ.
items.english_text: We venerate thy chains, which thou didst bear for Christ as an evildoer; and we kiss the wounds, O Paul, which thou bearest upon thy glorious and victorious body.

provenance.verbatim_source: We venerate thy chains, which thou didst bear for Christ as an evildoer; and we kiss the wounds, O Paul, which thou bearest upon thy glorious and victorious body.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ны́нѣ разрѣши́лся є҆сѝ а҆́пл҃е, ко и҆́же тобо́ю непреста́ннѡ жела́емомꙋ: съ ни́мже ꙗ҆́кѡ слꙋжи́тель водворя́яся, непреста́нными мольба́ми, твоѧ̑ рабы̀ къ себѣ̀ привлецы̀.
items.english_text: Now thou hast departed, O Apostle, unto Him Who was unceasingly desired by thee; dwelling with Him as a minister, by unceasing entreaties draw thy servants unto thyself.

provenance.verbatim_source: Now thou hast departed, O Apostle, unto Him Who was unceasingly desired by thee; dwelling with Him as a minister, by unceasing entreaties draw thy servants unto thyself.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Ны́нѣ ника́коже въ гада́нїихъ, нижѐ въ зерца́лѣ хрⷭ҇то́съ тебѣ̀ зри́мъ є҆́сть. лице́мъ же па́че зри́тся къ лицꙋ̀, соверше́ннѣ тебѣ̀ ра́зꙋмъ ѿкрыва́я бж҃ества̀.
items.english_text: Now no longer in dark riddles nor in a mirror is Christ seen by Thee, but rather face to face is He beheld,[^925] revealing the knowledge of the Godhead perfectly unto Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: Now no longer in dark riddles nor in a mirror is Christ seen by Thee, but rather face to face is He beheld,[^925] revealing the knowledge of the Godhead perfectly unto Thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Ты̀ прест҃ая бг҃ома́ти, похвала̀ хрⷭ҇то́выхъ а҆по́столѡвъ была̀ є҆сѝ, мꙋ́ченикѡвъ же сла́ва, и҆ прⷪ҇ро́кѡвъ ѡ҆снова́нїе: тѣ́мже вѣ́рнїи тя̀ всѝ, достодо́лжнѡ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou, O all-holy Mother of God, wast the boast of Christ's Apostles, the glory of the martyrs, and the foundation of the prophets; therefore all we the faithful worthily magnify thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Thou, O all-holy Mother of God, wast the boast of Christ's Apostles, the glory of the martyrs, and the foundation of the prophets; therefore all we the faithful worthily magnify thee.

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ленъ. Подо́бенъ: Жены̀ оу҆слы́шите: А҆́плѡвъ всѝ ве́рхъ воспое́мъ, петра̀ и҆ па́ѵла бж҃твенныхъ, вселе́нныя свѣти́льники, проповѣ́дники вѣ́ры, бг҃осло́вныя трꙋ́бы, оу҆че́нїй сказа́тели, цр҃ко́вныя столпы̀ и҆ разори́тели ле́сти. Два́жды.
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion. Tone 2, Podoben: "Give ear, ye women" (Жены̀ оу҆слы́шите):* Let us all hymn the summit of the Apostles, Peter and Paul the divine, luminaries of the universe, preachers of the faith, God-proclaiming trumpets, expounders of doctrines, pillars of the Church, and destroyers of deceit. *(Twice)*

items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: На хвали́техъ, стїхи̑ры на д҃. Гла́съ, д҃. Подо́бенъ: Зва́нный свы́ше: И҆́же съ нб҃се бл҃гть прїе́мь, * є҆гда̀ вопроше́нїе оу҆ченикѡ́мъ сп҃съ, * дванадесяточи́сленнымъ речѐ а҆плѡмъ: * кого́ мя глаго́лютъ человѣ́цы бы́ти? * тогда̀ оу҆́бѡ лꙋ́чшїй а҆плѡвъ пе́тръ, * бг҃осло́вствꙋя ѿвѣща̀, я́снѡ возопи́въ: * ты̀ є҆сѝ хрⷭ҇то́съ жива́гѡ бг҃а сн҃ъ. * тѣ́мже досто́йнѡ оу҆блажа́ется, * ꙗ҆́кѡ свы́ше прїе́мь ѿкрове́нїе, * вяза́ти же и҆ рѣши́ти * пра́веднѡ прїе́мъ,
items.english_text: Great and all-glorious is the mystery of thy childbearing, O Maiden full of the grace of God, and Virgin Mother of God! The prophets proclaimed it, the Apostles taught it, the martyrs confessed it, the Angels sing it, and men venerate it.

provenance.verbatim_source: Great and all-glorious is the mystery of thy childbearing, O Maiden full of the grace of God, and Virgin Mother of God! The prophets proclaimed it, the Apostles taught it, the martyrs confessed it, the Angels sing it, and men venerate it.

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera on 4. Tone 4, Podoben: "Being called from on high" (Зва́нный свы́ше)
items.day_or_date: Month of the Same, the 25th Day. The Holy Venerable-Martyr Febronia:
items.slavonic_text: Свы́ше зва́нъ бы́въ, а҆ не ѿ человѣ́къ, * є҆гда̀ земна́я тма̀ помрачѝ ѻ҆́чи тѣле́сныѧ, * нече́стїя ѡ҆блича́я свѣтова́нїе. * тогда̀ нб҃ный свѣ́тъ ѡ҆блиста̀ * мы́сленнїи ѻ҆́чи, * бл҃гоче́стїя ѿкрыва́я красотꙋ̀. * тѣ́мже позна́лъ є҆сѝ и҆зводя́щаго свѣ́тъ * и҆з̾ тмы̀, хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_text: Having received grace from heaven, * when the Savior addressed the question to the disciples, * to the twelvefold number of Apostles: * "Whom do men say that I am?" * Then indeed the chief of the Apostles, Peter,[^926] * theologizing answered, clearly crying aloud: * "Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God." * Therefore is he worthily called blessed, * as having received revelation from on high, * and justly receiving [power] * to bind and to loose.

items.english_text: When Christ, the Word of God Who appeared from the Father, asked: * "Whom do ye suppose Me to be?" * "Thou art the Son of the living Father!" * as the God-proclaiming mouth of all, * thou straightway didst cry aloud; * therefore also: "Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-Jonah!" * didst thou receive as reward. * For God glorifies * those who faithfully glorify Him, * and richly calls them to reception, * and He hath set thee as an unashamed rock, * the establishment and foundation of the Church.

items.english_text: Being called from on high and not of men, * when earthly darkness obscured the bodily eyes, * exposing the worldliness of impiety, * then the heavenly light shone upon * the spiritual eyes, * revealing the beauty of piety. * Therefore thou didst come to know Him Who brings forth light * out of darkness, Christ our God.
